name: Ambla SK SV suusatajate seeriajooks+kepikõnd
description: Ambla SK SV Skiers’ Series Run + Nordic Walking is a multi-stage running and Nordic walking series held at Kangrumägi in Järva County. The competition consists of five stages: the first four are time trials, and the final stage is a mass-start run. The results of the best four stages count toward the series standings, and prizes are awarded by age group. The competition is intended for runners using ski poles, which can be borrowed if needed. Special prizes are awarded to those who complete the series.
course_highlights: Five stages: the first four are time trials, and the final stage is a mass-start run
Held at Kangrumägi in Järva County
Only runners using ski poles are included in the competition standings
additional: Only runners using ski poles are included in the competition standings. Ski poles can be borrowed if needed. Every runner or Nordic walker who completes all five stages receives a special prize. Age groups range from age 6 to 55+. Points are awarded as follows: 1st place 30 points, 2nd place 27 points, 3rd place 25 points, and so on. In the event of a tie, the placing in the final stage decides. The fifth stage is scheduled for 8 November 2026, starting at 12:00. The best four stage results count toward the series standings.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run is a nighttime trail race focused on the experience and the magic of the dark. Dog Trail is a special class where you can share the evening with your dog over 5 km or 10 km, on courses designed to make for a memorable evening in the forest. The event emphasises safety in the dark: the courses are marked with reflective markers and a headlamp is required. All proceeds go to youth sports at Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: Courses marked with reflective markers
Flexible start time: 18:00–19:30 (10 km until 19:00)
Two distances for runners with dogs: 5 km and 10 km
additional: Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 (10 km runners can start until 19:00). The courses are marked with reflective markers and a headlamp is mandatory. The event is for runners who want to run with their dog (5 km and 10 km). Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 (10 km until 19:00); courses marked with reflective markers; headlamp required.

name: 53. Saaremaa kolme päeva jooks
description: The Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running competition in Kuressaare, inviting all running enthusiasts to take part. The event offers several distance options and age groups, with opportunities for both young people and adults. Registration takes place on site, and the entry fee is affordable, making the event accessible to a wide range of participants. The competition is part of a larger running series, which also includes season standings and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Several distances and age groups
The competition takes place in Kuressaare and the surrounding area
Electronic timing and event organization are provided for participants
additional: Registration takes place on site; participants are advised to arrive at least 15 minutes before the start. Electronic timing uses chips attached to the back of reusable race bibs. Race bibs and drinking cups are reusable and should be returned after the run. At the end of the competition, all participants receive a diploma and a sweet treat. You can register individually, as a pair, or as a team. Information about accommodation, transport, and catering is available on the organizer’s website.

name: Trail Kuršių Nerija
distance_verbose: 50 km, Maratonas, 30 km, Pusmaratonas, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: Trail Kursiu Nerija (#TKN) yra nepamirštama bėgimo nuotykis su neįtikėtinais vaizdais ir daug smėlio! Šis bėgimas vyksta Kuršių Nerijoje ir siūlo įvairias distancijas – nuo 1 km iki 104 km, todėl kiekvienas gali rasti sau tinkamą iššūkį.

images.alt_text: Bėgikas bėga per Trail Kuršių Nerija lenktynes.
Bėgikai miško takeliu.
Bėgikai miško takeliu, Kuršių Nerijos kraštovaizdis.
Bėgikas bėga taku per mišką ir smėlį. Aplink medžiai ir pilki debesys.

name: Graužikai - Kelmė Race
description: Bėgimas "Graužikai - Kelmė" V. Rimkui atminti vyko 2023 m. spalio 28 d. Kelmėje, minint 50-ąsias šio tradicinio renginio metines. Šiemet dalyvavo daugiau nei 200 bėgikų iš visos Lietuvos ir svečių iš Ukrainos, o 8 km nuotolyje greičiausias buvo Vitalij Kuznetsov. Tarp moterų greičiausia buvo Aurika Balsytė, kilusi iš Kelmės rajono. Taip pat vyko 1.8 km nuotolis, kur geriausiai pasirodė Lukas Mikavičius, ir 200 m bėgimas mažiesiems.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo startas su S-Sportas logotipu, dalyviai bėga pro starto liniją.
Bėgikų grupė su medaliais po lenktynių.
Bėgikų grupė su medaliais ir trofėjais.
Bėgikų grupė su Ukrainos vėliava prieš arba po bėgimo.

name: Pagarbos bėgimas IN MEMORIAM
location: Vingio parko estrada, M. K. Čiurlionio gatvė, Vilnius
description: Spalio 19 d. 10 val., jau 10-ą kartą Vingio parke, Vilniuje, vyks pagarbos/paramos bėgimas „In Memoriam“, skirtas pagerbti tuos, kurie paaukojo savo gyvybes už mūsų laisvę. Renginys suburia bendruomenę, siekiančią prisiminti ir paminėti šiuos herojus, o bėgimo dalyviai 10 km distancijoje varžysis dėl atviro Lietuvos kariuomenės čempionato apdovanojimų. Taip pat bus galimybė bėgti, eiti, riedėti 1 km ir 4 km nesivaržant, kuriose nugalėtojai ir prizininkai nebus renkami.

images.alt_text: Karių grupė bėga parke.
Lietuvos kariuomenės kariai su vėliavomis renginyje "In Memoriam", skirtame kariams atminti.
„IN MEMORIAM“ bėgimo reklama su data ir organizacijų logotipais.
"IN MEMORIAM" bėgimo reklama su bėgančio žmogaus siluetu ir informacija apie renginį.

name: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas
description: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas yra unikalus bekelės bėgimo renginys, kuriame bėgikai kas valandą turi įveikti 6,7 km ratą tol, kol lieka paskutinis stovintis. Varžybos vyksta kalnuotose ir bekelės trasose, kurios reikalauja ištvermės ir valios. Renginys yra iššūkis tiek fizinei, tiek psichologinei ištvermei, o nugalėtojas visada yra tik vienas. Trailo Kalvė organizuoja šį renginį su ypatingu dėmesiu trasų kokybei ir dalyvių patirčiai, kviesdama bėgikus išbandyti save ir įveikti save pačius.
course_highlights: Bekelės trasos su kalnuotomis vietovėmis
Kas valandą 6,7 km ratas
Varžybos vyksta tol, kol lieka paskutinis bėgikas
additional: Varžybos vyksta šaltuoju metų laiku, dažniausiai sekmadieniais. Dalyviai gauna Trailo Kalvės bėgimo juostą pirmą kartą sezone užsiregistravę. Medaliai dalinami tik už ypatingus pasiekimus, ne kiekviename etape. Renginyje dalyvaus apie 15 sportininkų, trasos nuo 5 km iki 60 km, nemokamos treniruotės, medalių ir suvenyrų dovanojimas, siekiama įveikti 100 mylių per 24 valandas rekordus, renginys organizuojamas nuo 2022 metų.

name: XII Pagarbos/Paramos bėgimas „IN MEMORIAM“, skirtas šiais metais mirusiems kariams atminti
organizer: Lietuvos didžiosios kunigaikštienės Birutės karininkų šeimų moterų organizacija
price_range: bilieto kaina – Jūsų pasirinkta paramos suma
description: Pagarbos ir paramos bėgimas „In Memoriam“ Vilniuje yra iškilus renginys, skirtas pagerbti šiais metais mirusius Lietuvos kariuomenės karius ir paremti jų šeimas. Renginys vyksta Vingio parke ir apima 1 km bei 4 km distancijas be varžybų, taip pat 10 km atvirą Lietuvos kariuomenės bėgimo čempionatą. Bėgimas gimė kaip jautri iniciatyva atminti jauną karininką ir tapo svarbia kasmetine pilietine bei patriotine tradicija. Organizuoja LDK Birutės karininkų šeimų moterų sąjunga kartu su Krašto apsaugos ministerija ir Lietuvos kariuomene.
course_highlights: Vingio parko trasos Vilniuje
1 km ir 4 km distancijos be varžybų
10 km atviras Lietuvos kariuomenės bėgimo čempionatas
additional: Renginio globėjas yra Lietuvos kariuomenės vadas gen. Raimundas Vaikšnoras. Dalyviai gali rinktis bėgti, eiti ar riedėti 1 km ir 4 km distancijomis be varžybų, nugalėtojai ir prizininkai šiose distancijose nerenkami. Renginys taip pat apima 10 km bėgimą su varžybų elementais. Parama mirusių karių šeimoms renkama per Paysera, banko sąskaitą ir PayPal platformą. Renginys skirtas karių atminti, paaukotos lėšos skiriamos jų šeimoms; vyksta rudenį.

name: Trail Kursiu Nerija #TKN
description: Trail Kuršių Nerija #TKN yra nuostabus bėgimas gamtos takais Kuršių Nerijoje, Lietuvoje, siūlantis įvairius distancijų pasirinkimus nuo vaikų 1 km trasos iki ekstremalių 104 km. Renginys žavi dalyvius savo nepakartojamais vaizdais, smėlio takais ir galimybe bėgti ar eiti pagal savo tempą. Tai puiki proga patirti gamtos grožį ir aktyviai praleisti laiką su šeima ar draugais. Renginys yra draugiškas visiems bėgimo lygiams ir amžiaus grupėms.
course_highlights: Gamtos takai su daugybe smėlio
Įvairios distancijos nuo 1 km vaikams iki 104 km ekstremaliems bėgikams
Neįkainojami Kuršių Nerijos vaizdai
additional: 10 km trasoje yra 76 m sukilimas, maksimalus dalyvių skaičius 400. Vaikų 1 km trasoje dalyvių skaičius ribotas iki 200, bėgimas su animatore šildomoje palapinėje. 10 km trasoje dalyviai privalo turėti ID dokumentą ir pakrautą mobilų telefoną arba laikrodį su trasos GPX. Po finišo dalyviams siūlomi dušai, masažas, košė, arbata, taip pat nacionalinio parko bilietas ir lauko žaidimai vaikams. Renginio centre yra šilta palapinė ir daiktų saugojimo vieta. TKN AFTER PARTY vyksta iki 01:30, paskutinis keltas į Klaipėdą 02:20. Renginyje siūlomos įvairios distancijos, įskaitant vaikų ir ultramaratonus, su aid stations, GPX sekimu, medaliais ir po varžybų renginiais. Registracija baigiasi vidurio rugsėjo mėn.

name: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 8 km distancijai taikomas 5,- Eur startinis mokestis

description: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė yra tradicinis Kelmės rajono bėgimas, skirtas Vaidoto Rimkaus atminimui. Varžybos vyksta spalio mėnesį ir siekia populiarinti bėgimą bei lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje, skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir didinti rajono gyventojų aktyvumą. Renginys pritraukia įvairaus amžiaus bėgikus, o dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų, įskaitant 8 km pagrindinį bėgimą. Varžybų metu dalyviai apdovanojami taurėmis, medaliais ir atminimo prizais.
course_highlights: 8 km distancija startuoja iš Graužikų
1,8 km bėgimas merginoms ir vaikinams prie Kelmės krašto muziejaus
200 m mažųjų bėgimas prie muziejaus
additional: Varžybų pradžia 12:30 val. su skirtingomis distancijomis ir laikais. Atvykimas iki 11:30 val. į Kelmės krašto muziejų, išvykimas į startą 12:15 val. Mažųjų 200 m bėgimas vykdomas be registracijos. Dalyviai privalo pateikti gydytojo pažymą apie sveikatos būklę. Apdovanojami įvairių amžiaus grupių nugalėtojai ir prizininkai, visi įveikę distanciją gauna atminimo medalius. Varžybos vyks Kelmės krašto muziejuje, su galimybe registruotis iki spalio 16 d. Dalyvių amžiaus grupės ir prizai.

name: Saaremaa Kolme Päeva Jooks
description: Saaremaa Three-Day Run is a traditional running competition held in the village of Iide. The competition consists of three stages, where participants can enjoy Saaremaa’s beautiful nature and varied terrain. The event is open to different age groups and offers a friendly, supportive atmosphere for everyone who enjoys running. Participants are provided with electronic timing, reusable bibs and drinking cups, and a sweet snack and drink after the run.
course_highlights: A three-day running competition in Saaremaa’s picturesque countryside
Reusable bibs with timing chips
A sweet snack and refreshment stations at the finish
additional: Timing is recorded using chips attached to the back of the bib, which must be returned after the competition. The entry fee covers event organisation, electronic timing, a drink, candy and a diploma at the finish. Reusable drinking cups and bibs help reduce waste. All participants receive a diploma after the run, and prizes are awarded to the three fastest runners in each age group. The competition includes individual and team classifications. Information about accommodation, transport and catering is available on the organiser’s website.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail is a trail-running series held on the hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km and 11 km, providing a range of challenges for trail runners. It showcases the beauty of the Kashubian landscape and regional attractions, and participants can look forward to excellent aid stations along the course. The event is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme and organised by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Excellent aid stations along the course
additional: The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km and 11 km, as well as the Junior Trail run of up to 1 km. The races take place at KJ Barłomino. The event promotes regional trails and tourist attractions in Pomerania and is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme. The event is supported by Coconaut and features courses at various difficulty levels, an attractive base in Barłomino and beautiful views of Kashubia.

name: Pomerania Ultra-Trail®
description: Pomerania Ultra-Trail® is a series of trail races held on the hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, providing a range of challenges for trail runners. The races showcase the beauty of the Kashubian landscape and regional attractions, and participants can expect well-stocked aid stations along the course. The event is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme and organised by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Well-stocked aid stations along the course
additional: The event takes place at KJ Barłomino. Five distances are available: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, as well as a Junior race of up to 1 km. The organiser is the Pomerania Sports Association. The event promotes long-distance trail running and Nordic walking. It is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme. The event features multiple distances, routes through the beautiful Kashubian landscape, support from #AktywnaWieś, and a base at KJ Barłomino.

name: ACE BATTLE RUN:  ACE BATTLE Mile indywidualni zawody rankingowe na dystan...
Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event at Hellasgården in Nacka, welcoming runners of all ages and abilities. The races pass through the Hellas area, by lakes and over hills on lovely running trails and roads, with short courses for children and longer options for recreational runners. The youngest runners have a relatively flat course, and the event is designed as an enjoyable day with music, refreshments and prize-giving ceremonies. It is described as a local, friendly family race with plenty of parking and bicycle parking.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Hellas area, by lakes and over hills
Lovely running trails and sections on roads—mixed terrain
Three distances: 400 m (the MICA race), 1,400 m and 5 km
additional: Location: Hellasgården, Ältavägen 101, Nacka; the bus from Slussen is listed as a transport option. There is plenty of parking and bicycle parking by the start area. Prize-giving ceremonies take place throughout the event, and refreshments will be available. The MICA race (400 m) is part of Hellasloppet. Distances include 400 m, 1,400 m, 5 km and 7.5 km, as well as a 1.5 km walking loop. Bus from Slussen to Hellasgården; plenty of parking around the start area and space to park bicycles in the start area; refreshments will be available.

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Welcome to the 32nd edition of Växjö Marathon, presented by VLK. The race consists of eight laps around Lake Växjö on what the organizer calls “Sweden’s fastest course.” The course is very flat (approximately 3 m of elevation difference) and mostly paved, with about 300 metres of fine gravel. The lap was officially measured in August 2024. A relay and a children’s race are also offered, and the course is marked with a lead cyclist and flag marshals.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Lake Växjö
Very flat course, approximately 3 m of elevation difference
Mostly paved, with about 300 m of fine gravel; marked with a lead cyclist and flag marshals
additional: The course is not closed to other users, so runners share the pedestrian and cycle paths with walkers and cyclists; motor traffic is encountered at three points along the course. The lap was officially measured in August 2024. Teams can take part in the relay, and the event also includes a children’s race in 2026. The relay consists of four runners, each running two laps. The course remains open to pedestrians and cyclists, and runners share the space with them and with motor traffic at three points.

name: Åhus TrailRun
location: Strandridaregården, Friseboda, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Åhus TrailRun is a trail race through the coastal forests and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne, organised by Pan-Kristianstad. The event offers distances of 17 km, 11 km, 6 km and 2.5 km, as well as a children’s race of approximately 350 m with a medal and no timing. The courses are gently undulating and feature a mix of trails, sand dunes, terrain and running on sand along the coast—participants are guaranteed a running experience beyond the ordinary. The race suits both competitive runners and recreational runners, and also includes team competitions. The participant cap is 1,000.
course_highlights: Gently undulating terrain with a mix of trails, sand dunes, challenging hills and sections of running on sand by the sea
17 km: approximately 60% trail, 25% terrain and 15% beach; elevation gain approximately 310 m
Event venue at Strandridaregården, only approximately 100 metres from the sea
additional: Participant cap: 1,000. Start times: 12:30 for 2.5 km and 6 km; 12:40 for 11 km and 17 km; children’s race starts individually from 13:00 to 15:00. Bib distribution from 10:45 (collect your bib at least one hour before your start). Time limit: the finish closes 2 hours 50 minutes after the 17 km start (at 15:30); the final 6 km lap must be started at least 60 minutes before the finish closes. Venue: Strandridaregården in Friseboda; parking is limited and parking is permitted only as directed by officials (carpooling tips are available via the race’s Facebook group). Bag storage is available for a fee (20 kr, cash or Swish). Children’s race with a medal and no entry fee; online registration closes on the Wednesday before the race; late registration is available at the start and finish area; bibs must be collected by 10:45; parking near the venue is limited; refreshments are available at all stations; electronic timing, with times available online.

name: Uppsala Marathon (inkl. DM i marathon)
price_range: Maraton: 825 kr; Halvmaraton: 625 kr; Stafett (4 deltagare): 1800 kr
description: Uppsala Marathon is a city and nature marathon that runs through historic Uppsala, starting and finishing at Uppsala Castle. The race combines the lively atmosphere of central Uppsala with scenic views along Lake Ekoln, the Fyris River and the mounds of Gamla Uppsala. The event offers a marathon, half marathon and four-person relay, and also serves as the District Championships (DM) in the marathon. The race is spectator-friendly and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Starts and finishes at Uppsala Castle; passes Carolina Rediviva and the central pedestrian streets
The route runs along the shores of Lake Ekoln and the Fyris River and out towards the mounds of Gamla Uppsala
Flat, fast, single-loop course consisting of half asphalt and half hard-packed gravel
additional: Start and finish at Uppsala Castle. The start area opens at 07:00; bib pickup is available from 1–16 October at Löplabbet (Dragarbrunns Torg 4–6) and on race day, 17 October, from 07:30 (no later than 45 minutes before the start). Registration is accepted via RaceID, and Epassi can be used for payment. Maximum entries: Marathon 1,500, Half Marathon 2,500, Marathon Relay 150 teams. Everyone who registers by 15 September 2026 will have their name on their bib. Minimum age is 17 for the marathon/half marathon (born in 2009 or earlier). The prize ceremony takes place at the finish area at 13:00. Food and non-alcoholic drinks are available at the finish area; relay teams receive a finisher shirt and medal. The recommendation is to travel by public transport or bicycle (Slottsbacken or Blåsenhus bus stops, routes 2 and 7); parking is within walking distance. DM medals are awarded in the Marathon and Half Marathon; the medal ceremony is on the Tuesday after the race; minimum age is 17 for the marathon/half marathon; Epassi payment, transfers via RaceID, start times, transport and parking, bag drop, changing rooms/showers, insurance and prizes; registration is open until 12 October 2026, with the possibility of closing earlier if the entry limit is reached.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a friendly race in central Jönköping, suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners. Starting at Lillsjöplan, the races follow a completely flat, officially measured course, making it ideal for personal bests and seeding. Both 5 km (1 lap) and 10 km (2 laps) are offered. The organizers emphasize a great atmosphere, with pacers for 40, 45 and 50 minutes in the 10K. Team registration gives a 10% discount when three runners sign up together, and group registration is available for larger parties.
course_highlights: Completely flat course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan
5 km = 1 lap; 10 km = 2 laps
The course is officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Federation and qualifies for seeding
additional: Start at Lillsjöplan. The 5K is one lap and the 10K is two laps. Pacers carrying flags will be available for 40, 45 and 50 minutes in the 10K. You can register up to 5 runners at a time through the regular registration; group registration is available for more runners. Team registration (three people) gives a 10% discount and the chance to win prizes. Race bibs are not sent out. The course and course profile are shown on the map/course profile page. Date and start time: 17 October 2026, starting at 11:00 at Lillsjöplan; 5K is one lap and 10K is two laps; aid stations will offer UMARA sports drink and water; bag drop at the start/finish; parking garages nearby; start list and pacer information; limited bag-drop facilities and race-bib collection on site.

name: XC-race Linköping
description: Linköping XC-race is an annual cross-country race organised by Linköpings OK in Vidingsjön, Linköping. The race features a marked 5 km loop over varied terrain, including trails and marshland, and is open to both recreational runners and competitive classes. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km for men and women, and a 5 km recreational class; the 10 km races cover two laps. The event is known for its challenging, muddy terrain, and the start and finish are at Vidingsjö Motionscentrum.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with trails and marshland
Distance options for both recreational and competitive runners
Start and finish at Vidingsjö Motionscentrum
additional: Muddy, challenging terrain; registration via the website, with payment by card or Swish on site; parking at Vidingsjön and LOK-gården.

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run in October offers evening trail races focused on the experience of light meeting darkness. Choose 5 km, 10 km or 30 km, starting and finishing at Väsby gård in Sollentuna. For the 30 km, you navigate using a downloadable GPS route and map, and there are energy stations along the way. Sign up today—all proceeds go to youth sports at Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: A night trail race by headlamp, with the course marked by reflectors
The 30 km route is run using a GPS route and map and has two energy stations
The final section of the 30 km follows the same reflector-marked course as the 5/10 km
additional: For the 5 km and 10 km, you can start at any time within the stated windows (18:00–19:30 for the 5 km; 18:00–19:00 for the 10 km). For the 30 km, you receive a GPS route and map in advance; the race has two energy stations and a time limit of 4 hr 30 min. The final section follows the reflector-marked course. The start and finish are at Väsby gård in Sollentuna. The organizer asks participants to finish by 20:30 at the latest, and registration is open until one hour before each start. The 30 km starts at 16:00 on October 17, 2026. The 5 km has a flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30, and the 10 km between 18:00 and 19:00; the course follows the reflector-marked route to the finish.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholm’s Steepest is an intense hill race in Hammarbybacken, taking place on 17 October 2026. The race is just over 3–3.5 km long, with a steep climb and more than 200 metres of elevation gain. It welcomes both experienced runners and beginners looking to challenge themselves. The finish is at the top of the hill, with a great view over the city. The children’s races, Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta, are also offered, but registration may be closed at certain times.
course_highlights: Approx. 3–3.5 km with more than 200 metres of elevation gain
Up and down the steep slopes of Hammarbybacken; finish at the top with a view over the city
Intense hill-focused race (finish-line services and water stations along the course)
additional: Race confirmation is sent by email (usually about 2 weeks before the race, or sooner for late registration). Bib distribution is listed as taking place in the event area on Hammarby Fabriksväg (the information text specifies bib distribution) and opens from 09:30 according to participant information. The bib contains a chip and should be worn unfolded at a 45–90° angle; attach it with safety pins (bring about 4) and write your name, phone number and medical information on the back. The race includes timing, a medal and water stations; the children’s races have water at the finish and a medal. Registration for Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta may be closed at certain times. Free hill-training sessions in Hammarbybacken are held before race day.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026
location: Rönninge, Salem Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 50 kr.

description: Rönninge Backyard Run is a lap race in Toredal, where each lap is 6,706 metres. The format is built around hourly starts: the first lap starts at 09:00, followed by a new start at the top of every hour, for up to 12 laps in total. Participants must complete a lap in under an hour to start the next one. The competitor who completes the most laps—and is fastest on the final lap—wins the women’s or men’s class. The race suits both competitive runners and those looking to test their endurance on a technical but runnable loop in scenic Garnudden. A shorter MiniBackyard is offered for children and beginners, with on-site registration and a separate afternoon start time.
course_highlights: A 6,706 m lap starting and finishing at Bubblan in Toredal
Approximately 80% asphalt and 20% gravel, partly along the waterfront path around Garnudden
Several longer climbs, a final downhill section, and a flat asphalt stretch toward the finish
additional: Registration for Rönninge Backyard Run opens on 1 March 2026. Rönninge 6h (6 June 2026) starts at 10:00 and runs until 16:00; registration is via RaceID (link on the page). MiniBackyard starts at 14:00, with on-site registration. Registration for the main race is personal and binding; cancellations must be made via info@lopklubb.se by 1 October, with an administrative fee of SEK 45. The race has hourly starts: lap 1 at 09:00, lap 2 at 10:00, and so on; the final start is at 20:00. Laps are recorded with a chip (in the 6-hour race). Refreshments are served at 20:00 for the final lap. Race details: 6,706 m per lap; up to 12 laps over twelve hours; first start at 09:00, final start at 20:00; approximately 80% asphalt and gravel; women’s and men’s classes. Mini Backyard is organised by KIF Toredal, and the on-site fee is SEK 50.

name: Solvalla Trail
description: Solvalla Trail is a trail running event where the SAUL Finnish Championships are being held for the first time. All age groups compete on the 10-kilometre course, with a choice of 10 or 20 kilometres; participants in the longer race complete the loop twice. The route winds through varied terrain, mostly along narrow trails, and features impressive rocky cliffs, stunning coastal scenery and beautiful forests. The highlight of the course is an almost 75-metre climb to the top of Swinghill.

name: Krusensterni jooks
location: Purila bus stop, Purila, Rapla County, Estonia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Õpilastele, pensionäridele ja Purila ning Hagudi elanikele - 4€

description: The Krusenstern Run is a traditional running race starting at the Purila bus stop and finishing at Hagudi Manor. The race is 4.2 km long and is suitable for students, pensioners and adults. The top men and women are awarded prizes, and special prizes are given to athletes in the veteran category, the youngest and oldest finishers, and the largest family. Participation is at your own risk, and all finishers are offered water, a treat and hot tea.
course_highlights: A 4.2 km route from the Purila bus stop to Hagudi Manor
The route is suitable for runners and Nordic walkers
Water, a treat and hot tea await participants at the finish
additional: Registration takes place at the Purila bus stop from 12:00 to 12:30 and online. The entry fee must be paid to the MTÜ Rapla Jooksuklubi Swedbank account. The awards ceremony takes place at 14:00. Prizes are awarded to the three top men and women and the top veterans. On-site registration is available at the Purila bus stop from 12:00 to 12:30 or online. The entry fee is €4 for students, pensioners, and residents of Purila and Hagudi, and €8 for adults. All finishers receive water, a treat and hot tea; the awards ceremony begins at 14:00.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
location: Stadion Miejski w Pucku, Puck, Puck County, Poland
description: The 17th Puck Land Half Marathon is a well-known running event in Pomerania, returning in 2026 in a refreshed format under the STONE TRI & RUN banner. The event takes place on an updated course in an autumn setting, making it an ideal way to round off the running season. It features a half marathon, a 5 km run, and a 5 km Nordic walking event, all with individual starts. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively in the beautiful Kashubian region and experience the sporting atmosphere of the Puck Running Triad.
course_highlights: Updated half-marathon course through the scenic Kashubian region
Autumn conditions that are ideal for runners
Final event in the Puck Running Triad
additional: The event features three competitions: a half marathon, a 5 km run, and a 5 km Nordic walking event, all with individual starts. The organizers ensure the courses are professionally prepared, clearly marked, and secured. The event is part of the STONE TRI & RUN series, which promotes an active lifestyle and a family-friendly sporting atmosphere in Kashubia. Asphalt course; start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Puck; final event in the Puck Running Triad; registration from 12 December 2025 to 12 October 2026.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is a fast, easy-to-run half marathon through beautiful natural surroundings, starting and finishing at Näsby Slott. The course offers coastal views along the shores of Värtan, a scenic loop around Lake Rönninge, and a final stretch back by the sea with views towards Bogesundslandet. The race is officially measured and organised by Täby IS Friidrott, and is ideal for runners looking to end the season on a fast and scenic course. In previous years, the race has been very popular, with limited places, so the organisers encourage early registration.
course_highlights: The first ~5 km follow the shores of Värtan, with sea views
A scenic loop around Lake Rönninge, passing Ängsholmsbadet and Skavlöten outdoor recreation centre
Approximately 125 metres of elevation gain; roughly 2/3 asphalt and 1/3 gravel
additional: Start and finish at Näsby Slott. Lilla TäbyMaran for children aged 5–11 (1.2 km), with start times at 10:00 (born 2017–2020) and 10:15 (born 2014–2016). Sports drink from partner Umara is served at the aid stations. The half marathon has a cut-off time of 2 hours 45 minutes. Race bib collection: at Stadium in Täby Centrum from the Wednesday before the race, and at the start area from 09:00–10:45 on race day. The course has approximately 125 metres of elevation gain and is roughly 2/3 asphalt and 1/3 gravel road; aid stations along the course serve Umara. Previous capacity: approximately 1,500 places.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen — perhaps the fastest officially measured 10 km race of the autumn, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course is 100% on cycle and pedestrian paths and fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for runners chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates an amount to Barncancerfonden for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.
course_highlights: Officially measured course (approved by a course measurer from the Swedish Athletics Federation)
100% paved cycle and pedestrian paths — a very fast course
Water station at 5 km and at the finish
additional: Changing rooms are available on site, but the organizer recommends that participants arrive changed. On-the-day registration is possible if the race is not full. The organizer does not award medals and instead donates an amount to Barncancerfonden for each registered runner. Prizes for the top three in the women’s and men’s categories, plus a draw for approximately 20 prizes. Names and photos from race day may be published on the club’s website and social media. Contact details: Henrik Kvarnlöt 073-0400790 and Peter Ness 070-3791299. Registration deadline: 15 October; on-the-day registration is possible if places are available; water at 5 km and at the finish; no medals will be awarded this year; approximately 20 prizes will be drawn among all participants; contact details are provided in the text on the event page.

name: Tjurruset (Haningen)
location: Rudans friluftsområde, Haninge, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Tjurruset is a challenging and fun cross-country race through overgrown woodland with natural obstacles in the Rudan Outdoor Recreation Area in Haninge. The race offers 5- and 10-kilometre distances, with muddy sections, trail paths and challenging terrain. Tjurruset is known for its fighting spirit and is open to both experienced runners and beginners who don’t mind getting dirty and muddy. Showers and rinse-off facilities are available after the race. The event is organised by Marathongruppen, with any surplus going back to sport.
course_highlights: Overgrown woodland and natural obstacles
Muddy sections and challenging terrain
Trail paths in the Rudan Outdoor Recreation Area, Haninge
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register before 2 September; otherwise, they can be collected at the venue from 08:30. Race bibs are personal and must be worn with the timing chip. After the race, warm showers are available in tents, along with basic rinse-off facilities. There are collection points for clothes that cannot be taken home. Travel by commuter train to Handen station is recommended. Transfer of a starting place to another person is possible for a fee until 24 September. The event also includes children’s races and often takes place alongside other cross-country races. Information about registration, parking and start times is available.

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organised by Enhörna IF in Södertälje. The race starts and finishes at Enhörna Friluftsgård and offers several categories for children, young people and adults. It is a well-established competition with a long tradition, where participants can enjoy a varied and scenic course. The event is open to everyone and follows the competition rules of the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: A combination of road and cross-country running
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård (sports ground)
Several distances and categories for children, young people and adults
additional: Late registration on site is possible until 60 minutes before each start, for an additional fee of SEK 100 for adult categories and SEK 50 for youth categories. Start times for youth categories are 11:00, 11:10 and 11:35, and for adult categories 12:30. By registering, participants consent to the publication of their names and any photos on the website and social media. Road and cross-country running, different distances for children, young people and adults, registration by 4 April, late registration on site until 60 minutes before the start

name: Kaarinan Syysmaraton
description: Kaarina Autumn Marathon is a running event offering several distances for different age groups, including marathon, half marathon, and 10 km races, open to both men and women. The races take place on an approximately 10.5-kilometre loop through beautiful, flat terrain in Kaarina and Piikkiö. A children’s run is also held, with the youngest children running an approximately 150-metre loop and older children an approximately 500-metre loop. All participants receive a medal, and the children’s run is free with no advance registration required.

name: Pukinmaki Run Helsinki 18.10.2026
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki, offering distances of 1 km for children, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The route is flat and fast, mainly on asphalt and outdoor trails, and loops around the boundaries of Pukinmäki. The event is open to runners of all ages and abilities, offering the chance to enjoy exercise and beautiful nature together with others. The event centre is located at Pukinmäki Sports Park, where refreshments and snacks are available.
course_highlights: Flat road and outdoor trail route, approximately 85% asphalt
Only 4.9 metres of elevation gain, making for a fast course
The route loops around the boundaries of the Pukinmäki district
additional: Advance registration closes on 13.10.2026 at 21:00. Late registration is available on Saturday 17.10 from 14:00 to 16:00 and on Sunday 18.10 at the race office. Bib collection begins on Sunday 18.10 at 11:00. The children's 400 m and 1 km races start at 14:20. The race lasts 3 hours; the course closes at 17:00. The event centre is located at Pukinmäki Sports Park, Kenttätie 3, Helsinki. The route is mainly asphalt, and the event offers refreshments and snacks. Participants can travel to the event by car, train, bus or plane. Registration opens well ahead of the event.

name: Pukinmaki Run 1/2 Maraton 10k 5k
description: Pukinmäki Run is an annual running event held in the Pukinmäki district of Helsinki. The officially measured distances are 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as a 1 km children’s race. The route follows the borders of Pukinmäki and is a flat road course, with approximately 85% asphalt, 10% compacted crushed stone and 5% running track. The course is fast to run, with an elevation difference of just 4.9 metres.

name: Emili jookseb
description: Emili Runs is a cheerful school community running event held in Kadriorg Park in autumn, attended by students, teachers and parents alike. The focus is on the joy of movement and supporting one another, not speed. This traditional event fosters a sense of togetherness and gives the community enjoyable moments of outdoor exercise. The first run took place amid golden leaves and was an inspiring start to the school holidays.
course_highlights: Colourful autumn scenery in Kadriorg Park
Fresh air and golden leaves
A cheerful, supportive atmosphere
additional: The whole school community took part, including parents, highlighting the community’s sense of togetherness. The aim of the run is to enjoy being active and encourage one another, not to compete for speed. The tradition continues with the spring event “Emili Rolls!” The event brings together students, teachers and parents and celebrates the joy of movement and encouraging one another.

name: 3. Holstre-Polli ööjooks
location: Holstre-Polli Sports Centre, Holstre, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: The 3rd Holstre-Polli Night Run takes place on the health and ski trails of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre in Viljandi County. This night run gives participants the chance to experience the wilderness and tranquillity surrounding the sports centre. The event is part of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre’s sports events series and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants. Participants can enjoy a unique night-running experience amid beautiful nature.
course_highlights: Run on the health and ski trails of Holstre-Polli Sports Centre
A night-running experience in the wilderness
15 km from Viljandi, in a peaceful and calming setting
additional: A headlamp is compulsory for all participants. Participant numbers are limited: 70 places in the children’s run and 140 places in total for the main run and Nordic walking. On-site registration is available if places remain.

name: Krosas Juodšilių ruduo
description: 2025 m. spalio 25 d. asociacija „Sporto renginiai“ kartu su Vilniaus rajono savivaldybės Juodšilių seniūnija organizuoja sporto šventę „Juodšilių ruduo“. Varžybų trasa apima Mokyklos g. miško taką ir Šilo g. miško takus, o vieno rato ilgis yra 4,5 km. Bėgikų numerių išdavimas ir naujų dalyvių registracija vyks nuo 10.00 iki 11.30 val., o varžybų startai prasidės 12.00 su 600 m bėgimu, 12.15 – 4,5 km, 9 km ir 18 km distancijomis.

name: Krosas „Juodšilių ruduo“
description: Juodšilių krosas yra Vilniaus rajono sporto šventė, vykstanti spalio 24 dieną Juodšiliuose. Renginį organizuoja asociacija „Sporto renginiai“ kartu su Vilniaus rajono savivaldybės Juodšilių seniūnija. Šis krosas skatina sportuoti vietos bendruomenę ir populiarina lengvąją atletiką bei bėgimą Lietuvoje. Varžybose gali dalyvauti visi norintys, o renginys orientuotas į sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir įvairių amžiaus grupių sportininkų išaiškinimą.
course_highlights: Trasa vyksta Juodšilių miestelyje, Mokyklos g. 9
Rungtys: 600 m, 4 km ir 12 km kroso distancijos
Dalyviai privalo turėti numerius ant marškinėlių priekio
additional: Numerių išdavimas ir registracija vyksta nuo 10:00 iki 11:30 val. Varžybose draudžiama perduoti numerį kitam dalyviui, naudotis asmenine palyda, vedžioti gyvūnus trasoje. Dalyviai privalo laikytis trasos ir teisėjų nurodymų, o pretenzijos priimamos raštu per 30 min. po varžybų su 30 EUR mokesčiu. Keičiant rungtį į trumpesnę taikomas 6 EUR mokestis, keičiant į ilgesnę - papildomas startinis mokestis. Renginio vieta: Juodšiliai, Vilniaus rajonas; rungtys: 600 m, 4 km, 12 km; registracija nuo 10:00 iki 11:30; dalyvių skaičius atviras, su specialiomis sąlygomis ir mokesčiais.

name: Sporto šventė Juodšilių ruduo
location: Juodšilių, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: Sporto šventė „Juodšilių ruduo“ yra Vilniaus rajono sporto renginys, vykstantis 2026 m. spalio 24 d. Juodšiliuose. Renginys skatina bendruomenės narius aktyviai sportuoti, populiarina lengvąją atletiką ir bėgimą bei propaguoja sveiką gyvenimo būdą. Varžybose gali dalyvauti visi norintys, o trasos ilgiai yra 600 m, 4 km ir 12 km. Dalyviai registruojami ir gauna numerius renginio vietoje nuo 10:00 iki 11:30 val., o varžybos vyksta laisva valia ir su atsakomybe už savo sveikatą.
course_highlights: Trasa Juodšilių seniūnijos teritorijoje, Vilniaus rajone
Rungtys: 600 m, 4 km ir 12 km krosas
Varžybų metu draudžiama vedžioti gyvūnus ir naudotis asmenine palyda
additional: Numerių išdavimas ir registracija vyksta nuo 10:00 iki 11:30 val. Dalyviai privalo turėti asmens dokumentą numerio atsiėmimui. Dalyviams draudžiama perduoti numerį kitam asmeniui, naudotis asmenine palyda, vedžioti gyvūnus trasoje ir nukrypti nuo trasos be teisėjo leidimo. Pretenzijos priimamos raštu per 30 min. po varžybų pabaigos su 30 EUR mokestiu. Rungties keitimo mokestis 6 EUR, keičiant į ilgesnę rungtį reikia primokėti skirtumą. Bėgimo rungtys: 600 m, 4 km, 12 km; registracija nuo 10:00 iki 11:30; dalyvių skatinimas ir atminimo medaliai; dalyvių apribojimai ir taisyklės.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
location: Yxbackens slalombacke, Norrköpings kommun, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a hill race held at Norrköping’s own ski slope. The race is described as challenging—in 2024, participants completed five tough laps of the hill—and is aimed at both competitive runners and families, with a separate children’s race. E2C is the title partner, and the event combines competition, children’s activities, and award and photo ceremonies afterwards.
course_highlights: Held at Norrköping’s ski slope (Yxbacken)
In 2024, consisted of five challenging laps of the hill
The children’s race “Lilla Yxbackenloppet” was introduced in 2024
additional: The 2024 race took place on October 19, and E2C was the title partner for the fourth year. Around 50 children took part in the 2024 children’s race and received medals at the finish; the winners received wreaths at the award ceremony. Magnus Media took photos, which were published on the race’s Facebook page. Around 300 participants in the first edition; in 2023, the event was photographed by Magnus Andersson (Magnusmedia.nu); the children’s race Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C was added in 2024.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C

description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a challenging race held at the classic Yxbacken outside Norrköping. The race consists of five laps, each featuring a tough climb of 100 metres of elevation over 350 metres, followed by a descent on the family slope. Participants can choose to run with or without timing. Poles are allowed, but runners using them are not included in the timed category. After the race, participants are treated to food and drinks as well as a free leg massage, and everyone receives a medal as proof of their achievement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope, Yxbacken
5 laps with a 100-metre climb over 350 metres on each lap
A descent on the family slope between each climb
additional: Race bibs can be collected at XXL on Friday 3 October between 14:00 and 18:00. Late registration is available via the website until 1 October and on site with payment by Swish. Water is available at the start and finish area. Manheims Säteri provides food and drinks after the race, Fenix Brewery provides non-alcoholic beer, and Finspångs Brunnsborrning provides sports drinks. Free leg massage is offered before and after the race. Professional chip timing uses a chip attached to the race bib. Toilets and a staffed bag drop are available at the event area. The event takes place in October and features challenging terrain with steep hills and multiple laps, making it a popular and challenging race for adventurous runners.

name: Stockholm: ALL OUT
description: All Out Dubstep is a long-running and influential club night in Stockholm that has shaped the city’s club music scene for almost two decades. With a unique mix of sub-bass, mutated garage, hip-hop, electro and techno, the resident DJs create an atmosphere that stretches from Kingston to London. The event also celebrates birthdays with a diverse line-up of DJs and artists playing everything from dancehall to afro and samba. It’s a party for everyone who loves club music and the vibrant energy of the dance floor.
course_highlights: Deep sub-bass and mutated garage at its core
A mix of hip-hop, electro and techno, with influences from Kingston and London
A broad range of music, from dancehall to afro and samba
additional: Free entry between 15:00 and 18:00, then admission from 200 kr. The event runs from 15:00 to 03:00 and is held at Capital Sound System in Kvarteret / Hus 7, Styckmästargatan 10, Stockholm. Music, club, dubstep, techno, hip-hop, afro, samba, dancehall, pre-party

name: Helsinki Halloween Run
description: Helsinki Halloween Run 2025 takes place on 25.10.2025 in Kalasatama, Helsinki! The event also includes a race for children, Kids Run Helsinki Halloween, with distances of approximately 450 m (for children under 7) and 900 m (for older children). Schedule: 16.00 Race office opens, 17.45 Kids Run 450 m, 18.00 Kids Run 900 m, and 18.30 start of the 5 km and 10 km races. Prizes will be awarded for the best costumes during the event, and a photo wall will be available for capturing the costumes.

name: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“
description: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“ yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Rumšiškėse, Lietuvos etnografinio muziejaus teritorijoje. Renginys siūlo įvairias distancijas nuo vaikų bėgimo 300 m iki pusmaratonio 21,098 km, kuris yra pagrindinis etapas ir įtrauktas į Lietuvos bėgimo taurės įskaitą. Dalyviai startuoja pagal amžiaus grupių handicap taisykles, o renginio programa apima registraciją, startus skirtingoms distancijoms ir apdovanojimus. Tai puiki proga aktyviai praleisti laiką gamtoje ir varžytis su bėgimo entuziastais iš visos Lietuvos.
course_highlights: Distancijos nuo 300 m vaikų bėgimo iki 21,098 km pusmaratonio
Startai pagal amžiaus grupių handicap taisykles
Vieta - Lietuvos etnografinis muziejus Rumšiškėse
additional: Renginio programa: 09:00 registracija ir numerių išdavimas, 10:45 varžybų atidarymas, startai nuo 11:00 iki 13:00 skirtingoms distancijoms, apdovanojimai nuo 14:00. Pagrindinė distancija - 21,098 km, sudaryta iš 4 ratų. Amžiaus grupių handicap sistema leidžia silpnesniems dalyviams startuoti anksčiau. Renginio vieta Rumšiškės, galimybė registruotis internetu, renginio programa apima startus, apdovanojimus ir specialias grupes.

name: Pärnu Rannajooks
description: Pärnu Beach Run is the season-ending race and final event in the Pärnu Two Bridges Club’s three-event series. It takes place at Pärnu Beach Stadium. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, which can be completed by running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles. The course runs through the beautiful Pärnu beach area, offering natural scenery and architectural landmarks characteristic of the city, including the seaside promenade. The event is suitable for recreational and experienced runners alike and offers an enjoyable sporting experience.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances, available for running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles
Course through Pärnu’s beach area, with beautiful natural scenery and architectural landmarks
Seaside promenade with views of the sea
additional: The distance options are 5 km and 10 km, which can be completed by running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles. The race is part of the Pärnu Two Bridges Club’s three-event series. Children’s races and virtual race distances are also planned. The event includes virtual races and children’s races and takes place at Pärnu Beach Stadium, offering a chance to enjoy sport and nature together.

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Nocna Ściema is a unique night marathon and half marathon held in Koszalin, known for its excellent atmosphere and distinctive nighttime ambience. The course consists of laps of approximately 7 kilometres, completed multiple times depending on the chosen distance. The race has official PZLA certification, which verifies the course distance and makes it possible to set world records. This is the sixteenth edition of the event, attracting runners who want to improve their personal bests in the one-of-a-kind conditions of a night race.
course_highlights: The course consists of laps of approximately 7 km, completed 3 or 6 times
Official PZLA certification confirms the course distance
Views of the stadium along the course and Koszalin’s undulating terrain
additional: The race office for children and young people opens at around 19:00, with a limited number of places (20). The race office for adults is located in the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall at ul. Racławicka, about 300 m from the stadium, and remains open until 30 minutes before the start. Participants must show a photo ID when collecting their race number. The course runs along the streets of Koszalin, with views of exhibits at the aviation museum. The medal and merchandise are updated each year and are an important part of the event. The event offers different distances, including a marathon and half marathon, with reports, photo and video galleries, and options to register online or at the race office. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes and the chance to compete in various themed categories.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: Sopot Half Marathon is an annual half-marathon held in the picturesque seaside city of Sopot. Participants can run a route through charming parts of the city, finishing at ERGO Arena, which offers a unique atmosphere and comfort. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering professional organization and attractive race packs. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of sport in the Pearl of the Baltic and earn a commemorative medal and T-shirt.
course_highlights: The route passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades
The finish is located at ERGO Arena
Picturesque views of the Baltic Sea and Sopot’s iconic pier
additional: The race pack includes an official T-shirt and medal. The half-marathon route is certified and passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades. The finish is inside ERGO Arena, providing comfortable conditions for runners after the race. Race packs available from 10 February 2026; participant limit: 3,500; discounts for holders of the Sopot Card; the event is part of the Korona Półmaratonów Pomorza 2026–2030 series.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
price_range: Półmaraton: od 50 PLN do 180 PLN, Maraton: od 60 PLN do 220 PLN
description: The 14th Vistula River Run along the Lower Vistula Valley Trail is an annual race held in Tczew County. Participants can choose between two distances: a certified 42.195 km marathon and an uncertified 21.097 km half marathon. The routes pass through the scenic Lower Vistula Valley and feature a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic. The marathon starts in Tczew at 9:00, and the half marathon starts in Małe Walichnowy at 11:00. Both finish in Tczew.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 42.195 km marathon through Tczew and nearby towns
21.097 km half marathon on an asphalt-and-gravel route
The route is marked every 1 km with painted markings and yellow signs
additional: The limit is 400 paid participants. The start line closes 15 minutes after the start. The marathon route is PZLA-certified; the half marathon is not. The finish is at the School Complex of Construction and Clothing in Tczew, ul. Bałdowska 19. The routes have varied surfaces. The participant limit is 400, registration is online, and the event includes a half marathon and a marathon.

name: Yddingeloppet
description: Yddingeloppet is one of Skåne’s largest cross-country races, organised by Heleneholms IF in the autumn-coloured Bokskogen forest in Torup. The race starts and finishes at Torups Friluftsgård and traditionally takes place on the last Sunday in October (2026-10-25). The course runs through forest terrain and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational runners who want to experience nature in autumn. All practical information and the race invitation are available on the event’s information pages.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Bokskogen (Torup)
Start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård
Autumn scenery and trails — traditionally held on the last Sunday in October
additional: Registration is via AnmälMigNu (see the registration page). The invitation, race categories, entry fees, course description, race information, start list and practical information are available in the tabs on the left-hand side of the event page. Race contact: tavling@heleneholmsif.se. Heleneholms IF office: kansli@heleneholmsif.se, tel. 040-19 42 20. Cross-country race in Bokskogen, Torup; two distances (12 km and 6 km); start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård; course map available; registration via AnmälMigNu; contact tavling@heleneholmsif.se.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is an annual running event celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026. It takes place on Sunday, 25 October 2026. The event website shows that the race has offered several distances (2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km, according to a previous registration form), and that the organiser publishes the invitation, race information, start list, map and results on the website. The website describes the course as scenic and the 14 km route as challenging. More information and course details are available via links on the event page.
course_highlights: Scenic course (linked from the event page)
Challenging 14 km course profile
Several distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km (according to a previous registration form)
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. The website includes links to the map and course profile, as well as race information, invitations, start lists and provisional results from previous years. A previous registration form (2020) offered a choice of distance and a choice of which day to run (23/10, 24/10 or 25/10). Content includes the invitation, race information, start lists, course map, results and course profile; 14 km course. The race traditionally takes place during the last weekend of October and celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026.

name: Lepokallion lenkki
description: Lepokallio Trail is a 5.8-kilometer hiking route in the varied forest landscapes of Hanhikoski, Ylistaro. It was renovated and is maintained by the Hanhikoski Rural and Home Economics Women's Association. There are two lean-to shelters along the route, Lepokallio Shelter and Pururata Shelter, both with a fire pit and firewood. The route is accessible year-round and offers an easy outing through varied terrain, including bright pine forests and atmospheric spruce forests.

name: Viikin Viitonen
description: Viikin Viitonen is an event open to everyone, held several times a year. This year, the event will be run on July 1, bringing runners together in the atmosphere of a summer evening. The event has set a new record with 106 participants, and the current maximum number of participants is 150. Advance registration and the entry fee cost 10 euros (incl. 10% VAT).

name: Tuusula Trailrun
description: Tuusula Trailrun 2024 trail race will be held on Sunday, 27 October 2024 at 11:00 at the biathlon stadium of Tuusula Sports Centre. The route runs along the trails of Tuusula’s Korpikylä and Sammaloja, offering varied terrain and wide, runnable trails. Trail running shoes or studded shoes are the most suitable, but the route can also be run safely in regular running shoes. There are water stations on the course at the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km marks, and the route is marked with ribbons, signs and chalk.

description: As autumn approaches, so does the traditional Hiidenhölkkä, which is being held for the 47th time this year. Hiidenhölkkä–Nummelan Tarmo. The 10 km and 20 km (2 x 10 km) Hiidenhölkkä routes circle Nummelanharju and Nummela Airport. Hiidenhölkkä starts at 12:00, and the running event ends at 14:00.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
location: Huskvarna, Jönköping Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, very hilly trail race held in Huskvarna, near Lake Vättern. The event offers several distances for adults and children, including 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, and children’s and youth classes. The courses run partly on trails and partly off-trail, with challenging hills such as Strutsabacken, where the Bergatroll title is awarded to the fastest runner up the hill. The event is family-friendly, with changing rooms, showers, refreshments, and safety staff along the course.
course_highlights: A tough, very hilly trail race, partly on trails and partly off-trail
Strutsabacken (the ski slope), a challenging hill with the Bergatroll competition
Aid stations with water, sports drinks, and bananas on the longer distances
additional: Race bibs with timing chips can be collected on race day by 11:15 at the latest and must be worn visibly on the front of your shirt. Chip timing records both finish time and the time taken to run up Strutsabacken. Aid stations on various distances provide water, sports drinks, and bananas. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at the IKHP lodge. Valuables can be handed in and collected at race-bib pickup. Safety staff and Red Cross medical personnel will be on site. Children’s and youth classes start at 10:45, adult classes at 11:30, and the 400 m Knattetrollen has a free start time between 10:00 and 12:00. Trail race with hilly terrain, on-site registration, medals for all participants, prizes for top finishers and the Bergatroll, and safety measures including medical support.

name: Vantaan Kestävyyskierros
description: At the Vantaa Endurance Series, you can challenge yourself in five different events. The series is suitable for fitness enthusiasts and endurance athletes of all levels, and offers a great opportunity to try completely new sports. The Vantaa Endurance Series consists of Vantaa Ski Race, Vantaa Off-trail Challenge orienteering, Vantaa Triathlon, Seutula Loop and Vantaa Marathon. The events are standalone competitions, but together they make up the Vantaa Endurance Series.

name: Pohjoisbaanan maili 2026
description: Pohjoisbaanan Mile 2026 is a traditional mile race held on Pohjoisbaanan in Käpylä, Helsinki, on October 31. The race gives runners the chance to test their pace over one mile (1.609 km). The start is on the pedestrian and cycle path near Käpylä railway station, and the event is open to all running enthusiasts. The event is organized by Helsingin Juoksijat ry, and participation is free for members. Welcome to enjoy a fast-paced, community-minded running event!
course_highlights: The distance is exactly one mile, or 1.609 km
The start is on the pedestrian and cycle path near Käpylä railway station
The event takes place on Pohjoisbaanan in Käpylä, Helsinki
additional: Participation is free for members of Helsingin Juoksijat ry. The start location is marked by a Helsingin Juoksijat flag. The event lasts about an hour, from 11:00 to 12:00. The event starts at 10:00, and no information is available about specific course features or registration procedures. Helsingin Juoksijat also offers a variety of running training and community events throughout the year.

name: Höstmilen
description: Höstmilen is a trail race in the Kolmården forests outside Åby, north of Norrköping, taking place on 1 November 2026. The course follows trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön and offers scenic, challenging terrain for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The event is organised by OK Kolmården and has three main race options: the classic 10.6 km, Höstfemman 5.2 km, and races for children and young people.
course_highlights: Trail race on paths between Sörsjön and Lillsjön
Höstmilen 10.6 km (Sörsjön → Lillsjön) and Höstfemman 5.2 km (start/finish at Lillsjön)
Running through the scenic, hilly terrain of the Kolmården forests
additional: Online registration closes on 29 October at 23:00; after that, it is possible to register on 31 October from 11:00 to 14:00 at XXL and at the start area on 1 November. For the classic Höstmilen, a bus runs from Jurslaskolan to the start at Sörsjön. The race information sheet will be published approximately one week before the event. The adult races have just two prize categories: Men and Women. A complete list of registered participants will be published on the “Registered” page. Distances and competition formats are 10.6 km, 5.2 km and children’s races (1.4 or 2.0 km); team, company and school competitions. The Höstmilen race information sheet and registration are available via hostmilen.nu.

name: Riston Hölkkä
description: Risto’s Run is held in Suomusjärvi, Salo, every year on the Sunday after All Saints’ Day. The event is named after Risto Nuuroks, a four-time World Championship medalist in orienteering who won silver in the individual event in 1978. Competitive and recreational categories are available for runners of all abilities, and the routes pass through rural landscapes, mostly on gravel roads. Risto’s Run will next be held on 2 November 2025, with the race headquarters at Sisumaja.

description: The Fiskars Marathon in Raseborg 2026 is an exciting running event that gives participants the opportunity to experience magnificent scenery and a sense of community. The event attracts runners of all levels and is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness and enjoy running. The marathon is designed to offer unforgettable moments for both competitors and spectators.

name: Itämeri Maraton
description: Baltic Sea Marathon will be run and walked on Saturday, October 4, 2025. The distance options are the marathon, half marathon, and quarter marathon (10.5 km). The official time limit is six (6) hours for the full marathon and 5.5 hours for the half marathon and quarter marathon. The course is officially measured, and the start and finish area are at Keskuskoulu, Halmstadinkatu 2. Advance registration closes on Tuesday, September 30, 2025, at 24:00.

name: Fiskarsin Maraton Rasepori
description: Fiskars Marathon Rasepori will be held on 20.06.2025 in Raseborg, starting from the Fiskari Athletes’ lodge at Kalliomäentie 4. The race starts at 10:00, and the race office opens at 8:30. Several distances are available: 15 km, 7 km, 2 km and 0.6 km for different age groups. The route winds through beautiful scenery along gravel roads, giving runners the chance to enjoy nature and peaceful trails.

Dalyviai galės rinktis iš įvairių distancijų: 400 m ėjimas, 2,8 km, 5 km, 10 km, pusmaratonis ir maratonas, su skirtingais amžiaus reikalavimais.

description: Varnutės bėgimas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys Jonavoje, siūlantis trasas įvairaus amžiaus dalyviams. Renginyje yra trys distancijos: 2,5 km, 10 km ir 300 m vaikams, todėl jis pritaikytas tiek pradedantiesiems, tiek patyrusiems bėgikams. Tai puiki proga aktyviai praleisti laiką ir pasimėgauti bėgimu bendruomenės apsuptyje.

Distancijos: 2,5 km, 10 km ir 300 m vaikams

name: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+
description: TrailHunt Vooremäe 1000+ is a trail race among the beautiful hiking trails and forests of Vooremäe in Tartu County. The race highlights challenges such as 1,000 metres of elevation gain in a single run, giving participants the chance to test their abilities and enjoy the positive energy of running on forest trails. The race centre is next to the new service building, with convenient shower facilities and a place to change clothes. There is a staffed aid station on the course, and timing uses a contactless SPORTIdent system. Distances range from a 14 km hike to a marathon of over 42 km, with marathon runners completing exactly three 14.1 km laps.
course_highlights: A 14.1 km lap following the direction of travel on Vooremäe’s large loop
More than 1,000 metres of total elevation gain on the marathon distance
A staffed aid station on the course, passed multiple times
additional: Race numbers can be found before the event in the start list on the Seiklushunt website. Timing uses the contactless SPORTIdent (SI AIR) system, with the chip attached to the wrist. Participants can shower and change clothes at the race centre after the event. There is one staffed aid station on the course, offering water, Coca-Cola and light snacks. On-site registration is not available. Transfers and other changes can be made only by email. Trail running, hilly terrain, registration via Stebby, aid stations, finisher medals, awards ceremony

name: 20 Gminne Biegi z okazji Święta Niepodległości
Jämjöhalvan och Jämjöhallenstafetten
location: Jämjö, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
price_range: Jämjöhalvan 21,1 km: 300 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 400 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 10 km: 250 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 350 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 5 km: 200 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 300 kr (3/10-2/11); Barnlopp 50 kr; Jämjöhallenstafetten: 600 kr per lag (4/6-2/11).
description: Jämjöhalvan is a mass-participation race organized by Team Blekinge LF, with distances ranging from a children’s race to a half marathon, as well as a relay (Jämjöhallenstafetten). The half marathon and other races take place on a fast, spectator-friendly loop course around Jämjö and can also be used as qualifying races for events such as Göteborgsvarvet. The event centre and finish are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum, and in 2026 the Swedish Veterans Championships in the half marathon will be held alongside the race. Runners of all abilities are welcome—the event emphasizes running community and clearly marked laps.
course_highlights: Loop course: 4 laps for the half marathon, 2 laps for 10 km, 1 lap for 5 km
Fast, spectator-friendly course around Jämjö
Distances are officially measured (measured 25 Sep 2021), and course marshals are stationed along the route
additional: The start, finish and event centre are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Start locations vary by distance. The half marathon and Jämjöhallenstafetten start at 10:30, the 10 km at 10:40, the 5 km at 10:45 and the children’s race (500 m) at 12:45. Runners must keep to the right and pass on the left; runners who are not running at a fast pace are asked to keep right. In the relay, teams hand over a baton in the exchange area near the lap point; late registration is not available for Jämjöhallenstafetten. Late registration for other distances is open on race day from 08:00 to 10:00 at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Payment is accepted in cash or via Swish. Start times: 21.1 km and Jämjöhallenstafetten 10:30, 10 km 10:40, 5 km 10:45, 5 km youth class (ages 12–16) 10:45, children’s race 12:45. Start locations vary by distance. There is no late registration for Jämjöhallenstafetten. The start and finish are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. The course is a loop with water stations every 5 km, in cooperation with Umara. Changing facilities and showers are available at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum from approximately 09:00. Free open training sessions are held on 17 September and 15 October before race day.

name: Höstrusket
description: Höstrusket is a trail and road race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, taking place on 7 November 2026. Choose from 10 km, half marathon (21.1 km) or marathon (42.195 km), with the start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, and features encouraging pacers, well-stocked aid stations and an atmospheric end to the running season in the Royal National City Park. The event is organised by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs, and the surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen in Norra Djurgården (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station)
Certified courses, mostly on asphalt with some gravel; 10 km: +103.9 m, marathon: total elevation gain +439 m
Well-stocked aid stations and lap support, as well as clearly marked kilometre signs
additional: Start/finish at Fisksjöäng (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station). Bib collection, pacer tent, food and coffee sales, bag drop for warm-up clothes and toilets at the event area. Changing and shower facilities are available at a nearby venue for a fee, a few hundred metres away. Chip timing by RaceTimer; pacers are available for several finish times (lists by distance). Cut-off times: 10 km 2:00, half marathon 2:30, marathon 5:30 (cut-off at the final lap point at 13:40). Minimum ages: 10 km from age 15 (age 13 when accompanied by a guardian); half marathon and marathon from age 17. Some aids and vehicles (poles, inline skates, strollers, bicycles, handcycles and racing wheelchairs) are not permitted; special conditions apply for guides and wheelchair users. The surplus goes back to sport. Registration is open.

name: Jätten Bule-löpet
location: Österbymo, Ydre kommun, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: Jätten Bule-löpet is a long-running cross-country race organised by IFK Österbymo on the first weekend of November. The race celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2019 and attracts runners of all ages to the forests of Ydre. Distances range from KnatteBule for the very youngest, to 2.4 km for children aged 4–12, as well as 5 km and 10 km events for running or walking on challenging terrain. The event is an autumn festival that welcomes both competitive runners and recreational participants.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on hilly, challenging forest terrain
Distances ranging from a children’s race to 10 km for adults
The race runs through the forests of Ydre around Bulevallen and the Bulespåret trail
additional: Distances include KnatteBule for the youngest participants, 2.4 km for children aged 4–12, and 5 km and 10 km events for running or walking. Bulevallen is the meeting point, and IFK Österbymo, together with Ydre Municipality, is responsible for the Bulespåret floodlit trail, a hilly 2.4 km route used during the event. The race includes various distances, from children’s events to adult races, and takes place in the scenic surroundings of Ydre. In 2026, weather conditions may affect the terrain, but the race is open to all runners and outdoor enthusiasts.

name: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra
description: Nuuksio Pikkujoulu Ultra takes place on Saturday, November 16, 2024, at Folkhälsan Solvalla Sports Institute, starting at 9:00 a.m. The competition category follows the backyard-style format, with simultaneous starts; the final start is at 4:00 p.m. and the finish closes at 5:00 p.m. In the recreational category, you can run at your own pace for as many laps as you like. There is also a shortened course of approximately 5 km, offering the atmosphere of a mass start. This event is a great opportunity to try ultrarunning amid the beautiful scenery of Nuuksio. Refreshments include mulled berry juice, warm juice, gingerbread cookies, and other light snacks.

name: Marceliński Bieg Jesienny 2026
description: Marceliński Autumn Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic courses that showcase the location’s aesthetic appeal. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Wielkopolska, offering participants a unique running experience in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Courses that showcase the location’s aesthetic appeal
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. Race packs can be collected using an authorization form template. Cross-country race, event in Marceliński Forest, November 8, 2026, puzzle-piece medals, forest routes

name: Haaga Run
description: Haaga Run will be held for the ninth time on 8 November 2025! The event is organized in collaboration by Runner's High and FC POHU. The distances are 5 km and 10 km, and the start is at Lassila Sports Park (Laurinniitynpolku 2, 00440 Helsinki).

name: Nummela Backyard Ultra
description: Welcome to follow the sold-out event at Nummelanharju! The event takes place on October 11, 2025, starting at 10:00 at Nummelanharju in Vihti. This is a Silver competition, whose winner earns a direct spot in the 2026 Satellite World Championships. The winner receives a €500 cash prize, and second place receives €300. All participants will receive a NUBU sauna bench towel and a wooden participation medal.

name: Hercules Trail Run 11.10
description: Hercules Trail Run, held for the ninth time, invites runners to Porvoo’s stunning trails! The day begins with the children’s Polkuralli, where those born in 2013–2025 can run a 2 km route through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Mustijoki River. One hour later, the 7 km, 14 km and 21 km races start in staggered waves. The route is designed for runners and outdoor enthusiasts of all levels, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy Porvoo’s finest trails on the second Saturday of October.

Polkujuoksijat metsässä juoksemassa.
