name: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“
description: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“ kviečia dalyvius gegužės 7 dieną aktyviai praleisti laiką nuostabaus grožio Anykščių kraštovaizdyje. Bėgimo trasos ilgis ir sudėtingumas pritaikyti įvairaus amžiaus ir fizinio pasirengimo dalyviams, nuo vaikų pramoginio bėgimo iki 11 km ištvermingiesiems. Renginys yra seniausias Lietuvoje ir garsėja savo tradicija bei draugiška atmosfera, kuri pritraukia sporto entuziastus iš visos šalies. Dalyviai bus apdovanoti atminimo medaliais, o greičiausieji 11 km distancijoje - piniginiais prizais.
course_highlights: Vaizdinga trasa Anykščių kraštovaizdyje, besidriekiančioje Antano Baranausko apdainuotame Anykščių šilelyje
Skirtingos distancijos: nuo 300 m vaikams iki 11 km ištvermingiesiems
Startas šalia Angelų muziejaus, Anykščiuose
additional: Startai pagal amžiaus grupes: 10:30 val. - vaikų pramoginis bėgimas „Puntukėlis“; 11:30 val. - 3 km distancija; 11:50 val. - varžybų atidarymas; 12:00 val. - 6 km ir 11 km distancijos. Registracija vykdoma tik iki balandžio 28 d. 12:00 val., bėgimo dieną registracija nevyks. Dalyviai, pasiekę finišą, gaus atminimo medalius. Greičiausieji 11 km distancijoje apdovanojami piniginiais prizais. Dalyviams siūloma išankstinė registracija, galimybė atgauti jėgas po varžybų baseine ir pirčių komplekse, prizai ir nuolaidos, įvairios amžiaus grupės

name: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas
description: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Girulių miško takais Klaipėdoje. Renginyje gali dalyvauti tiek mėgėjai, tiek profesionalai, skatinantys sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir fizinį aktyvumą. Trasos ilgis svyruoja nuo 2 km moksleiviams iki 42,2 km ekomaratono dalyviams, kurie bėga 10 ratų po 4,2 km. Renginys organizuojamas Klaipėdos miesto bėgikų klubo „Maratonas“ ir remiamas Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės.
course_highlights: Ekomaratono trasa - 10 ratų po 4,2 km Girulių miško takais
Moksleivių trasa - 2 km (1 km pirmyn, 1 km atgal)
Startas Girulių miške, dviračių takelio pradžioje už Vasaros Estrados
additional: Varžybų dieną laiko matavimo sistema veikia iki 15:00 val. Dalyvio starto mokestis mokamas vietoje atsiimant numerį. Pirmieji 300 dalyvių gauna atminimo medalius, visi dalyviai - pažymėjimus. Dalyviai privalo turėti asmens dokumentą numerio atsiėmimui. Dalyviai sutinka, kad renginio organizatoriai gali naudoti renginio metu darytas nuotraukas ir filmuotą medžiagą rinkodaros tikslais. 4,2 km ir 42,2 km distancijos, moksleivių 2 km, startas Girulių miške, registracija internetu iki balandžio 30 d.

name: VIII Rydzewski przełaj - bieg dla trzeźw...
X Półmaraton Doliną Rospudy
location: Filipów, Suwałki County, Podlaskie Voivodeship, Poland

name: Växjöloppet
description: Welcome to Växjöloppet on 1 May 2026—a running festival for the whole family, with distances ranging from children’s races to a half marathon. The event offers 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and Lilla Växjöloppet for younger participants. The start and finish are in Strandbjörket, with the start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen. The course combines forest trails through scenic Bokhultet with paved sections around Växjösjön. The half marathon is run over two laps on largely the same course, offering variety and spectator-friendly finishes.
course_highlights: Start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen
Scenic course passing through Bokhultet (mostly deciduous forest), becoming a forest trail after the first kilometre
The final approximately 3.5 km are paved and run around Växjösjön, with the finish straight at Lagunvallen
additional: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and several children’s race distances in Lilla Växjöloppet (children’s races are not individually timed). The 21.1 km race is run over two laps (the first lap is just over 11 km, the second is 10 km). Water stations: the 10 km course has four stations (after 1 km, 3 km, 5.5 km and 6.5 km); on the 21.1 km course, runners can take water eight times (including at 1, 3, 5.5, 6.5, 10, 13, 15.5 and 16.5 km). Lilla Växjöloppet: participants in some children’s races receive a race number, medal and fruit; Tidningslöpet provides a T-shirt and diploma. You can use your wellness allowance to pay the entry fee (register via mittlopp.se and submit the receipt to your employer for reimbursement through the wellness allowance). A team competition is available; start lists and participant information are on the official website. Distances are 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and Lilla Växjöloppet; water stations are located along the course (4 on the 10 km course; up to 8 water stops on the 21.1 km course); the Bokhultet station closes at 13:40 and the tunnel/Växjösjön station closes at 14:00; the finish closes at 14:30.

name: Risenloppet
location: Genarp, Lund Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden

name: Valio Helsinki City Run
description: Valio Helsinki City Run is Finland’s largest running event, bringing more than 24,000 runners from over 110 countries to Helsinki Olympic Stadium and the city streets. The event offers six different running distances, including a marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 5 km run and walk, and the children’s Minimarathon. The routes are scenic and coastal, and the finish is at Olympic Stadium. The event also offers a wide range of services, such as world-class timekeeping, refreshment stations, and free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run.
course_highlights: Scenic coastal routes in Helsinki
Finish and event centre at Olympic Stadium
Officially measured, AIMS-certified routes
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Olympic Stadium before the race. Payment with sports benefits is available (ePassi, Edenred, Zevoy Benefits). Group registration requires at least 5 runners. Groups of at least 10 people receive free event shirts. Free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run. Refreshment stations and gels along the route. Cancellation insurance is available for purchase. Free group training sessions and training plans. World-class timekeeping (excluding the walk). The event includes several distances, such as the marathon, half marathon, 5 km run, and walking events. Participants can follow live results and get their certificates as soon as they finish. The event takes place at Olympic Stadium and also includes an event week with activities and sponsorship opportunities.

name: Vilniaus pavasario maratonas
description: Vilniaus Pavasario Maratonas kviečia bėgikus visų lygių išbandyti savo jėgas pavasario ritmu Vilniaus Vingio parke. Renginys siūlo įvairias distancijas nuo 600 m vaikams iki klasikinio maratono 42,195 km, taip pat pusmaratonį ir trumpesnius bėgimus. Tai puiki proga pradėti bėgimo sezoną gamtos apsuptyje, judant per miestą ir parkus, mėgaujantis pavasario atgimimu. Renginys organizuojamas su dideliu dėmesiu visų dalyvių patirčiai ir skatina aktyvų gyvenimo būdą.
course_highlights: Startas ir finišas Vingio parko estradoje
Bėgimas per Vilniaus miesto parkus ir gatves
Distancijos nuo 600 m vaikams iki 42,195 km maratonui
additional: Renginys vyksta 2026-05-02, startas 10:00 val. Vingio parko estradoje. Distancijos: 42,195 km, 21,098 km, 10,6 km, 5,3 km ir 600 m vaikams. Nuostatai skelbiami https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis/nuostatai/. Registracija vykdoma per https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis. Renginyje siūlomos įvairios distancijos, įskaitant vaikų ir jaunimo bėgimus, taip pat galimybė dalyvauti su draudimu. Registracija vyksta per myrace.lt.

name: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton
description: The 45th Tartu Forest Marathon is a traditional event held at the Tartumaa Sports Centre, offering participants the chance to enjoy trail running in beautiful natural surroundings. The event is part of Estonia’s programme to promote recreational physical activity and is suitable for runners of different abilities who want to improve their fitness and mental well-being. The marathon highlights the importance of physical activity for maintaining health and well-being and invites everyone who leads an active lifestyle to take part. It is organised by the Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity, which supports the development of a healthier and more active society in Estonia.
course_highlights: Trail running through the beautiful forest landscapes of the Tartumaa Sports Centre
A varied and changing course suitable for runners of different abilities
An opportunity to enjoy nature and improve mental and physical health
additional: The event takes place at the Tartumaa Sports Centre. Participants can register and collect their race numbers at Turu 10 in Tartu and in the car park at Aura Centre.

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra is a welcoming Backyard Ultra race in Trekantsparken, Liljeholmen, Stockholm, organized by Run Raisers with fundraising for #Run4Diabetes. The race takes place on a 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken, on mixed terrain, with a new start every hour on the hour; participants must complete the loop within 1 hour to start the next one. The event offers an aid station, a medal, a goodie bag, and organizer support throughout the race. The start is at 14:00 on May 1, 2026.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken (start/finish in Trekantsparken, near Liljeholmen metro station)
Mixed terrain: trails with wooden bridges, gravel roads, and paved pedestrian/cycle paths
A steep uphill section at Örnberget and illuminated trails along Vinterviken
additional: Registration opens on August 1. Name changes can be made until 2026-04-17 for a fee of 150 SEK (by emailing info@runraisers.com with the new participant’s details). Race bibs are distributed on Thursday, April 30. Race format: a mass start every hour on the hour; anyone who does not complete the loop within 1 hour is out. The entry fee includes an aid station, race photos, a medal, and a goodie bag; 20% of the fee goes to #Run4Diabetes. The race is a charity event benefiting Run4Diabetes; 20% of the entry fee is donated to Run4Diabetes; the entry includes an aid station, a medal, race photos, a goodie bag, and prizes for the winners.

name: Sevede Trail Run
description: Sevede Trail Run is a welcoming trail race in Mariannelund, organised by Hässleby SOK. The race offers a challenging course that runs mostly along narrow trails through the beautiful Småland landscape—through dark, fairytale-like forests, along lakes and over long slopes with fast descents. There are men’s and women’s categories over 10 km and 26 km, as well as a children’s race of approximately 1 km. Everyone is welcome to register up to race day; the children’s race is free and participants receive a medal at the finish.
course_highlights: Mostly narrow trails through the Småland landscape
Through dark, fairytale-like forests and along lakes
Long slopes and fast descents
additional: Registration opens at 08:00 at Slättvallen in Mariannelund. To register, email sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com. Payment is accepted via Swish (123-358 26 99). Late registration is available on race day. The children’s race is approximately 1 km; all children run for free and receive a medal and a banana at the finish. A parent may accompany the child around the course. Distance options: 26 km and 10 km; start window: Saturday 10:00–16:00; contact: sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com; 2025 record number of participants: approximately 45; 2024 women’s course record for 26 km: 2:10:07 by Emelie Braf; children’s race with many participants; results and photos are available.

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a Backyard Ultra on a fast, easy loop course in central Trosa. Each loop is 6.706 km, and the race continues for as long as participants can complete a loop within one hour. The race starts on 2 May 2026 at 10:00. In the Backyard format, anyone who completes a loop within the hour may start again, until only one participant remains. The event is open to the public and family-friendly, with Mini-TUB for children (starting at 12:15) and awards for the top three men and women. The organiser provides sports drink, fruit and sandwiches at the start/finish area, and holds prize draws throughout the race.
course_highlights: 6.706 km loop (main course)
Runs mostly along the Trosaån and is very easy and flat (approximately <10 metres of elevation gain)
Mini-TUB: approximately 700 m course for children (follows the main course for 700 m before branching off)
additional: Start and finish at Västra hamnplan in Trosa; livestream on the Trosa Ultra Backyard Facebook page; Mini-TUB sponsored by Camfil; team competition in which each club’s three best results count (the club with the three best results receives 20% off next year); tent pitches outside the start area; limited motorhome spaces; no caravan spaces; food and energy supplies available (sweets, sports drink and fruit), plus a Selfie Corner after the race; free silicone cup from Umara for all participants in the main race.

name: Kanallöpet
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a welcoming running event along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg, open to competitive runners, recreational runners and families. In 2026, the event offers a half marathon (competitive and recreational categories) as well as recreational 10 km and 5 km races, and this year’s edition has DM/VDM status for the half marathon. All races start at 13:00 from their respective start locations, and the finish is at Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is promoted as a competition in beautiful Swedish countryside and also offers team registration.
course_highlights: The route follows the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Finish at Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
A scenic route through beautiful Swedish countryside along the canal
additional: Transport: Buses are arranged from Borensberg to the respective start locations (the half marathon to Ljungsbro, the 10 km to Sjöbacka, and the 5 km to Brunneby) and must be booked and paid for when registering. No transport is provided after the finish; places may be available on race day, subject to availability. The bus fee listed on the registration pages is 100 kr. Team registration: teams of 5 runners, all in the same category; the price per runner is 20% lower than for individual registration, and team registration is only available online. Race bibs are collected at the respective start locations. Registration is valid only once payment has been received; if payment has not arrived within 10 days, the registration will be cancelled. Further details will be provided later in the race instructions. Start locations: 21 km from Ljungsbro, 10 km from Sjöbacka bridge, and 5 km from Brunneby Musteri; buses to the start from Borensberg; registration via Swish or bankgiro; late registration from 11:30 to 12:30 at an increased price; race bibs are collected at the start location.

name: VAIS-loppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Loppet är gratis för medlemmar i Växjö AIS.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: För dig som inte är medlem är anmälningsavgiften 50 kronor.

description: VAIS-loppet is an enjoyable trail race in the Fylleryd nature reserve, organized by Växjö AIS every spring and autumn. There are two distances, 8.4 km and 4.4 km. The long course follows much of the Trestugespåret and becomes hilly towards the end, while the short course follows the floodlit trail. Both races start together at VAIS-torpet at 18:30, and the event ends with refreshments. The race is free for Växjö AIS members; non-members pay an entry fee of 50 kronor.
course_highlights: Hilly recreational trail through the Fylleryd nature reserve
The long course (8.4 km) follows much of the Trestugespåret and is particularly hilly towards the end
The short course (4.4 km) follows the floodlit trail, and both courses finish with a long hill up to VAIS-torpet
additional: Race information will be published on April 28; a map and course profile are available as a PDF; registration is stated to open via a form (new tab) on the event page; the event ends with refreshments at VAIS-torpet. Trail race in Fylleryd Forest with start and finish at VAIS-torpet; spring and autumn events; membership affects the entry fee.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a women’s fun run organised by Marathongruppen in Uppsala on 7 May 2026. The event offers 2.5 km and 5 km distances, starting and finishing at Studenternas IP. Participants can enter individually or as part of a five-person team, and can opt out of timing for a more relaxed experience. After crossing the finish line, teams are treated to a picnic, with a focus on community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Studenternas IP in Uppsala
Distances of 2.5 km and 5 km
Enter as a five-person team or individually; timing is optional
additional: Distances: 2.5 km and 5 km; open to women of all ages; online registration; early registration is encouraged; teams consist of five people; teams are offered a picnic after the finish. The 5 km course is officially measured. Registration is available until race day, up to one hour before the first start, and timing can be optional.

name: Bankvarvet
price_range: 125 kr/vuxen, barn och ungdom upp till 16 år deltar gratis
description: Bankvarvet is a fun run in Kisa, taking place on 7 May 2026. The event focuses on the joy of being active rather than achieving a personal best or running the fastest lap, and welcomes participants of all ages and abilities. Entertainment, activities and food experiences are also on offer throughout the day, making it a festival for the whole family and groups of friends. Bankvarvet encourages community spirit and setting your own goals, whether you walk, jog or run.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Kullaparken in Kisa
Focus on the joy of being active and setting your own goals
Family-friendly event with entertainment and activities
additional: The event runs from 16:00 to 20:00 and has over 2,000 participants. It includes entertainment, activities and food experiences. Participants are encouraged to sign up with friends or family for an even more enjoyable experience. Ultramarathon runner Frida Södermark shares training tips ahead of the race via the bank’s social media. The race starts at 18:30 in Kullaparken, Kisa; activities for the whole family; businesses can take part; entertainment and food throughout the day.

name: RASA Druskininkų maratonas
organizer: Asociacija Sporto renginiai ir Druskininkų sporto centras
description: RASA Druskininkų maratonas yra tarptautinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Druskininkuose prie Vijūnėlės ežero. Renginys skatina bėgimą kaip sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir siekia populiarinti lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje bei didinti Druskininkų gyventojų aktyvumą. Varžybose dalyvauti gali visi norintys, o maratono ir pusmaratonio rungtyse startuoti gali tik sulaukę 18 metų. Dalyviai varžosi įvairiose distancijose nuo 500 m iki maratono, o visi apdovanojami specialiais renginio medaliais.
course_highlights: 500 m, 5 km, 10,5 km, pusmaratonio ir maratono distancijos
Startai nuo 10:00 val., laiko limitai 5 val. maratonui ir pusmaratonio distancijoms
Varžybos vyksta prie Vijūnėlės ežero Druskininkuose
additional: Startai vyksta bangomis: 10:00 - 500 m (nefiksuojant laiko), 10:17 - 5 km (laiko limitas 43 min), 11:00 - 10,5 km, pusmaratonis ir maratonas (laiko limitas 5 val.). Dalyviai varžosi tik savo vardu. Maratono ir pusmaratonio rungtyse gali dalyvauti tik nuo 18 metų. Visi dalyviai apdovanojami specialiais renginio medaliais, o 1 - 3 vietų laimėtojams įteikiamos nugalėtojų taurės. Distancijos: 500 m, 5 km, 10,5 km, pusmaratonis, maratonas; registracija internetu; apdovanojimai už pirmas vietas.

name: Blue Power Run
organizer: Fundacja Pełnoprawni MY i Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom z Autyzmem SENSE
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organised for people on the autism spectrum, their families and friends. The event aims to support social inclusion through a shared sporting event that brings participants together and raises awareness of autism. The race takes place on a paved path by Arkonka Swimming Area in Szczecin. Above all, taking part is about the satisfaction of completing the challenge and overcoming yourself, regardless of finishing place. The event also includes group activities led by therapists and volunteers, further encouraging inclusion.
course_highlights: The route follows a paved path by Arkonka Swimming Area
An inclusive race for people on the autism spectrum and their families
Group activities led by therapists and volunteers
additional: The entry limit is 300 participants. Race packs can be collected at the Race Office on Friday, 16 May, from 10:00 to 12:00 and from 14:00 to 16:00, as well as on event day from 12:00 to 13:00. Starts are divided into age categories, with distances ranging from 200 to 600 metres. The Race Office and start are located by the Szyszka restaurant. The event is inclusive, with routes for children and adults, and takes place on a paved course in Arkonka. Online registration is available until 10 May 2025. The start is scheduled for 13:00.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting the sport since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the chosen locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature in Łódź.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The beauty of the chosen locations
Passionate organization since 2014
additional: cross-country, scenic routes, spring 2026 event

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: The Red Nordic Walking Route in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie is a scenic and challenging 8.2 km route, serving as the first stage of the 14th edition of the Nordic Walking Grand Prix. The event will take place on 9 May 2026 and offers an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and to discover local attractions such as the largest wooden clog and a communal feast table. Participants can prepare by using the certified Nordic Walking routes available in the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality.
course_highlights: Red route, 8.2 km long
Scenic but challenging terrain
Local attractions: a communal feast table, the largest wooden clog and a snuffbox
additional: The event starts at 11:00. Registration is open from 18 March 2026 to 7 May 2026. The route passes through the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality, encouraging participants to use the certified Nordic Walking routes available in the region. The event offers sporting challenges, beautiful views and local attractions to enrich participants’ Nordic Walking experience.

name: III M Park4RUN
description: The III M Park4RUN Half Marathon is a race of approximately 21.2 km, taking place on May 9, 2026, in Tarnów, on the grounds of the M Park Shopping Centre. The course is 100% paved, flat, and marked every 1 km, with road traffic restricted for the duration of the race. The event promotes running and recreation and brings the local community together. In addition to the main race, children’s and youth races are held over distances suited to different age groups. Participants in the main race receive a race pack containing items from sponsors as well as informational and promotional materials.
course_highlights: Approximately 21.2 km, 100% paved
Flat course, marked every 1 km
Refreshment stations at 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the finish
additional: The time limit for the main race is 180 minutes. The race office is open from 7:30 to 9:15. The children’s race office opens at 10:00; children’s and youth races take place at approximately 12:00–12:30, with the awards ceremony at approximately 12:30–13:00. Runners must keep to the right on the course. Classifications include overall categories for women and men and age categories for adults and children. Approximate children’s race distances: 100 m (preschoolers), 250 m (grades I–III of primary school), 500 m (grades IV–VI of primary school), and 800 m (grades VII–VIII of primary school). Online registration was available for the event, which also includes children’s races and community activities.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: The 4th Płużnica Five is a 5-kilometer race held in the scenic village of Płużnica. The course has a varied surface, making it appealing to both recreational and more experienced runners. Participants start in the village center, and the event also includes children’s races and an awards ceremony. The race has a friendly, family atmosphere, as confirmed by positive reviews from participants in previous editions.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the center of Płużnica
Surface: 71% asphalt, 23% dirt road, 6% paving stones
Scenic views and varied terrain
additional: Schedule: 10:40 official opening, 10:50 warm-up, 10:55 lining up at the start, 11:00 race start, 11:50 children’s races, 12:15 awards ceremony, 12:45 official closing. The course starts in the village center. Prizes and a welcoming atmosphere with refreshments are planned after the race. The participant limit is 200. The race is part of the Grand Prix of the Chełmno Land. Online registration, timekeeping, and live results are available.

name: ProviRun for Invisibles IX Mistrzostwa Biegowe Provi Run
description: ProviRun for Invisibles / 9th Provi Run Running Championships is a 5.5 km road race taking place on May 9, 2026, in Łódź. The event is for runners of different ability levels, and participants can use training plans tailored to their individual level and needs. The race is moderately challenging and takes place on an urban asphalt course. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions so everyone can prepare optimally for the start.
course_highlights: A 5.5 km road course
An asphalt course in the city of Łódź
Tailored training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks
additional: Participants can choose a training plan suited to their VDOT level, with training instructions and expert support. Training lasts from 8 to 20 weeks, allowing participants to prepare optimally for the race. 5.5 km race, online registration, eco-friendly event, categories for children and adults, support for a foundation, race packs with gifts, parking, post-race meal

description: Rajd Beskidy Short is a European adventure race held in the scenic Beskids, on the border between Poland and Slovakia. The event includes a variety of disciplines, such as mountain biking, trekking, kayaking, climbing and orienteering, with routes through mountainous terrain featuring beautiful views and challenging sections. The race is open to two-person teams or solo participants, offering an intense challenge for lovers of adventure and outdoor sports. The start and finish are in the Kosice area, and the organizers provide professional service and support.
course_highlights: Approximately 200 km of mountain biking, trekking and kayaking
Route through the Beskids and the Orava region
Varied mountain terrain with orienteering and climbing
additional: The race lasts approximately 30 hours, plus an additional 2 hours. Teams may be mixed four-person teams or two-person teams of any gender. Race office and start/finish: Dworek nad Wisłą, Wyzwolenia 65, 43-460 Wisła, Poland. The race includes various disciplines, such as climbing, kayaking, navigation and field tasks, and the route passes through scenic areas of the Polish mountains, including caves and rock formations.

name: VIII Ultramaraton Warmiński Warneland
description: The VIII Warmian Ultramarathon Warneland is a unique running event held in picturesque Olsztyn. The route follows charming trails in Warmia, along the Łyna River and Lake Ukiel, offering runners a chance to connect with nature and enjoy beautiful views. The event is a great opportunity to spend time actively, both for experienced ultramarathon runners and younger running enthusiasts, who can take part in the Ultra Warmiaczek children’s races. The atmosphere encourages participants to connect and share a sporting adventure.
course_highlights: Picturesque trails in Warmia around Olsztyn
Route along the Łyna River and Lake Ukiel
A chance to connect with nature and enjoy charming views
additional: Race packs can be collected on 9 May 2026 from 17:00 to 21:00 at the Best Western Plus Olsztyn Old Town Hotel, and from 07:30 to 10:00 at CRS Ukiel for the children’s races. The W50+ and W25+ distances start at 08:00. The time limit for completing the W50+ race is 10 hours, and for W25+ it is 5 hours. After this time, runners must leave the course and remove their race bibs. The Ultra Warmiaczek children’s races start at 11:10. The race village is located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Centre, close to numerous hotels and apartments. The event features distances of 53 km, 32 km and 19 km, as well as children’s races, with time limits of 10 and 5 hours. The start and finish are at CRS Ukiel in Olsztyn. Participants can expect medical and logistical support, and registration closes on 26 April 2025.

name: XXVII Bieg Wilka
description: The 27th Bieg Wilka is a 10 km road race taking place on May 9, 2026, in Grajewo. It is a moderately challenging event that attracts runners of varying ability levels. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to their individual level, with expert support available. The race is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Moderate difficulty
Scenic areas of Grajewo
additional: The organizers offer 8- to 20-week training plans tailored to a runner’s VDOT level, along with expert support. The platform can also be used to manage the race’s listing and for marketing collaboration. The website provides no details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. The race takes place in an urban area, with parking by the swimming pool and the Milk Museum. Race preparation includes training plans, and online registration is available.

description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a family-friendly recreational running event starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Mjölby. The main race is six kilometres through the town. There is also the KyrkRundan, approximately three kilometres long, and a free children’s race. The event features music and activities along the route and is a local celebration that welcomes walkers, joggers and runners alike. You are warmly welcome to a day of movement, togetherness and fun on Saturday, 9 May 2026.
course_highlights: Six kilometres, starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Mjölby
Approximately half of the route runs close to the Svartån River
99 percent asphalt; a few challenging uphill sections and the final kilometre through central Mjölby towards Gästisparken
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Intersport on Friday, 8 May, 12:00–18:00 (a 25% discount coupon is provided when collecting your number). Uncollected race numbers will be distributed in Stadsparken no later than one hour before the start. The tab at the top of the race number is the timing chip—without it, no time will be recorded. Late registration is available 30 April–7 May via the website, and can also be completed at race-number collection on 8 May or in Stadsparken on 9 May (Swish only). Fitness4You will lead the warm-up. Refreshments are provided by, among others, ICA Supermarket Mjölby, with water and sports drinks from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. Participant numbers have been high in previous years, with 1,074 runners mentioned in coverage of the event. Registration for 2026 opens, and results and records are published by the event’s organising media.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a local running event in Hultsfred, following a pleasant, flat course along Lake Hulingen. There is a 10 km course and two children’s races, and the organizers welcome both club runners and recreational runners. Children can also enter the longer course if they wish. For more information, the organizers refer participants to the race-day information on the event page.
course_highlights: Flat course along Lake Hulingen
10 km for adults and two different children’s races
A pleasant, family-oriented event setting at Herrstorpet
additional: The children’s races start at 10:00 and the 10 km race starts at 11:00. You do not need to belong to a club to participate. The organizers refer participants to the race-day information for more details. The children’s races start at 10:00 according to the schedule; Strandmilen is part of Herrstorpet New Building Day, with rail-bike rides, guided tours and a concert during the morning.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
location: Kolmården, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: Halvmarathon, 10 km, 10 km, 7.5 km, 5 km, 5 km

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.description: Till och med 3 Maj: 21 km 400 kr, 11 km 300 kr, 6 km 200 kr, Ungdom 50 kr, Kidz 50 kr.

description: Kolmårdstrailen is a hilly, experience-focused trail race in the scenic Kolmården area, with technical trails, rocky slabs and plenty of elevation gain. You can choose from courses of approximately 21 km, 11 km and 6 km (as well as a 500 m children’s course). The course is described as challenging but close to nature. It passes, among other places, through Rödgölens Nature Reserve and offers beautiful views from Kolmården’s highest point. The organizer emphasizes the experience and provides services including a water station and downloadable GPX data for your watch.
course_highlights: Hilly, technical trail terrain with plenty of elevation gain and sections of rocky slabs
Passes Rödgölens Nature Reserve and Lake Ågelsjön; views from Kolmården’s highest point (171 m above sea level)
Small trails and singletrack, a wooden bridge over marshy sections, a rope in “koklämman” and a tough, partly off-trail final kilometre
additional: Regular registration is open through 3 May; late registration is available online until 6 May and then on site on race day from 09:00 to 11:00, with payment by cash or Swish. GPX data for the courses is available to download. There is a water station after approximately 7.5 km at Scoutstugan. A children’s race of approximately 500 m is available for children up to age 10. For Kolmården Night Trail, bring a headlamp; the course is marked with reflectors, there are no shower facilities, and chanterelle soup is served at the finish. The organizer offers cancellation and accident insurance as optional extras. The Kolmården events in the series include Kolmården Vertical (5 km, 300 metres of elevation gain), Swimrun Kolmården, Kolmården Night Trail (9 km) and Luciatåget (7.5 km). A results page is available, and multiple distances are emphasized during the event.

name: Östhammars Stadslopp
description: Stadsloppet 2026 is organised by Östhammars Friidrott and takes place on Saturday, 9 May 2026, starting at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar. The event is presented on the club’s competition page and is aimed at local runners and participants from the surrounding area. The necessary contact details are collected during registration for race administration and publication of results, and photos from the event may be used on the club’s channels.
course_highlights: Start at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar
additional: The club states that contact details provided during registration are used for race-related communication, and that names, ages and results may be stored for results lists and competition statistics. Photos from events may be used on the club’s website, Facebook and Instagram; participants can contact the club to request their removal. Club membership for 2026 is managed through Svenska Lag. The webpage contains the start list, registration and results for Stadsloppet 2025.

name: Spångaloppet
location: Spånga IP, Spånga, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Spångaloppet is a local running race organised by Spånga/Bromstens Bandyklubb, returning on 9 May 2026. The race offers courses for different ages and ability levels: 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and past Spånga centre, a 2 km course for younger runners, and a 400 m children’s race. All races start and finish at Spånga IP. Everyone is welcome to take part, and registration is via RaceID under Spångaloppet 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and Spånga centre
2 km course for younger runners and a 400 m children’s race
All races start and finish at Spånga IP
additional: Register via RaceID under “Spångaloppet 2026”. For questions, contact spangaloppet@sbbk.nu. All races start and take place in the vicinity of Spånga IP. Registration via RaceID; questions to spangaloppet@sbbk.nu.

name: Älmhult Fights Cancer
description: Älmhult Fights Cancer is a charity race in Älmhult that raises money for the fight against cancer. The event is organised by Aktivitetshuset/the IKEA network and welcomes the general public, IKEA employees and their families. Registration is through RaceID, where participants choose both their distance and start time. Online registration is open until 9 May at 20:00, and on-site registration is available from 08:30, subject to availability. The race weekend also includes inspirational talks and an after-run at Grillen after the finish.
additional: Register through RaceID (choose a distance and start time). Online registration is open until 9 May at 20:00; on-site registration is available from 08:30, subject to availability. As this is a charity event, fees are non-refundable if you cancel. Group registration is supported (add additional participants during payment), and the confirmation email from RaceSupport includes your chosen distance and start time. Inspirational talks are held at Aktivitetshuset before the race (including Aron Anderson on 10 April, 17:00–19:00, and a talk by researchers on 24 April, 17:30–19:00). The after-run at Grillen starts at 14:00 after the race. A course map is available as a PDF on the event page, and IKEA Hotell is recommended for overnight stays.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
description: Ölands Kyrkstafett is a classic long-distance relay, being held for the 47th time, and offers a fantastic running experience on Öland as spring gets underway. The start and finish are in Färjestaden, and the race comes in two formats: a longer course with eleven legs, totalling 67.5 km, and a shorter course with six legs, totalling 23.5 km. The race welcomes both dedicated runners and beginners, with legs for all levels. Event staff and a race announcer follow the race to provide the best possible service and atmosphere throughout the event.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs, 2.7 km to 8.5 km, 67.5 km total
Short course: 6 legs, 2.7 km to 5.4 km, 23.5 km total
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden
additional: Race bibs can be collected on 8 May from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day, 9 May, from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall, 200 m north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio will lead a group warm-up before the start. Individual leg times, split times and teams’ finish times will be provided. The race announcer will follow the leaders from start to finish. Accommodation and food are available at Ekerum Resort and Best Western Plus Kalmarsund Hotell. Registration is open until 30 April 2026, with late registration available through 6 May. Participants can look forward to a well-organised event with event staff, a group warm-up and a prize-giving ceremony for the top teams.

name: Humlestafetten
distance_verbose: 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race held in Bruksparken in Bromölla, with the start and finish in the same place. The race consists of six legs and is suitable for all runners, from recreational runners to more experienced athletes. The course is flat and easy to run, with a mix of gravel and asphalt, making the event a day filled with running enjoyment and camaraderie. The anniversary year is celebrated with a mini race for children and a draw for a hot-air balloon ride for participating teams. The mass start is at 11:00, and race bibs can be collected from 09:00.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Six relay legs with timing via data chip
Water station at approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and many prizes are drawn among participants. Timing is done using a data chip, and both overall time and each runner’s leg time are recorded. The race has a mass start, and slower runners are asked to keep to the right to let faster runners pass. The event includes a mini race for children, medals for all participants, and prizes for the top three in each category. Race-bib collection starts at 09:00, and showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Registration is open through 8 May 2026.

description: Lundaloppet is a recreational race held in central Lund, offering several distances for all ages and abilities, including 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the children’s Little Lundaloppet. The race is known for its great atmosphere and scenic routes through parks and urban surroundings. It is a community celebration where both beginners and experienced runners come together to enjoy the joy of running in springtime Lund. The finish is inside Centrala Idrottsplatsen, the race’s vibrant heart since 1997.
course_highlights: 10 km of running joy through springtime Lund
Route through parks and the city centre
Child-friendly race of approximately 500 metres around Centrala Idrottsplatsen
additional: Race bibs can be collected at IFK-hallen at Centrala Idrottsplatsen on 8 May from 13:00 to 19:00 and on 9 May from 9:00. The warm-up for the main race takes place at the start on Svanevägen, with raised podiums along the way. Race confirmations are sent by email in week 18 and must be shown when collecting race bibs. Timing is recorded using a chip on the race bib, and the finish is filmed. Trail and city running; registration online; race numbers and T-shirts can be purchased in advance or on site.

name: Red Bull Wings for Life World run
description: Red Bull Wings for Life World Run yra unikalus bėgimas, vykstantis vienu metu visame pasaulyje, įskaitant Vingio parką Vilniuje. Dalyviai bėga tiek, kiek gali, kol juos pasivija „Gaudymo automobilis“. Šis renginys skirtas paremti stuburo smegenų traumų tyrimus, o 100 % dalyvio mokesčio skiriama moksliniams tyrimams. Prisijunkite prie tūkstančių bėgikų visame pasaulyje ir bėkite už tuos, kurie negali.
course_highlights: Bėgimas vyksta Vingio parke, Vilniuje
Startas vienu metu su bėgikais visame pasaulyje
Unikalus „Gaudymo automobilio“ formatas, kuris užbaigia bėgimą
additional: Startas vyksta 11:00 UTC. Dalyviai bėga tiek, kiek gali, kol juos pasivija „Gaudymo automobilis“. 100 % dalyvio mokesčio skiriama stuburo smegenų traumų tyrimams. Renginys vyksta vienu metu visame pasaulyje, įskaitant Vilnių. Renginys vyksta Vingio parke, dalyvių pasirinkimas bėgti ar eiti, neturi tradicinės finišo linijos, surenkama lėšų stuburo traumų tyrimams.

name: A.Vietrino taurės bėgimo varžybos
organizer: Lietuvos lengvosios atletikos federacija, Kauno bėgimo mėgėjų klubas, Lietuvos sporto universitetas
description: A.Vietrino taurės bėgimo varžybos yra skirtos Lietuvos maratono bėgimo pradininko Alfonso Vietrino atminimui. Varžybos vyksta Kauno Ąžuolyno parke, startas ir finišas prie S.Dariaus ir S.Girėno paminklo. Dalyviai gali rinktis 2,5 km arba 10 km distancijas, o trasa yra sertifikuota ir sudaryta iš 2,5 km ilgio rato. Renginys populiarina bėgimą Lietuvoje ir kviečia visus norinčius dalyvauti su gydytojo leidimu.
course_highlights: Trasa vyksta Ąžuolyno parke
Vieno rato ilgis - 2,5 km, sertifikuota trasa
Startas ir finišas prie S.Dariaus ir S.Girėno paminklo
additional: 2,5 km distancijos startas 11:30 val., 10 km distancijos startas 12:00 val. Dalyviai privalo turėti numerį ant marškinėlių priekyje. Apdovanojami amžiaus grupių nugalėtojai ir prizininkai, taip pat jauniausias ir vyriausias dalyviai atminimo taurėmis. Varžybose draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones ir asmeninę palydą. Renginio tikslas - skatinti fizinį aktyvumą ir bėgimo mėgėjų bendruomenę Lietuvoje

name: Tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos „Kresowe Trail“
location: Nemenčinės apylinkės, Nemenčinė, Vilniaus rajonas, Lithuania
organizer: Vilniaus rajono savivaldybė, Vilniaus rajono sporto centras, Vilniaus rajono sporto mokykla, fondas Maratony Kresowe
description: Tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos „Kresowe Trail“ Nemenčinėje siūlo unikalią galimybę bėgti per Vilniaus rajono sporto centro apylinkes. Varžybos vyksta birželio 2 dieną, o trasos yra įvairaus ilgio - nuo trumpesnio 6 km Szpurt bėgimo iki ilgesnio 18,6 km Wertep trasos. Renginys pritaikytas tiek profesionaliems bėgikams, tiek mėgėjams, su elektroniniu laiko matavimu ir starto numeriu, galiojančiu visą sezoną. Dalyviai gali mėgautis žaliais ir raudonais rodyklėmis pažymėtomis trasomis, o po bėgimo laukia apdovanojimai ir šiltas maistas.
course_highlights: Szpurt 6 km bėgimas su žaliomis rodyklėmis geltoname fone
Wertep 18,6 km bėgimas su raudonomis rodyklėmis
Du maitinimo punktai Wertep trasoje
additional: Registracija vyksta prieš startą nuo 8:30 iki 9:20 val., ne vėliau kaip 10 min. iki starto. Varžybų biuras veikia birželio 1 d. nuo 15:00 iki 18:00 Vilniaus rajono sporto centre. Laiko limitas trasose - 2 val. 15 min. Elektroninis laiko matavimas ir nemokamas starto numeris su laiko skaitikliu, galiojantis visą sezoną. Po bėgimo dalyviams siūlomas šiltas maistas. Starto sektoriai atskirti pagal distancijas: Szpurt 6 km ir Wertep 19 km. Renginyje yra maitinimo punktų, elektroninis laiko matavimas, nemokamas starto numeris, medicininė apsauga ir apdovanojimai.

name: 13. PKO Białystok Półmaraton
price_range: 75 zł - 170 zł (koszulki i bluzy dostępne w sprzedaży)
description: The 13th PKO Białystok Half Marathon is the largest race in eastern Poland. It has been held since 2013 and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown. Runners cover the half-marathon distance of 21.097 km in the picturesque city of Białystok. The event also includes the PKO Night Run over 5 km, which can be a great warm-up for the half marathon, as well as children’s races. It is a true celebration of running, attracting participants from across Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: A 21.097 km half-marathon course in central Białystok
Start zones based on predicted finish time, from elite runners to recreational runners
Side events: the 5 km Night Run, Junior Run, and Breakfast Run
additional: Start zones by predicted finish time: AA (elite), A (<1:35), B (1:35–1:44:59), C (1:45–1:49:59), D (1:50–1:54:59), E (1:55–1:59:59), F (2:00–2:09:59), G (>2:10). Race office hours: May 8, 17:00–21:00; May 9, 10:00–20:00; May 10, 7:00–9:00. Side events: Breakfast Run (approx. 4 km, free, starts May 9 at 9:00), PKO Junior Run for children aged 2–14. A weekend package combining the half marathon and the 5 km Night Run is available. Urban course; information about registration, medals, and promotional clothing; 3-hour time limit; course changes may be made for safety reasons.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz - Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race organised by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz, with an emphasis on the visual appeal of the locations. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and enjoy the beauty of nature during a spring race.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz
Routes with visual appeal and a natural character
Organised with passion and experience since 2014
additional: Cross-country race, off-road, registration on the website, location at the Myślęcinek Botanical Garden, spring event

name: Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: The Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race held simultaneously around the world. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the runners and gradually increases its speed until it catches the last participant. In Gdańsk Południe, the race will take place on May 10, 2026, starting at 13:00 near the Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie finish area. The course is an approximately 3 km loop on a paved surface, with a minimal uphill section on the connector. All entry fees support spinal cord research.
course_highlights: An approximately 3 km walking and running loop
Paved surface, uneven in places near the large reservoir
A minimal uphill section on the connector toward the smaller reservoir
additional: The race is open to runners and participants using wheelchairs. The Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the runners at a speed of 14 km/h and gradually speeds up. 100% of entry fees go toward spinal cord research. Participants use the Wings for Life World Run app to follow the race and results. The race starts at 13:00, and participants use the app to register and track their progress. The event is open to runners and wheelchair users.

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: The Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race in which all participants start at the same time around the world, running from the Catcher Car. There is no traditional finish line—participants run until they are caught by the car. All entry fees go towards research into treatments for spinal cord injuries, making this not only a sporting challenge but also a charity event. You can take part locally or via the app, which lets you run from anywhere in the world.
course_highlights: Simultaneous start around the world
No traditional finish line—the Catcher Car pursues participants
A race for runners, wheelchair users and first-timers
additional: Participants can join the race locally or via the Wings for Life World Run app, which tracks time and distance. 100% of entry fees support spinal cord research. Marketing tools and promotional materials are available for organisers of local app runs. Taking part supports research into treatments for severed spinal cords; the event also includes merchandise sales and the option to join remotely, with all proceeds going to scientific research.

name: Charytatywna Dycha
description: Charytatywna Dycha is a sports and charity running festival held in Miechów in support of the Caritas Hospice. The event brings the local community together to support hospice patients by raising funds for essential medical equipment. The race takes place around the park, and participants, donors, and organizers create an atmosphere of empathy and solidarity. This unique initiative not only promotes physical activity but also raises public awareness of hospice care.
course_highlights: The race takes place around the park in Miechów
The event combines sport with a charitable cause supporting the hospice
Strong support from the local community and organizations
additional: The event is a sports and charity festival, with local schools and organizations actively taking part. The funds raised go toward purchasing specialist medical equipment for hospice patients. The organizers emphasize the event’s social significance and its role in raising awareness about hospice care. The race and charity activities raise funds for medical equipment for the hospice.

name: IX Bieg Pilicy
price_range: bezpłatny dla mieszkańców gminy (dla biegów dziecięcych i młodzieżowych)
description: The 9th Bieg Pilicy is a small-scale running event held in the charming town of Białobrzegi on the Pilica River. The start and finish are located in the central, revitalized Zygmunt Stary Square, and the route follows the town’s main streets. The event combines sport, passion, and a family-friendly atmosphere, with distances suited to different levels of experience: a 10 km main race, a 3 km recreational run, and a 3 km Nordic walking event. Color runs for children and young people are organized for different age groups. Every participant can look forward to a hot meal, drinks, and a voucher for local ice cream.

All entry fees go toward spinal cord injury research, and the mobile app provides motivation and a unique audio experience during the run. It’s a race for everyone—from beginners to professionals, runners, wheelchair users, and amateurs.

A unique audio experience and motivation through the mobile app
additional: The race takes place worldwide, with a simultaneous start at 11:00 UTC. Participants can run individually or join App Run events. 100% of entry fees go toward spinal cord injury research. Virtual event, participation via the mobile app, global community, support for spinal cord research

The event features team competition, the EKIDEN Junior race for children, charitable support, attractions, and an exciting atmosphere of sporting competition.

name: III Półmaraton Brzegiem Bałtyku
organizer: Kołobrzeskie Stowarzyszenie Biegów Ulicznych Nadmorscy Biegacze
description: The 3rd Kołobrzeg Half Marathon by the Baltic Sea is a flat road race held in the picturesque seaside setting of Kołobrzeg. The course follows a granite-paved promenade, a cycle path and asphalt roads, with five refreshment stations along the way. The start and finish are located by the Seaside Park Hotel. The race is part of the Kołobrzeska Odyssey series, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the running community together. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours, and timing is electronic, using disposable chips.
course_highlights: Flat course following a promenade, cycle path and asphalt roads
Course marked every kilometre with vertical signs
Five refreshment stations along the course
additional: The race office is open on 16.05.2026 from 18:00 to 20:00 and on 17.05.2026 from 8:00 to 10:50 near the start and finish. Electronic timing with disposable chips. Runners must wear their race number with the chip clearly visible. Pedestrians and cyclists may be present on the course; runners must obey traffic regulations. Open categories for women and men, as well as a classification for residents of Kołobrzeg County. The course runs along the promenade, where pedestrians and cyclists may be present. Time limit: 3 hours. Children’s races are planned. Other distances may also be available (5 km, 10 km, marathon).

name: Kresowe Trail #5
location: Prostki, Ełk County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Kresowe Trail #5 in Prostki is a running challenge offering two routes: the shorter Szpurt (approx. 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17 km). The routes pass through scenic landscapes and feature technical elements such as climbs, sand and roots, as well as historic sites in the Municipality of Prostki, including the Border Pillar from 1545 and a former wooden Evangelical church from 1667. The start and finish are at the forest stadium in Prostki, providing a comfortable spot for spectators. The race is part of the season-long Kresowe Trail series, with overall and team classifications, and the option to take part in the DUAL competition combining running and cycling.
course_highlights: Routes of approximately 7 km (Szpurt) and 17 km (Wertep), featuring technical climbs, sand and roots
The routes pass through scenic surroundings and historic landmarks in the Municipality of Prostki, including the Border Pillar from 1545 and a wooden church from 1667
Start and finish at the forest stadium in Prostki, close to the town beach on the Ełk River and Lake Toczyłowo
additional: The overall classification is available after completing 6 races; the FINISHER title is awarded for 11 races and SUPER FINISHER for 12 races. Team competition is held separately for the Szpurt and Wertep distances. The DUAL competition combines the Szpurt run with the cycling Half Marathon. Most of the route follows a permanent MTB course marked since 2017, with varied sporting and scenic sections. The event includes trail races as well as other sporting activities, with online registration available. Route and registration details will be available on the organizer’s website.

name: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy
description: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Run is the second edition of an off-road race taking place on 17 May 2026 in Modrze, Poland. Participants can choose from a 5 km run, a 10 km run, or a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The course runs through fields and forests between the villages of Modrze and Drożdżyce, offering a chance to connect with nature and enjoy outdoor activity. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: The running and walking route passes through fields and forests between Modrze and Drożdżyce
Distances available: 5 km run, 10 km run, and 5 km Nordic Walking
The route and event format remain the same as in 2025
additional: No information about entry fees is available. The event is promotional and community-oriented, takes place on open land, and has no stated participant limit or start waves. The event uses natural off-road routes, and participants can expect friendly competition in a welcoming atmosphere. Starts are scheduled between 8:30 and 9:45, and registration is available through the official event website.

name: Półmaraton...Chce Ci się?
location: Nadleśnictwo Herby i Kłobuck, okolice Blachowni, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: “Half Marathon… Feel Like It?” is a cross-country race over 21 km, with an additional 32 km race, held on forest trails in the Herby and Kłobuck Forest Districts near Blachownia. Participants can run the course or walk with Nordic walking poles. The event also includes races for children and young people. This is the fifth edition of the event, combining sport and recreation in a picturesque forest setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country course on forest trails in the Herby and Kłobuck Forest Districts
Option to take part in Nordic walking and races over 21 km and 32 km
Additional races for children and young people
additional: Start schedule: 8:00 race office opens; 9:00 start of Nordic walking and the 32 km race; 10:00 start of the 21 km race; 10:10 start of the children’s and youth races; course closes at 13:00. Cross-country terrain, online registration, accompanying races for children and young people, 32 km race, Nordic walking

name: Run Toruń Plaza
description: The May edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy – Run Toruń Plaza, taking place on May 17, 2026, offers two race distances: 5 km and 10 km. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness in the spring edition of the series and experience the unique atmosphere of running in Toruń. The organizers provide a professionally run event with a nationwide reach while ensuring a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere. The event is part of a running series promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity.
course_highlights: Compete over 5 km or 10 km
The atmosphere of running in Toruń
The spring edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy series
additional: The race is organized by the “Run To Run” Association, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and sport. The event has a nationwide reach while retaining a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a unique medal and the opportunity to take part in a post-race satisfaction survey. 5 km and 10 km race, spring edition, Toruń Legends Trilogy series

name: Sierakowicka Piętnastka
description: Sierakowicka Piętnastka is an annual race held in Sierakowice as part of the Northern Poland Running Festival. The event takes place at the sports stadium at 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street and attracts runners of all ages, offering a 15 km main race as well as numerous races for children and young people. The event features electronic timekeeping, a lively atmosphere and prizes for the top competitors. Participants can expect professional organization, including medical and police support, as well as facilities such as bag storage, showers and a café.
course_highlights: 15 km main race course
Start and finish at the sports stadium in Sierakowice
Electronic timekeeping and rankings in 14 categories
additional: Race office opens at 10:00 at the Orlik sports field by the Primary School; bib numbers and chips will be distributed there. Free showers, bag storage, a café and toilets are available. Children’s and youth races start at 11:30; the 100 m preschoolers’ race starts at 12:40 (free). A recreational run-walk of 1,200 m starts at 13:05 for people not taking part in the main races. Prizes will be raffled among participants in the children’s and main races. Official parking is at 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street. Medical and police support will be provided. The event also includes preparatory training sessions, and online registration opens in December 2025. The race takes place at the sports stadium in Sierakowice, 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street.

name: VII Bieg im. Rektora Stanisława Komornic...
description: The 7th Rector Stanisław Komornicz Memorial Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Tarnów. This sporting event is aimed at runners of varying ability levels and offers the opportunity to prepare with dedicated training plans. The race takes place on the streets of the picturesque city of Tarnów, offering participants an attractive course and sporting excitement.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Scenic areas of Tarnów
Suitable for runners of varying ability levels
additional: Training plans are available for 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support. No detailed information about entry fees is available, and registration details have not been provided.

name: XII Bieg Kwitnących Ogrodów
organizer: Klub Biegacza Im. P. Sękowskiego w Płońsku
description: The 12th Blooming Gardens Run is an annual running event held in Kuchary Królewskie. The competition includes various distances suited to different age groups, including races for preschoolers and schoolchildren, a 10 km main race, a 3 km accompanying race, and a 6 km Nordic Walking event. The start and finish are by the forester’s lodge. After the competition, participants can look forward to an awards ceremony and a prize draw. The participant limit is 300, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km main race
3 km accompanying race
6 km Nordic Walking event
additional: The participant limit is 300. Registration and chip distribution take place from 9:30 to 10:15. After the races, at around 13:00, a closing ceremony with awards and a prize draw will take place on the main stage. Registration opens on 19 March 2026. The event includes various age categories and ability levels.

name: Sezon Ogórkowy/Monte Cassino
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Kajenloppet
organizer: Nacka Hockey och Kajen i Nacka strand
description: Kajenloppet is a running festival in Nacka Strand on 17 May 2026, offering 10 km and 6 km races, as well as two children’s races (1,200 m and 400 m). The course follows a scenic route along the water, passes historic sites and offers views of Stockholm’s inlet. The start and finish are at Kajen in Nacka Strand, and the event is combined with a family festival featuring activities, music and entertainment. The race celebrates local pride and is suitable for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Scenic route along the water
Passes historic sites and offers views of Stockholm’s inlet
Start and finish at Kajen in Nacka Strand; family festival with activities and music
additional: Distances: 10 km, 6 km, and children’s races of 1,200 m and 400 m. Date and location: 17 May 2026, Kajen in Nacka Strand. Start and finish at the same location, at Kajen. The day includes a family festival with activities, music and entertainment. Part of the registration fee goes to Min Stora Dag.

name: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna
location: Jabłonna, Legionowo County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Backyard Ultra Jabłonna is a unique ultra-running event in a format that originated in the USA. Competitors start every hour and must complete a 6.706 km loop. After completing the loop, they can rest until the next full hour, and the competition continues until only one runner remains who completes the final loop within the one-hour limit. This is an endurance race where speed, strategy and perseverance all matter.
course_highlights: A 6.706 km (4.167 mile) loop
Starts every full hour
A unique format—the race continues until a sole winner is determined
additional: There is no podium—only a throne for the winner. The event is for adults. The time limit for completing each loop is 1 hour. The rules and map are available to download on the website. The event features Backyard Ultra competition, participant limits and online registration. The series also includes winter editions and special editions offering Silver Tickets to the World Championships as prizes.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 1 etapas
description: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - tai tradicinis bėgimo turnyras, vykstantis Jonavos rajone, skirtas populiarinti sportą ir fizinį aktyvumą. Varžybos yra atviros visiems Lietuvos ir užsienio bėgikams, vyksta penkiuose etapuose skirtingose vietovėse. Dalyviai varžosi tiek bendroje įskaitoje, tiek amžiaus grupėse, o trasos driekiasi įvairiomis Jonavos rajono vietovėmis, suteikdamos įdomią ir įvairiapusę bėgimo patirtį. Registracija vykdoma internetu, o numerių atsiėmimas - varžybų dieną starto vietoje.
course_highlights: Penki etapai skirtingose Jonavos rajono vietovėse: Šilai - Jaugeliškiai, Ragožiai, Juškonys, Salupiai - Bartoniai, Jonava
Startas ir finišas įvairiose lokacijose, įskaitant Jonavos miesto centrinį stadioną ir seniūnijų pastatus
Varžybos vyksta vakaro valandomis, startas 19:30 val., numerių atsiėmimas nuo 18:30 iki 19:20 val.
additional: Numerių atsiėmimas vyksta varžybų dieną nuo 18:30 iki 19:20 val. starto vietoje. Registracija į kiekvieną etapą vykdoma atskirai. Dalyvavimas varžybose yra nemokamas. Renginys yra atviras visiems dalyviams, siūlo internetinę registraciją ir skirtingas trasas, vyksta penkiais etapais nuo gegužės iki rugsėjo.

name: Cytadela by Night # 115 - Wartostrada
location: Cytadela, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed races held in Poznań over distances of 5 km and 10 km. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of the Citadel, offering participants a unique night-racing atmosphere. The event attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Citadel in Poznań
Timed 5 km and 10 km distances
A nighttime racing atmosphere
additional: The races are free, held regularly, and timed. The event is supported by Kiprun Poznań Runners. It takes place at night and attracts participants of different age groups and ability levels, promoting physical activity and community integration.

name: Blodomloppet Kristianstad
price_range: 5/10 km – 350 kr till 28 april; Efteranmälan 400 kr; Lag: 1 750 kr till 28 april, därefter 2 000 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet – 100 kr till 18 maj; Efteranmälan Lilla Blodomloppet: 130 kr fr.o.m. 19 maj
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet Kristianstad in Tivoliparken on 19 May 2026. The event offers 5 km and 10 km races for men and women, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 0–12. It is suitable for runners and walking groups, participating individually or in teams. The scenic course heads into Vattenriket and has varied surfaces (grass, gravel and asphalt). The event traditionally ends with a picnic. It also has a clear community and blood-donation purpose and is run by local associations together with the blood centre.
course_highlights: Scenic course heading into Vattenriket
Surfaces vary between grass, gravel and asphalt
Lilla Blodomloppet takes place entirely within Tivoliparken; the 5 km and 10 km courses cross the Helge River
additional: Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to 12 years old; the start and finish area is in Tivoliparken; bag storage is available (for bags only); the deadline for team registration is 12 May, and the final registration deadline for all races is 19 May; an Excel template for team registration is available on the registration page

name: Vårruset Stockholm
description: Vårruset Stockholm is part of Sweden’s largest women’s recreational running tour and takes place on Tuesday, 19 May 2026, in Norra Djurgården. Choose between a 2.5 km distance and a measured 5 km course. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and experienced runners, with a warm, community-focused atmosphere. You can enter as a team and finish the evening with a picnic after the race. Registration is online, and the same price applies whether or not you choose to have your time recorded.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Norra Djurgården
The 5 km course is measured
Nearest metro station: Universitetet
additional: Included are a medal, a finish-line bag, the Vårruset music quiz with prizes, a race bib and, for those who choose it, official timekeeping. You can opt out of timekeeping so that your result is not published. Team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after the race; team members can run different distances. Recommended ages: 5 km from age 13 (11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km from age 11 (7 when accompanied by an adult). Registration is binding, and the entry fee is non-refundable in the event of cancellation. There is also a digital race for participants who cannot attend in person (with medals mailed after the tour). Race bibs are mailed to the address provided at registration for entries submitted before a specified date; any surplus goes 100% back to sport.

name: Kėdainių bėgimas „Babėnų pavasaris 2026“
location: Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelė, Kėdainiai, Lithuania
description: Kėdainių bėgimas „Babėnų pavasaris 2026“ kviečia visus aktyvaus gyvenimo būdo entuziastus dalyvauti 5 km ir 10 km distancijose Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelėje. Renginys skirtas skatinti fizinį aktyvumą įvairaus amžiaus dalyviams ir suteikti galimybę varžytis bei realizuoti savo bėgimo gebėjimus. Trasos driekiasi miško takais ir keliukais, o kiekvienas finišavęs dalyvis gaus atminimo medalį. Varžybos organizuojamos Kėdainių sporto centro ir Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacijos bendradarbiavimu.
course_highlights: Trasos driekiasi Babėnų miško takais ir keliukais
5 km ir 10 km distancijos
Varžybos vyksta Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelėje, Aušros ir Budrio gatvių gale
additional: Papildoma registracija vyks starto vietoje nuo 17:00 iki 18:15 val. Numeriai išduodami likus valandai iki starto ir baigiami dalinti likus 15 minučių iki starto. Apdovanojami kiekvienos amžiaus grupės nugalėtojai ir prizininkai, taip pat greičiausi 3 dalyviai 5 km ir 10 km distancijose. Visi finišavusieji gaus atminimo medalius. Renginys planuojamas 2027 m. gegužės 26 d., tačiau detalių apie trasas ar dalyvio mokestį nėra pateikta.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten takes place on Wednesday, 20 May 2026, in Folkparken in Norrköping. Teams of four take turns walking, jogging or running a lively 4 km leg each. There are timed and untimed categories, and the race is promoted as an accessible, festive relay for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and young people can take part for free, and there is specific information for schools.
course_highlights: Four legs of 4 km each (4 × 4 km in total)
Start, relay exchanges and finish in the beautiful Folkparken
Suitable for walking, jogging or running; timed and untimed categories
additional: Children and young people take part for free thanks to HSB; schools are encouraged to register (school contact: mikael.grip@lopparrangoren.se). The organiser offers tents and event furnishings for hire through Rent a Tent (booking deadline to guarantee availability: 5 May; contact norrkoping@rentatent.se). The start, relay exchanges and finish are all in the park, creating a lively atmosphere for spectators and the event. Teams consist of four participants; event communications mention a picnic bag from ICA Kvantum Mirum Galleria and a medal at the finish. More than 700 participants and around 180 teams took part in previous years; young people and students participate free of charge thanks to sponsorship from HSB and Fiskeby. More information and registration are available at norrkopingsstafetten.se. ICA Kvantum Mirum provides a picnic for all participants; various sponsors offer tents or gathering areas.

name: Blodomloppet (Karlskrona)
price_range: Individuell: 300-350 kr; Lag (5 personer): 1500-1750 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet: 100 kr; blodgivar-rabatt 40 kr per person
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Karlskrona on 20 May 2026—a recreational event that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, take part in Lilla Blodomloppet (800 m), or walk 5 km. The courses have been measured by an official from the Swedish Athletics Federation, and walkers have a separate route so participants can finish with a picnic together. The event is organised by KA 2 IF and offers individual and team entries, as well as discounts for blood donors and ICA members.
course_highlights: Four routes: 5 km run, 10 km run, 800 m children’s race and 5 km walk
Walkers have their own route and can set off first, then enjoy a picnic with the others
The courses have been measured by an official from the Swedish Athletics Federation and meet the requirements for competition courses
additional: Organiser: KA 2 IF (Blodomloppet contact: karlskrona@blodomloppet.se, tel. 0793-299924). A team can have up to 5 participants, and team members can take part in different distances. For larger entries, an Excel template is available in the registration system for importing details, as well as the option of a customer page for companies/organisations to manage entries and discount codes in one place. Blood donors and ICA members receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. A picnic after the event is part of the programme. Courses: 5 km, 10 km, 800 m and 5 km walk; Excel template for larger groups; start times and warm-up details will be shared later via the information channel.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is an evening 5 km race starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race is run on a 2.5 km loop, completed twice, with a pleasant atmosphere and great spirit along the course. You can take part individually or enter a team (at least five people), with the five fastest times combined. Welcome to the running festival in Stadsparken on Wednesday, 20 May 2026 at 19:00.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km loop run twice, with a lap split halfway
Start and finish in Stadsparken; the course runs through central Västervik
The course may be adjusted due to construction work on Storgatan
additional: Race bibs are available for collection well before the start and must be collected before 17:30 on race day. Collection: Monday 18 May – Intersport 11–14; Tuesday 19 May – Intersport 11–14; Wednesday 20 May – at the stage in Stadsparken from 12:00. Registration is via RaceID (link provided on the event page). Team competition: at least 5 people per team; the team result is the combined time of the 5 fastest participants; if more than 9 participants are from the same organization, multiple teams can be entered. 5 km course; start and finish in Stadsparken; race bibs must be collected before 17:30 on race day or according to the schedule; start at 19:00; VO-Joggen times included in the programme; 20% team discount with code LAG20.

name: XIII Bieg 5 Mil
organizer: Gdyński Dywizjon Okrętów Bojowych, Gdyńskie Centrum Sportu, Stowarzyszenie Oficerów Marynarki Wojennej
description: The XIII 5-Mile Race is a 5-nautical-mile (9260 m) race organized in Gdynia by the Gdynia Combat Ship Squadron and the Naval Officers’ Association in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Centre. The course consists of two 4630 m loops and runs along the waterfront. The start and finish are in front of the ORP Gen. K. Pułaski. The race is open to active-duty professional soldiers, civilian military employees, and civilian runners following prior verification. The event takes place in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: Distance: 5 nautical miles (9260 m)—two 4630 m loops
Start and finish in front of the ORP Gen. K. Pułaski
Coastal course in Gdynia, not certified by the PZLA
additional: Payments are processed through Przelewy24. Participants must be verified; foreign nationals may take part after prior agreement with the organizer. The participant limit is 500. Online registration, a post-race meal, and no PZLA certification.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Fram till och med 18:e maj gäller ordinarie pris (280:- för vuxna och 180:- för ungdomar/juniorer t o m 20 år och studenter).
