description: S:t Hans Extreme is a welcoming but challenging trail race at S:t Hans Backar in Lund, taking place on Thursday, 28 May 2026. The race offers several categories for different levels and ambitions: Ultra (6 hours), 10 km, 5 km and a shorter 2.5 km lap, as well as team events. The course is technical, with significant elevation gain on each lap, and suits both competitive runners and those looking for a tough training challenge. The organisers welcome everyone and provide practical information about registration, payment and start times on their information page.
course_highlights: The course runs on S:t Hans Backar: technical trail with clear climbs and descents
One lap is 2.55 km with 140 m of elevation gain (10 km = ~10.2 km, 560 m of elevation gain; 5 km = ~5.1 km, 280 m of elevation gain)
The ultra lap is 4.38 km (with an out-and-back section so runners can cheer each other on); ultra runners complete as many laps as possible within 6 hours
additional: Register via Mittlopp.se (link from the organiser’s registration page). The regular online price applies until 18/5; late online registration is available 18–25/5 at a higher price. You can also register late at Löplabbet in Lund on 26/5 from 16–18 (in-store discount), and at the event venue on 28/5 (ultra categories 13:20–13:50, other categories 16:45–18:20). Payment is preferably by Swish (Lunds OK’s Swish number: 123 303 6787); cash in exact change is accepted in exceptional cases. Runners from Lunds Orienteringsklubb pay a reduced fee (50:-). Team events: the fastest team is determined over 40 km, and there is also a team competition for the greatest total distance. Course information: lap-based course at S:t Hans Backar, 2.55 km per lap with approximately 140 metres of elevation gain; the ultra categories take place within 6 hours. Start and finish at S:t Hans Backar. Registration and payment via Mittlopp.se; Swish payment; a live results link is available on the race page. Ongoing roadworks on Svenshögsvägen between Norra Ringen and Magistratsvägen may affect access; cycling or public transport is recommended.

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and takes place on Thursday, 21 May 2026, starting at 19:00 at Lögastrand. The event offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and is suitable both for experienced runners and for those who want to jog or walk. Everyone who registers individually receives a medal, a finisher’s bag and a race bib; teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. Timing is available for the 5 km, but you can opt out when registering if you do not want your result published.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lögastrand
The course runs through central Västerås
The 5 km distance is officially measured (2.5 km is also available)
additional: Registration is online and remains open through race day, closing no later than one hour before the first start. Recommended ages: 5 km: 13 years (11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km: 11 years (7 when accompanied by an adult). Teams of five receive a picnic after finishing. Participant benefits include a medal, a finisher’s bag, the Vårruset music quiz and prizes, and a race bib. Timing is available for the 5 km but can be opted out of. Local organiser: Västerås FK (www.vasterasfriidrott.se); information about a local training meetup will be published with separate registration via Västerås FK’s registration page. The distances are 2.5 km or 5 km; a team consists of five people, and registration is available as a team or individually. Timing can be opted out of during registration. Registration is online, and a picnic is served after finishing.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
description: Take part in celebrating the life-saving act of blood donation at Blodomloppet Linköping! The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes that you can walk, jog or run, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for younger participants. The event is team- and business-friendly: many people take part in teams of five, and the race traditionally ends with a large picnic. You can register individually or as part of a team, and the organiser offers special discounts for blood donors and youth teams.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km (walk, jog or run)
Suitable for individual participants and teams (3–5 people; often teams of five)
The event ends with a large communal picnic
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (3–5 people); teams always pay for five, and you can add members to make a full team free of charge by 30 April (contact linkoping@blodomloppet.se). Youth teams (all members born in 2009 or later) pay half the entry fee until 30 April. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. The deadline for team registration is 14 May; online registration is open until the start. Everyone who registers by 14 May and provides a mobile number will receive an SMS ticket link for free travel within Östergötland for 6 hours on race day. Race bib collection: 19 May, 11:00–19:00 (GeBlod, Storgatan 32); 20 May, 12:00–18:00 (GeBlod); and 21 May, 16:00–19:00 (Saab Arena). From 1 May, some changes may require an in-person visit. Businesses can get a customer page in the registration system. Discounts for blood donors and information about training before the event are available. The team registration deadline may be in mid-May, and payment methods include Swish, card and e-invoice. The ticket provides free travel within Östergötland for up to 6 hours on race day.

name: Stigtomtaloppet 2026
location: Stigtomta, Nyköping Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Stigtomtaloppet is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta, organised by OK Hällen since 2012. The event is suitable for all ages and running abilities, with distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km, shorter children’s races, and a new dog class in 2026. The courses combine grass, trails and roads through woodland and a residential area. The event is popular with both individual runners and teams/work groups who want to compete together. Teams receive a picnic basket, which can be collected from the catering tent after finishing.
course_highlights: Course on asphalt, trails and grass through woodland and a residential area
Start and finish on the green space next to ICA Nära in Stigtomta
The hill sprint: timing on the steepest hill and prizes along the course
additional: Start times: Little Kids 17:40, Primary/Middle School Class 18:00, Dog 18:15–18:20 (fast dogs first), Adults (including team competition) 18:45. The participant bag and race bib with timing chip must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the relevant start. Teams receive a picnic basket (collected from the catering tent; drinks not included). The catering tent accepts card payments. Parking is available as directed along road 52; cycling is recommended. The dog class is limited to 30 participants, and dog owners must clean up after their dogs. A dog-friendly option will be introduced in 2026, with a separate start for runners with dogs; participants can run, have the dog pull them, or walk in Stigtomta.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas „Laisvės taku 2026“
description: Tradicinis bėgimas „Laisvės taku 2026“ vyks 2026 m. gegužės 22 d. Šimkaičių miestelyje, Jurbarko rajone, siekiant paminėti generolo Jono Žemaičio 117-ąsias gimimo metines. Tai 11 km ilgio krosas, kuris startuos nuo Generolo Jono Žemaičio vadavietės. Renginys skatina fizinį aktyvumą, sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir pagerbia Lietuvos laisvės kovotojo atminimą. Dalyviai kviečiami registruotis iš anksto ir dalyvauti bendruomeniškame sporto renginyje.
course_highlights: 11 km ilgio krosas Šimkaičių apylinkėse
Startas nuo Generolo Jono Žemaičio vadavietės
Autobusų transportas į starto vietą nuo Šimkaičių Jono Žemaičio pagrindinės mokyklos
additional: Dalyvių registracija vyksta nuo 9:00 iki 9:30 val. Numerių atsiėmimas - 2025-05-23 nuo 9:00 iki 9:30 val. Registracijos vieta - Šimkaičių Jono Žemaičio pagrindinė mokykla. Išvykimas autobusu į starto vietą 09:45 val. nuo mokyklos. Apdovanojimai numatyti 13:00 val. Dalyviai privalo turėti gydytojo leidimą arba būti pasitikrinę sveikatą. Rezultatai bus skelbiami viešai. Renginio metu bus daromos nuotraukos ir filmuojama medžiaga rinkodaros tikslais. Renginys vyks Šimkaičių Jono Žemaičio pagrindinėje mokykloje, dalyvių amžiaus grupės ir registracijos galimybė internetu.

name: If Vilniaus Pusmaratonis 2026
description: „If“ Vilniaus pusmaratonis yra didžiausia pavasario bėgimo šventė Vilniuje, vykstanti miesto senamiestyje. Renginys kviečia dalyvauti visų amžių bėgikus - nuo vaikų iki pusmaratonio distancijos dalyvių. Bėgimas skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą, fizinį aktyvumą ir bendruomeniškumą, o dalyviai gali jaustis saugiai, nes visi bėgikai yra apdrausti nuo nelaimingų atsitikimų. Renginys pasižymi įvairiomis distancijomis ir draugiška atmosfera, kuri sukuria ilgalaikius ryšius tarp dalyvių.
course_highlights: Startas Katedros aikštėje Vilniaus senamiestyje
Pusmaratonio distancija - 21,098 km
Vaikų ir jaunimo bėgimai įvairioms amžiaus grupėms
additional: Dalyviai, registruojantis iki balandžio 4 d., gauna vardinius numerius. Galima įsigyti renginio marškinėlius už papildomą mokestį. Renginyje yra vaikų bėgimai nuo 2 metų, jaunimo 4,2 km bėgimas, 5 km ir 10 km distancijos be amžiaus ribojimų. Dalyviai gauna starto paketus su laiko matavimo mikroschema. Renginio programa apima apšilimus ir apdovanojimus kiekvienai distancijai. Renginyje dalyvauja įvairaus amžiaus grupės, yra keli starto laikai ir papildomos veiklos Vilniaus mieste ir senamiestyje.

name: Atviros „Trakų Dainiaus bėgimo taurės“ 1000 m rungties varžybos
location: Trakų stadionas, Trakai, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: Atviros „Trakų Dainiaus bėgimo taurės“ 1000 m rungties varžybos yra oficialios 1000 metrų bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Trakų stadione. Renginys skirtas tiek jauniesiems sportininkams, tiek mėgėjams, norintiems išbandyti savo greitį ir patirti tikrą sportinę atmosferą. Varžybos vyksta profesionaliai paruoštoje aplinkoje su aiškia stadiono trasa. Tai puiki proga išbandyti save klasikinėje bėgimo rungtyje ir pasimėgauti sporto dvasia Trakuose.
course_highlights: 1000 metrų distancija stadiono lengvosios atletikos take
Profesionaliai paruošta trasa stadione
Varžybos vyksta Trakų stadione, Birutės g. 44
additional: Registracija vykdoma el. paštu drasutisbarkauskas@gmail.com. Renginys vyksta Trakų stadione, Birutės g. 44. Varžybos yra oficialios 1000 m rungties varžybos, skirtos tiek jauniesiems sportininkams, tiek mėgėjams. Renginys yra įtrauktas į ištvermės sporto kalendorių, o dalyviams siūloma galimybė varžytis ir mėgautis sportine atmosfera Trakuose.

name: Bėgimo varžybos Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio r. Kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams laimėti
organizer: Kupiškio r. kūno kultūros ir sporto centras
description: Bėgimo varžybos Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio rajono kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams laimėti kviečia dalyvius registruotis ir varžytis. Renginys organizuojamas Kupiškyje, siekiant skatinti sportinę veiklą ir bendruomeniškumą. Varžybos yra puiki proga pasitikrinti savo jėgas ir pasimėgauti bėgimu gražioje aplinkoje.
course_highlights: Renginys skirtas visiems amžiaus grupėms
Prizai laimėti Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio r. kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams
Vieta Kupiškis, Lietuva
additional: Renginys vyks 2027 m. gegužės 29 d., registracija vyksta internetu ir per socialinius tinklus.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Leśny Ogród Botaniczny Marszewo, Gdynia, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden in Gdynia. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Poland since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who value being close to nature and the beauty of their surroundings. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors among greenery and enjoy a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country route through the Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings and scenic beauty
Spring race as part of the Botaniczna Piątka series
additional: The race takes place between 10:00 and 14:00. The organizers are a group of running enthusiasts who focus on cross-country races and attractive locations. The event is part of a series of races held in different Polish cities during the spring season. It is open to runners of varying abilities, with the option to take part in a 5 km race. The event promotes outdoor activity and encourages local communities to take up running.

name: Pancerna Piątka
organizer: Zarząd Wojewódzki NSZZ Policjantów województwa podkarpackiego
description: Pancerna Piątka is the Podkarpackie Police Championships in the 5 km road race, held in Żurawica. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship Police Commander in Rzeszów. More than 400 participants take part, and the course follows roads through Żurawica. The event is organized by the Regional Board of the Independent Self-Governing Trade Union of Police Officers of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship.
course_highlights: 5 km road race
The course follows roads through Żurawica
The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship Police Commander in Rzeszów
additional: More than 400 participants take part. The event is organized by the Regional Board of the Independent Self-Governing Trade Union of Police Officers of the Podkarpackie Voivodeship. The race takes place on 23 May 2026, with electronic timing, and is part of local events promoting sport and physical activity.

name: Bieg Ulicą Piotrkowską Rossman Run
description: The Bieg Ulicą Piotrkowską Rossmann Run is one of Poland’s most important running events, held in central Łódź on Piotrkowska Street. Launched in 2003, the race attracts both recreational runners and leading competitors from across the country. The route runs along the city’s representative thoroughfare, and the event is accompanied by a wide range of attractions, including a food zone and a free post-race recovery meal. A Mini Run over shorter distances is organized for children and people with disabilities.
course_highlights: The route runs along Piotrkowska Street in Łódź
Start and finish near Scheiblerów Avenue, close to Poznańskich Avenue
Evening start at 19:00, with start zones assigned according to declared finish times
additional: The race office is open from Wednesday to Saturday at Łódź Fabryczna Railway Station. Bag storage and changing rooms are available at the station. Showers are available at the Well Fitness club upon presentation of a race bib. Participants can travel free of charge on Łódzka Kolej Aglomeracyjna on race day. After the race, the organizer provides a free recovery meal—a soup. Each participant can enjoy a one-hour visit to the pool and sauna area at Aquapark Fala from 20 to 25 May 2026. Accompanying persons are prohibited from travelling along the route on bicycles, scooters, or other vehicles. Traffic and public transport disruptions will occur during the race, which starts at 19:00; disruptions are expected from 18:00 to 21:30.

name: 23. Półmaraton Hajnowski
price_range: 180.00 PLN (standard), 90.00 PLN (zniżki dla mieszkańców powiatu Hajnowskiego i seniorów)
description: The 23rd Hajnówka Half Marathon is a unique and unforgettable race held in the picturesque area of Białowieża, near Hajnówka. The half-marathon route passes through the charming Municipal Park in Hajnówka, giving participants the chance to enjoy nature and beautiful views. The event is very popular and is organised by the Sports and Recreation Centre in Hajnówka, which takes care of runners’ comfort and safety. The race office is open the day before the race and on race day. Participants can expect race packs and a coffee buffet.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Municipal Park in Hajnówka
Picturesque landscapes of Białowieża and the surrounding area
A chance to enjoy nature and beautiful views
additional: The race office is open on 22 May from 15:00 to 21:00 at the Municipal Park Amphitheatre in Hajnówka, and on 23 May from 8:00 to 9:30. An ID card is required to collect the race pack. Running under another participant’s name is not permitted. Registration is not available on race day. Participants can enjoy a free coffee buffet. The route is on asphalt, with the start in Białowieża and the finish in Hajnówka. The race office is in the amphitheatre. Massages and showers are available after the race.

name: Bieg Lwa
location: Tarnów Podgórny, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg Lwa is an annual half marathon held in Tarnowo Podgórne, attracting both elite runners and amateurs. The event is known for its excellent organization, attractive course, and enthusiastic crowd support. The festival also features children’s races and various accompanying events, such as cheering competitions and concerts. Bieg Lwa is a great opportunity for sporting competition and family fun in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course in Tarnowo Podgórne
Pogoń za Lwem 10 km race course
Numerous refreshment stations along the course
additional: Option to transfer the race pack until 10 May 2026. Cheering Competition with a prize of PLN 1,000. Accompanying events: ØRGANEK concert, FOODSTIVAL, Hobby Horse Cup, and challenges on the stadium track. Major children’s races during the festival. Registration until 10 May, race and recovery packs, cheering competition, previous editions’ race sold out

description: Bieg Poznaniaka dla Przedszkolaka is a family running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in the picturesque Wielkopolski National Park and on the grounds of the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa. The program includes main races over 11 km and 5.5 km, a Nordic Walking march, and children’s and youth races over various distances. The event is charitable, with all proceeds going to support children with autism. The organizers provide electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals, and a range of activities for participants and their families, including free museum admission and outdoor games for children.
course_highlights: The main races and Nordic Walking route follow a marked loop of approximately 5.5 km in Wielkopolski National Park
Participants in the 11 km race complete the loop twice
Children’s races take place on the grounds of the National Museum of Agriculture and Agri-Food Industry in Szreniawa
additional: Electronic timekeeping is provided for all races except the virtual race. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal. Free admission to the National Museum of Agriculture and Agri-Food Industry in Szreniawa is available, along with outdoor games for children. The start area can be reached by car, by MPK bus lines 703 and 705, or by PKP train to Szreniawa station (a 150 m walk). 11 km and 5.5 km races, Nordic Walking march, children’s races, visit to the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals

name: Maraton Sztafet Ekiden
location: Kampus Główny Akademii Wychowania Fizycznego, Białołęka, Warszawa, Poland
description: The 20th Onet Marathon Relay is Poland’s largest team running event. It will take place on 23 May 2026 at the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Warsaw. This unique event brings together runners of all abilities, with six-person teams covering the marathon distance together in the Japanese ekiden relay format. The event promotes teamwork and cooperation, offering different relay-leg distances that make it easier for beginner runners to take part. It’s a great opportunity for friendly competition and bonding with friends, family or colleagues.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Main Campus of the Józef Piłsudski University of Physical Education in Białołęka
The course consists of two loops
A fast, team-friendly course for six-person teams
additional: Starts take place in waves; participants select their start time during registration. The race bib must be worn on the front of the outfit and kept visible. Participants should arrive well before the start to allow time to use the baggage drop, changing rooms and toilets. Time is measured net, from the moment each participant crosses the start line. Volunteers help with the event’s organization and atmosphere, and volunteer registration is open. The event promotes cooperation, community and team spirit, with different distances and categories for various age groups, including races for children and young people.

name: Nowomiejska Dycha
location: Nowe Miasto Lubawskie, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Nowym Mieście Lubawskim
description: Nowomiejska Dycha is a special night street race taking place on May 23, 2026, in Nowe Miasto Lubawskie. The route winds through the town’s atmospheric historic streets, offering participants a unique experience and the chance to compete for attractive prizes. The event features two races: 5 km at 18:00 and 10 km at 20:00. Both start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, post-race meals, and a great time in charming surroundings.
course_highlights: The route runs through the atmospheric historic streets of Nowe Miasto Lubawskie
Night street races starting and finishing at Nowomiejski Market Square
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
additional: Race packs include T-shirts, bags, commemorative magnets, and medals. Cash and merchandise prizes will be awarded to the top runners. Post-race meals will be available. Both races start and finish at Nowomiejski Market Square. The event combines a passion for running with joy and community in a charming small town. Night race, registration on Superczas.pl, prizes, race packs, festive atmosphere

name: Phoenix RUN
location: Smolarnia, Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Klub Biegowy Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska i Opalenicki Klub Biegacza
description: Phoenix RUN is a unique sporting event held in a scenic forest near the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. This is the second edition of the race, organized by the Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska Running Club, bringing together running and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The event offers a range of distances for adults and children, encouraging families and friends to spend time actively together. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, commemorative medals, attractive prizes, socializing, and a chillout zone.
course_highlights: 10 km main race through the forest
5 km Nordic walking for adults
Children’s races from 100 to 800 m
additional: Start and finish at the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. Children’s races start at 9:00; the main race and adult Nordic walking start at 11:00. The event offers opportunities to socialize, healthy food, a chillout zone, generous race packs, commemorative medals for all participants, attractive prizes for the top finishers, and a lottery. Events include a 10 km race, 5 km Nordic walking, and children’s races from 100 to 800 m. Participants can enjoy activities and prizes, and the forest route offers scenic views and an active day out.

description: The 7th Skaryszew Horse Run is an annual running event held at the Hubertus Horse Stud in Skaryszew. The main event is the 10 km Końska Dycha, which follows field, dirt and forest roads, offering participants a chance to enjoy nature and compete. The event promotes running as a form of active recreation and a healthy lifestyle, and brings the local community together. Children’s races are also held, making the event appealing to families.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race follows field, dirt and forest roads
Start and finish at the Hubertus Horse Stud in Skaryszew
Team classification takes competitors’ genders into account
additional: Main race limit: 150 participants. Age categories start at 16, with age-group divisions and an open classification. The team classification is based on the combined times of the four fastest runners, including at least one person of the opposite gender. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, while winners receive trophies and cash prizes in the open category. The course follows field, dirt and forest roads; registration is online and on Facebook. The outdoor event takes place whatever the weather, with prizes and medals provided.

name: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach
description: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach is an annual running event organized by the Wichrowo Forest District, attracting people who enjoy spending time actively in nature. The main event is a 10 km race through scenic forest areas. There are also races for children and young people, people with intellectual disabilities, and a Nordic walking event. The start and finish are located at the Wichrowo Forest District headquarters, and participants can take part in a familiarization run on the course.
course_highlights: The race course runs through the Wichrowo Forest District
Scenic forest trails over a distance of 10 km
Race categories for children, young people, people with disabilities, and Nordic walking
additional: The course familiarization run takes place on 6 June at 10:00. The children’s and youth races start between approximately 10:10 and 11:00. The Nordic walking event starts at 9:00 from Garnizonowa Street in Dobre Miasto and covers approximately 10 km. The start and finish of the main 10 km race are at the Wichrowo Forest District headquarters. Main race distance: 10 km; races for children and young people; Nordic walking; pre-race training; online registration until 21 May 2026; Nordic walking time limit: 2 hours.

name: XXI Cross Maraton przez Piekło do Nieba
description: The 21st Cross Marathon “Through Hell to Heaven” is a unique running event organized by the PTTK Branch in Końskie. The event will take place on May 23, 2026, and attracts both runners and recreational runners, offering a challenging route in scenic surroundings. The marathon is known for its interesting and demanding course, which passes through areas named Piekło and Niebo, underscoring its character and challenge. The organizers provide professional service and support for participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through the areas of Piekło and Niebo
Scenic landscapes around Końskie
Challenging cross-country terrain
additional: The organizer’s office is open Mondays from 13:00 to 17:00, and Tuesdays and Thursdays from 8:00 to 11:00. Telephone: +48 514 030 401. No details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees are provided on the website. Participation is open to people over 18, with various age categories and classifications. The race starts at 9:00, with an earlier start for participants expecting to finish in more than 6 hours. After the race, participants will receive medals and trophies and be served refreshments.

name: XXVIII Bieg Święców
location: Sławno, Sławno County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 28th Święcowie Run in Sławno is an annual running event taking place on May 23, 2026. The 10 km main race follows the city streets, including asphalt roads, basalt paving stones, and asphalt bike paths. The route is secured and marked, with water refreshment points along the way. The event also includes children’s and youth races at the athletics stadium over distances from 50 to 600 metres. The organizers promote community engagement and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race route (3 x 3.33 km) through the streets of Sławno: asphalt, basalt paving stones, and asphalt bike paths
Refreshment points along the route at 1.5 km, 3 km, 4.5 km, 6 km, and 7.5 km, with water served in paper cups
Children’s and youth races at the athletics stadium on a tartan track, over distances from 50 to 600 m
additional: The time limit for completing the main race is 90 minutes. Participants must follow instructions from the personnel securing the route. The children’s and youth races start at 11:00 at the athletics stadium, with distances adapted to participants’ ages. The awards ceremony will take place at the amphitheatre at 17:30. Registration is available online; the event also includes organized activities and support for runners.

name: V Ultra Nordic Walking World Records
adidas Stockholm Marathon
description: The adidas Stockholm Marathon is a classic marathon that takes place this year on 30 May 2026 and attracts both elite and recreational runners. The race is 42,195 metres long, measured according to current regulations, and follows a new course through central Stockholm. The event is organised by athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the organisers highlight extensive runner services along the course. The race starts at Stockholm Olympic Stadium and offers seeding opportunities through events including adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan.
course_highlights: 42,195 metres, measured according to the Swedish Athletics Association and IAAF
New course through central Stockholm (including Sveavägen and Kungsgatan), passing through the city
World-class runner services along the entire course
additional: Start and finish area: Lidingövägen outside the clock tower at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The race starts in two waves, at 12:00 and 12:10. The marathon time limit is 6.5 hours, and there are four checkpoints with cut-off times along the course. Seeding: the deadline for submitting a time for seeding is 3 May 2026; adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan count towards seeding. adidas Premiärmilen (10 km) takes place in Norra Djurgården, has a total elevation gain of 117 m, mixed surfaces and a provisional start time of 11:00; the time limit is 2 hours and the contact for Premiärmilen is info@premiarmilen.se. The event is organised by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the website is provided by Marathongruppen i Stockholm AB. The event is sold out for 30 May 2026. The course runs through central Stockholm and finishes at Stockholm Olympic Stadium; runners can also take part in related Adidas events such as Premiärmilen, Premiärhalvan and Shake Out Run.

name: Backyard Ultra Vänge
location: Vänge, Uppsala Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden
description: Backyard Ultra Vänge is a unique ultrarunning event organized by Hagunda IF, where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour on the hour until only one runner remains. The race takes place in Vänge, about 7 km outside Uppsala along Route 72, and combines challenging terrain with a scenic natural setting and a strong sense of community. There is also a team competition with a points system that rewards fair average times and larger teams; registration opens on 18/9, and the next race is planned for 23 May 2026.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 6.7 km (6,706 meters)
A trail race in scenic surroundings with challenging sections
A new loop starts every hour on the hour; complete it before the hour ends to continue
additional: The maximum capacity is listed as 180 participants (the page shows 179/180 places filled). The race has a team competition with a points system that removes the highest and lowest results to calculate a fair average and gives bonuses to larger teams. A loop starts every hour, and only those who complete it before the hour ends can start the next loop. Results and past races are published on the event’s results page. Capacity: 180 participants; 179 places filled and 1 place remaining.

name: Å-Varvet
description: Å-varvet in Eskilstuna is a city running race where runners can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances. The race starts and finishes in the city park in central Eskilstuna and offers a run through beautiful urban surroundings, according to official information sources. The date listed for the 2026 edition is 23 May, and the organiser is described as Eskilstuna Municipality. The official Facebook page also promotes a quarter marathon of approximately 10,549 metres, offering an additional distance option.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the city park in central Eskilstuna
Run through beautiful urban surroundings
Distance options: 5 km and 10 km (with consideration for different courses and experience levels)
additional: Official sources list the distances as 5 km and 10 km, with the start and finish in the city park. The 2026 edition is scheduled for 23 May. The Facebook page also promotes a quarter marathon of approximately 10,549 m.

name: Bėgam už Marijampolę - 2026
description: Bėgam už Marijampolę yra tradicinis, kasmetinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Marijampolėje ir suburiantis įvairaus amžiaus dalyvius. Tai ne tik varžybos, bet ir regiono gyventojų susitikimas po atviru dangumi, skatinantis aktyvų gyvenimo būdą ir bendruomeniškumą. Renginys pasižymi atnaujinta bėgimo trasa, kuri leidžia išbandyti ištvermę gražiame Lietuvos mieste. Finish in the middle of Stora Torget in Eksjö
The 10 km and 5 km courses are officially measured
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Snäckan (next to the swimming pool). Collection times: Thursday 28 May, 17:00–20:00, and Friday 29 May from 14:00. Changing facilities are available at Prästängshallen until 21:30 on race day. Late registration opens on 24 May for an increased fee and is available until one hour before the start of each race category via the same registration page. All finishers in the 600 m and 1000 m races receive a medal; finishers in the 5 km and 10 km receive a plaque. There is a sprint prize on the 10 km course after approximately 1.2 km (for the first man and woman, who must finish the race). Categories are determined by year of birth. Group registration by invoice: tavling.esik@gmail.com. Course maps can be collected at Snäckan on Thursday and Friday. Late registration opens on 24 May for an increased fee; race bibs can be collected at Snäckan by the swimming pool; parking is available at Storegårdsgatan 3A, Eksjö; changing facilities are available at Prästängshallen until 21:30 on race day.

name: adidas Shake Out Run
description: Get a taste of the unique marathon atmosphere by running the adidas Shake Out Run. The race is 5 km long, with the start and finish at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. It’s the perfect warm-up for anyone running the marathon the next day, but also an opportunity for others to experience the atmosphere during event weekend. The first 1,000 people to register are guaranteed an adidas T-shirt in their chosen size.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stockholm Olympic Stadium
5 km course—a short race that’s perfect as a warm-up
Take part for a taste of the marathon atmosphere during event weekend
additional: The race is organised by athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK. Minimum age: 13 (11 when accompanied by a guardian). The first 1,000 people to register are guaranteed an adidas T-shirt, distributed at the race; others can check at the information desk after the race to see which sizes remain. Payment options: online banking, Visa/Mastercard, Swish or invoice via Klarna. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the first start. Minimum age: 13; eco-friendly transport options to the event area (metro/bus or bicycle); registration is through a participant account; T-shirts and sizes are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis and collected at the information desk.

name: Samogitia Ultra 2027 - Where Dreams Go to Die
description: Samogitia Ultra is a unique endurance race held in the Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai, Lithuania. Participants run a 6.7 km forest trail loop every hour on the hour, continuing until only one runner remains, known as the Last Man Standing. The race challenges runners' endurance, strategy, and grit, with a minimum of 7 loops required to earn a medal. The course features about 70 meters of elevation gain per loop and is set in a beautiful natural reserve.
course_highlights: 6.7 km forest trail loop with ~70 meters elevation gain
Course runs through Germanto Landscape Reserve near Telšiai
100% forest single/double tracks and gravel, day and night same loop
additional: Runners must complete each 6.7 km loop within one hour or be eliminated. Minimum 7 loops (46.9 km) needed for award medal. Runners receive 3, 2, and 1-minute warnings before each loop. Personal tents can be set up from 6 PM the day before the race near the start gate. Toilets are available about 50 meters from base camp. Water and hot water are available at base camp. No showers, but a clean lake is nearby. Walking during the race is allowed and recommended. Personal items can be left in tents but are not the organizer's responsibility. Renginyje yra palapinių bazė ir pagalbos stotelės, tačiau yra apribojimų dėl pagalbos trasoje.

name: Vilnius 5000 2027
location: Vilnius Vingio parko stadionas, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Vilnius 5000 yra unikalios 5000 metrų bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Vilniaus Vingio parko stadione. Dalyviai turi galimybę varžytis kartu su greičiausiais Lietuvos ir užsienio bėgikais, mėgautis gyva DJ muzika ir šventiška atmosfera. Renginys siūlo įvairias rungtis, įskaitant individualius 5000 m bėgimus, 5x1000 m estafetę ir 2x400 m tėčio ir vaiko estafetę. Tai puiki proga pagerinti savo asmeninį rezultatą ir patirti nepamirštamą palaikymą bei bendruomenės dvasią.
course_highlights: Varžybos vyksta Vilniaus Vingio parko lengvosios atletikos stadione
5000 m bėgimas, 5x1000 m mišri estafetė ir 2x400 m tėčio ir vaiko estafetė
Gyva DJ muzika ir šventiška atmosfera su maisto vagonėliu po finišo
additional: Dalyviai suskirstomi į grupes pagal asmeninius rezultatus arba prognozuojamą įveikimo laiką. Elito grupių dalyviai privalo naudoti WA stadiono patvirtintus bėgimo batelius ir turėti antidopingo kursų pažymėjimą. 5x1000m estafetės komandos yra mišrios, o 2x400m tėčio ir vaiko estafetėje amžiaus ribojimų nėra. Renginio metu veiks maisto vagonėlis, o dalyviai sutinka, kad jų rezultatai ir foto/video medžiaga gali būti viešai skelbiami. Renginys vyksta Vilniaus Vingio stadione, dalyvių registracija vyksta renginio dieną, ir jame gali dalyvauti tiek profesionalūs, tiek mėgėjų bėgikai.

name: „Vilties bėgimas“
location: Klaipėdos senamiestis ir Tiltų g. 26, Klaipėda, Lithuania
description: Vilties bėgimas yra pilietinė iniciatyva, skirta kurti solidarumo ir vilties kultūrą onkologinių ligonių bei jų artimųjų palaikymui. Renginys vyksta Klaipėdos senamiestyje ir siūlo įvairias distancijas nuo 0,2 km vaikams iki pilno maratono 42,195 km. Bėgimas vyksta žiedinėmis trasomis, kurios leidžia dalyviams mėgautis miesto vaizdais ir kartu prisidėti prie svarbios socialinės misijos. Tai tradicinis renginys, suburiantis sportininkus ir bendruomenę vieningam tikslui.
course_highlights: Žiedinės trasos Klaipėdos senamiestyje
Maratonas - 8 ratai, pusmaratonis - 4 ratai
Įvairios distancijos nuo vaikų iki maratono
additional: Dalyvių registracija vyksta internetu iki gegužės 29 d. 21 val. ir išankstinė registracija bei paketų atsiėmimas Klaipėdoje gegužės 28-30 d. Renginyje yra specialios trasos vaikams, senjorams, žmonėms su negalia ir jų palaikytojams. Starto vieta ir finišas - Tiltų g. 26, Klaipėda. Renginys vyks 2027 m. birželio 5 d. Klaipėdoje, starto vieta - Klaipėdos Šventojo Pranciškaus Asyžiečio bažnyčia. Dalyvių registracija vyksta internetu ir vietoje, o renginys apima ir kitus su sveikata bei socialine gerove susijusius veiklos elementus.

name: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve

price_tiers.distance: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve

description: The 55th Arco Vara Run Around Lake Harku is a traditional 6.5 km running race taking place on 30 May 2026 at Lake Harku Beach. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its second event. There are refreshment points along the course, which is marked and secured by course marshals. Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome; they start in the last group. The event center is at the start-finish area, where race numbers are also distributed and the awards ceremony takes place.
course_highlights: A 6.5 km loop around Lake Harku
Refreshment points at the 3 km mark and at the finish
Course marshals and a marked route
additional: Race numbers will be distributed on race day from 9:30 to 11:30 at Lake Harku Beach. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the back of the race number. Participants receive a medal, sports drink and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance throughout the course. The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:00, with awards for the top 6 men and women and the age-group winners. The event has two distances and children's races; registration opens at 9:30 and the start is at 12:00. Participants can enjoy nature and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Koeru kergejõustikuvõistlused
location: Koeru KK staadion, Koeru, Järva County, Estonia
description: The Koeru athletics competition is a traditional track and field event held at the Koeru KK stadium. Men and women compete in two age groups across several events, including the 100 m, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw and 1000 m. The winner is determined by adding the points from their three best events. The competition is open to everyone, who may take part in all events. Young athletes use throwing implements appropriate for their age group.
course_highlights: Events: 100 m, long jump, shot put, discus throw, javelin throw and 1000 m
There are 4 attempts in the long jump and throwing events
The competition takes place at Koeru KK stadium
additional: In the men’s and women’s competitions, the winner of the three-event competition is awarded a cup, and places 2–6 receive medals. Winners of individual events are awarded medals. Young athletes use throwing implements appropriate for their age group. The competition takes place on 30 May 2026 at the Koeru sports track. Participants can score points across several events, and winners are awarded cups and medals.

name: Maardu kevadjooks
description: The Maardu Spring Run and Health Walk is a traditional sports day held in Maardu, bringing together people of all ages who enjoy being active. The event features several runs and health walks for different age groups and abilities, including children’s races, a youth run, a walk for people with special needs, and 3 km and 5 km runs. Participation is free, and every finisher receives a medal. The event aims to offer the joy of movement, a sense of well-being, and an active day in the fresh air, while celebrating time spent together with family and friends.
course_highlights: Several distances: 100 m children’s race, 1 km youth run, 500 m walk for people with special needs, and 3 km and 5 km runs
Health walk over a 3 km distance
Starts and activities take place on the main avenue beside the Maxima XX shopping centre
additional: Participation is free. Registration is open online until 29 May at 19:00, or at Maardu City Stadium from 14 to 29 May, 13:00–17:00. On the day of the Spring Run, on-site registration is available only for the 500 m walk for people with special needs. All finishers receive a medal. The day concludes with a lottery among participants. Registration and the award ceremony take place at the finish on race day. The event includes various running and walking distances and is intended for the whole family.

name: jooks ümber Harku järve

price_tiers.distance: Arco Vara 55. jooks ümber Harku järve 6,5 km

description: The 55th Arco Vara Run Around Lake Harku takes place on May 30, 2026, at Lake Harku beach in Tallinn. This 6.5 km race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is the series’ second event. Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome and will start in the last group. There are water stations along the course, and the event center also offers a children’s athletics workshop and pop-up shops. Participants receive a medal, chip timing, sports drink and water on the course, and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A 6.5 km loop around Lake Harku
Water stations at the 3 km mark and at the finish
Course marshals and a marked route
additional: Race numbers will be issued on event day from 9:30 to 11:30 at Lake Harku beach. Timing is provided by a chip attached to the back of the race number. Participants are provided with a medal, sports drink and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance. The awards ceremony is at 13:00. Nordic walkers start after the runners, in the last starting group. Event-day activities include children’s races, an awards ceremony, prize draws, and additional activities such as a ski jump hill and sports equipment sales. Registration is open until 2026-05-20.

name: RockRun Jarocin
description: Rock Run Jarocin is a unique running event taking place on 30 May 2026, combining sport, music and the atmosphere of Jarocin, a city known as the heart of Polish rock. The race attracts both experienced runners and newcomers, offering a route through the most interesting parts of the Jarocin municipality. It is not only a sporting competition, but also a community of enthusiasts and a great sporting adventure that stays in your memory for a long time. The event is part of the Wielkopolska Half Marathon Grand Prix and focuses on good organisation and enthusiastic support from spectators.
course_highlights: The route passes through the most interesting parts of the Jarocin municipality
The event combines sport with the atmosphere of a city of music and a rock vibe
The race is part of the Wielkopolska Half Marathon Grand Prix
additional: Details of the race pack will be revealed around 2 weeks before the race. The event offers music, spectator, photo and finisher zones. Participants will receive a medal and a T-shirt at the finish. The junior race gives children the chance to enjoy their first sporting experience and the joy of being active. The distances include 21 km, 10 km and junior races. The event uses electronic timekeeping, and the start and finish are located on Maratońska Street. Participants can register on the STS-Timing website.

name: Ultraroztocze
description: Roztocze Ultra Race is a unique running event taking place on 30 May 2026 in Józefów, in the Roztocze region. Participants can choose from a range of routes, from short night races to ultra distances of 60 km and 120 km, passing through the scenic Roztocze countryside. The event is organised by the Janosik Race Series Foundation, which has promoted an active and mindful lifestyle through sport since 2014. The race attracts both recreational and experienced runners, offering unforgettable experiences and a chance to connect with nature.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the scenic Roztocze countryside, including forests and rolling hills
Distances range from short night races to an ultra of 120 km
Scenic views and varied terrain, including forest paths, trails and dirt roads
additional: The event offers a range of distances, including night races and ultra distances. The organiser provides race shirts for participants. The event takes place in the scenic Roztocze region, and the routes are marked and secured. The start and finish are located in Józefów. Various forms of support and refreshment stations are available along the route. Ultra distances, mountainous terrain, online registration, various distances

name: 13 Bieg Konopielki
organizer: Ośrodek Kultury w Gminie Juchnowiec Kościelny
description: The 13th Bieg Konopielki is an annual running event held in Juchnowiec Dolny, scheduled for May 30 in 2026. The main 10 km race starts at noon, preceded as tradition dictates by the Family Run. After the sporting competition, participants are invited to a social gathering in Frampol, the birthplace of Edward Redliński, author of the novel "Konopielka." The race pack includes a soft blanket that can be used for a picnic after the race. The event has a family-friendly, literary atmosphere, making it unique.
course_highlights: 10 km main race course
Family Run of approximately 200 m
Social gathering in Frampol featuring a literary touch and regional dishes
additional: The race pack includes a soft blanket to use for a picnic after the race. After the race, the program includes a gathering with regional dishes, visits to Ranczo Frampol and the Edward Redliński House of Creativity, a draw for book prizes, and a music concert. Registration for the main race is also available at the Race Office on the day of the event, while places in the Family Run are limited. 10 km course, Family Run, gathering in Frampol, race packs with blankets

name: 8 Borowiacka Dycha
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Tuchola Forests. The event attracts runners who enjoy being close to nature and taking part in a sporting competition on a moderately challenging course. The organizers, Stowarzyszenie Biegające Śliwice, ensure professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere for participants. The race is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich, underscoring its importance in the local running calendar.
course_highlights: The course passes through the picturesque Tuchola Forests
A 10 km distance with a moderate level of difficulty
Part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich
additional: The race is organized by Stowarzyszenie Biegające Śliwice, which promotes an active lifestyle and running. The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich series. A contact form and race updates are available on the website. The event also includes races for children, who receive medals and sweets. Registration is open, and participants can look forward to sporting competition and a good time.

name: Bieg Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema
description: Bieg Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema is a 10 km road race taking place on 30 May 2026 in Żelkowo, in Kashubia. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for the race with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers encourage participants to use the training plans and expert support to prepare optimally for the race. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, a platform supporting runners across Poland.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Scenic Kashubia as the race setting
Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to VDOT level
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, with instructions and expert support. Organizers can manage the race listing and explore marketing collaboration. The platform also offers a runner’s zone with tools for tracking progress and following training plans. Registration for the race opened on 10 April 2026, and the event is part of local initiatives promoting physical activity and Kashubian culture.

name: Biegowe Grand Prix Mazur
location: Sorkwity, Mrągowo County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Silent Hill Resort Sp. z o.o.

description: The Masurian Running Grand Prix is a series of races held in the picturesque Masuria region, promoting running close to nature. The routes lead through forests and along lakes, offering participants the chance to experience the beauty of the natural surroundings. The event attracts runners who enjoy outdoor activities and the charm of Masuria’s landscapes.
course_highlights: Routes through the forests of Masuria
Races along lakes
Close contact with nature and picturesque landscapes
additional: Free races are available for children and young people. Online registration is open until May 27, 2026. Various distances; surfaces include asphalt and forest roads. Online payment is available.

name: Dolska Dycha
location: ul. Kościelna, Dolsk, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Centrum Promocji, Kultury i Sportu w Dolsku
price_range: 50 zł do 28.05.2026, 80 zł w biurze (Dolska Dycha); 25 zł do 28.05.2026, 40 zł w biurze (Kozia Trójka)
description: Dolska Dycha is a 10 km road race taking place on 30 May 2026 in Dolsk. The course is certified by PZLA and marked every kilometre. It runs on roads closed to traffic within the Dolsk municipality. The event also includes a 3 km race, “Kozia Trójka.” Runners can expect refreshment points, medical care and a post-race recovery meal. The event aims to promote running and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the city and municipality of Dolsk.
course_highlights: Course certified by PZLA
Kilometre markers and volunteers at points where navigation is difficult
The race takes place on roads closed to traffic
additional: The race office is open on 30 May 2026 from 16:00 to 17:30 at Janusz Kusociński Primary School, ul. Kościańska 4, Dolsk. Race packs may be collected by a third party or transferred to another person. No baggage deposit is available for participants. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes for the 10 km race and 60 minutes for the 3 km race. Runners are placed at the start according to age category and declared pace. A water station is located at the 5 km mark. The start and finish are on ul. Kościelna in Dolsk, near Janusz Kusociński Primary School. The event also includes races for various age categories and an open category, with medals and prizes available.

name: Kresowe Trail #6
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of intimate trail races held amid the scenic natural landscapes of Eastern Poland and the Vilnius Region. The courses are marked according to cycling standards, making navigation easier. Distances include the shorter Szpurt (approx. 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), which features elements of ultra trail. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature and local communities, and a sense of community among runners through a shared spirit of passion, competition and friendship. The competition runs throughout the season and concludes with overall and team standings.
course_highlights: Courses marked with arrows and ribbons according to cycling standards
Distances: Szpurt (approx. 7 km) and Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), with elements of ultra trail
Races take place in the forest, surrounded by unspoiled nature and scenic views
additional: The races have a limited number of participants to ensure safety and quality organization. The organizer is the Maratony Kresowe Foundation from Białystok. Competition is held in age-group and team categories, with awards presented at each stage. The courses include climbs, sand and roots, adding to the challenge. The event aims to promote an active lifestyle and sport in the region; registration details are not yet available.

It is an event for running enthusiasts who want to discover lesser-known natural areas and take on off-road challenges. The organizers, the Janosik Race Series Foundation, ensure professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.

Ultra distances available: 60 km (Roztoczańska Trzydziestka Ultra) and 120 km (Mega Ultra)
A variety of courses, from short races to challenging ultras, including the Półmaraton Bobrowisko and Nocna Trójka Roztoczańska
additional: The event is organized by the Janosik Race Series Foundation, which has been active since 2014. Courses cover various distances, including night races and ultras. Professional organization is provided, along with access to a photo gallery and online results. Events include different distances and types of competition, with the option to participate in several events during the same season. Participants can use GPX files, detailed instructions, and online briefings. The event is very popular and highly organized.

name: XI Bieg Memoriałowy
description: The 11th Adam Lewandowski Memorial Run in Orchowo is an annual running event organized by the Orchowo Municipality. The race commemorates Adam Lewandowski and attracts runners from various age categories. The event takes place in Orchowo and is an opportunity for sporting competition and for bringing the local community together. The organizers warmly invite all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: A 10 km race through the scenic surroundings of Orchowo
Online registration makes it easy to take part
Organized by the Orchowo Municipality, promoting sport and community integration
additional: The event is part of local sports initiatives, encourages physical activity, and commemorates runners who have made a significant contribution.

name: XV Kwidzyński Bieg Papiernika
organizer: MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. oraz Fundacja Opiekuńcza MM Kwidzyn
description: The 15th Kwidzyn Paper Run is an annual running event founded in 2010 out of a passion for running and promoting physical activity for health and enjoyment. The 10 km race runs through the centre of Kwidzyn and brings together the local community and runners from across Poland. The event accompanies Paper Maker’s Day, a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees, and participation in the race and other attractions is free of charge. The organisers are MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. and the MM Kwidzyn Care Foundation.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through the centre of Kwidzyn
Two checkpoints and two water stations along the route
Safety and comfort provided throughout the route
additional: The event accompanies Paper Maker’s Day—a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees—with a range of all-day attractions. The schedule includes the opening of the race office, a group warm-up, the main race, the awards ceremony and a children’s race. Participation in all attractions is free of charge. Photos and video footage will be taken during the race for promotional purposes. The event takes place on 30 May 2026, with online registration available. It runs all day and offers attractions for participants and their families.

name: Markaryds Sparbankloppet
location: Markaryd, Markaryds Municipality, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: Markaryd Savings Bank Run is a long-distance race held in Markaryd alongside the bank’s anniversary celebrations and the spring market. The race is mentioned as part of the anniversary programme and is being planned together with other activities during the anniversary year. According to sources, participation is funded through a registration fee that benefits local associations, making the race an initiative that strengthens the community. The event is presented as a welcoming opportunity to take part in a local setting and contribute to community life.
course_highlights: Held in May in Markaryd, alongside the spring market
Part of Markaryd Savings Bank’s 150th anniversary programme, which includes several activities
The registration fee supports local associations
additional: Register by filling in the form on the registration page. The race date is 2026-05-30, and the deadline for advance registration is 2026-05-27. Start lists will be published closer to race day (an archived 2025 start list is available). The Savings Bank Run is mentioned as an activity with a registration fee that benefits participating associations; planned anniversary activities include lectures, a treasure hunt and a family day.

name: Öland Lighthouse Challenge
price_range: 1490 kr/100 miles, 990 kr/50 miles, 590 kr/50 km
description: Öland Lighthouse Challenge is an ultramarathon on Öland, starting at Långe Erik Lighthouse. The race is offered over three distances—50 km, 50 miles and 100 miles—and follows coastal routes, meadows and woodland, with views of the Alvar and the Baltic Sea. The event is well organised, with water and aid stations along the course; all finishers receive a medal and a T-shirt. The organiser is Högby IF, and the event is suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and distance-trained recreational runners.
course_highlights: Start at Långe Erik Lighthouse, followed by coastal running along the Kalmar Strait to Sandvik (finish for the 50 km)
Route through meadows and woodland to Lindby (finish for the 50 miles), continuing to Långe Jan for the 100 miles
Views of the Alvar and the Baltic Sea; water and aid stations approximately every 20 km
additional: Bib collection on Friday from 13:30; race information, course maps and a GPX file (updated) are available on the race website; drop-bag labels are provided; all finishers receive a medal and T-shirt; 15% accommodation discount at Böda Sand (mention Lighthouse Challenge when booking); payment for late registration/bib collection: cash, card or Swish. Information about training and runs is available; aid stations approximately every 20 km; 15% accommodation discount at Böda Sand for the weekend (mention Lighthouse Challenge when booking); start at Långe Erik and finish at Långe Jan; medal and T-shirt included in the entry fee; late registration possible until 27 May, according to the race information.

name: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra
organizer: Highland Trail Club and Höglandskyrkan i Sävsjö
description: Welcome to Highland Charity Backyard Ultra in Sävsjö—a charitable and challenging backyard ultra organized in collaboration between Höglandskyrkan in Sävsjö and Highland Trail Club. The race is run in timed laps, with a mass start at 09:00 and a new start every hour on the hour. Anyone who cannot complete a lap within 60 minutes is out. Participants can choose between an easy 3.7 km loop around the lake and the tougher 6.7 km Bäckaskogsrundan. Proceeds from the race go to charitable causes.
course_highlights: 3.7 km around the lake (gravel road, trail, asphalt)—an easy course with good footing
6.7 km Bäckaskogsrundan (gravel road, forest trail)—technical, hilly forest running
Lap format: a new start every hour on the hour; 15 laps correspond to approximately 55 km or 100 km, respectively
additional: Parking at the Slottsruinen car park (toilets available); race bib, water bottle, food, and coffee and a bun are included in the entry fee. Food is served to participants at 11:30, 15:30, and 19:30. Race bibs can be collected from 07:30 to 08:30 on race morning. Late registration is open May 24–May 30 at 08:30 (late registration fee: 350 kr). The winner is the last person remaining to complete a lap, or the first to finish lap 15 if several participants remain. Participants choose their distance before each hourly start; prizes are awarded only to those running the longer course. Backyard Ultra format with two distances; maximum 15 laps; start at 09:00 and finish no later than 00:00; advance registration and late registration available until race day; start and finish area at the Slottsruinen car park in Sävsjö.

name: Läänemaa sörgib ühissörk
description: Läänemaa Sör gib ühissörk (Läänemaa Community Jog) is a cheerful, relaxed family event taking place on May 31 at Haapsalu railway station. The community jog covers approximately 3+ kilometres at an easy running pace (~7:30 min/km) and welcomes everyone in Läänemaa who enjoys being active. The event is the grand finale of a campaign that brings together the various jogs held across the county during May.
