Warming up on the course during the race is prohibited; warm-up trainers are available free of charge at the race centre. Traffic is controlled on the race courses, but most of the route is not closed to cars. Participants must follow traffic laws and keep to the right-hand side of the road. The series’ Kullapada rewards programme recognises consistent participation at every stage. Several stages and participant categories, prizes and medals, the detailed schedule and registration are available on the website. The event takes place on Wednesday evenings and offers various distance options.

name: Blodomloppet Stockholm
description: Blodomloppet Stockholm is a festive community race held to highlight the need for blood donation. The event offers 5 km and 10 km distances for runners and walkers, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for children, and traditionally ends with a picnic. Timed race categories are available, with prizes for the three fastest runners. Everyone is welcome—run, jog or walk for an important cause.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km options to walk, jog or run
5 km walking category where dogs are allowed
Lilla Blodomloppet for children: 1.1 km (ages 7–12) and 800 m (ages 1–6)
additional: A team consists of 5 people (at least 3 names are required at registration), and team registration must be completed by 28 May; team registration includes a picnic bag. Extra picnic bags cost SEK 250 and can be added until 28 May. Blood donors receive a SEK 40 discount (state this at registration) and a blood donor gift is distributed at the GeBlod tent; remote participants receive an ICA gift card (SEK 250) instead of a picnic bag. Invoice payment is available only for orders over SEK 1,500. Walking poles are allowed only in walking categories; strollers are not allowed during the race but are welcome in the event area. Venue at Djurgårdsbrunn; the start corral opens approximately 20 minutes before the start; the walking category is untimed; no access to changing rooms or showers; blood donors receive a registration discount (SEK 40).

name: Valgamaa lahtised MV
description: The Valgamaa Open Championships in Orienteering Sprint is an orienteering competition held in the Valga area. The event is part of the RMK Eestimaa Orienteering Series, family events with no age restrictions. The courses are designed for participants of different skill levels, and competitors can choose their own pace. Timing is used, and an SI card can be rented if needed to help with orienteering. The event is for everyone who wants to enjoy outdoor activity and orienteering in good company.
course_highlights: Orienteering sprint in the Valga area
Courses suitable for participants of different skill levels
SI card available to rent; compass can also be used
additional: The competition is part of the RMK Eestimaa Orienteering Series, family events with no age restrictions. Competitors are advised to wear sports clothing and bring a compass and an SI card, which can also be rented if needed. Timing is used, but competing is not compulsory; the emphasis is on enjoying outdoor activity and choosing a comfortable pace. Participants can take part in different distances and enjoy Estonian nature and sport. The competitions are open to different age groups and offer a variety of sporting experiences.

name: Wydminy Night Run 5K
location: Wyspa Wydmińska, Wydminy, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Wydminy Night Run 5K is a night race held on Wydmińska Island in Wydminy. The event attracts runners who want to take on a 5-kilometer course in scenic surroundings. The race is recreational and sporting in nature, and offers a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers promise a unique atmosphere and unforgettable experiences during the night run.
course_highlights: A 5 km course on Wydmińska Island
A night race in scenic natural surroundings
Organized as part of the local community of the Wydminy Municipality
additional: The event takes place in the evening, starting at 19:00 and ending by 23:00. Registration opens on 20 April 2026. Participants can look forward to the atmosphere of night running in the beautiful scenery of Wydminy.

name: III Ryszewkowy Bieg o Puchar Strażaka
Narva Linna Jooks
description: Narva City Run is Ida-Virumaa’s largest sporting event. It encourages people to take up physical activity and showcases the region on Estonia’s cultural and sporting scene. The beautiful route through the border city, with its rich history, attracts participants from Narva, elsewhere in Virumaa, across Estonia and abroad. The event takes place by the Joaoru beach building and recreation area, offering a varied and engaging running experience.
course_highlights: A beautiful route through the border city of Narva
Held as Ida-Virumaa’s largest sporting event
Participants from the local area and abroad
additional: The event takes place on 5 June 2026, starting at 17:30, by the Joaoru beach building and recreation area at Linnuse tn 2, 20308 Narva. The entry fee is 25 euros and covers various distances and the children’s run. The route passes through Narva’s scenic spots, and the event is part of the Ida-Virumaa sports events series.

name: Olimpinės dienos bėgimo renginiai
description: Olimpinės dienos bėgimo renginiai Kaune kviečia miesto gyventojus ir svečius dalyvauti įvairiose nemokamose sporto veiklose. Renginyje siūlomos skirtingos bėgimo distancijos: 500 metrų vaikų bėgimas, 1988 metrų lietuviškos olimpinės mylios bėgimas, 5 ir 10 kilometrų varžybos. Be bėgimo, dalyviai gali išbandyti ekstremalų bėgimą su kliūtimis, orientavimosi sportą ir 3×3 krepšinio turnyrą. Šis renginys siekia suburti bendruomenes ir skatinti aktyvų gyvenimo būdą, kartu suteikiant galimybę susitikti su profesionaliais sportininkais ir olimpiečiais.
course_highlights: 500 metrų vaikų bėgimas
1988 metrų lietuviška olimpinė mylia
5 ir 10 kilometrų varžybos
additional: Renginyje dalyviams bus išdalinta daugiau nei 15 tūkst. prizų. Taip pat galima dalyvauti edukaciniuose ir olimpinio švietimo renginiuose, žaidimuose bei susitikti su olimpiečiais. Renginys yra nemokamas ir orientuotas į masiškumą bei bendruomenių subūrimą. daugiau nei 100 veiklų, bėgimai, turnyrai, edukaciniai renginiai, koncertas, kino seansas

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
location: Jaanikese Moto- ja Vabaajakeskus, Jaanikese, Tartu County, Estonia
description: The Jaanikese Cross-Country Run is the second event in the running series and takes place at the Jaanikese Moto and Recreation Centre. The course features varied terrain suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event offers the chance to enjoy a sporting competition in beautiful natural surroundings and is part of the centre’s active running and cycling trail network.
course_highlights: A varied running course on the grounds of the Jaanikese Moto and Recreation Centre
The route includes a hiking trail, cycling trail and running trail
Scenic views and varied terrain
additional: The cross-country run is part of the running and cycling trail network at the Jaanikese Moto and Recreation Centre, which also has a hiking trail and disc golf facilities. The centre has a history room and a café, open on training days. The event is organised by Valga Sport and is part of a larger set of sporting events where participants can also enjoy activities such as motocross and disc golf.

name: Narva Linna Jooks - 5 km ja 21,1 km
description: The Narva City Run is Ida-Viru County’s largest mass-participation sporting event. It takes place on June 5 and 6 at Joaorg in Narva. The two-day event features a mile race around Town Hall Square on Friday, followed by the main races on Saturday, including the 5 km and 21.1 km distances. This year’s course is flatter, allowing runners to achieve faster times, and the competition also serves as the Estonian Road Mile Championships. The Narva City Run brings thousands of recreational runners and elite athletes to the course, offering a great mass-participation sporting experience.
course_highlights: The flat course allows runners to achieve faster times
The mile race takes place around Town Hall Square on Friday
The main races, over 5 km and 21.1 km, take place on Saturday
additional: The event center is at Town Hall Square. The mile race takes place around the square on Friday, with the start and finish beside the square. The Narva City Run also hosts the Estonian Road Mile Championships. The two-day program features a thoughtfully designed course with sights along the way. More than 3,000 participants are expected. Entry fees were not mentioned.

name: Ida-Virumaa staadioniultra
location: Kohtla-Nõmme Kooli staadion, Kohtla-Nõmme, Ida-Virumaa, Estonia
description: The 5th Kohtla-Nõmme Stadium Ultra, also known as the 6th Ida-Viru County Stadium Ultra, is an ultrarunning event held at Kohtla-Nõmme School Stadium. The race starts at 12:00 on June 6 and continues until midday on June 7, giving participants the opportunity to test their endurance and running ability over an extended period. The event is organized by MTÜ Gurmeejooksud, who welcome all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy the sporting experience.
course_highlights: The race takes place at Kohtla-Nõmme School Stadium
The event lasts 24 hours, from midday on June 6 until midday on June 7
A well-known ultrarunning event in the Ida-Viru County region
additional: The race starts at 12:00 on June 6 and continues until midday on June 7 (24 hours). The event is organized by MTÜ Gurmeejooksud. The race takes place at Kohtla-Nõmme School Stadium, Kooli tn 6, Kohtla-Nõmme, Ida-Viru County. Stadium, ultramarathon, 308 m laps, 12-hour result, Estonian Championships

name: Luhamaa piirijooks
description: Luhamaa Border Run is part of the Võrumaa Running and Walking Series, offering a range of distances for both runners and walkers. The main course is approximately 5.9 km long and runs on asphalt around the Luhamaa village community centre. There are also shorter mini-distances and children’s runs, suitable for participants of all ages. The series aims to offer a sporty and friendly race experience amid Võrumaa’s beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: The main course runs on asphalt around the Luhamaa village community centre
Mini-distances and children’s runs are suitable for beginners and children
The course is mostly paved with asphalt, making it well suited to fast running
additional: The entire course is on asphalt. The children’s runs take place in Kesklinna Park and around EWERS in Väimela. The event is part of the 12-stage Võrumaa Running and Walking Series, which offers various distances and walking options. Information on entry fees and registration; transport arranged; the course partly runs through an area that is not normally accessible to the public.

name: Padise liigub
location: Lääne-Harju Kultuurikeskus Padise rahvamaja, Padise, Lääne-Harju, Estonia
description: Padise liigub is part of the Lääne-Harju movement series and takes place at the Lääne-Harju Cultural Centre Padise Community House. The course runs through Padise’s beautiful countryside, offering excitement and scenic views for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers. The event is suitable for the whole family; alongside the 5 km main distance, children’s races are also scheduled. It’s a wonderful opportunity to enjoy being active in a historic and naturally beautiful setting.
course_highlights: The course runs through Padise’s beautiful countryside
Suitable for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers
Children’s races are held alongside the 5 km main distance
additional: The event centre opens at 10:00; race-number collection and registration take place before the start. Children’s races begin at 11:00, warm-up exercises at 11:45, and the main-distance start is at 12:00. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:50 and the finish closes at 13:15. The route is scenic and suitable for all levels; registration is available on the day of the event from 10:00. The event includes children’s races and a 5 km main distance.

name: Jaanikese jooksukross
description: The II Jaanikese Cross-Country Run takes place on 6 June 2026 at the Jaanikese Moto and Recreation Centre and is part of the Rein Leppik Memorial Valgamaa Running and Walking Series. The event features several distances, including children’s races, a 2.7 km run and walk, and the 5.4 km main race. The routes follow the cross-country track, giving participants the chance to enjoy a sporting competition across different age groups. The event is organised by the Valgamaa Sports Association, which welcomes everyone interested in running to take part and enjoy an active day.
course_highlights: Races take place on the Jaanikese cross-country track
Several distances, from children’s races to the 5.4 km main race
The course follows a cross-country track, offering varied terrain
additional: Pre-registration is available online at www.timesport.ee. On-site registration opens at 10.30. Electronic timing is provided from the 2019–2020 age group onward. Awards are presented in all age groups, and prizes are awarded to the top three overall finishers in the 5.4 km main race. Children’s races are free of charge. The event takes place on 6 June 2026 and is open to everyone interested in running, offering an opportunity to enjoy nature and take part in recreational sport.

name: SunRun
description: SunRun Saaremaa 2026 is a team running adventure set amid Saaremaa’s beautiful natural scenery. The race starts at sunrise in Kuressaare and finishes at sunset at Illiku laid in Orissaare, covering a total of 180 km. All groups, circles of friends and sports clubs can take part by forming a team and sharing the distance among themselves. The aim is not to win, but to enjoy running together with friends at a comfortable pace. Each participant receives a GPS wristband that serves as a relay baton, and there are refreshment and water stations along the route.
course_highlights: A 180 km route from Kuressaare to Orissaare
15 stages, with the GPS wristband serving as the relay baton
Beautiful running trails and coastline on Saaremaa
additional: The race starts on 6 June at 4:30 in front of the Wow Centre in Kuressaare. Each team receives a GPS wristband, which must be handed to the next runner at points of their choosing. There are water stations along the route, as well as hot soup, tea and bread along the way, and shower facilities at the finish. The finish is at Illiku laid, where a summer starting-party takes place. Changing runners along the route is prohibited. Support vehicles must comply with Estonian traffic regulations. The route includes Saaremaa’s landscapes and coastal roads; registration requires the use of a GPS device and the race kit. The event takes place on 6 June 2026, starting in Kuressaare at 4:30.

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: The 4th Skolwińska Mile is an annual street race held in Szczecin, attracting both adults and children. The event takes place on June 13, 2026, and continues the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the chance to compete over a short distance. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide an easy way to get in touch via the entry form, as well as administrative support.
course_highlights: A 1-mile (1,609-meter) course in a scenic recreational area
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the top finishers and medals for everyone who finishes
additional: The event also includes children's races over a distance of approximately 200 meters. Participants can use the entry form available on the website to contact the organizer and system administrator quickly. Participants can use training plans lasting from 8 to 20 weeks. The event is supported by a local building-supply store, and the participant limit is 60.

name: Poznańska Piwna Mila #19
description: The Poznań Beer Mile is an annual cross-country race held in Poznań, attracting runners who appreciate scenic routes and a sporting atmosphere. The event is part of a series of races organized by enthusiasts from the Greater Poland region, who have been promoting running and the beauty of local areas since 2014. The race features start groups with participant limits, allowing for a comfortable experience and good organization. Particular emphasis is placed on the scenic qualities of the route and bringing runners together.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Start groups capped at 60 participants
Routes with scenic appeal and a sporting character
additional: Starts take place in waves every 20 minutes from 12:00 to 15:40, including two HARD waves and a “0%” group. Each group is limited to 60 participants. The schedule of group starts with participant limits, and the event on a summer evening promotes activity and having fun.

name: Półmaraton Kurpiowski Pśejåk Bieg Szlakiem Schronów Bojowych SGO "Narew"
description: The Kurpiowski Pśejåk Half Marathon follows the route of the SGO "Narew" combat bunkers in Nowogród. The half-marathon course passes through historic areas dotted with numerous combat bunkers, giving the race a unique character and combining sport with history. The event attracts runners who value both off-road challenges and the atmosphere of the Kurpiowszczyzna region. It is an excellent opportunity to spend time actively and learn about local history.
course_highlights: The course follows the route of the SGO "Narew" combat bunkers
The race takes place in the picturesque Kurpiowszczyzna region
A 21.097 km half marathon combining sport with history
additional: The event includes races over various distances, including a half marathon and shorter distances, with options for different age groups. The race promotes local history and nature, and participants can look forward to attractive routes and an atmosphere conducive to sporting competition.

name: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84
description: Cross Maraton u Ryśka vol 84 is a race held in Wieluń and part of Liga Biegowa, a platform promoting physical activity and running competitions in Poland. The event is open to runners at various distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and marathon. Liga Biegowa allows participants to earn points and compete in numerous rankings throughout the year, encouraging regular running and athletic development. The race is open and inclusive, welcoming both recreational and more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Marathon distance (42 km)
Scenic route in Wieluń
Annual traditional running event
additional: Liga Biegowa is a year-round running platform that automatically records results for races at 5 km, 10 km, half-marathon and marathon distances, converts them into points and enables competition in numerous rankings. Participants can create private leagues and access materials on training, diet and sports psychology. No details are available about the route, registration or other notes concerning this specific race.

name: Nocna Dycha Kopernika Bieg z Panem Kleksem
description: Nocna Dycha Kopernika is a unique street race held in the magical setting of Toruń, the city of Copernicus. Participants can choose from the 10 km and 5 km distances, Nordic Walking, and a special children’s race, “Odkrywcy Mocy” (“Discoverers of Power”). The event takes place at night, giving it a distinctive atmosphere and appeal. The start and finish are located in the city, and the organizers provide full logistical support and attractive race packs.
course_highlights: A night race through the streets of Toruń, the city of Copernicus
10 km start at Galeria Copernicus; finish at the Municipal Stadium
Available events: 10 km, 5 km, Nordic Walking, and children’s races
additional: The race office is open on June 6, 2026, from 15:00 to 21:00 at Galeria Copernicus, next to the Decathlon store. A baggage drop is available at the start, with bags transported to the finish. The 10 km starts at Galeria Copernicus; the 5 km and Nordic Walking start from Józef Piłsudski Bridge (Camping Tramp). The finish is at the Municipal Stadium. Time limits are 1 hour 20 minutes for the 10 km, 50 minutes for the 5 km, and 60 minutes for Nordic Walking. PZLA-certified courses; fast, flat routes; 22:00 start; various distances; children’s race; medals and prizes; opportunity to take a guided walk.

name: Söder Runt
description: Söder Runt is a 10 km evening race that makes a lap around Södermalm and is consistently described as both scenic and very fast. The fourteenth edition takes place on Saturday, 6 June 2026, with the first start provisionally scheduled for 19:45. The course is officially measured, flat and easy to run along the water, making the race popular with people aiming for personal bests. After the finish, an After Run party is held with food, drinks and music.
course_highlights: 10.00 km around Södermalm along the water
Flat, easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel
Water stations after 4 km and at the finish
additional: Age limit: 14 (18 for the After Run); strollers and dogs are not permitted; everyone who completes the race receives a medal and products at the finish; the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation; volunteers are mainly from Löparakademin and Fredrikshofs FIF; payment via online banking, card, Swish, or invoice/bankgiro for larger group registrations. Start at Tantolunden; finish at Hornstulls strand; flat course on asphalt and gravel; age limit: 18; strollers and dogs not permitted; After Run party; sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation.

name: Fiskebäcksloppet 2026 (Önnered)
description: Fiskebäcksloppet is Räddningsmissionen’s running festival in the Sjöbacka nature area, taking place on Saturday, 6 June 2026. The event offers several distances: 10 km (Tre hamnar), 5 km (Sjöbacka), 2.5 km (Lilla Fiskebäcksloppet) and a mini race. The course passes through three harbours and features beautiful scenery. All entry fees go directly to Räddningsmissionen’s social work, and the event welcomes both first-time and returning runners.
course_highlights: The course passes through three harbours
Beautiful scenery in the Sjöbacka nature area
Several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km and a mini race (approx. 500 m)
additional: The event area is open from 11:30 to 17:00. Race bibs can be collected on site. There will be a group warm-up and an awards ceremony on stage. Marshals, medical staff and traffic stewards will be on site. Facilities include bicycle parking, toilets, a bouncy castle and bag drop. A team competition is available, and participants can start their own fundraiser for Räddningsmissionen. The course passes three harbours. The event area is open from 11:30 to 17:00, with race-bib collection, food for purchase, a group warm-up, an awards ceremony, a bouncy castle, medical staff and traffic stewards. Participants can also take part in the team competition and start their own fundraiser for Räddningsmissionen’s social work.

name: Victorialoppet 2026
location: Kungsgatan, Borgholms Idrottsplats, Borgholm, Kalmar County, Sweden

price_tiers.distance: Lilla Victorialoppet (2 km / 1,5 km) & Parasport (2 km)

description: Victorialoppet in Borgholm is Öland’s big running festival, offering races for the whole family—from Mini for the very youngest to the 9 km main race. The running event has a long tradition and donates part of its surplus to Crown Princess Victoria’s Fund; a virtual running option is also available. The Mini, Lilla and Victoriajoggen races start on Kungsgatan by Borgholm’s sports ground, and the event has a festive atmosphere with spectators, music and seaside views. Participants can find information about bib collection, changing facilities and prizes in the participant information.
course_highlights: The main race has a fast, easy-to-run course
Beautiful seaside views, with the courses running mostly through the harbour area
Enthusiastic spectators and music entertainment at several points along the course
additional: Bib collection on race day at Borgholm Sporthall, 10:00–18:00. There is water along the 9 km course, with music entertainment at several locations. Prizes and commemorative plaques/medals are awarded by category (Victorialoppet receives a commemorative plaque; Victoriajoggen and para categories receive a medal; Lilla Victorialoppet receives a medal, ice cream and a drink). Changing rooms and showers: men/boys at Borgholm Sporthall; women/girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Timing uses a disposable chip where timing is offered. Standard fees apply from 15 June, and late registration on 15 July has higher fees. Check-in deadlines: 9 km by 18:00, 4 km by 16:45, and 2 km/1.5 km at least 15 minutes before the start.

name: Usedom Beach Marathon - 6. Juni 2026
price_range: 42€ für den Marathon, 99€ für die Staffel
description: The Usedom Beach Marathon is Germany’s first beach marathon and takes place on June 6, 2026, on the island of Usedom. The races run exclusively on sand along the Baltic Sea coast, with no asphalt or road traffic, offering a unique nature and running experience right by the sea. Choose from the marathon, half marathon, 10 km short distance, or marathon relay. The event combines a sporting challenge with a special beach atmosphere and a professional program in the finish area in Ahlbeck.
course_highlights: Run exclusively on sand, with no asphalt or road traffic
Start in Zinnowitz, finish in Ahlbeck (marathon)
11 aid stations with water, sports drink, bananas, gels, and cola
additional: The marathon has a time limit of 7 hours (finish cutoff at 16:00). After the time limit, course support and refreshments are no longer provided. The relay consists of 5 legs, with at least 3 runners per team, and categories for women’s, men’s, and mixed teams. Start areas are in Zinnowitz, Koserow, or Ahlbeck, with a shared finish area in Ahlbeck. The finish area hosts a professional program with entertainment and information from 10:00 to 18:00. Run on sand, no asphalt course, start and finish areas in Zinnowitz, Koserow, or Ahlbeck, refreshments, medal, certificate, and shuttle transfers included.

name: Bėgimas Tėvo dienos proga 2026
description: Bėgimas Tėvo dienos proga Tauragėje yra šventinis renginys, kviečiantis dalyvauti visus bėgimo entuziastus kartu su šeima ir draugais. Tai puiki proga paminėti Tėvo dieną aktyviai ir smagiai, dalyvaujant miesto šventėje. Renginys vyksta Tauragės miesto šventės metu, suteikiant galimybę patirti bendruomeniškumą ir sportinę dvasią.
course_highlights: Šventinis bėgimas Tauragės miesto šventės metu
Draugiška atmosfera šeimoms ir draugams
Galimybė aktyviai paminėti Tėvo dieną
additional: Renginys yra dalis Tauragės miesto šventės, vyks lauke, ir skatina aktyvų laisvalaikį bei šeimų dalyvavimą.

name: 5000 m bėgimo varžybos „Vilnius 5000“.
description: Vilnius 5000 yra unikalios 5000 metrų bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios Vilniaus Vingio parko lengvosios atletikos stadione. Renginys siūlo ne tik individualius 5000 m bėgimus, bet ir estafetinius bėgimus - 5x1000 m mišrią estafetę bei 2x400 m tėčio ir vaiko estafetę. Dalyviai gali mėgautis gyva DJ muzika, šventiška atmosfera ir palaikymu, kuris padeda siekti geriausių rezultatų. Varžybos skirtos tiek profesionalams, tiek mėgėjams, o renginio organizatoriai siekia populiarinti lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje ir skatinti sportinę bendruomenę.
course_highlights: Varžybos vyksta Vilniaus Vingio parko lengvosios atletikos stadione
5000 m bėgimas, 5x1000 m mišri estafetė ir 2x400 m tėčio ir vaiko estafetė
Gyva DJ muzika ir šventiška atmosfera su maisto vagonėliu po finišo
additional: Dalyviai suskirstomi į grupes pagal asmeninius rezultatus arba prognozuojamą įveikimo laiką. Elito grupės dalyviai privalo naudoti WA stadiono patvirtintus bėgimo batelius ir turėti antidopingo kursų pažymėjimą. 5x1000m estafetės komandos yra mišrios, o 2x400m tėčio ir vaiko estafetėje amžiaus ribojimų nėra. Po finišo dalyvių laukia maisto vagonėlis. Varžybų nugalėtojai ir prizininkai apdovanojami rėmėjų prizais ir piniginiais prizais už aukštus rezultatus. Varžybos vyks 2027 m. birželio 13 d., siūlomos įvairios kategorijos, įskaitant elitinius ir mėgėjų bėgikus, su išsamia tvarkaraščio informacija. Renginys skatina sporto populiarinimą ir šeimų dalyvavimą.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 24. Laekvere – Simuna jooks
description: The third stage of the Lääne-Virumaa running and walking series in 2026 is the traditional Simuna-Laekvere Run, which has secured a firm place in runners’ calendars and hearts. The run is unique in that its direction changes every year. The event takes place at Simuna School and invites all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: Traditional Simuna-Laekvere Run
The direction of the run changes every year
Venue: Simuna School
additional: The event takes place at Simuna School and is part of a series of running events in Lääne-Virumaa, offering a range of distances and age groups. Registration is online, and all participants have the opportunity to receive an award.

name: E-Lux Peetri Jooks
location: Peetri, Rae Parish, Harju County, Estonia
description: E-LUX Peetri Jooks is one of Estonia’s most vibrant mass-participation sports events, bringing together running enthusiasts of different ages and abilities. The main distance is 10 km, with timing and awards for the top finishers, but there is also a charity run, a youth run and children’s races. The event takes place in Peetri and, in addition to running, features a large expo and market area with various vendors and entertainment. The charity run supports the Tartu University Hospital Children’s Foundation and, through it, children with mobility impairments. All finishers receive a cool summer medal.
course_highlights: 10 km main race with timing and awards
5 km charity run and walk with timing and awards
Children’s races over 300 m and 1 km, with no timing
additional: The virtual run lets participants choose their own distance, time and location, and virtual runners receive a medal and prize-buffet products delivered to a parcel locker. Children’s races are untimed, with no rankings—all participants are winners. The event also features a large expo and market area with handicrafts, farm products, sweet treats, sports equipment and a children’s area. Volunteers are offered a hot meal and a goodie bag. The event includes an exhibition and community gathering, medals for finishers, and various categories for all age groups.

name: Simuna-Laekvere rahvajooks
description: The Simuna-Laekvere Fun Run is a traditional amateur race held every other year, alternating between Simuna and Laekvere. The course follows paved roads, with rolling sections and some climbs, offering participants a varied running experience. The event is friendly and well organized, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners, and offers a sauna and hot soup after the race. There are usually around 100 participants, creating a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. Age categories are awarded, and the first ten finishers receive a race shirt.
course_highlights: The course follows paved roads
Rolling profile with some steeper climbs
A varied running experience in an area with little traffic
additional: Participants are offered a sauna and hot soup after the race. Awards go to the top three in each age category, and raffle prizes include a bicycle and other surprises. Bus transport between Laekvere and Simuna is provided before and after the race as needed. The outdoor course runs on asphalt and includes different age categories; registration details are not specified.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
location: Kazimierz Biskupi, Gniezno County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Run Under the Millennial Oaks is a unique sporting event held in picturesque Kazimierz Biskupi, in the heart of Bieniszew Forest. The race brings together sport, history, and the beauty of the local landscape, taking participants along an avenue of millennial oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, beginners, and families alike, with races over various distances and a Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Aktywny Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Municipality of Kazimierz Biskupi, and the race tradition dates back to the beginning of the 21st century.
course_highlights: The course follows a picturesque avenue of millennial oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve
The race takes place in the heart of Bieniszew Forest, offering a chance to connect with nature
Running courses of 10 km and 5 km are available, along with a 5 km Nordic walking event
additional: Race-day check-in and race bib distribution take place the day before the race (June 6, 2026) from 17:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 8:30 to 12:15. The 10 km main race starts at 13:00; the 5 km accompanying race and 5 km Nordic walking event start at 13:10. The time limit for completing the race is 14:40. The winners’ awards ceremony and event closing take place after the race at 14:45. Participant limits: 250 for the main race, 150 for the accompanying race, and 100 for Nordic walking. The event was revived for the first time in 2007, with online registration available. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes and certificates.

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Warszawa

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata za udział dzieci i młodzieży

description: IRONMAN 70.3 Warsaw is a prestigious triathlon held in the heart of Poland’s capital, combining a swim in Zegrze Reservoir, a 90 km bike ride to central Warsaw, and a half-marathon run. The event attracts both experienced triathletes and amateurs, offering the chance to qualify for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship. The atmosphere is filled with sporting excitement and the historic spirit of Warsaw, and the finish line is at the Multimedia Fountain Park, adding a distinctive character to the competition.
course_highlights: 1.9 km swim in Zegrze Reservoir
90 km bike course leading to central Warsaw
21.1 km run finishing at the Multimedia Fountain Park
additional: The swim cut-off is 1 hour 10 minutes, and the combined swim and bike cut-off is 5 hours 30 minutes. The overall race cut-off is 8 hours 30 minutes. The start and finish are located at the Multimedia Fountain Park. Athletes can qualify for the IRONMAN 70.3 World Championship 2026 in Nice. Athlete services include bike rental, bike transfer, bike build and pack, finisher photos, medal engraving, a camper park, licenses, and accommodation. The event also includes IRONKIDS, Night Run, and other triathlon activities; it is sponsored by Enea. Relay options and services such as bike rental and transfers are available.

name: X Festiwal Biegów Polski Północnej i Akt...
location: Wdzydze Kiszewskie, Gmina Kartuzy, Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 10th Festival of Running and Physical Activity of Northern Poland in Wdzydze is a milestone edition of an event promoting running and physical activity in the scenic Kashubian region. It takes place from 5–7 June 2026, with its base at the sports field on Leśna Street in Wdzydze Kiszewskie. The festival brings together the running community of Northern Poland, promotes a healthy lifestyle, and showcases local culture and nature. The programme includes races over various distances, Nordic walking events, and cycling rallies.
course_highlights: Running routes of 1.6 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and 21 km
Scenic Kashubian landscapes and the forests of the Kościerzyna Forest District
Promotion of the “Kashubian Sea” and nearby natural attractions
additional: The race office is open during the festival. The event base is at the sports field on Leśna Street in Wdzydze Kiszewskie. The programme also includes Nordic walking events and cycling rallies. This milestone edition brings together the running community of Northern Poland. The event features various forms of physical activity, including running, walking, and cycling, promoting a healthy lifestyle in the Kashubian region.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
description: The 13th DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon, named after Barbara Karaczyńska, is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie and organized by the Daszrade Foundation in cooperation with the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Centre. The marathon course is entirely paved and runs through the scenic fields and forests of Kociewie. It is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and features numerous fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race takes place on a June morning and offers unforgettable views and a unique atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal, and everyone who finishes receives a commemorative medal, diploma and T-shirt.
course_highlights: Paved route through the fields and forests of Kociewie
646 m of total elevation gain, with numerous steep climbs
Course marked every 1 km, with aid stations every 5 km and on-course refreshment points
additional: Aid stations every 5 km, plus on-course refreshment points. A recovery meal is served after the race. Participants receive a commemorative medal, diploma and T-shirt. The 10 km “Olka” route partially overlaps with the half-marathon, is on a firm surface and runs through the forest. Paved route, 646 m of elevation gain, aid stations every 5 km, commemorative medals and T-shirts, 10 km “OLKA” route.

name: III Bieg Charytatywny Dookoła Jeziora Cz...
Västerås Stadslopp
description: Västerås Stadslopp is organized by Västerås Friidrottsklubb and invites everyone to a welcoming, family-friendly day of running in the city on Sunday, 7 June 2026. The event offers races for adults (including 10 km and 2.5 km), three children’s race distances, and a Para Race for participants with disabilities. There is a four-person team category with a picnic/food hamper as the prize, activities for children in Vasaparken, and every participant receives a city race medal. The organizer encourages people to register early, as places in the children’s races are limited and have sold out in previous years.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Rådhuset, with a festival area and services at the start
Children’s races and the Para Race in Vasaparken, with distances of approximately 200 m, 400 m, or 800 m to choose from
Toilets and water refill points in front of Rådhuset, near the start and finish
additional: The children’s races have three untimed distances (approximately 200 m, 400 m, and 800 m) and are limited to a maximum of 400 children. Teams of four receive a food hamper from Hemköp Malmaberg (the deadline for team registration is 31/5), and team members do not have to run the same race. Race numbers can be collected in the days before the event; they must be attached with safety pins and worn visibly on the stomach/chest. Friskis & Svettis leads a warm-up approximately 10 minutes before each race. Participants in the Para Race receive a medal and a goodie bag. There is no prize-giving or timing for the 2.5 km race; honorary prizes go to the top three finishers in the 10 km and 5 km races. Companies can book a tent (5000 kr) or a beach flag (2500 kr) via henrik@vasterasfriidrott.se. Team registration is available (teams of four receive a food hamper after finishing). All participants receive a medal and a goodie bag at the finish. There are water stations along the course and activities in Vasaparken during the event.

name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
location: Võru Staadion, Võru, Võru County, Estonia
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of athletics events combining track races, throws and jumps. Each evening includes one throwing event, one jumping event and running distances, offering a varied athletics experience. The competitions take place at Võru Stadium and use the IAAF scoring tables to determine the rankings. The series has five stages, one of which is the Võru County Championships. Participants must register separately for each stage, and their bib number is valid for the entire season.
course_highlights: A variety of athletics events at Võru Stadium
Each evening includes throwing, jumping and running events
The IAAF scoring tables are used to determine the rankings
additional: Registration opens on 28 May. Separate registration is required for each stage. The bib number is valid for the entire season, and participants are advised to leave it with the organizer at the end of each stage. Registration for throwing and jumping events usually closes at 16:30–16:45, and registration for races at 18:30–18:45. The competition schedule includes the exact registration and start times. The final stage of the series is on 3 August. Awards are presented at the end of the season. Competitions take place at several stages and include races, throws and jumps; registration is handled stage by stage. The event is part of the Võru sports calendar and welcomes all sports fans.

name: Aastajooks
description: Pärnu Year Runs is a running series that began in 1985, inspired by the Eastern zodiac calendar and dedicated each year to the animal symbol of that year. The theme of the 2026 series is the Year of the Fire Horse. It consists of nine stages held at three locations in Pärnu: Vallikäär, the beach, and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail. Three stages take place at each location, offering a varied and enjoyable running experience. The series is organised by the Pärnu Two Bridges Club, which invites all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy an active summer in Pärnu.
course_highlights: The series has 9 stages, held at three different start locations in Pärnu
Stages take place at Pärnu Vallikäär, Pärnu Beach, and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail
Three runs take place at each start location, offering a varied running experience
additional: The stages take place throughout the summer, starting at 18:00. Participants can purchase a season pass or register for individual stages. The organisers also offer the opportunity to volunteer. The series rules provide more detailed information about moving along the course, equipment, and safety. Participants can take part in different age and distance categories. Registration is open, and the event takes place at the beginning of summer each year.

name: Lääne-Virumaa noorte MV
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Youth Championships is an athletics competition for young people and adults held in Rakvere. The competition includes several athletics disciplines, such as running, jumping and throwing, and is intended for age groups from U-14 through to adults. Its aim is to honour the memory of Eerik Konist and promote athletics among young people. Medals are awarded in all age groups, and the top performers receive special prizes. The competition takes place at the stadium and starts at 11:00; registration opens at 10:00.
course_highlights: A range of athletics disciplines: running, jumping and throwing
Age groups from U-14 through to adults
The competition takes place at Heino Lipp Stadium in Rakvere
additional: Registration opens at 10:00, and technical event declarations must be submitted half an hour before the competition begins. In all events, competitors have four attempts in the jumps, shot put and throws. The top three in each age group are awarded, and the boy and girl with the best results receive special prizes. Registration begins at 10:00, and the competition starts at 11:00. Participants can enjoy sport and friendly competition, with medals and special prizes for the top performers.

name: 6. ETAPP - Nõmme terviserada
description: The Nõmme health trail is part of the Tradehouse Health Run and Walk series organised by Stamina Sports Club, which encourages people to stay active by collecting health kilometres. This stage offers the chance to enjoy the Nõmme area health trail, suitable for both runners and walkers. As part of the series, participants can collect health kilometres at both in-person and remote stages, as well as during individual training. The event is open to everyone who enjoys physical activity and wants to improve their health and spend time actively.
course_highlights: Nõmme health trail in Tallinn
Suitable for runners and walkers
Participation in the Tradehouse Health Run and Walk series
additional: The health kilometres programme runs from April to December, allowing participants to collect kilometres at series stages and during individual training. The list of registered participants is updated once every 24 hours. The series includes several stages in different locations and offers participants opportunities to improve their health. The event dates are 8 to 14 June 2026, and participation is available both in person and virtually.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 3. etapp
location: Viljandi järve tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Estonia
description: The 3rd stage of the Joosu Lake Run Series is a running event held on the health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful views of the lake and varied terrain. The event is part of a series organised by the Joosu Health Sports Club, which promotes an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone is welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful lake views throughout the course
Varied terrain suitable for runners of different levels

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Krakės - Laiko ratu“
organizer: Krakių bendruomenės centras, Krakių kultūros centras, Krakių seniūnija
description: Bėgimo varžybos „Krakės - Laiko ratu“ yra tradicinis respublikinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Krakių miestelyje, Kėdainių rajone. Varžybos kviečia dalyvauti visus - nuo profesionalų iki pradedančiųjų ir mėgėjų, siūlant įvairius distancijų variantus pagal amžiaus grupes. Startas ir finišas yra miesto centre, Laisvės aikštėje, o renginys pasižymi draugiška atmosfera ir apdovanojimais įvairiose amžiaus kategorijose. Dalyviai vaišinami tradiciniu šiupiniu, o renginio metu galima žaisti medinius lauko žaidimus „LPA GAMES“.
course_highlights: Startas ir finišas Laisvės aikštėje, Krakių miestelyje
Skirtingos distancijos pagal amžiaus grupes: 2,5 km, 5 km ir 10 km
Krakių garbės rato 600 m bėgimas „Pagauk gandrą“ vaikams ir šeimoms
additional: Starto numeriai išduodami nuo 11:00 val. Varžybų atidarymas ir 600 m bėgimas „Pagauk gandrą“ prasideda 11:30 val. Visi dalyviai vaišinami Krakių bendruomenės centro pagamintu šiupiniu. Renginio metu galima žaisti medinius lauko žaidimus „LPA GAMES“. Apdovanojami amžiaus grupių nugalėtojai, jauniausias ir vyriausias dalyviai, greičiausi 10 km bėgimo dalyviai. registracija išankstinė internetu, starto mokesčio mokėjimas banku, įvairios distancijos ir amžiaus grupės, renginio metu taip pat vyksta žaidimai ir pramogos

name: Vanglateenistuse jooks
location: Jõhvi Muusikaväljak, Jõhvi, Ida-Viru County, Estonia
description: The Prison Service Run is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series and takes place at Jõhvi Music Square. This athletics event gives participants the chance to enjoy running in the beautiful surroundings of Ida-Viru County. The series includes several stages in different locations, offering a varied running experience. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and is traditionally well organized and friendly.
course_highlights: Venue: Jõhvi Music Square
Part of the 2026 Ida-Viru Running Series
An athletics event suitable for runners of different levels
additional: The run takes place over several distances, and registration is usually through Facebook or the official website.

name: ELVA SÜDAÖÖJOOKS 2026 TARTUMAA LIIGUB ETAPP
description: Elva Midnight Run 2026 is a night-time running and walking event held in Elva by the Cultural Centre. The races start in the evening and offer several distance options, including a 10 km run and walk, as well as children’s races. The event is part of Tartu County’s physical activity events and is suitable for both active runners and families. The organisers welcome everyone to take part and enjoy a sporty evening in Elva’s beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: 10 km run and walk around Elva Cultural Centre
Children’s races over 300 m and 600 m
Night-time event, with the running and walking races starting at 23:00
additional: The races begin with the children’s races at 21:00; the 10 km run and walk start at 23:00. It is also possible to take part in a virtual 10 km run. The organiser is Elva Sports Association, which brings together several local sports clubs. Virtual runs are also held as part of the event, and registration is open until race day. Participants have the opportunity to receive a medal and enjoy Elva’s beautiful natural surroundings and city atmosphere.

name: Eesti noorte KV
location: Tammiste staadion, Pärnu, Pärnu linn, Pärnu maakond, Estonia
description: The Estonian Youth Cup in archery takes place in Pärnu, giving young athletes the opportunity to compete and develop their skills. Several archery clubs from across Estonia take part, making it an important event in the young archers’ calendar. The competition is held at Tammiste Stadium, where athletes can demonstrate their accuracy and skill. This traditional event supports the development of young people in archery.
course_highlights: The competition takes place at Tammiste Stadium in Pärnu
Young athletes from several Estonian archery clubs take part
The competition includes different archery divisions
additional: A total of 88 young athletes from 8 archery clubs took part. Vana-Võidu VK / Viljandi SK had the largest contingent, and Türi Archery School won the most medals. Different archery divisions are represented, including recurve and compound. The competition features young athletes, with results including details of medalists and participants. The 2026 competition includes different events and has a substantial number of participants.

name: Coconaut Pomerania Summer Trail
description: Pomerania Summer Trail is a running challenge on the hilly trails of Pomerania, offering three distances: 45 km, 25 km, and 10 km. The event takes place in the picturesque area of Czymanowo, right by Lake Żarnowieckie and the Kaszubskie Oko observation tower, creating a unique trail-running atmosphere. The organizer, the Pomerania Sports Association, together with local sports centers, invites both first-time participants and experienced ultrarunners to take part in this unforgettable event. It’s a great opportunity to take on challenging courses and enjoy the beauty of Kashubian nature.
course_highlights: Hilly Kashubian trails
Courses of 45 km, 25 km, and 10 km
Start and finish by Lake Żarnowieckie and the Kaszubskie Oko observation tower
additional: Online registration usually closes 7 days before the event, but registration on race day may be possible if places are still available. The organizer provides a great race village at the concert square in Czymanowo, by Lake Żarnowieckie and the Kaszubskie Oko observation tower. The event offers different distances, GPX files to download, and requires specific equipment. The race takes place in a beautiful area with access to tourist attractions in Kashubia and Pomerania.

name: IV Bilczańska Dycha
organizer: Zakład Gospodarki Komunalnej i Rekreacji w Morawicy
description: The 3rd Bilczańska Dycha is a 10 km road race held in the recreational area of Bilcza Park in the Municipality of Morawica. The event is aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages, and children’s races and a family festival are also held on race day. The race is open to all and promotes active recreation in the scenic surroundings of the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship.
course_highlights: The course runs through the recreational area of Bilcza Park
A 10 km road race
Scenic surroundings in the Municipality of Morawica
additional: A family festival and children’s races are also held on race day. The event includes children’s races, a family festival, and recreational activities at Bilcza Park. Registration is available online, and the event promotes active recreation and integration within the local community.

name: 23 Wilcza Dycha
location: Osieczna, Powiat choszczeński, województwo zachodniopomorskie, Poland
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association. The event promotes an active lifestyle and attracts runners from the region, offering a scenic route through the Tuchola Forests. The race takes place in Osieczna and is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. Participants can expect professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km route
Scenic terrain in the Tuchola Forests
The race takes place in Osieczna
additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich series, with the chance to win a unique collection as part of the series. Participants can expect competitive racing and attractive prizes.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the town’s streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level with officially recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime atmosphere. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by providing refreshments after the race and awards ceremonies for the winners.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Night race starting at 21:55
Urban course through the streets of Szamotuły
additional: Temporary traffic arrangements will be in place on race day, with parking disruptions and designated detours. Race packs can be collected from 17:00 to 21:30. Refreshments for participants and awards ceremonies for the winners are planned after the race. There are 26 free race packs available for people with disabilities in the family race, accompanied by a caregiver, upon request by email. The event includes road closures and detours, and offers various distances, including 5 km, 255 m, and 555 m. Participants can find news and information on the website and Facebook.

name: Bieg Iskry
description: Bieg Iskry is a unique running event taking place on June 13, 2026, at Mielec Airport. Participants will cover a 6.5 km route along the runway with the lights on and the sun setting, creating a one-of-a-kind aviation atmosphere. The organizers provide professional medals, T-shirts featuring the Iskra aircraft, and prizes including trophies and vouchers for tandem flights. After the race, participants can admire the aircraft and enjoy refreshments and dietary supplements.
course_highlights: A 6.5 km route along the runway at Mielec Airport
A race with the lights on and the sun setting
Start, finish, and awards ceremony in the hangars of the White-and-Red Wings Foundation
additional: Participants will receive running T-shirts featuring the Iskra aircraft, commemorative medals, and trophies and diplomas in the open and age categories. Medical and sanitary facilities will be available. At the end, there will be a draw for a glider flight sponsored by the Polish Aviation Foundation. Event partner DepilConcept salon is providing a voucher for photoepilation treatments for the first woman to cross the finish line. Airport grounds, online registration, medals, T-shirts, prizes, aviation attractions, post-race meals

name: Bieg Recepta na Zdrowie
location: Łódzki Park Arturówek, Łódź, Łódzkie, Poland
description: The eighth national “Recepta na Zdrowie” run will take place on 13 June 2026 in Arturówek, Łódź. This healthy running event promotes physical activity, integration between the running and pharmaceutical communities, and a healthy lifestyle. The race routes follow a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest, with 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as 5 km Nordic Walking. Shorter races on the same route are planned for children and young people. A family picnic with free health checks and consultations will be held near the start and finish.
course_highlights: The running and Nordic Walking routes follow a 5 km loop in Łagiewnicki Forest
Two 5 km loops for the 10 km distance
Family picnic with blood pressure and blood sugar checks and consultations
additional: The start and finish are by the Arturówek recreational facilities. The race office will be open from 8:00 on race day. The 5 km run and Nordic Walking start together at 10:00, the children’s and youth races begin at 12:00, and the 10 km run starts at 13:30. The course is not certified. Awards and prizes for children and young people will be presented immediately after their races. Registration for children requires an account on zapisy.inessport.pl. The event, supported by organizers from the pharmaceutical industry, places strong emphasis on promoting a healthy lifestyle and preventive healthcare. It takes place in June 2026 in Arturówek, Łódź.

name: Leśna ZaDyszka
location: Leśnictwo Szulmierz, gmina Regimin, Mazowieckie, Poland
description: Leśna ZaDyszka is a race held in the picturesque Szulmierz Forest District in the Regimin municipality, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in forest areas. The course is a 5 km loop along forest tracks and a section of asphalt, showcasing the beauty of the Mazovian countryside. Participants can choose from three events: 5 km, 10 km (two loops), and 5 km Nordic Walking. Children can take part in a 1.5 km run with no classification. The start and finish are on a forest clearing by the Szulmierz-Regimin road, and times are recorded using a professional chip timing system.
course_highlights: A 5 km loop along forest tracks and asphalt
Views of the Mazovian countryside and a fallow deer farm
The course is safeguarded by volunteers
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 on the forest clearing by the Szulmierz-Regimin road. Participants receive a commemorative medal and a restorative meal after the race. They can choose a standard T-shirt at no extra cost or a Premium LAS T-shirt for an additional 20 zł. Times are recorded using chips attached to participants’ shoes. Prizes are awarded for age-group and overall placements, with a prize draw among participants. Courses include forest tracks and asphalt, with various distances and categories, including running, Nordic Walking, and Cross Duathlon. Entry fees depend on the registration date.

name: Memoriał Mariana Szymańskiego
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Radomsku
description: The 13th Radomsko Street Run, the Marian Szymański Memorial, is an annual running event held in Radomsko to commemorate Marian Szymański. The race takes place on the city streets, giving participants the chance to compete in a friendly atmosphere. It is organized by the City of Radomsko and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Radomsko, with timing provided by Pomiar Czasu Atelier Sportu. The race is scheduled to start at 17:30, and online registration is open until 10 June 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km street race
Participation in a memorial race commemorating Marian Szymański
Organized by MOSiR Radomsko, with electronic timing
additional: The event is scheduled for 13 June 2026, with a 17:30 start. Online registration is open until 10 June 2026. The race takes place on the streets of Radomsko.

name: Nocna Piątka

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pakiet Smyki na Piątkę 35 zł ( numer startowy, chip, medal)

description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka is an annual road race in Szamotuły, certified by the Polish Athletic Association. The 5 km course runs through the town streets, offering official results and a unique night-race atmosphere. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races. It attracts considerable interest, and participants can look forward to refreshments and an awards ceremony after the race.
course_highlights: A 5 km course certified by the Polish Athletic Association
A night race starting at 21:55
Route through the streets of Sportowa, Lipowa, Szczęsnego, Kolarska, Wioślarska, Łąkowa, 3 Maja and Staszica
additional: Temporary traffic changes apply on race day, with parking restrictions and designated detours. Race packs are distributed from 17:00 to 21:30. Refreshments and an awards ceremony for the winners are planned after the race. Free race packs are available for people with disabilities taking part in the family race with a guardian. The 5 km race starts at 21:00; the course is marked every 1 km and has a limit of 800 participants. Various categories are available, including family and children’s races, with race packs containing T-shirts and medals. An event schedule and traffic restrictions for the duration of the race are planned.

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: The 8th Kwidzyńska zaDyszka is a 10 km road race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Kwidzyn. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is aimed at runners with varying levels of experience who want to stay active and compete on a course of moderate difficulty. The organizers provide expert support and access to a platform for managing race information.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
Scenic surroundings in Kwidzyn
Course of moderate difficulty
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Expert support and a platform for managing the race profile and marketing collaboration are provided. Registration runs from April 17 to June 8, 2025; participant limit: 200.

name: XIX Bieg Marszałka
description: The 19th Marshal’s Run is an annual road race held in Sulejówek, commemorating the traditions of the pre-war Sulejówek–Belweder marches. The main race, approximately 10 km long, takes place in June and commemorates Józef Piłsudski settling in Sulejówek. The event also includes accompanying races, including the Halina Zielińska Memorial over 3.6 km and races for children. The race has a patriotic and sporting character, with uniformed services and museum staff taking part. The start and finish are at 94 Paderewskiego Street, next to Willa Bzów.
course_highlights: Main race of approximately 10 km on the streets of Sulejówek
Halina Zielińska Memorial over approximately 3.6 km
Traditional start and finish by Willa Bzów, 94 Paderewskiego Street
additional: The main race and the Halina Zielińska Memorial start at 10:20, the Little Kids’ Run at 10:30, and the Older Kids’ Run at 10:40. A flower-laying ceremony at the monument to Marshal Józef Piłsudski takes place at 9:50. Race packages can be officially and safely transferred to another participant. Uniformed services and museum staff also compete in separate categories. Registration and race-package collection take place at the Józef Piłsudski Museum, with registration also available by email. The event features various distances and forms of competition, including races for children and seniors.

name: XV Bieg Szlakiem Króla Zygmunta Starego
description: The 15th Run in the Footsteps of King Sigismund the Old is an annual race held in Kozienice, commemorating a historic route associated with King Sigismund the Old. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering a scenic course and sporting competition. The organizers provide professional support and a welcoming atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: A race course following the historic route of King Sigismund the Old
Scenic landscapes of Kozienice and the surrounding area
A well-marked and prepared running course
additional: Registration for the event is available online; the event attracts nearly 180 runners, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the region.

name: XV Siemiatycka Wieczorna Dycha
location: Amfiteatr miejski, Grodzieńska 31, Siemiatycze, Podlaskie, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Siemiatyczach
description: The XV Siemiatycze Evening 10K is a 10 km road race held in Siemiatycze. The start and finish are at the municipal amphitheatre at 31 Grodzieńska Street. The course follows the city’s asphalt streets. In addition to the main 10 km race, there are also 5 km races and a 400 m race for children. The event takes place in the evening, with a start time of 18:00. Participants can use municipal parking near the amphitheatre.
course_highlights: Asphalt course through the streets of Siemiatycze
Start and finish at the municipal amphitheatre, 31 Grodzieńska Street
Additional 5 km races and a 400 m race for children
additional: Participants can park at the municipal car park along Nadrzeczna Street and at the municipal car park behind the Biedronka store. The race office is located at the municipal amphitheatre at 31 Grodzieńska Street. Participants in the M65, M70+ and K60+ categories in the 10 km race, and the M65+ and K60+ categories in the 5 km race, are exempt from the entry fee. Participants can take part free of charge in the M65+, M70+ and K60+ categories. Registration is through the Time2go.pl platform. The race takes place on asphalt, and its evening format makes it an attractive sporting and social event in the region.

name: 200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
XIX Bieg Zajączkowski
location: Zajączki Drugie, Gmina Krzepice, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: XVI Grand Prix Stargardu Cztery Pory Roku
location: Morzyczyn, Stargard County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Öland Ultra Trail
location: Böda Sand, Böda, Borgholm Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Öland Ultra Trail is a nature-focused trail race in northern Öland, with 50 km and 25 km distances for both men and women. The course runs through classic Öland woodland and coastal landscapes, passing places including Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen. The 50 km race starts at Böda Sand and the 25 km race starts in Byxelkrok, with both distances finishing at Böda Sand. Participants who register by 6 June receive a T-shirt.
course_highlights: Byrums raukar (coastal area of rauks, or limestone sea stacks)
Neptuni åkrar (coastal meadow landscape with views)
Trollskogen (distinctive pine forest in northern Öland)
additional: Location: Sport Camp, Böda Sand (northern Öland). Date: 13 June 2026; 50 km starts at 09:00 at Böda Sand, and 25 km starts at 10:00 in Byxelkrok; both distances finish at Böda Sand. All finishers receive a medal. To receive a T-shirt, register by 6 June and provide your shirt size (men’s/women’s). Bib collection: Friday 12 June, 19:00–20:00, and on race day, 13 June, 07:30–09:00 (the last opportunity for on-site registration). On-site registration payment: cash, card or Swish. Contact/organiser: Högby IF. Both distances finish at Böda Sand; start times are 09:00 for 50 km and 10:00 for 25 km. Registration by 6 June 2026 for advance entries and until 11 June for late entries; advance registration includes a T-shirt.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm
location: Stora Skuggans Amfiteater, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, 33 km, 16 km, 8 km, 0.7 km
description: EcoTrail Stockholm is a trail race held in and around Norra Djurgården and Stockholm, with several distances on race day in June 2026. The course combines technical forest trails, coastal paths, countryside, and urban sections and sights. It suits both fast international runners and those looking to finish over the course of a full-day outing. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggans Amfiteater, and all finishers receive an annual wooden medal; the organizers also provide food and an after-run gathering at the finish. More detailed race information will be published on the website and emailed to registered participants before the race.
course_highlights: A mix of archipelago scenery, technical forest trails, countryside, urban sections, and several viewpoints
Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amfiteater on Norra Djurgården (easy to reach by metro/bus)
The 80 km course passes through seven municipalities and nine nature reserves; generous time limit (14 hours) and limited participant numbers
additional: Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amfiteater; wooden medal for all finishers; participants must bring their own cup/mug or bottle to refill at aid stations; GPX file available to download; the 80 km race has a 14-hour time limit and is limited to 200 participants; more details and the schedule will be emailed to registered participants approximately two weeks before the race. The registration deadline for all distances is 11 June 2026. Mandatory equipment for the 80 km race: a container for at least one litre of water, a cup/mug, and a mobile phone with a fully charged battery and the race organizers’ phone number; aid stations do not provide cups.

name: Öllsjö Löpfest 2026
description: A warm welcome to Öllsjö Löpfest on 13 June 2026! After two previous editions, we’re back with a family-friendly running festival featuring several different races for all ages and levels. The event offers chip timing, a team competition and an activity area with music and family activities. Participant numbers are limited to maintain a cosy, family atmosphere.
course_highlights: Children’s races: 450 m and 1,700 m
Distance race: 5 km
7.5 km trail mix (with trail sections on the course)
additional: Automatic chip timing and a team competition are offered. A service fee of 12.50 kr is mentioned for registrations. The event area is open 10:00–14:00. Late registration from 8–12 June costs 225:-, and registration on the day, 13 June, costs 250:-. Music and activities for the whole family; participant numbers are limited. The fun run is promoted as inclusive for everyone, but the text does not specify registration details or distances. Webscorer mentions a manual wave start that may affect the start schedule.

name: Mano MAMA juda – Gelgaudiškio TRAIL spalvų bėgimas 2026
description: Mano MAMA juda - Gelgaudiškio TRAIL spalvų bėgimas 2026 yra šeimoms ir bėgimo entuziastams skirtas renginys, vykstantis Gelgaudiškio dvaro parke ir apylinkėse. Renginio tikslas - populiarinti bėgimo sportą Šakių rajone ir skatinti fizinį aktyvumą. Trasą sudaro miško takeliai ir asfaltas, o bėgimo metu įrengti spalvų punktai suteikia papildomo džiaugsmo dalyviams. Varžybos vyksta birželio 21 d., siūlant 400 m vaikų bėgimą, 5 km ir 10 km distancijas.
course_highlights: 5 km ratas pagrinde miško takais
10 km distancija - du 5 km ratai
Trasos danga - miško takeliai ir asfaltas
additional: Numerių išdavimas vyksta nuo 9:00 iki 10:00 val. Vaikų 400 m bėgimas startuoja 10:00 val., 5 km ir 10 km distancijos startuoja 10:30 val. Apdovanojimai numatyti 12:00 val. Nepilnamečiai dalyviai privalo turėti raštišką tėvų ar globėjų sutikimą. Dalyviai sutinka, kad renginio metu darytos nuotraukos ir filmuotą medžiagą organizatoriai gali naudoti rinkodaros tikslais. Renginys apima spalvų bėgimą, įvairias distancijas, iššūkius ir reljefo įvairovę. Dalyvių rezultatai fiksuojami profesionalia laiko matavimo sistema, tačiau svarbiausia - patirtis ir emocijos.

name: Alytaus maratonas 2026
location: Didžiosios Dailidės ežero apylinkės, Alytus, Alytaus rajonas, Lithuania
description: Alytaus maratonas 2026 vyks 2026 m. birželio 14 d. Alytuje, Didžiosios Dailidės ežero apylinkėse. Renginys skirtas populiarinti bėgimą Lietuvoje ir garsinti Alytų, kviečiant tiek mėgėjus, tiek profesionalus varžytis įvairiose distancijose nuo vaikų 500 m iki pilno maratono. Dalyviai galės rinktis iš kelių bėgimo ir šiaurietiško ėjimo distancijų, o trasos yra techniškai paruoštos varžyboms su elektroniniu laiko matavimu. Renginys organizuojamas VšĮ „Maratomanija“ ir užtikrina saugias bei taisyklingas varžybas visiems dalyviams.
course_highlights: Distancijos nuo 500 m vaikų bėgimo iki 42,195 km maratono
Startas ir finišas prie Didžiosios Dailidės ežero Alytuje
Elektroninis laiko matavimas su mikroschema ant marškinėlių
additional: Varžybų dalyviams draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones trasoje. Laiko matavimas vykdomas elektronine mikroschema, kuri turi būti pritvirtinta ant marškinėlių priekinės dalies. Varžybų limitai: maratonui 6 val., pusmaratoniui 3 val., 10,6 km - 2 val., 5,3 km - 1 val., 2 km - 0,5 val., šiaurietiško ėjimo distancijoms - 5 val. Startai skirtingoms distancijoms: 12:00 val. daugeliui bėgimų, 16:30 val. 2 km bėgimui, 16:45 val. 500 m vaikų bėgimui. Renginyje bus įrengtos vandens ir maitinimo stotelės, dalyvių limitas - 300, ir įvairios distancijos, įskaitant vaikų ir šeimų bėgimus. Registracija atidaroma balandžio 1 d. ir galioja iki pat renginio dienos.

name: EKVA lahtised kergej. võistl.
description: The EKVA Open Athletics Competition takes place in Kohila and offers veterans and recreational athletes the opportunity to compete in various athletics events. It is intended for active athletes of all ages who want to test themselves and enjoy competing in athletics. EKVA regularly organizes various championships and series that help promote running and athletics in Estonia. The competition is open to both recreational athletes and veterans, with age-group categories.
course_highlights: The competition takes place at the stadium and in the surrounding area
A varied selection of athletics events: running, long jump, discus, shot put and javelin
Veteran age-group categories start at age 35
additional: The EKVA membership fee for 2026 is EUR 15 per year; honorary members and those over 77 are exempt from the fee. Please send competition results in PDF format to ennoakkel754@gmail.com. Veteran age-group categories start at age 35, and prizes are awarded to the top three women and men in each age group. The competition involves veterans and active athletes and offers opportunities to participate in the Estonian Championships and international competitions.

name: Viimsi maraton
description: Viimsi Marathon 2026 takes place on the Viimsi Peninsula and offers participants a course consisting of one large loop. The start and finish are in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied terrain includes both paved roads and forest trails, with climbs and descents throughout the course. It’s a great opportunity to enjoy a summer run with a positive community.
course_highlights: One large loop on the Viimsi Peninsula
Varied terrain: paved roads and forest trails
Climbs and descents throughout the course
additional: The course includes climbs and descents, and participants are advised to bring enough drinks and food. Participants receive a commemorative medal at the finish.
