description: The 17th Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is an annual running event held in Elbląg, attracting runners to the 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as the Mini Piekarczyk Run for children. The event is known for its unique atmosphere of sporting excitement and community, and participants receive one-of-a-kind collectible medals. The organizers provide comfortable race-day facilities, including a race office for collecting race packets, a baggage deposit, and sanitary facilities. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and compete on the city’s scenic routes.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes along the streets of Elbląg
Mini Piekarczyk Run for children in various age categories
A unique collectible medal that can be combined with medals from other races in the city
additional: Race packets can be collected at Ogrody Shopping Centre (Saturday, 12:00–18:00) and at the Helena MOSiR Ice Rink Hall (Sunday, 7:30–9:30 for the 5 km and 10 km races; 7:30–13:30 for the Mini Run). Participants can use the baggage deposit, changing rooms, and showers at the ice rink hall. The Mini Piekarczyk Run includes several children’s age categories, with distances ranging from 50 m to 600 m. Races start from 12:35 on Sunday. 5 km and 10 km distances, team classification, entry-fee promotions, limited number of places, online registration

name: Grodziski Półmaraton Słowaka
location: Grodzisk Wielkopolski, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Hunters Grodziski “Słowaka” Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Grodzisk Wielkopolski since 2007. The race commemorates Juliusz Słowacki, the patron of the local high school, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among residents. The half-marathon course is flat and runs through the town streets over two laps, with numerous refreshment and hydration stations. After the race, participants receive medals and can enjoy a hot meal and drinks. The event also provides an opportunity to promote the town and its local running community.
course_highlights: Flat course through the town streets, with two laps of approximately 10.5 km each
Course marked every 1 km with vertical and horizontal signs
Four nutrition stations and four hydration stations on each lap
additional: The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours. The race office is located at Grodziska Sports Hall, ul. Żwirki i Wigury 2A. Timing is provided by chips attached to race bibs. After the race, the organizer provides a hot meal and drinks. A team classification for sponsor teams is held in the 5 km race. The combined participant limit for the 5 km and 10 km races is 500. Registration and race-pack collection take place in Grodzisk Wielkopolski, ul. Żwirki i Wigury 2A, on 13 June 2026 from 12:00 to 20:00 and on 14 June 2026 from 6:00 to 8:00. Training sessions are held from registration until race day.

name: Rozbiegane Suwałki
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Suwałkach
description: Rozbiegane Suwałki is an annual citywide celebration of running held in June in Suwałki. The three-day event attracts hundreds of participants of different ages and abilities. The programme includes children’s races, the Bieg na Piątkę (5 km), the Suwalska Ćwiartka (10.5 km), and the Śniadaniowy Bieg na Wyspę (approx. 3.5 km). The courses are flat and fast, making them ideal for personal bests, and the atmosphere combines sporting competition with community spirit.
course_highlights: Flat, fast urban courses
Evening 10.5 km main race — Suwalska Ćwiartka
A range of distances for children and adults
additional: The three-day event includes races for children and young people, a 5 km race, the evening 10.5 km main race, and a recreational run of approx. 3.5 km with breakfast at the finish. The courses are flat and fast, making them ideal for personal bests. The organiser is the Suwałki Sports and Recreation Centre, which also offers bicycle and water sports equipment rentals, as well as sports venue rentals. Distances: children’s races, 5 km, 10.5 km, approx. 3.5 km; flat, fast courses; three-day event; online registration; located in Suwałki.

name: X Bieg o Złotą Monetę
price_range: od 25 zł dla dzieci i młodzieży, od 75 zł dla dorosłych
description: The 9th Charity Run for the Golden Coin in Olsztyn is an annual running event organized by the Future for Children Foundation, which supports sick and disabled children in Warmia and Masuria. The 5 km main race takes place by Lake Ukiel and is welcoming to all participants, including first-time runners. The event also features a family picnic and numerous attractions. Taking part is not only a sporting challenge, but above all a way to support children in need. The main race starts at 16:30, and the scenic route is also accessible to those who prefer walking.
course_highlights: Scenic route by Lake Ukiel in Olsztyn
A 5 km distance suitable for runners and walkers
Family picnic and numerous accompanying attractions
additional: There are accompanying races for children and young people over distances suited to their age; the first children’s race, over 400 m, starts at 15:35. The time limit for the 5 km main race is 1 hour. The event is a charity fundraiser supporting the rehabilitation and treatment of children from the region. Special guest Krystyna Abramczyk Puzio is a multiple Polish and world weightlifting champion. The event includes various distances, from 200 m for children to 5 km for adults, with participant limits and online registration. All proceeds go to charitable causes, and participants receive medals and keepsakes.

name: Mrowna Run Grodzisk łączy w biegu
Dadathlon Run and Festival (Stockholm, Hagaparken)
description: DaddyHood Dadathlon is a family-oriented sports event that encourages fathers and their children to move and spend quality time together. The Dadathlon is organised as a series of three discipline-specific races held at different times during the year, and participants can join live events (such as in Stockholm's Hagaparken) or take part virtually. One of the events is a running-with-kids challenge where strollers are explicitly allowed and activities are tracked with an app or sports watch and uploaded to the platform. The event emphasises participation, shared experiences and inspiring photos/videos rather than only competition.
course_highlights: Family-friendly running with kids (strollers allowed)
Live event in Stockholm's Hagaparken with a parallel virtual competition
Three-part series across the year (complete all three to become a full Dadathlon; single-event sign-up possible)
additional: Event supports both live and virtual participation; participants track activity with an app or sports watch and upload results and device activation link to the platform. A leaderboard is available, but prizes are awarded for the most inspiring pictures/videos rather than pure time-based competition. It is allowed to stop your tracking device to take breaks for the child's comfort. The organisers encourage tagging @daddyhoodeurope and using #DaddyHoodDadathlon. Free registration; Hagaparken, Stockholm; Running with children (1.5 km or 3 km); fundraising for Barncancerfonden.

name: Rapla Selveri suurjooks, virtuaaljooks
description: Rapla Selveri Suurjooks is a traditional running event held in Rapla, offering several distance options from children’s races to a half marathon. The event centre is located in the Rapla Selver car park, and the courses run along the town’s streets and highways. They are clearly marked and measured. Participants’ safety is ensured, and the race is organised by Kehakultuur OÜ in cooperation with Jooksja magazine. Pre-registration closes on 20 May, and start groups are formed according to expected finish times to ensure a smooth and safe race day.
course_highlights: The courses run along the streets and highways of Rapla
The 10 km course is certified, and the courses are marked
Cut-off times for the distances help ensure the race runs smoothly and safely
additional: The event centre opens at 9:00 in the Rapla Selver car park. The children’s races take place near Sadolin Sports Hall. Start groups are formed according to expected finish times to ensure safety and a smooth event. Nordic walkers and walkers are also welcome in the 5 km fun run. Participants must follow the instructions of traffic controllers and keep to the right side of the course so faster runners can pass on the left. Registration closes on 20 May. Various categories are available, as well as options for young participants and a virtual race.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 2 etapas
description: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 2 etapas yra bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Ragožių kaime, Jonavos rajone. Tai tradicinis bėgimas, skirtas aktyviems sporto mėgėjams, siūlantis įvairias distancijas ir galimybę išbandyti savo ištvermę bei jėgas. Renginys yra atviras visiems, norintiems aktyviai praleisti laiką ir mėgautis bėgimu gamtoje. Organizuoja Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija, kuri rūpinasi sklandžia varžybų eiga ir dalyvių patogumu.
course_highlights: Bėgimas vyksta Ragožių kaimo apylinkėse
Skirtingos distancijos pritaikytos įvairaus lygio bėgikams
Gamta ir natūralios trasos suteikia malonų bėgimo potyrį
additional: Renginys yra atviras visiems aktyviems ir sportiškiems Lietuvos žmonėms. Tarp skirtingų distancijų ir kliūčių ruožų kiekvienas gali rasti sau tinkamą iššūkį ar pramogą. Nėra specifinės informacijos apie renginio trasą ar dalyvių skaičių; registracijos vyksta per oficialią platformą.

name: Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp
organizer: Norrköpings Löparklubb i samarbete med Söderköpings OK

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alla barn deltar som vanligt helt gratis i Ramunderstaden Lilla Brunnsparksloppet.

description: Modine Söderköping City Run is a fast, popular 5-kilometre race starting and finishing in Brunnsparken in Söderköping. The seventh edition takes place on Tuesday, 16 June 2026, on a flat, easy-to-run course suited to both fast runners and recreational participants. The course is lined with music stations and a large cheering crowd. After finishing, participants are treated to a summer platter from ICA Supermarket. The event also includes the free Ramunderstaden Little Brunnsparken Run for children, with several age groups.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 5 km course (officially measured by federation measurer Per Lindh)
Start and finish in Brunnsparken, Söderköping
Music stations and strong crowd support along the course
additional: Race bib collection: ICA Supermarket Söderköping, Monday 15 June, 12:00–18:00; remaining bibs can be collected in the start/finish area up to one hour before the start. The timing chip is attached as a tab at the top of the bib and must not be removed. Water is available at the start/finish and at 2.8 km. World Class leads the warm-up (15 minutes before each start; the children’s races warm up at 16:45). After finishing, ICA Supermarket serves a summer platter; massage is available after the race. Late registration: online and on site. Online registration is open through 14 June at 16:00, according to the information provided. The regular late-registration period (increased fee of 50 SEK, for a total of 375 SEK) runs from 8 June until one hour before the start; late registration is also available on site/at bib collection (the website’s news page lists the on-site fee as 345 SEK). The 5 km course runs through Söderköping; the start/finish area is in Brunnsparken; chip timing by Racetimer; warm-up before the start led by World Class; water at the start/finish and at 2.8 km; a medal for all participants; bag/outerwear drop-off at the start and finish; the Little Brunnsparken Run (1.1 km) for children; registration via the website; bibs collected at ICA Söderköping.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Visby—a community running event that raises awareness of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, or take part in Lilla Blodomloppet. The courses pass through Visby’s cultural heritage areas and are open to both recreational runners and teams. The event is organised locally by VIF Gute Friidrott together with the blood donation centre in Visby, and often ends with a picnic and activities for participants.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses run along Visby’s ring wall and through the town centre
The 10 km course includes the seafront promenade, Almedalen and Visby harbour
Scenic historic surroundings close to the town
additional: Team registration is available and costs 1,750 kr up to and including 26 May; groups can register many participants using an Excel template imported during registration; the event highlights blood donation and provides information about gifts for blood donors; local organisers: VIF Gute Friidrott (contact: Annie Gardell, Tel 0733 909722, email visby@blodomloppet.se) and the Blood Donation Centre in Visby (Tel 0498-26 84 53, email blodcentralen@gotland.se). There are three categories: 10 km, 5 km and Lilla Blodomloppet; registration via blodomloppet.se; start times in Visby are listed on the website; included: technical T-shirt, race bib and medal; team registration is available for companies and groups; the event is streamed live on blodomloppet.se.

name: Filter Temposari (3. etapp)

description: The Bieg Dwie Wieże is a race of approximately 15 km held in Kopalino. The course runs along unpaved roads, the beach and a pavement, offering varied surfaces and picturesque views. The time limit is 2.5 hours, and participation is limited to 250 people. The event is well organized, with water stations along the course and a recovery meal at the finish.
course_highlights: Approximately 15 km course
Runs along unpaved roads, the beach and a pavement
Water stations at 4, 8 and 12 km, and at the finish
additional: Participant limit: 250 people. Race office hours: 19.06, 13:00–19:00, and 20.06, 8:00–9:45 (verification closes at 9:45). Identity verification is required (ID card/student ID). A chip is mandatory; collect it at the race office and return it at the finish. Water and a recovery meal are available at the finish. Medical support is provided. Participants consent to the use of their image. Personal accident insurance is recommended. Online registration, limit of 250 participants, medical support, photography and filming, and rules of conduct on the course.

name: Challenge Poland
description: Challenge Gdańsk is a prestigious middle-distance triathlon held on the Baltic coast in the beautiful surroundings of Gdańsk. Athletes start from the city beach, completing a 1.9 km swim, a fast and flat 90 km bike course through the Vistula Fens, and a 21.1 km run along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park. The finish is on a unique urban pier, making the finale unforgettable. The event is an official qualifier and is highly regarded by triathletes around the world.
course_highlights: 1.9 km swim in the Baltic Sea off Gdańsk’s city beach
90 km flat and fast bike course through the Vistula Fens
21.1 km run along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park, finishing on the urban pier
additional: Races are spread over three days: June 19 features races for children and the TREFL Aquathlon; June 20 features the sprint and Challenge Women by Brooks; and June 21 features the middle distance, with separate wave starts for PRO men, PRO women, and Age Group athletes. You can purchase an option to cancel your registration until June 1, 2026. Special discounts are available for teams of 10 or more. The bike course passes, among other places, Polsat Plus Arena Stadium. Race headquarters and the expo area are located by Brzeźno Beach in Gdańsk. The event also includes an expo, transition areas, technical briefings, and various race categories, and is an official qualifier for major international triathlons.

name: VI Bieg Świętojański
description: The 6th Świętojański Run is a 10 km road race taking place on June 20, 2026, in Zawichost. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic, moderately challenging course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare with training plans tailored to different experience levels and offer expert support. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, which promotes running and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Scenic areas of Zawichost in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship
A moderately challenging course
additional: The organizers offer training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to runners’ VDOT levels, as well as expert support. The website also features a Runner’s Zone with tools to track progress, courses, and running resources. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. On event day, several distances will be available, including 600 m and 800 m races for children, and on-site registration will be possible. The event promotes physical activity among people of different age groups.

name: VI Maraton Leśny
location: Kwidzyn Forest, Kwidzyn, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 6th Kwidzyn Forest Marathon is a unique running event taking place on June 20, 2026. The marathon route passes through the picturesque woodland areas of the Kwidzyn Forest District, giving participants the chance to connect with nature and enjoy an active day surrounded by forests. The event combines sporting competition with environmental education, promoting environmental protection and local natural heritage. The organizers provide safety and support throughout the event.
course_highlights: The route passes through the woodland areas of the Kwidzyn Forest District
Contact with nature and picturesque scenery
Environmental education in a forest setting
additional: The event is organized by the Kwidzyn Forest District. It is linked to an environmental education program. No information is available about entry fees, start time, or online registration. The Kwidzyn Forest District’s telephone and email contact details are available. The event is connected with environmental education and forest activities, takes place in the Miłosna Forest Range, and offers the possibility of participating in various distances.

name: VIII Nocny Bieg
description: The 8th Open Łomża Academic Championships in Night Street Running is an annual sporting event organized by Łomża Academy under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Łomża. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, at 9:00 p.m. on the streets of Łomża, with two routes: 10 km, certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), and 5 km, uncertified. The event commemorates the founding of Łomża Academy and promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants must be at least 18 years old, and the time limit for completing the route is 1.5 hours.
course_highlights: 10 km route certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA)
Night race on the streets of Łomża
Mandatory timing checkpoint on the route
additional: Participant limit: 100 runners for the 5 km and 100 for the 10 km, plus places reserved by the organizers. Runner check-in at the Race Office on race day is from 7:00 p.m. to 8:45 p.m. The office closes after 8:45 p.m. Runners registered after the limit has been reached may still take part, but will not receive a race package (backpack). Proof of identity must be shown to collect the race package. Minors must provide consent from a parent or legal guardian. 10 km route certified by PZLA; 5 km route uncertified; limit of 100 runners per distance; start and check-in in Łomża; night street race

name: XIX Bieg O Błękitną Wstęgę
description: The 19th International Blue Ribbon Run is an annual running event organized by Stargard Athletics Club and held on the streets of Stargard. The main race starts at 21:00, creating a unique atmosphere for night running. The route starts at the Amphitheatre and circles the Jewel of Pomerania, offering views of Stargard’s most beautiful historic landmarks by moonlight. The event promotes health, fitness, and positive energy, encouraging an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Start at the Amphitheatre in Stargard
Route around the Jewel of Pomerania
Views of Stargard’s most beautiful historic landmarks at night
additional: The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere. The route is designed to let runners admire Stargard’s historic landmarks by moonlight. The organizer encourages runners to build endurance and prepare mentally for the race. night run, route around historic landmarks, registration coming soon

location: Owińska, Poznań County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: SPORT CHALLENGE Fundacja Wspierania Aktywności Fizycznej

description: ZIELONKA CHALLENGE is an individual, long-distance running race and Nordic Walking event held in the scenic Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The event offers distances ranging from approximately a quarter marathon to an ultramarathon, following forest roads, tracks and ravines among nature reserves and lakes. It is known for its excellent organisation, well-stocked refreshment stations, and a unique atmosphere of sporting competition and camaraderie. The event centre is in Owińska, near Poznań, and the finish is at the bathing area. The event will take place on 20 June 2026.
course_highlights: Routes follow forest roads, tracks, trails and ravines
Scenic nature reserves and lakes in the Zielonka Forest
Long-distance, point-to-point cross-country running and walking
additional: Starts are staggered: 7:00 — 100+ km ultramarathon and 21+ km Nordic Walking; 8:00 — 21+, 42+ and 75+ km runs; 10:00 — 10+ km run and Nordic Walking. The time limit is 12 hours (14 hours for the 100+ km ultramarathon). The event centre and race office are in Owińska at Traperska Osada; the finish is at the bathing area. The organiser provides refreshment stations and post-race recovery meals. Distances range from 10 km to 100 km. The event takes place in forest areas and features cross-country routes, Nordic Walking events, a 12–14-hour time limit, and registration online and on Facebook.

name: 55-asis bėgimas – pusė maratono „Aplink Elektrėnų marias“
description: 55-asis bėgimas „Aplink Elektrėnų marias“ yra tradicinis pusės maratono bėgimas Elektrėnų savivaldybėje, vykstantis gražioje Elektrėnų miesto aplinkoje. Renginys suburia sporto entuziastus ir aktyvaus laisvalaikio mėgėjus, siūlydamas galimybę bėgti aplink didžiulį Elektrėnų marių tvenkinį. Tai puiki proga pažinti Elektrėnų krašto gamtą ir istoriją, mėgaujantis sportu ir bendruomeniškumu. Renginys vyksta birželio mėnesį, tradiciškai prasideda ryte ir tęsiasi iki popietės.
course_highlights: Bėgimas aplink Elektrėnų marias - didelį tvenkinį, susidariusį užtvigus Strėvos upei
Vaizdingas maršrutas Elektrėnų miesto ir gamtos aplinkoje
Tradicinis renginys, vykstantis nuo 1971 metų
additional: Renginys vyksta birželio 21 d. nuo 08:30 iki 16:00. Registracija vykdoma per oficialią svetainę su paskyros kūrimu. Elektrėnų savivaldybė siūlo daug apgyvendinimo ir maitinimo galimybių netoliese renginio vietos. Renginio data 2027 m. birželio 27 d., startas ir finišas Elektrėnuose, dalyviams siūloma registruotis iš anksto. Renginys vyksta visą dieną, nuo 08:30 iki 16:00.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 4. Pariisi Maastikujooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 brings together health-conscious runners and recreational athletes from spring to autumn, offering a variety of running and walking options. The series aims to promote healthy lifestyles and encourage local people to take part in sporting events. The 4th Pariisi Trail Run takes place on 21 June at Pariisi Holiday Village and is part of a long-running series featuring different age groups and distance options. Timing is chip-based, and race numbers must be attached to the abdomen or chest, reflecting the organisers’ attention to participants’ comfort and safety.
course_highlights: Trail run at Pariisi Holiday Village
Distances from 5 km to 10 km for the main races
Various age groups and race categories
additional: Timing is provided by a chip attached to the back of the race number and covered with a foam pad. Race numbers must be attached to the abdomen or chest, not the back. Pre-registration closes at 16:00 on the day before the race. On-site registration takes place at the times specified in the race guide. The series also includes walking distances from 1.8 km to 10 km. The event offers various distances, including up to 10 km, 5 km, 1.6 km, and short courses for young participants and children. Participants can register online, and the event supports healthy lifestyles and community sports.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Rummu is a varied obstacle race held at the Rummu quarry. On the course, participants climb, crawl, lift and haul their way through mud, water, sand and hills, making it a challenge for everyone. The race is part of the Vägilase jooks series, known as Estonia’s best OCR event. The course is more substantial and offers exciting obstacles and experiences in nature.
course_highlights: 4 km and 8 km distances
Mud, water, sand and hills
Varied obstacles and technical challenges
additional: Register for at least three Vägilase jooks events at once to receive a 15% season discount. Participants under 20 and seniors aged 60 and over receive an automatic 30% discount based on their year of birth. A 20% group discount applies when at least 4 people register for the same event. Children’s races are free when registered online in advance; registration on site costs €3. The children’s races feature manageable obstacles and medals for all finishers. Starts take place in waves, with groups of 8 starting every 2 minutes. Participants may make unlimited attempts at obstacles; failing to complete an obstacle means losing their wristband. Obstacle race, children’s races, registration online and via Stebby, season discounts and invoices, competition categories and start groups, safety and alternative exercises at obstacles

name: Maraton igas linnas Keila
description: Marathon in Every City Keila is a unique running event that gives participants the opportunity to run a marathon distance in different cities. There are refreshment stations along the course every 400 metres, as well as toilets, making the run comfortable and supporting athletes’ wellbeing. The event is suitable both for experienced marathon runners and for those who want to test their endurance. It is well organised and offers a pleasant experience for all participants.
course_highlights: The marathon course runs through city streets and a stadium
Refreshment stations every 400 metres
The risk of getting lost on the course is minimal thanks to clear markings
additional: The marathon takes place at a stadium and on city streets, with a refreshment station and toilet every 400 metres. The risk of getting lost on the course is eliminated thanks to clear markings. The event takes place in the city of Iisaku, offering the chance to enjoy a stadium-based course and take part in different running distances.

organizer: Starostwo Powiatowe w Gryficach, Powiatowe Centrum Sportu Rekreacji i Promocji w Gryficach, PLMKS Chrobry Gryfice, Zarząd Dróg Powiatowych w Gryficach, Klub Sportowy "RunGryf"

description: The 9th edition of Gryf Arena Run will take place on June 21, 2026, in Gryfice. The route runs through the city streets, offering participants a great atmosphere, sporting excitement, and positive energy. The event is family-friendly, with children’s races over distances from 100 to 600 metres, tailored to different age groups. Every child taking part in the races will receive a commemorative T-shirt, a medal, and a sweet treat at the finish. It is one of the largest running events in the region, combining sporting competition with fun for the whole family.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of Gryfice
Children’s races over distances from 100 to 600 metres, tailored to different age groups
An atmosphere full of sporting excitement and positive energy
additional: The McDonald’s Gryfice children’s races start at 10:00. Every child will receive a commemorative T-shirt, a medal, and a sweet treat at the finish. Online registration is available for the children’s races. The entry fee on race day, payable at the race office, is 50 zł. The event takes place in the city of Gryfice, with a road route and electronic timing. Online registration is available; medals and prizes are planned for the best finishers. The participant limit for the main race is 150.

name: IX Bieg Wolności
location: Samorządowa Instytucja Kultury Kasztelania, Kije, Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 9th Bieg Wolności – Kije 2026 is a special sporting event that brings together a passion for running, community spirit, and the promotion of the beautiful Ponidzie region. The race will take place on June 21, 2026, at 18:00 at the Kasztelania Local Cultural Institution in Kije, where the start and finish will be located. Participants can compete over two distances: 10 km and 5.5 km (“Piątka z plusem”), either running or walking with Nordic walking poles. The event offers a great atmosphere, cash and non-cash prizes, and commemorative medals and race packs for all participants.
course_highlights: Two distances: 10 km and 5.5 km (Piątka z plusem)
The course is open to runners and Nordic walkers
Start and finish at the Kasztelania Local Cultural Institution in Kije
additional: All participants will receive commemorative medals and race packs. The organizers have prepared local and age-group classifications, as well as attractive cash and non-cash prizes. The start and finish are located at the Kasztelania Local Cultural Institution in Kije. The grounds around Kasztelania, online registration, commemorative medals, cash and non-cash prizes.

name: X Bieg STO-nogi
location: Milanówek, Warszawa County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Społeczne Liceum Ogólnokształcące Nr 5 STO w Milanówku
description: The X STO-nogi Run in Milanówek is a traditional 10 km road race held in the picturesque town of Milanówek. The T-shaped course consists of two 5 km loops along the town’s streets, with turnarounds by a wayside shrine and on Brzozowa Street. The start and finish are at Social General Secondary School No. 5 at 41 Herberta Street. The race is organized by running enthusiasts from the STO-nogi group, who promote running among residents and visitors.
course_highlights: A 10 km T-shaped course consisting of two 5 km loops
A road race through Milanówek, with turnarounds by a wayside shrine and on Brzozowa Street
Start and finish at SLO No. 5, 41 Herberta Street
additional: Start and finish at SLO No. 5 (41 Herberta Street). Road course with two turnarounds. The race is organized by the local STO-nogi running group, which promotes sport among residents. Previous editions have also included races over other distances and night runs. Contact the organizers by phone: Leszek Janasik 666 353 600, Jerzy Stypa 601 825 560. The event includes a 10 km race through the streets of Milanówek, with online registration and training plans available to help participants prepare. Participants can also take part in accompanying night events.

description: The 10th Ostróda St. George’s Half Marathon is the anniversary edition of the event held in Ostróda. The course runs along the promenade by Lake Drwęckie and through the city streets. It consists of two identical loops, covering a total of 21.098 km. The race starts and finishes at the Amphitheatre at 17a Mickiewicza Street, and water stations are located approximately every 4 km. The organizers provide a commemorative medal and a voucher for a post-race meal, with a choice of a race package with or without a T-shirt. The event is charitable, supporting the rehabilitation of a girl named Maja.
course_highlights: The course runs along the promenade by Lake Drwęckie and through the streets of Ostróda
Two identical loops covering a total of 21.098 km
Water stations approximately every 4 km (4 stations per loop)
additional: The participant limit is 400. The start and finish are at the Amphitheatre at 17a Mickiewicza Street. The time limit is 3 hours. The race package includes a personalized bib, a bag for the baggage drop, safety pins, a commemorative medal, and a voucher for a post-race meal. After June 10, registration is available only at the race office (June 20–21), with a basic package priced at 180 PLN. The timing chip is rented and must be returned after the race. The participant limit is 170 out of 400 places. Entry fees include medals, bags, and a meal voucher. Proceeds from the fees support a charity campaign for Maja’s rehabilitation. The course is not certified by PZLA. Water stations are located every 4 km. The time limit is 3 hours.

name: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka
location: MOSiR Zgierz Malinka, Zgierz, Łódzkie, Poland
description: The 11th Zgierz Malinka Trail Run is a trail race held in the wooded grounds of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. The course features varied terrain, climbs and descents of different lengths and gradients, large sandy patches, and narrow sections through bushes. Its cross-country character attracts runners looking to get away from the asphalt or prepare for mountain races. The event offers three distances: 4, 8, and 12 km, as well as a 4 km Nordic walking event and races for children and young people. Participants receive symbolic medals inspired by raspberries, while the top female and male finishers in each distance receive trophies.
course_highlights: The course runs through the wooded grounds of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka
Varied terrain with climbs, descents, sand, and narrow sections through bushes
A cross-country course, unusual for an urban setting
additional: All runners start at the same time, regardless of distance. Children and young people can take part in races over 150 m (ages 0–6) and 800 m (ages 7–15). The event village at MOSiR Zgierz Malinka offers numerous attractions, including playgrounds, a pump track, beach volleyball courts, mini football and basketball courts, swimming areas, kayak rentals, and a golf driving range. The event includes various race distances, children’s races, medals, electronic timing, and on-site sports attractions.

description: Bieg Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna is an annual running event held in the picturesque area of Deczno near Świecie. The main 10 km race takes participants through the Recreation and Leisure Centre grounds, offering an appealing course and sporting competition. The event also includes free races for children, making it a family-friendly and inclusive event. The organizers provide professional timing and race packs with T-shirts for early registrants. The main race is limited to 300 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km course around the Deczno Recreation and Leisure Centre
Picturesque areas along the banks of the Deczna River
Children’s races as an integral part of the event
additional: The main race is limited to 300 participants, and the children’s races to 100 participants. The children’s races are free. The race pack includes a T-shirt for registrations received by May 31. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00. Organizer contact: Bartosz Gładyszew, tel. 669-056-101. The event also includes competitions for children and attractive prizes for the top runners.

name: Midsommartrail - Möt ljuset
description: Midsommartrail – Meet the Light is a personal trail race held on the longest day of the year, with the experience at its heart. The race starts before dawn so you can run into the daylight along a 30 km route through beautiful forest terrain. The number of participants is limited (maximum 100) to create an intimate and considerate atmosphere, and after the finish the organizers serve a generous breakfast. Navigation is by a GPS route provided in advance and a map at the start, and there are two aid stations along the way.
course_highlights: 30 km of trail running at dawn, meeting the light along the route
Two aid stations along the route
Navigation using a GPS route and map (runners are responsible for their own navigation)
additional: Start/finish at Attunda Orienteering Club’s clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22, Sollentuna; easiest public transport: commuter train to Rotebro (1.5 km walk); parking at Sollentuna Golf Club (500 m walk); parking on Ytterbyvägen is not permitted; maximum 100 participants; breakfast served after the race; registration open until one hour before the start; minimum age 18. Recommended accommodation: Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna (discount code NIGHTTRAILRUN). Start time: 02:00 on 2026-06-21. 30 km trail run; GPS route and map; two aid stations along the way; breakfast after the finish; hotel discount at Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna with code NIGHTTRAILRUN.

name: Night Trail Run  Sommar 2025
description: Night Trail Run Sommartrail is a personal trail race in Sollentuna, held on the longest day of the year. The race is 30 km long and starts at dawn, giving participants the experience of meeting the summer light. Participant numbers are limited to preserve an intimate atmosphere. Participants navigate using a GPS route, sent in advance, and are also given a map at the start. After the finish, a hearty breakfast is served so you can share the experience with the other runners.
course_highlights: 30 km of trail running, starting before dawn and reaching daylight
Participants navigate themselves using a GPS route and a map provided at the start
Two energy stations along the course and breakfast after the finish
additional: Maximum 100 runners. Start/finish at Attunda Orienteering Clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22 in Sollentuna. Nearest public transport: commuter train to Rotebro station, followed by an approximately 1.5 km walk to the venue. Parking is recommended at Sollentuna Golf Club (approximately 500 m away); parking on Ytterbyvägen is not permitted. Participants are responsible for navigating; the GPS route is sent in advance and a map is handed out at the start. Registration is open until one hour before the race starts. Minimum age: 18. Recommended accommodation: Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna (discount code NIGHTTRAILRUN). Seasonal versions include Sommartrail, Hösttrail and Hundtrail, with the experience and the nighttime experience highlighted as the essence of Night Trail Run.

name: Bėgimo varžybos „Už vaikų rytojų“
description: Bėgimo varžybos „Už vaikų rytojų“ yra renginys, skirtas skatinti visuomenę tapti vyresnių vaikų globėjais ir keisti neigiamas nuostatas apie globojamus vaikus. Varžybos vyksta Kauno Ąžuolyne, startas ir finišas yra prie Lietuvos sporto universiteto centrinių rūmų. Renginys skirtas atkreipti dėmesį į globėjų šeimų laukiančius vyresnius nei 10 metų vaikus ir viešinti globos centro teikiamas paslaugas. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų, o kiekvienas finišavęs dalyvis gauna atminimo medalį.
course_highlights: 5 km distancija - 2 ratai po 2,5 km
Startas ir finišas prie Lietuvos sporto universiteto centrinių rūmų
Varžybos vyksta Kauno Ąžuolyne, prie paminklo S. Dariui ir S. Girėnui
additional: Varžybose yra trys distancijos: 500 m (gimę 2014 m. ir jaunesni, startas 18:30), 1 km (startas 18:45) ir 5 km (startas 19:05). Dalyviai privalo turėti numerį ant marškinėlių priekyje. Apdovanojami nugalėtojai ir prizininkai įvairiose amžiaus grupėse, o kiekvienas finišavęs dalyvis gauna atminimo medalį. Dalyviams ir palaikantiems asmenims draudžiama naudoti transporto priemones ir asmeninę palydą varžybų metu. Registracija vyksta internetu, renginys skirtas vaikams ir jaunimui, siekiant skatinti aktyvų gyvenimo būdą ir socialinį įsitraukimą

name: Pärnumaa Võidupüha maraton
description: The Pärnumaa Victory Day Marathon takes place on 22 June 2026 in Tori Parish, with the event centre located beside the historic Tori Estonian Soldiers’ Memorial Church. The marathon brings several new features and is organised in cooperation with the Pärnumaa Sports Association and supporters. It is a traditional and legendary race, offering athletes a varied and memorable experience.
course_highlights: Event centre beside the legendary Tori Estonian Soldiers’ Memorial Church
Varied and historic course through the Pärnumaa landscape
Organised in cooperation with the Pärnumaa Sports Association and Tori Parish
additional: The event centre for all distances is located beside the legendary and historic Tori Estonian Soldiers’ Memorial Church. The event is organised by Tori Parish in cooperation with the Pärnumaa Sports Association and supporters. Volunteers will be involved in the event. The marathon will use a new course, and the event is part of the Victory Day celebrations in Pärnumaa.

name: VI-asis Alaušo maratonas
location: Sudeikių ežeras, Sudeikiai, Utenos rajonas, Lithuania
organizer: VšĮ Utenos verslo ir turizmo agentūra
description: VI-asis Alaušo maratonas yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Sudeikių miestelyje, Utenos rajone, Joninių nakties išvakarėse. Maratonas suteikia galimybę sporto entuziastams patirti unikalią atmosferą ir išbandyti savo ištvermę gražioje gamtos aplinkoje prie Sudeikių ežero. Renginys prasideda vakare, birželio 23 dieną, 19:30 val., ir kviečia dalyvius bei žiūrovus į aktyvų ir smagų sporto vakarą.
course_highlights: Vyksta Sudeikių miestelyje prie Sudeikių ežero
Renginio pradžia Joninių nakties išvakarėse, birželio 23 d. 19:30 val.
Maratonas vyksta Utenos rajone, gamtos apsuptyje
additional: Registracija vykdoma per oficialią svetainę su galimybe prisijungti per Facebook. Renginys vyksta Joninių nakties išvakarėse, todėl startas numatytas vakare. Renginio vieta pažymėta Google Maps nuoroda Sudeikių miestelyje. Renginys apima ne tik bėgimą, bet ir kitus aktyvius užsiėmimus, registracija vyksta internetu, ir jis yra svarbi vietinė sporto šventės dalis.

name: Häädemeeste Võidupüha jooks
description: The Häädemeeste Victory Day Run is a traditional running event held near the Häädemeeste bus station. The event invites everyone who enjoys being active to celebrate Victory Day in a sporting and community-minded spirit. In addition to the main race, a children’s run for the youngest members of the family will be held for the first time. After the run, participants can enjoy the Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden. Participation is free, and registration takes place on site.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Häädemeeste bus station
Children’s run before the main race
Midsummer celebration at Häädemeeste Summer Garden after the run
additional: Registration and gathering take place on site at the Häädemeeste bus station from 16:00 to 17:30. Participation is free.

name: 49. Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve
location: Karksi ordulinnuse varemed, Karksi-Nuia, Põhja-Sakala vald, Estonia
description: The 49th Jaanijooks around the Karksi-Nuia reservoir is a traditional running race held near the ruins of Karksi Order Castle. The race follows a route around the picturesque Karksi-Nuia reservoir, offering participants beautiful views and an enjoyable running experience. The event is intended for both recreational and experienced runners, and offers a chance to enjoy an active day in the community.
course_highlights: A run around the Karksi-Nuia reservoir
Picturesque views of the reservoir and the castle ruins
Rural and forest roads, suitable for different types of runners
additional: The event is part of the local community’s sports calendar and takes place near a historic site, giving participants the chance to experience nature and history at the same time.

name: Jooks suvesse
description: The Pööripäevajooksud are an annual race series consisting of several stages, where participants can earn points and compete in age groups. Jooks suvesse is one of the series’ stages and takes place in Loode tammik in Kuressaare. The course has varied terrain, including a shared-use path and forest roads, which may be muddy depending on the weather. Participants are provided with electronic timing, reusable race bibs and drinking cups, and a sweet treat and drink at the finish.
course_highlights: The loop is 2,346 metres long
About 600 metres of the course is on a shared-use path
Three quarters of the course runs through the forest on dirt/gravel roads
additional: Reusable race bibs with timing chips, which must be returned after the race. The entry fee is paid in cash on site. There is a small car park at the finish, as well as parking along the roadside. All competitors receive a diploma at the finish, and prizes are awarded to the three fastest in each age group. Taking part in at least three stages qualifies participants to receive a diploma and trophy for the season overall. The event includes various running activities and gives participants the chance to enjoy the summer atmosphere of Saaremaa.

name: Jaanijooks ümber Karksi-Nuia paisjärve
description: Jaanijooks around the Karksi-Nuia reservoir is a traditional road race held in the Karksi-Nuia area. The race gives participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful surroundings of the lake and take on a sporting challenge. The event is organized by MTÜ Karksi Sport, which is dedicated to promoting local sports. Jaanijooks is a great opportunity for both recreational and experienced runners to take part in a friendly and supportive environment.
course_highlights: A run around the Karksi-Nuia reservoir
Beautiful lakeside scenery
Road surfaces and pedestrian and cycle paths
additional: Participants can register online or on race day. Participants have the opportunity to receive awards and use a race bib and chip. Health and insurance liability for participants is also addressed as part of the event.

name: V Charytatywny Bieg dla Dzieci Bohaterów Biegaj - Pomagaj
12. Rõuge maastikujooks-kõnd
description: The 12th Rõuge Trail Run and Walk is a trail running and Nordic walking event held in the beautiful Rõuge Ööbikuorg, Võru County, offering participants the chance to enjoy nature and exercise. The event is suitable for runners, Nordic walkers and walkers looking to spend time actively. The Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity organizes the event to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Participants can experience beautiful scenery and the joy of movement while supporting their well-being.
course_highlights: Beautiful scenery in Rõuge Ööbikuorg
Suitable for running, Nordic walking and walking
A nature-rich route in Võru County
additional: The route includes forest trails and hiking trails; the event promotes physical activity and health; registration and further information are unavailable.

name: Herbatka u Tadka, czyli Bieg do Herbacia...
Böda Beach Run
location: Böda Sand-stranden, Löttorp, Borgholm Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Böda Beach Run is a race that stands out at Böda Sand. It is a challenging competition on sand and in water, suited both to those looking to compete and to families looking to have fun, with courses ranging from 500 metres to 10 km. Everyone who finishes receives a medal. The event is held at Böda Sand Beach Resort on 24 June.
course_highlights: Courses from 500 m to 10 km
A challenging competition on sand and in water
A medal for everyone who finishes
additional: Date: 24 June. The event takes place at Böda Sand Beach Resort (Bödasandsallén 11, 387 73 Löttorp). Contact/phone for Böda Sand: (+46)485-22200. The event is promoted as family-friendly and recurring in the resort’s events calendar. Special accommodation offers are available at Böda Sand; late registration and race-number pickup take place at Nordpoolen at 12:00 on race day.

name: Aastajooks
organizer: Spordiklubi Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi MTÜ
description: Pärnu Annual Runs are a tradition dating back to a running series launched in 1985. Inspired by the Eastern calendar, the series is dedicated each year to that year’s symbolic animal. The 2026 series features the Year of the Fire Horse Run, comprising nine stages held at three locations in Pärnu: Vallikäär, Pärnu Beach and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail. Three stages take place at each location, offering runners a varied and enjoyable experience. Throughout the series, participants can enjoy different landscapes and beautiful views of Pärnu.
course_highlights: Nine stages across three starting locations: Pärnu Vallikäär, Pärnu Beach and the Reiu-Raeküla health trail
Varied terrain and beautiful views of Pärnu and its coastal area
Three runs at each location, offering the chance to experience different running routes
additional: The series consists of nine stages held at three different starting locations, with three runs at each location. Starts usually begin at 18:30. Participants can purchase a season pass or register for individual stages. The organizer is Pärnu Kahe Silla Klubi. The event takes place in Pärnu during the summer season and includes various stages and child-friendly activities. Registration and the detailed schedule are available on the organization’s website.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – edycja nocna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań - Night Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences. The event is part of a race series organized since 2014 by a group of enthusiasts who focus on attractive courses and promoting running. After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those awarded at the spring edition, encouraging them to collect them. It is a special opportunity to run in beautiful surroundings and enjoy the atmosphere of a night race.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in the Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences
Picturesque, attractive courses
Night edition with unique medals
additional: At the finish of the night edition, participants receive medals different from those awarded at the spring edition, encouraging them to collect them. The organizers are a group of running enthusiasts active since 2014, specializing in cross-country races and attractive locations. Scenic trail in the Dendrological Garden of the Poznań University of Life Sciences, scenic routes, scenic location, scheduled for June 26, 2026

name: Trosa Stadslopp
description: Trosa Stadslopp is a long-running community celebration, always held on the first Friday after Midsummer. In 2026, the race takes place on Friday, 26 June. The course runs through picturesque summer-time Trosa, with large crowds and close to the water, creating a summery atmosphere for both competition and recreation. The event offers categories for elite runners, recreational runners, young people and children, as well as the 8,900 m main race and shorter recreational options.
course_highlights: The course runs through picturesque summer-time Trosa, close to the water
The 8,900 m main race, plus the 4 km Jogging/Walking with poles event and a 700 m children's race
Start and finish at Trosa square, with large crowds and stage activities
additional: Registration remains open until the start, and payment can be made by Swish or card; alternatively, pay to Trosa Stadslopp's bankgiro 488-8335. Folksam recreational race insurance is available (e.g. SEK 155 for basic cover, Startklar Plus SEK 275). Bib collection opens at 10:00 at Team Sportia on race day. The 8,900 m main race has start groups based on target times (start group 1 at 21:00, followed by additional groups); there is also a children's race (700 m) and award ceremonies on stage. The organiser gives 50 cl of Vitamin Well to runners in the 8,900 m and 4 km races. The programme also includes 700 m and 900 m distances, Jogging/Walking with poles over 4 km, and information about night buses to Stockholm after the race.

description: Sillamäe Promenade Run is a well-known city race held near the Sillamäe Cultural Centre. The race tradition began as a stair run, and since 2021 it has been called the Promenade Run. The event offers various distances, from short runs for little ones to the adults’ 7 km main distance, which also challenges trained athletes. It is a community-focused and engaging event, with several activities in addition to running, and an important contribution from supporters and volunteers.
course_highlights: The 7 km main distance includes the Sillamäe stairs—the race’s toughest but most beautiful climb
Shorter distances for children and young people: 150 m, 450 m and 3.5 km
A city run along the Sillamäe promenade and stairs
additional: Registration takes place online and usually closes one month before the race. The participation fee must be paid to the account of the Sillamäe School Sports Association. The event also features volunteers, several supporters, and additional activities such as dancing, singing, cycling and basketball shooting. The race is organised by several local sports organisations and schools. The event includes various distance options and cultural activities and is aimed at engaging the community. Participants can also enjoy beautiful nature and views of the sea.

name: EUTR - Estonia Ultra-Trail Race
description: The 9th edition of the Estonia Ultra-Trail Race (EUTR) will take place on 26–27 June 2026 in Narva, Ida-Virumaa, Estonia. The race starts and finishes at the Akkekula (Nut Hill) sports complex. Organized by the non-commercial sports club SK ETR, the event features trails certified by the International Trail Running Association (ITRA), with ITRA points awarded to finishers. The race offers several distances for trail runners of different levels, including an ultra-trail and shorter trail options.
course_highlights: 126 km Ultra-Trail distance with 4 ITRA qualification points
63 km Trail distance with 2 ITRA qualification points
33 km Trail distance with 1 ITRA qualification point
additional: Reregistration is possible for a fee of 15 EUR, plus any price difference when changing distance. The race offers changing rooms, storage facilities, and an EXPO area. Registration for the Breakout® race for athletes with disabilities using wheelchairs is closed. The organizer reserves the right to use photos and videos taken during the event indefinitely. The event offers various distances, including ultramarathon, trail, and wheelchair racing. Registration and schedule information are available on the website.

name: XIII Dycha Anny Wazówny
location: Brodnica, Brodnica County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Anna Vasa 10K is a 10 km road race taking place in Brodnica. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness over a middle distance, and the organizers encourage participants to prepare with dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The race is open and welcoming to runners, offering expert support and the chance to take part in a sporting event in the picturesque Kuyavian-Pomeranian region.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Picturesque surroundings in Brodnica
Designed for a moderate difficulty level
additional: The organizer offers training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to runners’ VDOT levels, as well as expert support. Educational materials on warming up, foam rolling, and running preparation are also available on the website. The event includes several distances, including the 10 km main race, children’s races, and a 3 km race. Registration is available online, and the event promotes active leisure and discovering the region.

name: III Bieg w Sławicach
description: The 3rd Sławice Run is a 10 km road race taking place on 27 June 2026 in Sławice, Masovian Voivodeship. Runners can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness over a middle distance in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers welcome both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Designed for a moderate difficulty level
Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available to help runners prepare
additional: Training plans ranging from 8 to 20 weeks are available and tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Expert support is available during preparation. Runners can use the Runner’s Zone, which offers additional materials and courses. No detailed information is available about entry fees, registration, or the exact course. Follow official sources for updates.

name: X Lubeński Cross
description: The X Lubeński Cross is a mountain cross-country race held in the picturesque area of the Lubenia municipality. The start and finish are at the market square in Lubenia. The main race routes are 13.8 km and 22.3 km long, covering varied terrain: asphalt, paved roads and field paths, as well as 3 or 5 green hills. The race is known for its high level of difficulty and beautiful views, creating a unique sporting celebration. Children’s and youth races are also held at the stadium, divided by age and gender categories.
course_highlights: The routes pass over 3 green hills on the shorter distance and 5 on the longer distance
Varied terrain: asphalt (21–25%), paved roads (32–38%), field roads and paths (41–43%)
Picturesque mountain terrain in the Lubenia municipality
additional: Children’s and youth races take place at the stadium on a marked loop of approximately 200 m, divided by age and gender categories. Children’s race numbers must be collected by 10:30. This year, on-the-day registration for children is unavailable because all starting places have been filled. Registration for children at the stadium opens after 10:30, with a limited number of race packages available. The children’s races begin after the shorter main race starts. Mountain terrain, online and stadium registration, annual event held since 2016, varied routes and distances.

description: The 13th Cichociemni Run is a cross-country race held in Sochaczew, dedicated to the memory of the Polish heroes and soldiers known as the Cichociemni. The course is challenging, with numerous natural and artificial obstacles of varying difficulty that require participants to get wet, jump over obstacles, and crawl beneath them. The race takes place once a year in June and attracts people who want to overcome their weaknesses and aren’t afraid of mud. It’s a unique opportunity to get to know the banks and bed of the Bzura River and feel the wind in your hair during a sporting competition.
course_highlights: Cross-country course with natural and artificial obstacles
Route along the banks and bed of the Bzura River
Challenging features: mud, water, ditches, jumps, and crawling beneath obstacles
additional: Registration is available through the Zmierzymy Czas platform. Entry fees increase as the race date approaches and depend on the date payment is made. A race-specific T-shirt can be ordered during selected periods. Running groups of at least 6 people can receive a discount by contacting the organizers by email in advance. Payment must be made within 30 days of registration. The organizer is UKS Dragon Fight Club Sochaczew. terrain, online registration, obstacles, challenging course

name: XXI Dziesiątka Unisławska
description: The XXI Unisław 10K is an annual 10 km race and Nordic Walking event organized in Unisław as part of Unisław Days. The race route follows paved roads through the picturesque Chełmno Landscape Park, passing through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty. The race is certified by the Polish Athletic Association and is part of the 2026 Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running. All running and Nordic Walking enthusiasts are invited to take part in this sporting event.
course_highlights: The route passes through Chełmno Landscape Park
A 10 km distance certified by the Polish Athletic Association
Passes through Unisław, Stablewice and Gołoty
additional: The race and Nordic Walking event take place on 27 June 2026. The race routes follow paved roads. The race counts toward the 2026 edition of the Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship Grand Prix in Long-Distance Running. Nordic Walking is also available as an event, and the route is marked and supported by medical services. The race starts at 10:00, and participants can expect refreshment points along the route.

name: XXXVII Cross Świętojański
location: Pogórze, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 37th Jan Marek St John’s Cross in Pogórze is a traditional race organized by LKS Pogórze, taking place on June 27, 2026, at 18:00. The event is held in the scenic village of Pogórze and attracts runners who enjoy competing on off-road courses. The organizers provide professional RFID timing and comprehensive technical support to ensure the event runs smoothly. All running enthusiasts are welcome to take part in this exceptional sporting event.
course_highlights: Running course through the scenic terrain of Pogórze
Professional RFID timing
Start at 18:00, allowing for a run in pleasant evening conditions
additional: Registration closes on June 21, 2026, at 23:59. The organizer provides electronic timing at the start and finish lines, an electronic LED clock at the finish, and real-time results on the website. The organizer is responsible for operating the race office and distributing race numbers. Registration ends on June 21, 2026. The event is open to different age groups, and the course is likely to run through outdoor areas in Pogórze.

name: Kalmar Malkars 21 km
description: Kalmar Malkars 21 km is a fast, one-lap half marathon that takes runners through many of Kalmar’s beautiful surroundings. It is well suited to both competitive runners and recreational participants. The start and finish are at Malkars Träningscenter on Torsåsgatan, and the course offers views of Kalmarsund, Kalmar Castle and the Öland Bridge. In addition to the half marathon, Malkars Femman (5 km) is also offered and is open to walkers, wheelchair users and strollers—the focus is on the joy of exercise. All finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: One-lap course passing Kalmar Castle and Kalmarsund
Views of the Öland Bridge along Ängöleden
Fast course where many runners set personal records
additional: Start and finish at Malkars Träningscenter, Toråsgatan 1, Kalmar. Bib collection: Friday 26 June, 15:00–17:00, and Saturday 27 June, 12:00–15:00. Late registration is available through 25 June, and may also be possible at bib collection after that date. Payment for late registration: cash, card or Swish. Half-marathon water stations after 5, 10, 15 and 18 km, and at the finish (Umara sports drink and water). Everyone who registers for the 21.1 km race by 20 June receives a shirt at bib collection. All finishers receive a medal; ICA MAXI provides a drink, fruit and a piece of chocolate after the race. Information: Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02. The half marathon includes water stations after 5, 10, 15 and 18 km and at the finish; bibs are collected at the specified times; late registration is available through 25 June; payment by card, cash or Swish; a shirt is offered to those who register before 20 June; all finishers receive a medal.

name: Kustmaran (Kristianopel)
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halvmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 0.9 km
description: Kustmaran och Kristianopel Runt is a running festival for the whole family in picturesque Kristianopel on the east coast, with distances from 0.9 km up to the marathon (42.2 km). The event takes place on 27 June 2026 and offers both competitive races and recreational options, with dedicated support from Team Blekinge’s event staff. The day combines running through an idyllic summer landscape with opportunities for swimming, dining and overnight stays in the area. Everyone is welcome, from the children’s race and the untimed walk/run “Sommarlunken” to the half and full marathons for more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Run through an idyllic summer landscape around picturesque Kristianopel on the east coast
A range of distances: marathon (42.2 km), half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 0.9 km (children’s race) and Sommarlunken 4 km
The children’s race takes place inside Kristianopel Camping; swimming and local amenities are available in the village
additional: Race bibs can be collected and late entries made on race day from 08:00. Regular registration can be paid for by card or Swish; for payment by bank giro, contact register@teamblekinge.nu before registering. Electronic timing is provided by Racetimer. Participants in the half marathon and marathon must turn at least 17 during the year. Sommarlunken is untimed and no medal is awarded; prizes are drawn by lottery. Start times vary by distance; electronic timing; registration and payment options: card and Swish for regular registration, bank giro by arrangement if needed; late entries can be paid for by Swish or cash; parking outside Kristianopel; water stations, changing facilities, toilets and medical assistance at the finish area; rules in accordance with the Swedish Athletics Association.

name: Kustmaran
price_range: 50 kr - 600 kr (beroende på distans och anmälningsperiod)
description: Kustmaran and Kristianopel Runt is a running festival for the whole family, held on 27 June 2026 in Kristianopel, Blekinge. With distances from 0.9 km up to the 42.2 km marathon, there is something for all levels and ages. The race offers beautiful, idyllic summer scenery, with enthusiastic support and cheerful cheers from Team Blekinge’s volunteers. Participants can also enjoy Kristianopel’s charm, with swimming, restaurants, cafés and accommodation. It is a memorable day focused on running and community, for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Distance options from 0.9 km to 42.2 km
Running through idyllic summer scenery on the east coast
Children’s race at Kristianopel Camping
additional: Race bibs can be collected and late registration completed on race day from 08:00. Electronic timing by Racetimer. Rules follow the Swedish Athletics Federation’s regulations for road races. Only participants who turn at least 17 during the year may enter the half marathon and marathon. Sommarlunken is a 4 km untimed recreational distance, with no medal and prizes awarded by raffle. Trail terrain, registration via the website, water stations, swimming facilities, camping and changing rooms are available.

name: Muraste jooks
location: Muraste Kooli staadion, Muraste, Harku vald, Harju maakond, Estonia
description: The Muraste Run is part of the Harku Municipality Running Series and takes place on June 28, 2026, at Muraste School Stadium. The course runs along the streets and shared-use paths of Muraste, on marked, open roads. A range of distances is available for children and adults, and participants can also take part in a family competition. The top finishers in each age group will be awarded prizes, and those who complete the series will receive a season medal. The event is organized by MTÜ TreeningPluss, which promotes the joy of movement and active lifestyles.
course_highlights: The course runs along the streets and shared-use paths of Muraste
The course is marked and runs on open roads
A range of distances is available for children and adults
additional: The event centre opens at 10:00. Race materials are issued until 15 minutes before the start. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:30, with prizes for the top three men and women in each age group. The family competition is for mothers, fathers and children, who score points according to age groups. Participation is at each participant’s own risk; for minors, responsibility lies with a parent or guardian. Participation may be free or paid; exact information is unavailable. Registration is available in advance and on site, and the course runs along the streets and shared-use paths of Muraste.

name: Märgatud laps jooksmas
description: The charitable running series “Märgatud Laps jooksmas” takes place at Kose Song Festival Grounds and offers participants the chance to enjoy a sporting experience while supporting a good cause. The aim of the series is to bring the community together and offer the joy of exercise to all age groups. The event is open to everyone interested in running and creates a friendly, supportive atmosphere.
course_highlights: A supportive and friendly atmosphere throughout the running series
A charitable purpose and community involvement
Held at Kose Song Festival Grounds
additional: The run aims to involve the community and promote healthy lifestyles. Participants can support a charitable cause.

name: Kresowe Trail #7
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale, non-commercial trail races held amid the scenic natural landscapes of eastern Poland and the Vilnius Region. The courses pass through unspoiled forests, varied climbs, sand and roots, offering challenges for both beginners and experienced runners. The races feature two distances: the shorter Szpurt (approx. 7 km) and the longer Wertep (approx. 17–21 km), which is an ultra-distance race. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, respect for nature and bringing together runners from different backgrounds.
course_highlights: Courses pass through forests with natural obstacles, including climbs, sand and roots
Courses are marked to cycling standards with clear arrows and ribbons
Scenic views, abundant nature and the region’s multicultural heritage
additional: The races take place in an intimate atmosphere, with participant numbers limited for safety and to protect nature. Competition includes overall and team classifications, with awards for the top runners in age categories. The courses are easy to navigate thanks to the markings, and the event promotes physical activity in a healthy forest environment. To be included in the Kresowe Trail series classification, participants must complete at least six races; registration details are not provided.

name: Roztoczański Festiwal Biegowy
location: Kresowa Osada, Basznia Dolna, Lubaczów, Poland
description: Roztocze Running Festival 2026 is one of the largest running events in the Roztocze region, organized by the Lubaczów Municipality. The three-day festival takes place in Basznia Dolna, at Kresowa Osada, the start and finish venue for all races and Nordic walking events. Participants can choose from ten different distances, ranging from night races and Nordic walking to an ultramarathon and a half marathon, across the picturesque landscapes of the Lubaczów region. The event combines sporting competition with a festival atmosphere, attracting experienced runners and amateurs alike.
course_highlights: Courses pass through the distinctive landscapes of the Lubaczów region and Roztocze
The start and finish are at Kresowa Osada in Basznia Dolna
A range of distances, from a 5 km Nordic walking event to an ultramarathon of approximately 60 km
additional: The festival lasts three days: Friday opens with a 7 km Night Run and a 5 km Nordic walking event; Saturday features an ultramarathon of approximately 60 km, the 39th Lwów Rifle Infantry Regiment Memorial Marathon, a 4x10.5 km marathon relay, and a Nordic walking relay; Sunday includes a run of approximately 30 km, the Crystal Cup Half Marathon, a 10 km run, and a 10 km Nordic walking event. The main 5 km race starts at 10:00, followed by children’s and youth races in four age categories. Participants in the main race will receive a medal and a sweet snack, while younger runners will receive a medal and a surprise. The top runners will be presented with awards after the event. The event is part of a running series and offers race packages to the first people to register.

5 km main race course
Children’s and youth races in 4 age categories

Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and a highlight of the main race is a sausage after the finish. Register at olandrunning.se or on site. The registration deadline is June 26, 2026, with late registration available until July 1.

location: Unos Park, Gamleby, Västervik Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Byrundan is a city race held in Gamleby, starting and finishing in Unos Park. The event offers races for all ages and is well suited to both recreational runners and families. Welcome on 3 July 2026 — registration opens shortly.
course_highlights: Takes place in Gamleby’s urban setting
Starts and finishes in Unos Park
Races for all ages
