name: 45. jooks ümber Pühajärve
location: Pühajärve Spa & Holiday Resort, Otepää, Valga County, Estonia
description: The 45th Run Around Lake Pühajärv is a traditional running race held around Pühajärv Spa & Holiday Resort. The distance is 10.7 km, and the course is well marked and secured, offering participants beautiful views of the lake. The race is part of the 2026 Maru Lake Runs series and is its third event. The start is at 12:00 on Saturday, July 11. Participants are provided with timing, refreshment stations and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: A 10.7 km course around Lake Pühajärv
Refreshment stations at 4.4 km and 7.7 km
The course is marked and secured by course marshals
additional: Start groups are formed based on previous results; elite runners may start in the first group. Timing is chip-based, with the chip attached to the back of the race bib. Participants receive a medal, sports drink and water on the course and at the finish, as well as medical assistance along the entire course. The awards ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:30, with awards for the top six. Participants can register on site, and discounts are available. The course runs around Lake Pühajärv and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triatlon 2026
location: Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Triathlon takes place on 11 July 2026 at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre and offers an exciting recreational triathlon experience. The main distance consists of a 250 m swim, a 20 km mountain-bike ride and a 4 km run, which runs largely along the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Protection Area. In addition to the main event, participants can take part in the Stebby duathlon and youth duathlon, which are intended for different age groups. The event is well organised, with chip timing, medical support and aid stations. After the race, participants receive a medal and can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and bike washing facilities.
course_highlights: The swim takes place in the pond at Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre; one lap, with a maximum depth of 2.5 m
The 20 km cycling course follows the ski trails and forest roads of the Põhja-Kõrvemaa Landscape Protection Area
The 4 km trail run is marked and secured
additional: Starts are staggered in waves of five, with a 10-second interval between each start. Competitors must wear a helmet while cycling and a timing chip around their ankle. The entry fee includes medical first aid, aid-station service, a medal, hot soup, a smoothie, access to a sauna and hot tub, and bike washing. There is a bag drop at the event centre and a place to change clothes in the sauna anteroom. The swim number must be written on the cheek or shoulder with a waterproof marker. Drafting is allowed during the cycling leg. Trail course, family races, free soup and sauna, registration information, entry fees vary, limited number of places

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 22. Emumäe jooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series 2026 brings together recreational athletes and active-lifestyle enthusiasts from spring to autumn, offering the chance to test their abilities across different age groups and distances. The 22nd Emumäe Run is the series’ fifth stage and takes place at Emumäe on 4 July. The series aims to promote running and fitness walking and support local recreational athletes. Races are held over several distances, from short children’s races to main races of up to 10 km. Timing is by chip, and race numbers must be attached to the abdomen or chest.
course_highlights: Several distances from 100 m to 10 km, suitable for different age groups
Chip timing; race numbers must be attached to the abdomen or chest
The series stages take place at various locations in Lääne-Virumaa; the Emumäe Run is the fifth stage
additional: Pre-registration is available on the running series website and closes at 16:00 on the day before the race. On-site registration takes place at the times specified in the race guide. No points are awarded in the youngest distance categories (Tillujooks, Minijooks, Lastejooks). Chips are attached to the back of the race number and covered with foam board; they must not be removed. The running series features various distances and categories, welcomes a diverse range of participants, and aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the community together.

name: Võhma terviseraja maraton
location: Võhma, Põhja-Sakala vald, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: The Võhma Health Trail Marathon is a trail marathon held on the Võhma city health trail. The course is a 620-metre loop to be completed 68 times, for a total of 42.2 km. The race takes place on 4 July 2026, starting at 9:00, and offers participants a medal, timekeeping, course support, food at the finish, and washing facilities. In addition to the marathon, participants can also run a shorter distance for free, without their time being recorded; this option is suitable for anyone who enjoys being active.
course_highlights: 620-metre loop on the health trail
68 laps for the marathon distance (42.2 km)
Trail terrain
additional: Race-day packet pick-up starts at 8:00. The number of participants is limited. From 9:00 to 13:00, runners wishing to cover a shorter distance than 42 km are allowed on the course; participation is free and times are not recorded. Everyone who completes at least 17 laps (10.5 km) receives a medal. The marathon is open to active participants born in 2010 or earlier. Timekeeping is manual. The time limit is 6 hours 30 minutes. The entry fee includes a medal, timekeeping, course support, food at the finish, and washing facilities. The entry fee can be paid in cash on race day or in advance to a bank account. Previous marathon winners may participate for free. Trail terrain, registration by email, limited number of participants, medal and services included in the entry fee

name: J. Lossmanni mälestusjooks
description: The Jüri Lossmann Memorial Run is a traditional running event held in Viljandi. The event takes place on 4 July 2026, starting at 19:00. The run is dedicated to Jüri Lossmann and offers participants the chance to enjoy a pleasant summer evening and a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Location in the city of Viljandi
Evening start at 19:00
Traditional memorial run
additional: The run takes place in the evening and is part of the traditions of Estonia’s running community, offering participants the chance to remember and celebrate.

name: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny
description: The Kalisz Night Amber Hellena Half Marathon is a unique night-time half marathon held in Kalisz. The race attracts hundreds of runners from various cities, offering a one-of-a-kind atmosphere and a running challenge after dark. The half-marathon course passes through charming parts of the city, giving participants an unforgettable experience. The event has become an established tradition and is popular with both amateur and professional runners.
course_highlights: A night run through the streets of Kalisz
Half-marathon distance (21.097 km)
A sporting celebration with hundreds of runners
additional: The race starts at 22:00 and runs until 2:00 a.m. The list of confirmed participants is available online. The event has a participant limit, with more than 860 runners currently confirmed. The event includes a half marathon, and the course passes through sports facilities and streets in Kalisz. Registration is online, and participants can expect a well-organized event with extensive race-day arrangements.

name: Mam Marzenie 12.RAZ 25h RUN
organizer: Fundacja Mam Marzenie oraz Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia (RAZ Szczecin)
description: 25h RUN is a unique running event organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, combining sport with charity. The 10th-anniversary edition takes place by Lake Arkonka in Szczecin and aims to fulfill the dream of Marlena, a beneficiary of the foundation, to travel to the island of Zakynthos. Participants run for 25 hours, and every kilometer brings them closer to making this dream come true. It is not only a sporting challenge but also an opportunity to join forces in support of children in need.
course_highlights: The run lasts 25 hours, making it a unique endurance challenge
The course is located beside picturesque Lake Arkonka in Szczecin
The event combines physical activity with a charity initiative to make children’s dreams come true
additional: The event is organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, which has fulfilled more than 10,000 children’s dreams since 2004. The event is charitable, and every kilometer run contributes to fulfilling the beneficiary’s dream. Registration is available at the external website https://raz.szczecin.pl/. The event supports fundraising to fulfill a child’s dream. Participants register online and can count on support and motivation throughout the 25-hour run.

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowska ZaDyszka is an annual road race held in Janikowo, attracting runners of different age groups and ability levels. The race takes place over a 10 km course, with professional timekeeping provided using Chronotrack technology. The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Janikowo, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, which offers high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and welcoming to everyone who enjoys physical activity.

Professional timekeeping with active Chronotrack chips
Organized by the local Sports and Recreation Center
additional: Timekeeping is 99.8% reliable thanks to active Chronotrack chips. The race office and organizer can be reached at ul. Bp. Michała Kozala 3, 88-160 Janikowo. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, or additional services. Date: 2026-07-04; location: Janikowo; the event is intended for runners of different ability levels.

description: The XI Krokowska 10 is one of the events in the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series, taking place on July 4 in Żarnowiec. The race offers a 10 km distance through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the region. Kaszuby Biegają is the largest running event in northern Poland, promoting physical activity and local culture. Participants can expect professional organization and unique medals assembled from elements earned at individual stages.
course_highlights: Scenic routes through Kashubia
A 10 km distance in northern Poland
Part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, featuring a unique assembled medal
additional: The Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series includes 11 events in different locations across the region. Participants can collect unique pieces of the assembled medal by running 5 km and 10 km distances. Nordic Walking events are available at selected stages. Shorter distances of 400 to 800 m are prepared for children. Registration takes place on the zapisy.info portal. The event includes a 10 km race, options for local runners, and virtual participation. Registration opens in December 2025. The event commemorates Jacek Bandurski.

The event attracts runners from across Poland and from various age groups.

Start and finish at the Main Beach in Kretowiny
Age categories for men and women

The opening ceremony is at 9:50, and the closing ceremony with the awards presentation is scheduled for around 14:30 on the stage by the Main Beach. The race takes place at the Main Beach in Kretowiny, with the awards ceremony and participant registration held on site; the event is part of the Run for the Crystal Pearl series.

description: Kolmården Ultra Trail is a welcoming but demanding trail race for both elite runners and recreational runners. Choose between the longer challenges (45 km or 60 km), with routes taking you through Kolmården Forest, up onto Kvarseboklint’s mountain ridge and down to the shore of Bråviken, onward past the natural surroundings of Nävsjön, and finally through the technical Bråviksbranten before the finish. The race combines technical trails, boardwalks across bogs and spectacular views, with well-equipped aid stations along the way. The organizer emphasizes safety and mandatory equipment, as well as a medal and light refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: Kvarseboklint’s impressive mountain ridge with views
Descent to the shore of Bråviken and passage by Nävsjön, with boardwalks across vast bogs
Technical and demanding running through the Bråviksbranten Nature Reserve
additional: Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, running vest/backpack with fluids (at least 0.5 L), pressure bandage/blood-stopping dressing, and a map with the emergency number (provided at bib collection). Aid stations: 45K = 4; 60K = 5 (detailed stations with different energy products are listed for the 48 km variant). Bib collection from 05:30; bibs must be collected at least 30 minutes before the start. The course is marked with large orange arrows and flagging tape. Light refreshments and a custom-designed medal are included at the finish; massage is available at cost. Energy and fluids provided in partnership with Umara. Mandatory equipment; start times: 45K 08:00; cutoff time 13:30 at 44 km; aid stations: 45K = 4, 60K = 5; finish: a meal is included in the entry fee.

name: Gotland Run 511k (2026)
description: Gotland Run 511k is more of a running adventure than a traditional race: a self-supported journey around Gotland of approximately 511 km, starting and finishing in Visby. Participants follow a clockwise loop that also includes a circuit of Fårö, with support from four so-called Angel Stations along the way. The organizer provides some basic services, but runners are responsible for most food and logistics arrangements. The entire route must be completed on foot within 10 days, with regular position reports throughout the day.
course_highlights: Circular route around Gotland (starting and finishing in Visby), including a circuit of Fårö
Most of the route follows Gotlandsleden: long stretches of asphalt, gravel roads, and shorter sections of trail
Four Angel Stations along the course offering water, support, and sometimes the opportunity for a short rest or a bed
additional: Self-supported format: the organizer provides only the most basic services; participants are responsible for food and most accommodation. A pre-race dinner and race briefing in Visby on the evening before the start are mandatory. One night’s accommodation at Visby Fängelse Hostel and breakfast on race morning are included, as are a race bib, luggage storage during the race, and a souvenir for finishers. Transport back to Visby is available for participants who withdraw. Participants must report their position twice daily (10:00 and 22:00) using an online check-in tool and a Google Maps link. The overall time limit is 10 days (an average of ~51 km per day). The information page has sections on mandatory equipment and basic rules. History: the first edition in 2023 had 5 starters and 3 finishers. Distance approximately 511 km (318 miles); four Angel Stations along the way; no pacing; mandatory equipment; pre-race dinner and briefing; one night’s accommodation in Visby included; luggage storage; race bib; transport back to Visby if withdrawing; finishers receive a souvenir.

name: PALMS Südasuve Challenge - Võsu 2026
location: Võsu, Lääne-Nigula vald, Lääne County, Estonia
description: PALMS Midsummer Challenge - Võsu 2026 is a sporting summer event held in the town of Võsu. It is an enjoyable and active challenge for running enthusiasts, offering the chance to enjoy summer nature and community support. The event is part of the Estonian Night Run series and brings together runners from different regions. Võsu’s beautiful coastal scenery provides excellent conditions for a sporting experience.

A pleasant, active summer running environment
Part of the Estonian Night Run series
additional: The event includes a range of swimming distances and is open to both local and virtual participants, offering summer sea air and sport in a friendly atmosphere.

name: 6. Navi jooksu-kõnnitiir
description: The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series is a multi-stage series of running and walking events, offering a range of distances for adults and children. The main distances are approximately 5 to 8 kilometres, and the course runs mainly on asphalt and gravel roads, with a short section on soft ground. The series also includes mini distances and children’s runs suitable for all age groups. The events take place in various locations across Võrumaa, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy the region’s beautiful nature and sporting community.
course_highlights: Main distances of 5–8 km, mainly on asphalt and gravel roads
Mini distances and children’s runs suitable for all age groups
The course passes through scenic natural areas in Võrumaa and includes some soft terrain
additional: The series offers several distances: the main distance, a shorter distance, a mini distance, a walk, and a children’s run. The course is mostly paved with asphalt; the mini distances and children’s runs also take place on asphalt. Detailed course maps and instructions are available for the individual stages. Timed-run results are available through Nelson Timing. The series also includes a family and friends team category, and participant numbers can be tracked across seasons. The Võrumaa Running and Walking Series comprises multiple stages and distances, held on different dates and at various locations in the Võrumaa region. Entry fees and registration information are below.

description: Navi Run is a running, Nordic walking, and walking event held in Võru County and organized by Navi Village Association. The event offers an opportunity to enjoy exercise and a healthy lifestyle in beautiful natural surroundings, and is suitable for participants of different ability levels. The run is part of a broader initiative to promote recreational exercise, with the aim of supporting an active and healthy lifestyle. Everyone who enjoys being active is invited to enjoy a sporting day and the pleasure of movement.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural surroundings in Võru County
Varied terrain suitable for running, Nordic walking, and walking
Organized by Navi Village Association
additional: An opportunity to take part in different distances; registration and results are online, and the event is part of the wider Võrumaa running and walking series.

name: Pogoń za Jednorożcem
description: The Unicorn Chase is an annual running event held in Jednorożec, and in 2026 it will take place for the eighth time. The event includes a 5 km race and Nordic walking over the same distance, as well as children’s races over shorter distances. It is organized by the “Jednorożec robi co może” Association in cooperation with local partners and patrons, offering participants sporting competition, numerous attractions and prizes. The start and awards ceremony take place on the same day, and participants can expect professional organization and timekeeping.
course_highlights: 5 km running and Nordic walking
Children’s races over distances from 100 m to 800 m

Timing is provided using a modern UHF RFID system, with immediate results and an SMS sent after the event. The races take place on asphalt. Various age categories are available, and registration is available online and on-site. The event also includes children’s races.

Flat terrain that favors fast running
additional: The event includes a beach run. Registration takes place in person at the sports hall at Jarosławiec Primary School, 65B Bałtycka Street, on 4–5 July 2026.

name: Västervik City Run
description: Västervik City Run is a 6.2 km city race in and around central Västervik, starting and finishing at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget. The course consists of two loops of approximately 3 km, with the lap point at Fiskaretorget. The race has been held since 2011 and traditionally takes place on the Monday of week 28, starting at 20:00. It is well established in Västervik and attracts runners of different ages.
course_highlights: 6.2 km city race (two loops of approximately 3 km)
Start and finish at Grönsaks- och Fiskartorget
Lap point at Fiskaretorget
additional: The children’s race (Sparbanksloppet) is an 800 m fun run for children up to age 10, with a group start from Fiskaretorget at 18:30. The children’s race starts level with the Stegeholm Castle ruins, by the sun deck and Myntbryggan, and follows the cycle path along Gamlebyviken to the finish at Grönsakstorget. Participants receive a medal after finishing. Bib collection is at ICA Maxi or the race office; advance registration closes on 3 July at 16:00; registration on race day is open from 13:00 to 19:00.

name: Kambja Tervisejooksud
description: Kambja Health Runs is a three-stage running series that invites both recreational and experienced runners to enjoy active time outdoors. At each stage, participants can choose between a loop of the approximately 5 km health trail and a 10 km race. There is also an exciting power run to determine the best strength-to-speed ratio. Series finishers are eligible for prizes and prize draws, including the grand prize of a bicycle. Participation is free, and registration is available online or on site.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km health-trail loop
10 km race starts at 18:00
Power run to determine the strength-to-speed ratio
additional: The start is open from 18:00 to 20:00; the 10 km race starts at 18:00, and the finish closes at 21:00. Prizes will be drawn among everyone who participates in at least two stages. The grand prize—a bicycle—will be drawn among everyone who finishes all three stages. Everyone who finishes all three stages will receive a series T-shirt. Participation is free, and registration is available online or on site. The series is part of the Tartumaa Running and Walking Series. Participants can register online or on site; participation is free, and prizes, including a bicycle, will be drawn as part of the series. This is part of the Tartumaa Running and Walking Series.

name: 7. ETAPP
description: Käime Koos is a recreational sports series by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev, inviting participants to take part in various hiking and walking stages across Estonia. The 7th stage takes place on Kesselaid, offering participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment. The series aims to promote physical activity and a healthy lifestyle through hiking and walking together. Participants can experience varied terrain and combine exercise with good company.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural scenery of the Muhu escarpment
Varied terrain suitable for walking and hiking
The series takes place in different parts of Estonia, showcasing local natural beauty
additional: Käime Koos stages take place in different locations across Estonia, where participants can enjoy nature and physical activity. The series is organised by the Estonian Sports Association Kalev. More information and contact: Sirje Soovik +372 506 2250.

name: 31. Joosu Järvejooksu sarja 4. etapp
location: Tervise- ja suusarada, Viljandi, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: The 4th stage of the Joosu Lake Run series is a running race around Lake Viljandi on the health and ski trail. The race is part of the traditional Joosu series, offering participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The course has a good surface and is suitable for runners of different abilities. The event is organised by Tervisespordiklubi Joosu, which welcomes all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: Health and ski trail around Lake Viljandi
Beautiful nature and varied terrain
Good running surface suitable for different ability levels
additional: The race takes place around Lake Viljandi, probably in nature or on roads, and is part of a wider sports event in 2026.

name: Vooremäe tipujooks
description: Vooremäe Summit Run is a running competition organized by the Tartumaa Sports Association and held at Vooremäe. It is a traditional summer sporting event that welcomes running enthusiasts and offers the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting competition. The event is part of Tartumaa’s sports calendar and is suitable for runners of different abilities.
course_highlights: The competition takes place in the Vooremäe terrain
Beautiful natural scenery and views along the course
Suitable for runners of different abilities
additional: The event is part of the Tartumaa running and health-walking series and focuses on trail running at Vooremäe, offering recreational sport and an opportunity to get active in nature.

name: Ultramarathon Górski - 3 x Sniezka = 1 x Mont Blanc
description: The 3 x Śnieżka = 1 x Mont Blanc Mountain Ultra is a challenging mountain race held in Karpacz. It is also a qualifier for the prestigious UTMB and a member of ITRA. Runners can choose from three distances of varying difficulty and elevation gain, earning ITRA points. The course follows scenic trails in the Karkonosze Mountains and includes multiple ascents of Śnieżka, offering challenges for experienced ultrarunners as well as an opportunity for beginners to take part in a mountain race.
course_highlights: Elevation gain from 1,100 to 3,300 metres and distances from 18 to 58.5 km
Multiple ascents of Śnieżka (1, 2 or 3 times, depending on the distance)
Scenic Karkonosze trails with refreshment points along the course
additional: The start and finish are in central Karpacz, at 48 Konstytucji 3 Maja Street, near the sports and entertainment hall. As part of the World Championships, accreditations, conferences, opening and closing ceremonies, and transport for teams from Wrocław Airport are planned. Time limits for the different distances range from 7 to 11 hours, and GPX files of the courses are available to download. The event promotes tourism and mountain activities, encouraging runners to take part alongside family and friends, who can accompany participants along the course.

name: Mõisa jooks
location: Mäetaguse mõisa piirkond, Mäetaguse, Ida-Viru County, Estonia
organizer: SK Team Kehtna ja Alutaguse vallavalitsus
price_range: 10.- for main race, 8.- for youth, 3.- for children
description: The Kehtna Manor Run is a friendly, community-focused running event held in the area around Kehtna Manor. It offers three distances: a 5 km main race, a 2.5 km youth race, and a 500 m children’s race, suitable for participants of different ages. In addition to the races, the event features Children’s Day activities, pony rides, and trampolines, creating a pleasant family-day atmosphere. It is organized by SK Team Kehtna, which is committed to promoting sport and physical activity in the community.
course_highlights: 5 km main race
2.5 km youth race
500 m children’s race
additional: The event center opens at 11:00. The children’s race starts at 12:00, and the youth and main races start at 12:15. The awards ceremony takes place at 13:00. After the races, there are Children’s Day activities, pony rides, and trampolines. The races take place in July and include various age groups and distance options; registration is available on the website; the event includes activities for children and lists the start times.

name: 5. Pühajärve pargimiil
location: Pühajärve Spa & Holiday Resort, Otepää, Valga County, Estonia
description: The 5th Pühajärve Park Mile is a 1.6 km running race held in the park of Pühajärve Holiday Centre on Saturday, 11 July 2026. The start and finish are at the same location, and the race begins at 12:10. The race is open to all running enthusiasts and offers a pleasant opportunity to enjoy a run in beautiful park surroundings. Participants receive a medal and race bib, chip timing, sports drink and water at the finish, and medical assistance along the entire course.
course_highlights: The marked course is one mile, or 1.6 km long
The start and finish are in the park of Pühajärve Holiday Centre
Sports drink and water are available at the finish
additional: Race bibs will be distributed on race day from 9:30 to 11:45. Timing is by a chip attached to the back of the race bib. Participants receive a medal and race bib, timing, a result in the final results, services, sports drink, and water at the finish. Medical assistance is available along the entire course. Parking is provided in a separate car park, just past Pühajärve Holiday Centre on the right when arriving from the direction of Otepää. The race takes place in the park of Pühajärve Holiday Centre, with the start and finish at the same location. The event is part of the local running calendar and offers an opportunity to enjoy nature and experience a friendly community atmosphere.

name: Pajusi Mudajooks
organizer: MTÜ Sporty ja MTÜ Pajusi Küla Selts
description: Pajusi Mud Run is a popular mass-participation sporting event in Central Estonia, offering participants an exciting and adventurous obstacle course of up to 10 km. The event takes place on 11 July 2026 in Pajusi village and is suitable for both individual runners and teams. The course features natural and man-made obstacles that test participants’ physical and mental endurance. Separate courses are available for children, and all finishers receive a commemorative medal. Free parking and hot soup after the run are provided for participants.
course_highlights: A course of up to 10 km through Central Estonia’s varied natural landscape
Natural and man-made obstacles along the course
Separate courses for children and young people
additional: The main race starts together from the Pajusi Village House. Shoes that could damage the obstacles, such as shoes with spikes or sharp elements, are not permitted on the course. All finishers receive a commemorative medal. Hot soup is available for participants, and food is also offered by vendors on site. Free, unattended parking is available near the start area. Participant names and personal identification codes, as well as a team name, can be added to the ticket. The name on a ticket can be changed until 30 June 2026. Participants can choose from different categories, including courses for children and young people. The event takes place on 11 July 2026, with additional on-site services including food and drinks, and medals for finishers.

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race held in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to take on a course of moderate difficulty. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, making event logistics convenient. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km course in Bukowiec
Race office in the sports hall in Bukowiec
A commemorative medal for every participant who finishes the race
additional: The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec. Every runner who crosses the finish line receives a medal. A registration form is available, allowing you to contact the organizer and system administrator quickly. Registration takes place online, the event is local in nature, and results are available electronically.

name: VI Warmiński Bieg Uliczny
location: Reszel, Kętrzyn County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 6th Warmian Street Run in Reszel is an annual sporting event that attracts both recreational and experienced runners. The race takes place on the streets of Reszel, giving it a unique atmosphere and allowing participants to experience the city from a different perspective. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively, compete in sport, and meet fellow running enthusiasts. The organizers welcome everyone, regardless of ability level, highlighting the importance of exercise and positive energy.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of Reszel
A unique atmosphere for a city street race
An event for runners of all ability levels
additional: Registration is online at www.superczas.pl. The event is open to runners of all ability levels. No information is available about specific distances, start waves, or participant limits. Online registration at www.superczas.pl; time limits: 50 minutes for 5 km and 1 hour 30 minutes for 10 km; entry fee on the day of the event: 60 PLN; the event includes various distances and additional attractions.

name: Musköloppet
location: Muskö Hembygdsgård, Muskö, Haninge kommun, Stockholms län, Sverige
description: Musköloppet is a long-standing running race in a spectacular archipelago setting, starting and finishing at Muskö Local Heritage Centre/Muskö IF’s clubhouse. The race usually attracts around 300 runners (about 400 including the youngest children) and has a friendly, homecoming atmosphere, with many taking the opportunity to meet relatives and neighbours. The event offers children’s and youth classes as well as recreational classes (5 km and 10 km) on varied surfaces, and takes place on Saturday, 11 July 2026.
course_highlights: Start/finish at Muskö Local Heritage Centre, near the clubhouse, outdoor gym and hockey rink
Course surfaces: approximately 50% asphalt, 30–40% gravel and 10% trail
The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured (course measurer Mikael Hill, 240523); this year, the 10 km is run as a single loop
additional: Late registration is available at the start/finish area up to one hour before the race starts. Food and drinks are available at the start/finish. Directions by car and public transport, as well as parking information, are available on the “Find us” page. Around 300 runners usually take part (about 400 including the youngest children). Start/finish area at Muskö Local Heritage Centre/Muskö IF’s clubhouse; 5 km and 10 km courses with varied surfaces (approximately 50% asphalt, 40% gravel and 10% trail on one course; approximately 60% asphalt, 30% gravel and 10% trail on the other); merchandise, kiosk snacks, coffee, soft drinks and food from Micke’s Grill; late registration at the finish area up to one hour before the race starts.

name: Klåveröd Backyard 2026
description: Klåveröd Backyard 2026 is an event published on Facebook in Svalöv, taking place on Saturday, 11 July 2026, and created by Linda Bengtsson. The event is associated with Klåveröds Ski Club and is presented on an official Facebook event page. It is located in Klåveröd near Söderåsen, offering trail and forest running in a natural setting. For details and contact information, see the event page on Facebook.
course_highlights: Running in Klåveröd/Svalöv near Söderåsen
Trail and forest terrain (event organized through Klåveröds Ski Club)
Close to the natural areas and national park area of Söderåsen
additional: Organizer/creator: Linda Bengtsson; event associated with Klåveröds Ski Club; the main information page and invitation are on the Facebook event page: https://www.facebook.com/events/1496584765165217/; Klåveröd's Facebook group and page are used for local information. At the previous Klåveröd Backyard in 2024, Jonas Elmer won with 14 laps, approximately 90 km in total.

name: V-asis maratonas „Vilniaus tiltai“
location: Vilniaus Laisvalaikio zona prie Baltojo tilto, Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Maratonas „Vilniaus Tiltai“ yra tradicinis bėgimo renginys, vykstantis Vilniaus laisvalaikio zonoje prie Baltojo tilto. Renginyje dalyviai gali varžytis įvairiose distancijose nuo vaikų 500 m bėgimo iki pilno maratono 42,195 km. Trasos vingiuoja Neries krantinėmis ir per Vilniaus tiltus, suteikdamos unikalų miesto vaizdą bėgikams. Renginys skirtas tiek mėgėjams, tiek profesionalams, populiarinant bėgimo kultūrą Lietuvoje ir garsinant Vilnių.
course_highlights: Trasa vingiuoja Neries krantinėmis ir per Vilniaus tiltus
Maratono distancija sudaryta iš 4 ratų po 10,6 km
Galimybė varžytis įvairiose distancijose nuo 500 m iki 42,195 km
additional: Numerių išdavimas prasideda 6:45 val. Maratono, pusmaratonio ir 10,6 km distancijų dalyvių apšilimas 7:50 val. Yra apdovanojimai vyrų ir moterų maratono distancijose, taip pat gausiausios ir ištvermingiausios komandų nominacijos. Laiko limitai: maratonui 7 val., pusmaratoniui 3 val., 10,6 km - 2 val., 5,3 km - 1 val., šiaurietiško ėjimo distancijoms - 6 val. Varžybų vieta - Vilniaus Laisvalaikio zona prie Baltojo tilto; būtina registracija ir sveikatos patikrinimas; renginys skatina bendruomeniškumą ir aktyvų gyvenimo būdą.

name: Vimka tõusu maraton
description: Vimka tõusu marathon is a summer marathon on the Viimsi Peninsula, offering participants one large loop. The start and finish are located in the parking lot of Randvere School. The varied course includes both paved roads and forest trails, with several climbs and descents that make the run exciting and varied.
course_highlights: One large loop on the Viimsi Peninsula
Varied course with asphalt and forest trails
The course includes climbs and descents
additional: 64 loops, each approximately 666 m; approximately 40 m of elevation gain per loop; varied terrain; one refreshment point; official chip timing; results in the statistics platform marathon100.com

name: Bajoro 26
description: Bajoro 26 is a 10 km race taking place on 12 July 2026 in Starogard Gdański. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to both beginners and more experienced runners. Bajoro 26 is a moderately challenging event on a paved surface, ideal for improving your fitness and competing in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km distance on a paved surface
Moderately challenging course
Scenic surroundings of Starogard Gdański
additional: Training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks are available and tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. Organizers can use a platform to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing. The event is planned for summer 2026 and is aimed at runners of different age groups and ability levels, with the option to take part in the 10 km race.

name: II Galicyjska 10
description: The 2nd Galician 10K of the Podkarpackie Regional Chamber of Civil Engineers is a sporting event bringing Chamber members and their families together. It will take place on July 12, 2026, in Urzejowice, in the park by the stadium. The event includes a 10 km run, a 7 km Nordic Walking march, and children’s races in various age categories. It’s a great opportunity to spend active family time outdoors, promote a healthy lifestyle, and bring the civil engineering community together. Participants can look forward to a sporty atmosphere and fun at the finish line.
course_highlights: 10 km run
7 km Nordic Walking march
Children’s races in various age categories
additional: The event is open to active Chamber members and their families. In addition to the run and Nordic Walking march, children’s races are held in various age categories. The event promotes integration and a healthy lifestyle. The detailed programme and registration form will be published soon. The start and finish are in the park by the stadium in Urzejowice. name: Võru kergejõustikuõhtu
location: Võru Staadion, Võru, Võru County, Estonia
description: The Võru Athletics Evenings series is a traditional series of athletics events combining throwing, jumping, and running disciplines. The series consists of several stages, where participants can compete in different distances and events, with the IAAF scoring tables used to determine rankings. Competitions take place at Võru Stadium and are open to athletes of varying abilities. The series offers a varied athletics experience for both recreational and advanced athletes.
course_highlights: Combines throwing, jumping, and running disciplines
Multi-stage series at Võru Stadium
Uses the IAAF scoring tables to determine rankings
additional: Registration usually opens in May. Separate registration is required for each stage. Registration for throwing and jumping events usually closes at 16:30, and for running events at 18:30. Participants receive a race number that is valid for the whole season. The competition schedule includes exact registration and event times; for example, registration for the long jump and discus throw closes at 16:45, and attempts begin at 17:00. Competitions take place at Võru Stadium. Information about the multiple stages, different athletics events, registration, and schedule is available.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 3 etapas
description: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - tai atviras bėgimo turnyras, vykstantis Jonavos rajone, skirtas populiarinti sportą ir fizinį aktyvumą. Varžybos vyksta penkiais etapais skirtingose vietovėse, kur bėgikai varžosi tarpusavyje ir renka taškus bendram įvertinimui. Kiekvienas etapas turi savo trasą ir starto laiką, o dalyvavimas yra nemokamas. Turnyrą organizuoja Jonavos sporto centras kartu su Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacija ir kitais partneriais.
course_highlights: Penki etapai skirtingose Jonavos rajono vietovėse
Trasos nuo 6 km iki 8,4 km ilgio
Startas vakare, 19:30 val., numerių atsiėmimas prieš varžybas
additional: Numerių atsiėmimas vyksta varžybų dieną nuo 18:30 iki 19:20 val. starto vietoje. Registracija į kiekvieną etapą vykdoma atskirai internetu. Dalyvavimas varžybose yra nemokamas. Varžybų trasos gali kirstis su kelių eismu, todėl dalyviai privalo laikytis kelių eismo taisyklių. 5 etapų serija, registracija internetu, atviros visiems Lietuvos ir užsienio dalyviams, startai dažniausiai 19:30 val.

name: Victorialoppet
price_range: 175-550 kr beroende på kategori och registreringsdatum
description: Victorialoppet is an annual running festival in Borgholm, celebrating its 45th year in 2026. The event offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including the 9 km main race, the 4 km Victoriajoggen, the 2 km Lilla Victorialoppet, and Mini for the youngest participants. The course is fast and easy to run, with beautiful coastal views and an enthusiastic crowd. The event is a festive celebration, with music along the course and a welcoming atmosphere for participants and spectators alike.
course_highlights: Fast, easy-to-run 9 km course with coastal views
Music at several points along the course
Courses for all ages, including para-sport categories
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 10:00 to 18:00 on race day at Borgholm Sports Hall. Changing rooms and showers are available for men and boys at the sports hall, and for women and girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Water is provided along the 9 km course, and participants receive refreshments after the finish. Timing uses disposable chips for most races; timing is optional for Victoriajoggen and the para-sport categories. Children in Lilla Victorialoppet receive a medal, ice cream, and a drink after the finish. The event runs from early afternoon into the evening, with several start times and races. Distances include 9 km, 4 km, 2 km, and 1.5 km, with participants from different age groups and disability categories. The event takes place in Borgholm’s sports area and includes both competitive and recreational races, as well as fundraising for charitable causes.

name: Lüllemäe mägedejooks
description: The Lüllemäe Mountain Run is the third stage of the Valgamaa running series and takes place on the Lüllemäe health trails. The main race is 4.5 km, with tiny and mini races for children also held at the Lüllemäe Basic School stadium. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and offers the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting atmosphere. Children’s races are free, and the main race entry fees are reasonable, encouraging broad participation.
course_highlights: 4.5 km main race on the Lüllemäe health trails
Children’s tiny and mini races at the stadium, over distances from 100 m to 900 m
The event takes place in a beautiful natural setting in Valgamaa
additional: There is no entry fee for the children’s races. The NM18 age group in the main race is also free. Entry fees are paid in cash on site. For event information, call +372 5202962. Trail run on local terrain; registration at www.timesport.ee; free entry for children and the NM18 group.

name: Night Run Gdynia
description: Night Run Gdynia is a 5-kilometre night race held on the Baltic Sea coast as part of the IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends. After dark, as city lights reflect off the asphalt and water, hundreds of runners set off on a spectacular route through the streets of Gdynia. The event has become an important and eagerly anticipated part of the city’s sporting calendar, combining competition with the unique atmosphere of a night run.
course_highlights: A 5 km route along the Baltic Sea coast
A night race with striking city lights reflected on the asphalt and water
An event held as part of the IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends
additional: The race is held as part of the IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends in Gdynia, Warsaw and Poznań. It attracts hundreds of runners and is a regular feature of these sporting events. Seaside route, limit of 1,500 participants, entry fees in tiers of 60 zł, 75 zł, 90 zł and 100 zł.

name: Trakų naktinis pusmaratonis 2026

course_highlights: Startas Karaimų g. 13

Trakų pilies apylinkės ir naktinė atmosfera
additional: Dalyvių numerius ir laiko matavimo elektronines mikroschemas atsiimti galima liepos 18 d. nuo 17 val. Trakuose, Birutės g. 4. name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 9. Rakvere valla Suvejooks

Various distances and age categories
Large number of participants and community involvement

name: Väinjärve jooks , 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud VI etapp

The Väinjärv Run, taking place on 18 July 2026, is the sixth stage of the series. The race offers participants the chance to enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and varied terrain around the lake. The series offers several distances and is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Runs take place by different lakes in Järvamaa
Varied terrain and beautiful natural surroundings
The sixth stage of a traditional running series, held by Väinjärv
additional: The races take place around Väinjärv and include several distances, including 400 m, 1.2 km and 4.6 km. Pre-registration is recommended to secure your participation.

The Water Festival also features other sports and activities offering entertainment for participants of all ages.
course_highlights: Beautiful surroundings of Lake Väinjärv
Traditional running event around the lake
Suitable for all running enthusiasts

The event is a traditional, entertaining occasion for athletes and families alike. Participants register on site. The event is part of a larger water festival and sports programme, featuring various sports and activities, and participation is free. It is part of the Lääne-Virumaa Running and Walking Series and offers a sporting challenge for running enthusiasts. The courses are varied and suitable for runners of different levels. The race is friendly and community-oriented, welcoming all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Sõmeru area
Suitable for runners of different levels
Part of the Lääne-Virumaa Running and Walking Series
additional: The race takes place at the Sõmeru-Näpi recreational sports field and is part of a local series of sporting events that brings together stages of the running and walking series.

description: The 12th Szczecin Night Port Marathon and the 7th Szczecin Night Port Half Marathon are night road races held in Szczecin, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The marathon course consists of two identical loops, each 42.195 km long, while the half marathon is one 21.097 km loop; both courses are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The race starts at 23:00. Participants can expect original T-shirts and a special classification for people connected with the maritime industry. The event is organized by Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia, Zachodniopomorska Federacja Sportu, and RAZ Event, with the support of the City of Szczecin and port partners.
course_highlights: The marathon course consists of two identical loops through the streets of Szczecin and is certified by the PZLA
Start and finish at Florian Krygier Municipal Stadium
Course markers every 1 km and refreshment stations along the course and at the finish of each loop
additional: The marathon time limit is 6 hours. A new classification category, “People of the Sea,” is for participants connected with the maritime industry. Start and finish at Florian Krygier Municipal Stadium. The course may be modified slightly due to renovation work near Trasa Zamkowa. Registration opens at 12:00. The course may be subject to minor changes due to construction work. The event includes a “People of the Sea” category for participants connected with the maritime industry.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail race taking place on 18 July 2026 in the scenic Elbląg Upland, by the Vistula Lagoon. The course runs along wild trails, with varied elevation and peaceful natural scenery, offering runners a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity in harmony with nature and welcomes both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support and a comprehensive race pack.
course_highlights: The wild natural landscapes and scenic hills of the Elbląg Upland
Routes through Elbląg Upland Landscape Park and four forest reserves
Views of the Vistula Lagoon and historic sites, including Old Prussian hillforts and the Imperial Stone
additional: The race pack includes a waterproof race bib with a chip, medical support, course markings, aid stations, drinks and snacks at the finish, a commemorative medal, and a GPS tracker for the 81 km distance. Starts take place in waves from 5:00 (81 km) to 10:30 (14 km), with separate Garmin Junior races for children. The online technical briefing on Facebook will take place on 15.07.2026 at 20:00. Renginys vyksta asfaltuotu keliu, todėl rekomenduojama tinkama bėgimo avalynė. Renginys skirtas pagerbti Medininkų aukas, vyko Vilniuje, dalyvavo pareigūnai, trasa 34 km, 7 etapai, simbolinė lazdelė su žeme, medaliai ir vaišės finiše

name: Pajūrio basatlonas
description: Pajūrio Basatlonas yra unikalus bėgimas basomis pajūrio smėliu, vykstantis Smiltynėje, Klaipėdoje. Renginys vyksta per Jūros šventę ir suteikia dalyviams nepakartojamų įspūdžių bėgant tarp jūros ir kopų. Varžybos populiarina bėgimo kultūrą Lietuvoje ir skatina sveiką gyvenimo būdą. Dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų ir mėgautis nuostabia pajūrio gamta bei švelniu vėju.
course_highlights: Bėgimas basomis pajūrio smėliu
Startas paplūdimyje prie pietinio molo, Kopgalis, Smiltynė
Distancijos 500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km ir 10 km su 2 valandų laiko limitu
additional: Visoms distancijoms skirtas 2 valandų laiko limitas. Dalyviai privalo turėti asmens dokumentą ir pritvirtintą numerį bei elektroninę laiko matavimo mikroschemą ant marškinėlių. Varžybų dalyviai bėga laisva valia ir prisiima visą su dalyvavimu susijusią riziką. Bėgimas basomis pajūrio smėliu, įvairios distancijos (500 m, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km), registracija internetu, nuostatai ir taisyklės, apdovanojimai ir atminimo medaliai.

name: KFC Südasuve Challenge - Pirita 2026
description: KFC Midsummer Challenge is a midsummer sports celebration taking place in Pirita for the third time. This community race offers beautiful views of the sea and Old Town, and a choice of three distances that participants can run or walk, or complete with a stroller or walking poles. The start and finish are conveniently located together on the shoreline, and the course follows the seaside pedestrian and cycling path without closing roads to traffic. All finishers will receive KFC gifts, and an event host and mascot will keep the spirits up.
course_highlights: Beautiful views of the sea and Old Town
Start and finish conveniently located together on the shoreline
The course follows the seaside pedestrian and cycling path without closing roads to traffic
additional: An interval-start system has been set up on the course to avoid bottlenecks. Participants can also complete the course with a stroller or walking poles. Challenges and prize draws for running enthusiasts will take place at the event and on social media. Multiple distances, a virtual participation option, a shoreline route, medals and prizes for finishers, a free concert, and themed food at KFC restaurants

name: Leigo Trail
description: Leigo Trail is a varied trail race in southern Estonia, held around the Leigo lakes. The race centre is at Leigo Tourism Farm, and the course offers a range of distance and difficulty options, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The routes follow forest trails, clay and gravel roads, and natural paths by the lake, featuring technical climbs and descents as well as beautiful views. The event brings together nature, exercise, and community, offering an enjoyable experience for the whole family.
course_highlights: An 18 km route on forest trails with steep climbs and descents; two laps of the 9 km loop
A winding 10 km clay-and-gravel route with moderate climbs; one lap
A scenic 4 km lakeside route; two laps of the 2 km loop, suitable for a first trail run
additional: The race centre is at Leigo Tourism Farm, with a race office, start and finish area, changing facilities and baggage storage, medical assistance, and catering. Free parking is available in a separate area; carpooling is recommended. Families and groups receive a 20% discount. Leigo Tourism Farm is open to visitors, and Open Farm Day takes place on the same weekend. To arrange accommodation, contact Leigo Tourism Farm. Family and group discounts are available as part of the event, and participants can choose from three distances. The course runs through natural surroundings, and registration includes various options. Parking and transport services are planned for race day.

name: Iigaste metsajooks
price_range: 4 euro (veteranid ja põhivõistlus), 8 euro kohapeal, tasuta lastejooksud ja NM18
description: The Iigaste Forest Run is part of the Rein Leppik Valgamaa Running and Nordic Walking Series, held every summer. This forest run gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting challenge on the 7.4 km main run, as well as shorter running and Nordic walking distances. The event takes place in Iigaste village and is suitable for different age groups, with medals and certificates awarded to the best finishers. Entry is affordable, and registration is conveniently available online.
course_highlights: 7.4 km main run on forest roads
3.7 km run and Nordic walking on the shorter distances
The event takes place amid the beautiful nature of Iigaste village
additional: Participation in the children’s races and the NM18 age group is free. The top three finishers in each age group receive a medal and certificate. Participants are responsible for their own health. Supporters are Eesti Kultuurkapital, Valgamaa Spordiliit, Mapco.ee and Iigaste village. The event takes place on a forest trail. Registration is through https://timesport.ee. Participants can choose from different distances, and the event is part of the Valgamaa Running and Nordic Walking Series.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
description: The Nadmorski Spa Run is an annual running event held in the picturesque town of Dąbki in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the attractions of the Dąbki Health Resort and the Municipality of Darłowo. The program includes races for children and young people, a 10 km race, and special accompanying races such as the Spa Sea Mile. Organizers provide a varied program and attractive prizes, and the race route runs through the charming spa area.
course_highlights: 10 km race route through the Dąbki Health Resort area
Spa Sea Mile over a distance of 1,852 m
Children’s and youth races over distances from 150 m to 1,100 m
additional: The event program spans two days: on 25 July, the Spa Sea Mile, with separate races for women and men; and on 26 July, races for children and young people, the ZaRadnych i OdWażnych 1,100 m race, and the main 10 km race. The race office is open from 16:00 to 18:00 on 25 July and from 8:30 on 26 July. The time limit for completing the Sea Mile is 20 minutes. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and the Dąbki Health Resort, with registration opening on 1 April 2026.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
organizer: Zachodniopomorskie Centrum Kultury Obszarów Wiejskich i Edukacji Ekologicznej
description: The summer edition of Botaniczna Piątka is a 5 km race held in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden. It is a great opportunity to combine physical activity with relaxation amid greenery and nature. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series and is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants receive a commemorative water lily-shaped medal, and the main race is scheduled to start at 10:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the Przelewice Dendrological Garden
Picturesque scenery surrounded by greenery and nature
A relaxing atmosphere for a summer race
additional: The race takes place as a special summer edition of the Botaniczna Piątka series. Participants receive a commemorative water lily-shaped medal. The event is co-financed from the budget of the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and held under the honorary patronage of the Marshal of the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Przelewice Gardens also offer a range of attractions and services, including garden tours, a restaurant, conference rooms and guest rooms. Finisher medals; an event connected with culture and education; the opportunity to take part in a summer edition in beautiful gardens.

name: Kresowe Trail #8
description: Kresowe Trail #8 is a 10 km race taking place on July 26, 2026, in Chełm. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic trail course designed for runners of varying experience levels. The organizers encourage participants to use training plans tailored to their individual levels to help them prepare optimally for the race. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, a platform that supports runners in their development and in organizing races.
course_highlights: A 10 km trail course
Scenic areas of Chełm in the Lublin Voivodeship
A course suited to runners of varying experience levels
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to runners’ VDOT levels and supported by experts. The platform TreningBiegacza.pl offers the option to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing. Participants can look forward to attractive trail routes, and the event is part of a series of trail races in the region. More information about dates and locations is available on the series’ homepage.

name: V Bursztynowy Półmaraton Jantar
location: Jantar, Gmina Stegna, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 10. ETAPP
description: TV 10 Olympic Start is a competition series organized by the Estonian Athletics Association for schoolchildren and young athletes. Competitions are held in different age groups and include a variety of track and field events. The 10th stage takes place on 29 July 2026 at Tamme Stadium in Tartu, giving young people the opportunity to test their skills and gain experience. The series aims to support young people’s athletic development and provide a fun and motivating competitive environment.
course_highlights: Competitions take place at Tamme Stadium in Tartu
A variety of track and field events for different age groups
Open to schoolchildren and young athletes
additional: Registration takes place half an hour before the competitions begin. The top three in each event and age group are awarded medals, and the best performances receive special prizes. The competition is part of the TV 10 Olympic Start series and supports the development and competitiveness of young athletes.

name: ATEA Kalmarmilen
description: ATEA Kalmarmilen is an established 10K race in Kalmar, held on 29 July 2026, and welcomes both recreational and elite runners. The race starts at Teatervallen and finishes at Larmtorget. The course passes Kalmar Castle, Stensö, the Old Town, the harbor, Fredrikskans, Lindö and Ängö before returning to the city centre for the final stretch. The race also has District Championship/Veteran District Championship status for Östsvenska and is organised by Högby IF. It is part of the I Run Kalmar race series. The children’s race, Lilla Atea Kalmarmilen, is held on the same day for different age groups, making it a family event with several running options.
course_highlights: Starts at Teatervallen and finishes at Larmtorget in Kalmar
The course passes landmarks including Kalmar Castle, the Old Town and the harbor
Illuminated running tracks and exercise trails in Kalmar; Lilla Atea Kalmarmilen for children is held at the same time
additional: Högby IF’s athletics page lists several upcoming races, including Kalmar Backyard Ultra, Skälbyloppet and Ölands Tjurrus, with dates and start times. The pages mention GPX files and a course map, as well as a walking category (Skälbyloppet: 4 km without timing) and separate start times for youth and senior categories. Race bib collection is at Kalmar Teater on 28 July from 15:00 to 17:00 and 29 July from 15:00 to 19:00. ICA MAXI provides drinks, fruit and chocolate after the race. Lilla Atea Kalmarmilen is held at the same time for children aged 2–13; the main race has a 10 km distance, as well as mini categories and distances for younger age groups.

name: 4 PolandRockowy Bieg Policz się z cukrzy...
location: Broczyno, Czaplinek, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: ÜLEMISTE Ööjooks - Tallinn 2026
description: ÜLEMISTE Night Run - Tallinn 2026 is a running and walking event taking place in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn. The event offers an opportunity to get active and support well-being and health. It is part of a wider initiative to promote recreational physical activity in Estonia, organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban environment and support their mental and physical health.
course_highlights: Running and walking in the Ülemiste district of Tallinn
A great opportunity to get active and support your health
Organised by the Centre of Competence for Recreational Physical Activity
additional: Participation involves running and walking; registration is open

name: Vormsi maraton
location: Sviby Harbour, Vormsi Island, Vormsi Parish, Lääne County, Estonia
description: Vormsi Marathons VIII is a two-day running event on Vormsi Island, taking place on July 31 and August 1 near Sviby Harbour. Participants can choose the marathon or half-marathon distance on either day, with the routes running mainly on paved roads on Vormsi Island. The routes are marked, and timing is recorded using electronic SI sticks. After the run, participants can enjoy a social get-together, a sauna and hot soup at the finish. The event is small and friendly, suited to both experienced runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: The marathon route runs along Vormsi Island’s main paved roads
The half-marathon route passes through the villages of Hullo, Rälby, Diby and Norrby
The route follows hard-surfaced public roads, with turns marked
additional: The start and finish are on the square in front of the kiosk near Sviby Harbour. There is no course support; supplies can be replenished at the Hullo shop. The marathon is timed at one intermediate checkpoint and at the finish; the half-marathon is timed only at the finish. Every finisher receives a commemorative medal. After the run, participants can enjoy a social get-together and use the sauna. On Saturday, the finish closes at 16:45; on Friday, it stays open as long as needed. A purchased entry is valid for one or both days. It is not possible to complete both distances on the same day. Two-day run; no course support; camping or campground accommodation available; transport from Rohuküla.

name: 28. Holstre-Paistu maanteejooks Hanno Priksi mälestuseks
description: Holstre-Paistu Road Race is the fourth stage of Viljandi Municipality’s running series and takes place in Paistu. The race is intended for runners of all abilities and offers young people and adults alike the opportunity to take part. Participation in the series motivates runners to complete all four stages, and active participants are rewarded. The course runs through the scenic Viljandi County, offering an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Road race in the Paistu area
Participation opportunities in different age groups
Participants are motivated by awards in the running series

name: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane
location: Lähte terviserad, Lähte, Tartu County, Estonia

price_tiers.distance: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane Lähte 5 km

description: Mapri Ehitus x Öövägilane is an obstacle race held on the Lähte health trails. It is a varied and challenging run where participants climb, crawl, lift and drag themselves through mud, water, sand and hills. The event is suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers, offering an exciting and fun experience. The series aims to offer a multi-day competition, with each stage having its own character and an emphasis on both fun and physical challenge.
course_highlights: 5 km course on the Lähte health trails
A variety of obstacles: climbing, crawling, lifting and dragging
Mud, water, sand and hills along the course
additional: A 15% discount applies when registering for at least three Vägilase jooks events at once. Payment via Stebby is possible. Discounts for young people under 20 and seniors aged 60 and over are applied automatically based on year of birth. Group discount of 20% for registering at least 4 people for the same event. The competition takes place over several days; each stage has its own character, with an emphasis on both fun and physical challenge. Participants take part at their own risk. Registration is open until 1 August. The entry fee includes a race number, medal, drink and snacks.

name: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase jooks Lähte
location: Lähte terviseradad ja jõulinnakus, Lähte, Estonia
description: Mapri Ehitus x Vägilase Run Lähte is an obstacle race held on the Lähte health trails and at the strength-training park. The courses are 4 km and 8 km long and offer participants a serious challenge, with a variety of obstacles testing both strength and agility. Vägilase Run is Estonia’s most versatile obstacle-race series event, suitable for both beginners and experienced obstacle racers. The event is part of a series focused on terrain, obstacles and an adventurous experience.
course_highlights: 4 km and 8 km obstacle courses on the Lähte health trails and at the strength-training park
A variety of obstacles testing strength and agility
Mud, water, sand and hills along the course
additional: Children’s runs for participants up to 14 years old are free (when registered online before the event); on-site registration costs €3. All finishers in the children’s runs receive a medal and a treat. Participants are responsible for their own health; minors may participate with parental permission. There is no overall series ranking, but participants who take part in at least three stages receive a gift at the end of the season. Registering for at least three events at once gives a 15% discount. Vägilase Run shirts are available to purchase at a discounted price in December. Participants can register online, and the event has different categories and discounts. The course follows existing trails and roads, and the obstacles are built to be challenging and safe. Participation is at one’s own risk, and the event is open to all age groups.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź edycja letnia
price_range: w formularzu zgłoszeniowym na edycje letnie
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the aesthetic appeal of the locations. The organizers aim to popularize running and provide participants with a unique sporting and scenic experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively and join a close-knit running community.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The aesthetic appeal of the proposed locations
Organized since 2014, with an emphasis on popularizing running
additional: Registration for the main distance and children’s races in the Summer Edition has closed. The organizers run a newsletter to share updates. Trzymsie.pl is a partner of the autumn Botaniczna Piątka series. Scenic routes, cross-country races, locations in Łódź

name: 32. Bieg św. Dominika
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious running event held annually in Gdańsk since 1994 and an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. The race attracts over 1,200 participants and tens of thousands of spectators, offering a unique atmosphere in the city’s historic centre. The course runs through the picturesque streets of Gdańsk’s Old Town, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration. The running festival features several races, including the 5 km Women’s Run, the 5 km Men’s Run and the Polish 10 km Championships.
course_highlights: A 1,412 m loop through central Gdańsk, starting and finishing by Neptune’s Fountain
The route passes along Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników, Podwale Przedmiejskie and other streets
Cheering from more than 25,000 spectators along the course
additional: The course is a 1,412 m loop in central Gdańsk, allowing spectators to follow the competition closely. The event is accompanied by the varied programme of St. Dominic’s Fair, with concerts, shows and partner stands. The run promotes social integration, a healthy lifestyle and sport for people with disabilities as part of the “Chase St. Dominic” prologue. The event includes various race categories for women, men, elite runners and VIPs, with a wide range of age groups. Participants can support charitable causes through their entry fees, which go towards various social initiatives.

name: Arm Race Kamień
location: Cekow-Kolonia, Kamień County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: ARM Race Kamień is an extreme OCR obstacle race that welcomes both professionals and amateurs looking for an adrenaline rush. It is a challenge for whole families, including children, offering unusual entertainment and a chance to overcome personal weaknesses. The race is among Poland’s elite events of this kind and continues to grow, giving participants unforgettable experiences.
course_highlights: Extreme OCR obstacle race
Courses for different experience levels: PRO 10K, PRO 5K, OPEN 10K, OPEN 5K, FUN 5K, Pomarańczowy Wojownik
An event for families with children, amateurs, and professionals
additional: Distances: 5K and 10K; various formats; natural terrain; online registration

tiers.label: tier_2

description: The Bieg o Wronkę Szlakiem Świętego Jakuba is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Wronka near Giżycko. The event includes various age categories, including 500 m races for children and 5 km and 10 km main races on gravel roads. The organizers provide a race pack with a bib, medal, and voucher for a recovery meal. The event is family-oriented and brings people together, with routes running through the charming countryside around Wronka.
course_highlights: Main race route on gravel roads
500 m races for children, with no timekeeping
Picturesque countryside around Wronka near Giżycko
additional: The race office is open from 8:00 to 11:30. The race pack includes a race bib, a finish-line medal, and a voucher for a recovery meal prepared by the Wronka Rural Housewives’ Association. Children’s distances will not be timed or ranked. The timing chip must be returned at the finish. The awards ceremony and prize draw will take place at 13:15. Maps of the 5 km and 10 km routes are available via Google Maps links. Registration is open until 29 July 2026. Participants can expect a variety of race packs and attractive prizes.

name: XI Czastarska Piątka
description: The 11th Czastary Five is an annual road race held in the Czastary municipality, attracting runners from various regions. The event combines sport and recreation and follows a 5-kilometer route through the municipality’s picturesque areas. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and support for participants, promoting an active lifestyle and integration within the local community.
course_highlights: 5 km route
Road race through the picturesque areas of the Czastary municipality
Sport and recreation event
additional: Registration for the race opens on May 5, 2026; route details have not been provided in detail
