The website also links to an information sheet (PM Festivalloppet).

name: Alytaus Pusmaratonis – 2026
description: Alytaus pusmaratonis 2026 kviečia visus bėgimo entuziastus į ypatingą vasaros finišą Alytuje. Renginys prasideda ir baigiasi Alytaus rotušės aikštėje, o trasa veda per gražiausias miesto vietas - žaliuojančius parkus, jaukias gatves ir Nemuno pakrantes. Dalyviai patirs bendrystę, judesį ir emocijas, o finiše jų lauks šventinė atmosfera ir palaikymas. Tai puiki proga pažinti Alytų ir išsinešti nepamirštamas emocijas tiek siekiant geriausio rezultato, tiek tiesiog praleidžiant prasmingą dieną.
course_highlights: Trasa veda per žaliuojančius parkus
Jaukios miesto gatvės
Įkvepiančios Nemuno pakrantės
additional: various race distances, registration required, medals for all participants, awards for top finishers

name: 9. Kristiine Rahvajooks
description: The 9th Kristiine Community Run takes place on 30 August 2026 at the playground in Löwenruh Park, Tallinn. This is a family event featuring children’s races for children up to 10 years old, in addition to the main 5 km distance. The event centre, start and finish are located beside Löwenruh Park, providing a pleasant and safe setting for running enthusiasts. The event aims to promote running as an accessible form of exercise and offer a sporting experience for different age groups.
course_highlights: 5 km course (2 × 2.5 km) on the streets of Kristiine and in Löwenruh Park
Children’s races for children up to 10 years old, 300 m without timing
Event centre, start and finish beside the playground in Löwenruh Park
additional: Registration for the children’s races takes place on race day from 10:00. The event centre opens at 10:00, and race-pack distribution begins at the same time. The award ceremony is scheduled for approximately 12:45 or after the last participant finishes. A competition category will be held even if there is only one participant. Finishers receive medals; the winner is awarded a trophy, and the top three receive prizes. The event takes place on 30 August 2026 and also includes children’s races and various activities, which start at 10:00 and end at 12:45.

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: The Jurassic Championships ON THE EDGE OF CROSS-COUNTRY are challenging cross-country races held in picturesque Przewodziszowice near Żarki, in the Kraków-Częstochowa Upland. The routes wind through Jurassic hills, limestone outcrops, dense forests, winding paths, rocky climbs and open spaces with views of the Jurassic Landscape Park. The event offers a variety of distances, from short races for beginners and Nordic walkers to the demanding Trentaraton for experienced runners. It’s a great opportunity to compete and enjoy the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Jurassic hills and limestone outcrops
Winding paths and rocky climbs
Views of the Jurassic Landscape Park
additional: The race office is open on 30 August 2026 from 8:00 to 10:00. Online registration is available until 24.08.2026; from 24.08.2026, registration is available only on race day at the race office. Children can participate for free. The event also includes Nordic walking over distances of 14 km and 7 km. Distances from 7 km to 30 km, races for children, on-site registration from 8:00, Jurassic terrain, races and walks, a sports and recreational event.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
location: Plac Jasne Błonia im. Jana Pawła II, Szczecin, Poland
description: The 47th PKO Szczecin Half Marathon is an annual running event taking place on 30 August 2026 in Szczecin. Participants can choose between the half-marathon distance (21.0975 km) and a 10 km race, both following a single-loop route through the city streets. The start and finish are at Jan Paweł II Jasne Błonia Square. The course is certified by PZLA and marked every kilometre, and timing is electronic, using chips in the race bibs. The organisers offer wave starts and high-quality Ventus technical shirts in the extended race packages.
course_highlights: Single-loop route through the streets of Szczecin
Distance-choice point at 9.6 km on the route
PZLA-certified course, marked every kilometre
additional: Participants can choose a basic or extended package, with a Ventus technical shirt included in the extended package. Start and finish at Jan Paweł II Jasne Błonia Square. Participant limit: 6,000. Electronic timing using chips in the race bibs. Wave starts available. Race packages can be shipped by InPost courier, with the option to redirect them to a parcel locker. Distances: half marathon and 10 km race; location: Jasne Błonia, Szczecin; date: 30 August 2026, 09:00–13:00

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
location: Jezioro Kierskie, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held by historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon in 1984. Athletes can expect calm, warm waters for the swim; a fast, flat bike course through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań; and a run towards the city centre, finishing at the Poznań International Fairgrounds, a modern symbol of the city. This unique event combines sporting competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.
course_highlights: Swim in the calm, warm waters of Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon
A flat, fast bike course through villages and the western part of Poznań
A run towards the city centre, finishing at the Poznań International Fairgrounds
additional: The race starts in a rolling-start format. The start and finish venues are Lake Kierskie and the Poznań International Fairgrounds. IRONKIDS will take place the day before, on August 29, 2026, with a start time of 11:00. Registration for the main race is sold out; notifications are available in case additional places open up. Participants can change their race date free of charge under the Flex90 offer. The event also includes activities such as the Night Run and IRONKIDS, and the participant limit is 1,500. Registration requires a credit card.

name: Kresowe Trail #10
description: Kresowe Trail is a series of small-scale trail races organized by the Kresowe Marathons Foundation, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in nature. The races take place on scenic routes in eastern Poland, with respect for nature and local communities. The events are intended for both beginners and experienced runners, and aim to build a running community based on passion, competition, and friendship. They are non-commercial and intimate, with a limited number of participants to ensure safety and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Trail routes through scenic forests and hilly areas of eastern Poland
Respect for nature and local communities
Small-scale events with a limited number of participants
additional: The races are small-scale, with a limited number of participants. The organizer provides electronic timing, medical cover, aid stations along the course and at the finish, and commemorative medals. Participants can earn points toward the overall standings and titles of Finisher and Super Finisher by completing multiple races. The organizer encourages respect for the environment and asks participants not to litter on the routes. The event brings together the trail-running community, promotes outdoor activity, and supports the development of the local running scene. Registration takes place through an online platform, and the event is part of a series held at various locations.

description: The Busko Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Busko-Zdrój. In 2026, it will take place on August 30. The race starts at 8:30 a.m. from the Municipal Stadium. The half-marathon route passes notable hotels and sanatoriums, the picturesque Spa Park, and charming promenades, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The time limit for covering the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes. The race is open to both experienced runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: The route passes notable hotels and sanatoriums in Busko-Zdrój
The race goes through picturesque Spa Park and charming promenades
A unique atmosphere and scenic surroundings along the route
additional: The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours and 30 minutes. The route is established and popular, and this is the fourth year the race has been held on the same course. The event is organized by the Busko Sports and Recreation Centre and Athletics Busko-Zdrój Sports Club. GPX files of the route are available to download for Suunto and Garmin devices. Registration is open until May 31, 2026. Start time: 8:30 a.m. Time limit: 3 hours and 30 minutes. The route covers urban and park areas.

name: 17. ETAPP / Paljassaare poolsaar
description: STAGE 17 / The Paljassaare Peninsula is part of the Stamina Health Run series and takes place on 2 September 2026 at the Paljassaare Beach car park in Tallinn. The race distance is 6.5 km, and the route winds through the scenic terrain of the Paljassaare Peninsula, offering participants an enjoyable challenge and a chance to enjoy nature. The event is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners looking to take part in a recreational sports event. The organiser, Stamina, ensures a smooth and enjoyable race experience.
course_highlights: A 6.5 km route on the Paljassaare Peninsula
Scenic nature and coastal terrain
Suitable for both recreational and experienced runners
additional: Contact person: Urmo Raiend, phone +3725019572. The list of registered participants is updated once every 24 hours. The venue is the Paljassaare Beach car park. Several stages take place at different locations in Tallinn, and registration and further information may be available on websites.

name: Blodomloppet

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Join in celebrating the life-saving act of blood donation at Blodomloppet Växjö on 2 September 2026. The event offers 5 km and 10 km (10 km = two laps of a course-measured 5 km route), as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for the youngest participants. The start and finish are in Linnéparken, and the course is described as flat and fast, with plenty of crowd support along the way. The event welcomes both individual participants and teams, and traditionally wraps up with a picnic and activities in the event area.
course_highlights: Start and finish in beautiful Linnéparken, in front of the main stage
Flat, fast, course-measured 5 km route (10 km = two laps)
Separate walking route for the 5 km walk and a dedicated loop for Lilla Blodomloppet (~600 m)
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (maximum 5 participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. The deadline for team registration is 26 August 2026. An Excel template is available for bulk registrations, and the organiser can help set up a customer page or discount code for companies registering more than 20 participants. Changing a name or changing category/distance costs 50 SEK. Registration is open until the day of the event, and you can also register on site in Linnéparken (at the late-registration and race-number pickup tent). Lilla Blodomloppet takes place on its own loop in Linnéparken, with the same start and finish. Course details: the start and finish are in Linnéparken; the 5 km course is used for the 10 km race; on-site registration and team registration are available; a T-shirt, race number, medal and goodie bag are included; water stations and storage are mentioned.

description: The Mägede Lake Run is the 8th stage of the Järvamaa Lakes Run Series and takes place in the Mägede sports area. This is a traditional local running event that gives participants the chance to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting challenge. The courses run between lakes and forests, making them suitable for both recreational and experienced runners. The event is part of Järvamaa’s active sports calendar and welcomes all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The courses run between beautiful lakes and forests
Suitable for both recreational and experienced runners
Held in the Mägede sports area in Järvamaa
additional: Prizes are awarded to the top participants in the men’s and women’s categories, and participants can enjoy the beautiful scenery of the lake loop.

name: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie is a cross-country race held in Koszalin on September 3, 2026. The course follows the usual route in the opposite direction, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic Walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies for the top finishers in various categories. The race is the season finale of Leśne Piątki and part of the Touru Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, encouraging activity throughout the year.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the forest of the Karnieszewice Forest District
Start and finish at the car park on Słupska Street in Koszalin
The route is run in the opposite direction, offering a chance to experience it anew
additional: Race numbers with chips can be collected at the race office on race day. Participants can compete in the running, Nordic Walking, and mixed-pair categories. The race is part of the Touru Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, where the kilometres covered count, not pace. After the race, a photo gallery prepared by the A7 FILM team will be available. Participants can register online. The event also features photography attractions and is part of the Touru Biegów po Okolicy (TurBO).

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 28. Aseri Savijooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa running series is a traditional running and walking series offering distances suited to different age groups and ability levels. Its stages take place in various locations across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners a variety of interesting routes. The series offers both the excitement of competition and the chance to enjoy good company and nature. Aseri Clay Run is one of the series’ events and takes place at the Aseri Leisure Centre.
course_highlights: Varied routes across the Lääne-Virumaa region
Different distances for children and adults
Stages in a long-running race series
additional: The series offers a range of distances, from children’s runs to the main races. Participants include both young and older running enthusiasts. The stages take place at different locations across Lääne-Virumaa, and the running direction may change from year to year. Participants can choose from different distances, and registration takes place online. Results and information are published on the series website.

description: Tallinn Autumn Run 10 km is an autumn running event held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn. The start is on 12 September 2026 at 14:00. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers, with timed and untimed participation options. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and the city’s autumn beauty.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through central Tallinn
Participate by running or walking, with or without timing
Start and finish at Freedom Square
additional: Discounts: 20% off for seniors aged 60 and over and young people under 20. A 10% group discount applies when at least 10 people register together. The event offers discounts for seniors, young people and groups, and is part of the Tallinn Marathon, taking place on 11–13 September 2026.

name: Nike Noortejooks
description: Nike Youth Run is a running event for young people, held at Freedom Square in the heart of Tallinn. It is part of the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon event series and offers young people the chance to take part in a fun, sporting event. The race starts in the evening, creating a pleasant atmosphere and encouraging an active lifestyle among young people. Registration is easy, and early-bird prices are available.
course_highlights: Held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn
Evening start at 18:30
A safe running environment suitable for young people
additional: Registering early can secure lower entry fees. Young people and seniors can also get special discounts in the Tallinn Marathon series. Participants are provided with a safe running environment and well-organised event. The race takes place in Tallinn’s Old Town and at Freedom Square. Participants can join a community of young athletes, and awards are presented to the top finishers.

description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional running event in Pärnu, held on the first weekend of September. It brings together thousands of sports enthusiasts, offering a 10 km run, Nordic walking, and an evening run. The event takes place in the scenic area of Pärnu and its bridges, offering a sporting experience for participants of all ages. It is organised by the Pärnu Two Bridges Club, which invites everyone to get active and enjoy moving.
course_highlights: 10 km run and Nordic walking in Pärnu’s scenic bridge area
Pärnu Evening Run over a 3 km distance
Children’s races and a wheelchair race on Family Day
additional: The event includes both timed and untimed distances, as well as a Family Day with children’s races and a wheelchair race. The event centre is located by Endla Theatre. Registration takes place in several waves, allowing early registrants to get lower prices. This family event offers a variety of running and walking activities, as well as the chance to enjoy activities organised by local sports clubs and hobby schools. Registration and further information are available on the organiser’s website.

name: 15. Kütioru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: The Kütioru trail run and walk is part of the Võrumaa Running and Walking Series, offering a range of distances for both runners and walkers. The event takes place at the Kütioru Ski Centre, and the course is off-road, providing a varied running experience. The series includes distances ranging from children’s races to the main events, with options for all levels. This traditional event is open to everyone interested in sport who wants to enjoy Võrumaa’s beautiful nature and friendly sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Off-road course around the Kütioru Ski Centre
A range of distances, from children’s races to the main events
Enjoy Võrumaa’s beautiful nature and varied terrain
additional: The series offers running and walking events for different age groups and ability levels. The course may include asphalt and gravel roads as well as softer ground. Children’s races take place in separate areas. An event centre and transport arrangements are usually provided, but check the season’s guide for details. Participants can enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and varied terrain. The event is part of the Võrumaa Running and Walking Series, which features different distances and age groups.

description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional sporting event in Pärnu that brings together thousands of running enthusiasts on the first weekend of September. The event takes place in Vaasa Park and offers various distances and ways to participate, including an evening run, a wheelchair race and children’s races. The Two Bridges Run is known for its beautiful urban course along the bridges, offering a sporting challenge and a pleasant atmosphere for all participants. The event is open to both recreational and experienced runners and celebrates the joy of movement and community spirit.
course_highlights: 10 km run and walk on a beautiful course in Vaasa Park
Evening run and family day with children’s races
Wheelchair race for an inclusive sporting experience
additional: The family day also features children’s races and a wheelchair race. The events take place in Vaasa Park. Walking is also available as part of the event. Registration is on the website, which also provides guidelines and entry fees. The event is timed. It offers several running and movement activities, including children’s races, a wheelchair race and the main 10 km run, which passes scenic views of the Pärnu River and the city.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
location: Portowy region Gdańska, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 60th Walking Festival is a prestigious international sporting event held in the port region of Gdańsk on 5 September 2026. It brings together athletes of various ages and ability levels, with race-walking events over 10 km (women and men, including Open, U20 and U18 categories), 5 km and 3 km for younger participants, as well as the Polish Masters Championships over 5 km. The festival also includes the Polish U23 Championships over 10 km and accompanying events such as the “Walk with the Postman” Prologue and the Polish Post Office Defenders’ Run – Energa Cup. The organiser, LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, promotes physical activity among people with disabilities, too, with wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions.
course_highlights: Race walking over 10 km, 5 km and 3 km, with distances suited to different age categories
Polish Masters Championships over 5 km and Polish U23 Championships over 10 km
Accompanying events, including the “Walk with the Postman” Prologue and the Polish Post Office Defenders’ Run
additional: The festival promotes physical activity among people with disabilities through wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions. It is organised by LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club and supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism. Events cover several distances, including 10 km, 5 km and 3 km, and online registration is available. The event promotes sporting activity among people of different ages and people with disabilities, with support from the Ministry of Sport and Tourism.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: The Praski Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Warsaw, attracting both recreational and experienced runners. The half-marathon course passes through the scenic and historic parts of Praga, offering participants exceptional views and atmosphere. The event takes place at night, giving it a unique character and appeal. The organizers provide professional support, timekeeping, and race packs that include an official T-shirt.
course_highlights: The course passes through the historic Praga district of Warsaw
The race takes place in the evening, giving the event a nighttime character
Scenic views and the unique atmosphere of a night half marathon
additional: Official race T-shirt for participants. Electronic timekeeping. The event is held at night, with the start at 20:00. Race packs with a race bib and chip are available. The course is certified and secured. Participants can also take part in the 5 km race, the Praska 5k Run. The event also includes results and details about the course and regulations. The races are open to a wide range of participants, and the event is growing in popularity among runners from Warsaw and the surrounding area.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The XLVI International Usedom Marathon is a unique running event that crosses two countries along Europe’s longest seaside promenade. The 42 km course connects Świnoujście in Poland with Wolgast in Germany, passing through historic seaside resorts and scenic woodland. Runners can enjoy varied surfaces and beautiful views of the Baltic Sea, as well as the unique atmosphere of Usedom Island.
course_highlights: The route follows Europe’s longest seaside promenade
Passes through the historic seaside resorts of Ahlbeck, Heringsdorf and Bansin
Varied surfaces: asphalt, cobblestones and forest trails
additional: Transport to the marathon start is provided by the organizer’s buses, with a stop near the race office at 7:15. Boarding is available at various points on Usedom Island. Baggage transport to the stadium in Wolgast is provided. Time limit: runners must pass Kölpinsee (km 21.8) within 2:30 h and Zinnowitz (km 30) within 3:30 h; otherwise, they will be withdrawn from the course. After these time limits, the course will not be supported and no refreshment stations will be available. Start in Świnoujście, finish in Wolgast, bus transfer available, registration until 30 August 2026. The routes include urban, forest and coastal sections.

name: XIV Grand Prix Nordic Walking Nowa Wieś Lęborska
MOSSARUN
description: Mossarun is a small, welcoming charity race in southern Sweden, focused on technical singletrack and community rather than prize money. The main format is a 17 km loop used for the 24-hour ultra; there are also 51 km and a children’s race. The course is technical and hilly, with many short, steep climbs and mostly singletrack. The organizers emphasize simplicity and sustainability, and a large portion of the entry fee goes to charity.
course_highlights: 17 km loop — used for the 24-hour ultra (51 km = 3 laps)
Approximately 500 m of elevation gain per lap (according to barometric watches)
90% singletrack, 10% gravel; technical terrain with many short hills
additional: Accommodation: you can sleep in the barn (20–30 places) or camp on site; social activities before and after the race include a campfire and BBQ/pizza. Wood-fired pizza is sold (100–120 kr, 13:00–15:00). 24-hour runners pass the base camp every lap; there are special features for the 24-hour race ("chainsaw segment") — see the race rules. The cut-off for the 24-hour ultra is stated as Sunday 6.09.2026. The event provides separate toilets/changing rooms and access to menstrual products; support is available to help find a night-running buddy for dark laps. Swish donations to WAR Child: 900 55 47 (write "mossarun"); alternatively, donate via the respective NGO’s website. Registration requires proof of a donation to War Child or another NGO; the event offers several distances and a child-friendly course.

name: Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is an iconic 10 km race for women, taking place in 2026 on Southern Djurgården and through central Stockholm on 5 September. The race is suitable for all levels—from walking to fast running—and is divided into start groups to ensure a smooth race flow. The course draws large crowds and combines scenic sections with urban surroundings. Timing is optional, and prize money is awarded to the top 3.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Southern Djurgården and through the beautiful surroundings of central Stockholm
Plenty of crowd support along the course and a high-energy atmosphere
Option to shorten the race to approximately 6 km (start group 12) for those who wish
additional: Timing is included but can be opted out of; registration is binding. Late registration is available digitally, subject to availability, until 1 hour before the first start. Payment options: online banking, Visa/Mastercard, Swish or invoice via Klarna. The minimum age for Tjejmilen Stockholm is 15 in the year you turn 15 (13 when accompanied by an adult). The start is divided into 12 start groups, and prize money is awarded to the top 3. Two 10 km races for women (Sälen trail and Stockholm City race); start groups; minimum age 15; late registration may be available; dogs are not permitted; planning information is available on the official page.

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
description: Join the 44th International Open Cross-Country Race for the Forest Cup in memory of Tomasz Hopfer, taking place on 6 September 2026 in Obliwice. The main race course is 6.4 km long and consists of two 3.2 km loops, with the start and finish in the same place. The event has a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for the whole family amid nature. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and an athlete, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity in the local community.
course_highlights: Main race course: two 3.2 km loops
Start and finish at the same point
Forest and natural surroundings in Obliwice
additional: Race schedule for 6 September 2026: ceremonial opening at 11:00; races for children and young people over 600 m and 1.609 km; main race start at 13:20 over 6.4 km; mayors’ and VIP race at 14:00; International Mile in memory of Piotr Gładki at 17:00; and the Ecological Feast at 17:30. Around 300 athletes are expected to take part in the main race. The top athletes in the main race qualify for the International Mile. Forest terrain, online registration, accompanying events, sports memorial.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is Poland’s oldest continuously held 10-kilometre road race, taking place in Gdańsk. The race starts at the historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The course is certified and marked at every kilometre, and the finish is at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, providing an added attraction for participants. The event draws up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Defenders of the Coast in 1939.
course_highlights: Certified course marked every 1 km
An opportunity to run through the Tunnel under the Dead Vistula, which is normally closed to pedestrian traffic
Finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, a modern football stadium
additional: Race bib collection at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk on 6–7 September 2026. Water station on the course at approximately 6 km. Participant limit: 5,000. Free buses will take runners to the start on race day. Bag drop available with a race bib sticker. No showers. The awards ceremony will take place at the finish at approximately 11:45. Cash prizes and trophies for the winners in the OPEN and age-group categories. Registration runs from 2026-03-02 to 2026-08-20, with a limit of 4,900 participants. Official T-shirts can be purchased at the Expo. The event includes race-pack collection, the Expo, transport, the start, and the awards ceremony at Westerplatte.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła is a 5 km race held in Bukownica, Mazowieckie. It’s a great opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness on an easy asphalt course. The organizers encourage participants to prepare using training plans tailored to their individual level, with support from experts. The event has a friendly, motivating atmosphere and is ideal for anyone looking to improve their fitness and enjoy running.
course_highlights: 5 km course
Easy asphalt surface
Scenic surroundings of Bukownica
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to runners’ VDOT levels and accompanied by instructions and expert support. Training preparation is available to participants, and the event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle in the local community.

name: LöpRallarn
location: Bottnaryds IP, Bottnaryd, Ljungby Municipality, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: LöpRallarn is part of Rallarloppen and is organized by Bottnaryds IF. The race offers shorter distances (listed as 7.5 km and 15 km) and attracts both young people and recreational runners—for example, the 2025 race drew around 102 participants. The start is at Bottnaryds IP, and the event takes place as a late-summer activity in the area around Bottnaryd. The organizer publishes results and contact details via the race’s designated email address.
course_highlights: A gently undulating loop near Bottnaryds IP (described as an 8 km loop in the Rallarloppet information)
A route that follows parts of the old, disused railway embankment
Passes natural areas near Dumme Mosse
additional: Previous editions (2025) featured both 7.5 km and 15 km, with many young people on the start list; the organizer publishes results via the same website and designated email address. LöpRallarn is part of the Rallarloppen series, alongside RallarLoppet (cross-country skiing) and CykelRallarn. The Rallarloppen course runs through the surrounding countryside, with the start and finish at Bottnaryds IP. LöpRallarn offers several distances (1 km, 2 km, 7.5 km and 15 km) for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
description: Blodomloppet in Eskilstuna takes place on 7 September 2026 and is organised by Eskilstuna Friidrott. The event offers women’s and men’s 5 km and 10 km races, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet. The courses are described as fast and flat. The event is held in Stadsparken and combines recreational running with the aim of raising awareness of blood donation, including through a donor gift and a picnic tradition. Information and event details are published on the event page, and participants can register individually or as a team.
course_highlights: A fast, flat course with very little elevation change
The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured
The start and event area are in Stadsparken
additional: Participants can register individually or as a team (maximum 5 people per team); members of the same team can take part in different distances. For larger registrations, an Excel template can be downloaded from the registration page, and the organiser can help set up a customer page or discount code for companies with more than 20 participants. Blood donor gifts are distributed at the Unilabs blood donor centre tent in the event area. Bag storage/drop-off is available (drop-off and collection are listed as 17:00–20:00). Course distances: 5 km and 10 km. Lilla Blodomloppet is 800 m. The event area includes bag drop and a picnic bag; participants can register individually or as a team (maximum 5 people per team).

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 4 etapas
location: Ukmergė, Ukmergė district municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurė 2026 yra penkių etapų sporto renginys, apimantis bėgimo kroso, MTB dviračių kroso ir rogainingo varžybas. Renginys skatina aktyvų laisvalaikį gamtoje ir populiarina sportą įvairaus amžiaus dalyvių tarpe. Varžybos vyksta Ukmergėje, o pagrindinis organizatorius yra VšĮ Sportas miške. Dalyviai varžosi pagal amžiaus grupes ir rungčių tipus, o renginio metu vyksta bendras startas visoms grupėms. Laiko limitas varžyboms yra 120 minučių, išskyrus Mini Rogainingą.
course_highlights: Varžybos vyksta Šilo pagrindinės mokyklos stadione
Varžybų startas bendras visoms grupėms ir vienodas visuose etapuose
Renginys apima bėgimo, MTB dviračių kroso ir rogainingo rungtis
additional: Numerių ir laiko fiksavimo daviklių išdavimas vykdomas nuo 16:30 iki 17:30 varžybų starto vietoje. Dviračių rungties starto laikas 18:00 (naktinio etapo 19:15). Bėgimo rungties starto laikas 18:05 (naktinio etapo 19:20). Žygeivių startas 18:10 (naktinio etapo 19:25). Rogainingo rungties žemėlapių dalinimas 17:45, startas 18:00. Laiko limitas pabaigti varžybas yra 120 minučių (išskyrus Mini Rogainingą). Renginys apima kelių sporto šakų varžybas, registracija vyksta varžybų vietoje, dalyviai gali būti įvairaus amžiaus, yra keli etapai ir skirtingos rungtys.

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus i Skärblacka, Skärblacka, Östergötland, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early Bird, 250 kr, fram till och med 30 april 23:59.

description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual fun run in Skärblacka, offering a festival atmosphere for runners and spectators. The main race is 6 km through the town, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus. There is also a 4 km walking class and a 900 m Little Children’s Race. The race is open to all levels and features generous prizes, lotteries and goodie bags for participants. Organisers Frida Södermark and Stefan Fransson warmly welcome everyone to the starting line on 9 September 2026.
course_highlights: 6 km through Skärblacka, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus
The course includes asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and some trails
4 km walking class (shortened course) and 900 m Little Children’s Race near Parkskolan
additional: Start and finish at Folkets Hus in Skärblacka. Race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on Tuesday 8 September, 11:00–18:00; any remaining race numbers will be handed out at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late entries are available when collecting race numbers. All participants receive a goodie bag; prizes, a sprint prize and lotteries are offered (including a tyre prize and course-record bonus). The walking class was introduced in 2024; race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka; registration is via raceid; late registration is available on race day from 15:30; payment is accepted only by Swish or cash; a chip in the race number records the time; medical care, food and drink are available on site.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Gripholms Slott, Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: 100 miles, 100 km, 50 km, Halvmarathon, 8 km, 8 km, 2 km
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a multi-day event (11–13 September 2026) through the scenic and biologically rich landscapes of Sörmland, with distances ranging from approximately 8 km to 100 miles. The routes follow technical singletrack, coastal trails and faster sections, and suit both experienced ultrarunners and recreational runners, depending on the distance chosen. The event focuses on the trail-running experience, with local food, talks and a friendly, inclusive atmosphere. The organisers offer GPS tracking, GPX files and aid-station support for a memorable weekend in Sörmland.
course_highlights: A route featuring forest trails and coastal cliffs along the Sörmlandsleden
Approximately 300 metres of elevation gain (22 km) and technical singletrack
Terrain: approximately 85% trail, 10% gravel and 5% asphalt
additional: GPX files are available to download; live GPS tracking and intermediate and final results are provided. The event is cupless—bring your own cup. Longer distances include a buff, live tracking, GPX, a window decal and a handmade wooden finisher’s medal or belt buckle, depending on the distance. Detailed mandatory kit lists apply to the 100 km and 100-mile distances (including 1 litre of fluids, a mobile phone, navigation tools, a first-aid kit, a map, a GPS tracker, an emergency blanket, a rain jacket and a headlamp). Early cut-offs and aid-station locations have been published; the organiser plans shuttle buses from Nävekvarn Camping to Nyköping (approximately 100 SEK, payable via Swish on site). A Night Trail and a 2 km children’s race are included; start and finish locations include Gripholms Slott in Mariefred and Nävekvarns Folkets Park. Bus transfers and GPX routes are included in the information for various distances.

name: ASTRI KESKUS Narva Sügisjooks 2026
location: Astri Keskus, Narva, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
description: Astri Keskus Narva Autumn Run 2026 is a running, walking and hiking event held in Ida-Viru County, inviting everyone who enjoys being active to take part. The event is part of the activities of the Centre of Excellence for Recreational Sport, which aims to promote a healthy and active lifestyle. The Autumn Run offers an opportunity to enjoy exercise and support your mental and physical health. Participants can choose the activity that suits them and share the joy of exercise with others.
course_highlights: Takes place around Astri Keskus in Ida-Viru County
Suitable for running, walking and hiking
An event that encourages participants to be active and promotes health
additional: The event includes running, hiking and walking and takes place on 19 September 2026. Registration is open, and the event is intended for all age groups and ability levels.

name: 84. laste Paala järve jooks
description: The 84th Paala Lake Children’s Run is a traditional children’s race held on the shore of Paala Lake near Viljandi. The event offers different distances depending on the children’s ages, from 300 metres to a two-lap run around the lake. The race is organised by the JOOSU recreational sports club and gives children the chance to be active and enjoy nature. The race starts on 12 September 2026 at 10:00. Prizes and keepsakes are provided for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the shore of Paala Lake
Route around Paala Lake; one lap is 1,200 m
Distances from 300 m to 2 laps (2,400 m)
additional: Participant registration opens at 10:00 on the same day. Distances are divided by age group: children’s run, 300 m (ages 5 and under); main race, 1 lap around the lake (boys and girls aged 6–10 and girls aged 11–12); and main race, 2 laps around the lake (boys aged 11–12). Many prizes and keepsakes. The race is organised by the JOOSU recreational sports club. The event starts at 10:00, and registration takes place on site. The event focuses on health and physical activity and is intended for children and young people.

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines the excitement of sport with tangible support for an important social cause: the mental health of children and young people. The event will take place across Poland on September 12, 2026, encouraging participants to run together and take action for their communities. Every lap, kilometre and minute on the course matters, highlighting the spirit of community and helping others. This anniversary edition invites runners to take part and show their support.
course_highlights: Multiple locations across Poland, including Gdańsk, Ruda Śląska, Łomża, Krosno and Stalowa Wola
Virtual run option using an app
Charity relay races and runs for children and adults
additional: The event takes place across Poland, combining physical activity with a charitable cause supporting the mental health of children and young people. The PKO Charity Run is an initiative where it is not just the result that matters, but above all, acting together and supporting the community. The event supports the mental health of children and young people, includes relay races and fundraising for therapy, participation in many cities across Poland, and a virtual participation option.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a popular race by Lake Bysjön in Åtvidaberg, organised by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The courses combine asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails, with the start and finish at Edbergavallen. There are distances for both children and adults. The race is traditionally held on the second Saturday in September and welcomes recreational runners, competitive runners and teams alike.
course_highlights: Mixed surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails along Lake Bysjön
Start and finish at Edbergavallen
The 10 km course includes a hilly trail section (the illuminated trail in Humpa) and is more challenging
additional: Register via the link to the registration system; payment by Swish or bank giro (discount codes may be available online). Race bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen; on-site late registration is available from 10:00 (payment by Swish or exact cash). Distance information: 700 m (children, untimed), 1.3 km (children, timed), 5 km (measured 5.0 km, mixed asphalt/gravel) and 10 km (measured 10.0 km, mixed asphalt/trail/gravel, hilly). All finishers receive a medal; a special commemorative medal is awarded for completing the race for the 10th or 20th time (adult categories). Team registration (4–6 participants) includes a picnic bag intended for 5 people; team registration may close on 7 September if the bags run out. There is a kiosk at the event site. The prize ceremonies are at approximately 12:00 for the 1.3 km and approximately 14:00 for the 5 km and 10 km. Distances: 1.3 km, 5 km and 10 km; all finishers receive a medal; adult categories can earn an extra commemorative medal for their 10th or 20th race; team registration is for 4–6 participants; race bib collection at Edbergavallen; an ICA picnic bag after the finish; kiosks at the event site; prize ceremonies according to the prize table. Preparatory activities include a running workshop and open group interval training before the race.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna StadsTrail is a welcoming trail race offered over 5, 10 and 21 km, starting and finishing at Gränna Square. The courses combine fast-running asphalt with winding trails through beech and coniferous forests, offering magnificent views of Lake Vättern and Grännaberget. The race is designed to be as much about the experience as the performance, and is suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. All participants receive timing and a unique medal at the finish.
course_highlights: 5 km: mostly asphalt, finishing with a descent down Grännaberget on a winding trail
10 km: a mix of asphalt and trail, with views along Lake Vättern and Grännaberget
21 km: winding trails through beech forest, gravel roads and challenging hills, with magnificent views
additional: A mass start from the square takes runners through Gränna to the harbour, where timing begins; timing on all distances; a unique medal for all participants; the event venue and finish area are in the centre of Gränna, close to cafés, restaurants and accommodation; the courses may be changed depending on conditions and permits. Timing on all distances. Start and finish at Gränna Square. Distances: 5, 10 and 21 km. The courses may change depending on conditions and permits.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a 26 km trail race in Paradiset Nature Reserve south of Stockholm. The race features technical, winding trails over rocky outcrops, boardwalks across marshes and through open pine forest—a challenging yet scenic trail event. The distance is a round in the Outnorth Trailtour, and the race emphasises community, personal challenge and a festive atmosphere after the finish. The organiser is Trailrunning Sweden AB, and the event is aimed at trail runners who want to experience the wilderness south of Stockholm.
course_highlights: Technical singletrack trails with climbs and descents over rocky outcrops
Boardwalks across marshes and small tarns, as well as stretches of open pine forest
26 km through Paradiset Nature Reserve—a round in the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: The race date is listed as 12 Sep 2026. The event highlights the post-race celebration and finish-line atmosphere, and that the race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour. The organiser is listed as Trailrunning Sweden AB (Hästtorget 6, 312 30 Laholm). The terrain is described as challenging, with winding trails, rocky outcrops, boardwalks and marshes. The courses are marked with course tape, with start groups for each distance; start times and aid stations are listed; dogs are not allowed; there is a hydration arrangement and an after-party at Oasen.

name: Nybro Backyard 12h
organizer: Nybro Skidklubb & Topp och Dröm HB
description: Topp & Dröm organizes Nybro Backyard 12h as part of its annual race program in Nybro. The race is a 12-hour Backyard format that welcomes runners seeking an ultra challenge at a social and inclusive event. The organizer emphasizes exercise, community, and enjoyment of nature, and also offers rentals and personal training in Nybro. Contact details for Topp & Dröm are available on its website.
course_highlights: 12-hour Backyard format
Organized in Nybro by Topp & Dröm
The organizer focuses on exercise, community, and enjoyment of nature
additional: Organizer: Topp och Dröm HB, Sommargatan 17, 382 38 Nybro. Organization number: 969796-6407. Contact email: info@toppochdrom.se. Swish payment number: 123 698 89 01. Topp & Dröm also offers ski rentals (roller-ski and cross-country ski packages) and personal training in Nybro. The race features a 6,706 m loop, starts every full hour, and has changing rooms and showers nearby; parking is available at the stadium, and camping and motorhome pitches are available through Nybro Camping. Registration is via Mittlopp, and race bibs can be collected from 06:30 to 07:45 on race day.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet is a family-friendly race and fun run in Saltsjö-Duvnäs, winding through a beautiful, hilly residential area. The event is organised by Saltsjö-Duvnäs Sports Club and includes races for children and adults, starting and finishing at Ringparken. Everyone can take part, whether you run for fun or are more competitively minded, and the event emphasises community and enjoyment. Registration opens on 1 June 2026, and the race takes place on 12 September 2026.
course_highlights: Hilly residential area with several steep hills (including Fogdevägen and Vargungevägen)
The 5 km and 10 km courses follow the same route; the 10 km is two laps
Shorter race (1.7 km) and children’s race start and finish at Ringparken
additional: Registration opens on 1 June 2026. The regular advance-registration deadline is (usually) around 11 September; registration is accepted after that until race start for a higher fee. Race numbers can be collected at Ringparksstugan on Friday evening from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 10:00 (at least one hour before the start). The timing chip is attached to the race number; 10 km runners use two race numbers (one at the front and one at the back). Registration is binding. Registration opens on 1 June 2026; distances are 5 km and 10 km (10 km is two laps); the children’s race starts at 11:00 and the adult race at approximately 12:30; race numbers can be collected at Ringparksstugan on race day or the evening before; advance registration is open until 11 September; the race is looking for volunteers.

name: Innovationsstafetten
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott; Ideon Science Park; Medicon Village
description: Innovationsstafetten is a team relay held in the Brunnshög and Ideon areas in north-eastern Lund. The start, finish and relay exchange area are in Nobelparken, and the course winds north towards ESS and through Kunskapsparken before returning to Nobelparken. Teams compete in women’s, men’s or mixed categories, and each runner covers approximately 5 km. The event is organised in collaboration with IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park and Medicon Village. It is well suited to companies, student teams and families, alongside Nobelloppet and Brunnshögskalaset.
course_highlights: The course passes through Nobelparken and Kunskapsparken and heads towards ESS/Max IV
A relatively flat course with approximately 10 metres of elevation change
A mix of gravel and asphalt, with views over north-western Lund from the hill
additional: Teams consist of 2–4 people (company pages state 2–4; some texts mention 4); each runner covers approximately 5 km. The first leg starts together at 14:00; subsequent exchange times depend on the team’s pace (there is no time limit). Changing facilities, storage for outerwear, and food and drink are available in Nobelparken; runners receive a medal or a sausage after finishing. Recommended transport: tram line 1 to Brunnshögstorget. Four-person teams; start, finish and relay exchange area in Nobelparken (Brunnshög); the course heads towards ESS and Kunskapsparken; late registration on 1 September; student pricing; a Mecenat card is mentioned for bib collection; organised in collaboration with IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park and Medicon Village.

name: SaaristoTrail
description: SaaristoTrail is an exciting trail-running event in Parainen, offering varied routes through stunning archipelago scenery. The event has three main distances: 7 km, 14 km and a 21 km half marathon, suitable for both beginners and more experienced trail runners. The routes include varied trails, forest tracks and significant elevation changes, including the steep climbs of Svinövuori, offering unforgettable views and a challenge. The relaxed atmosphere and careful organization make it an enjoyable experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Varied trails and forest tracks
Steep climbs up Svinövuori, with juice served at the summit
Approximately 850 metres of total ascent on the 21 km route
additional: The 1 km children's run is free for those who register in advance (the last day to register is 10.9) and costs 5 euros for late registration. All children taking part receive a medal. The event centre is at Finby Ski Stadium, where shower facilities are also available in the changing rooms at Archipelagia Golf. The route is marked with red-and-white plastic tape. Race materials can be collected from the race office starting at 8.45 and up to half an hour before your start. Juice and water are available at the finish, and the results are posted on the information board. Late registration at the event venue is available via MobilePay or bank card; cash is not accepted. The event offers different route options, so participants can choose a suitable distance. Routes and results are available on the event website, and the event offers a chance to enjoy the archipelago’s natural scenery and the joy of exercise.

name: Swedbank Vilniaus maratonas 2026
description: Swedbank Vilniaus maratonas yra didžiausias bėgimo renginys Lietuvoje, vykstantis Vilniaus senamiestyje. Renginys siūlo įvairias distancijas nuo vaikų bėgimo iki pilno maratono, leidžiančias kiekvienam dalyviui rasti sau tinkamą iššūkį. Maratono trasos vingiuoja per Vilniaus senamiesčio gatves, parkus ir Neries pakrantę, suteikdamos nepamirštamų vaizdų ir emocijų. Tai tarptautinis renginys, pritraukiantis bėgikus iš įvairių pasaulio šalių, ir puiki proga patirti sporto džiaugsmą bei bendruomeniškumą.
course_highlights: Trasa vingiuoja per Vilniaus senamiestį, Vingio parką ir Neries pakrantę
Maratono, pusmaratonio, 10 km, 5 km ir vaikų bėgimo distancijos
Vaizdingos miesto gatvės ir parkai su tarptautine dalyvių bendruomene
additional: Dalyvio numeris tvirtinamas prie marškinėlių ant krūtinės ir turi būti aiškiai matomas. Maratono, pusmaratonio, 10 km, 5 km, ėjimo bei vaikų bėgimo dalyviai apdovanojami atminimo medaliais. Renginio dalyvių susirinkimo vietose veiks biotualetai. Nepilnamečiai privalo turėti tėvų ar globėjų sutikimą numerių atsiėmimui. Įmonių registracija baigiasi rugsėjo 1 dieną. Renginyje siūlomos įvairios distancijos, vaikų bėgimai ir vaikščiojimo renginiai; registracijos informacija ir nemokami marškiniai ankstyviems registruotojams.

name: RUN & RAVE Palanga
description: RUN & RAVE Palanga yra nauja bendruomenės iniciatyva, skirta tiems, kurie mėgsta judesį, muziką ir gerą energiją. Renginys vyksta Palangoje ir apima mobilumo treniruotes, 5 km socialinį bėgimą su DJ muzika, ledinį vonios ritualą bei kavos pertraukėles. Tai puiki proga susipažinti su naujais žmonėmis, užmegzti pažintis ir patirti vasaros energiją viename rytiniame renginyje. Registracija yra būtina, o dalyviai kviečiami pasiimti sportinius batelius, maudymosi šortus ir rankšluostį.
course_highlights: 5 km socialinis bėgimas su DJ muzika
Mobilumo treniruotė
Ledinė vonia Vytauto Ice Bath
additional: Renginys vyksta kelis kartus vasaros metu, įskaitant 2026-09-13. Dalyviai kviečiami pasiimti sportinius batelius, maudymosi šortus ir rankšluostį. RUN & RAVE yra bendruomenės renginys, kuriame dera judesys, muzika ir gera energija, su DJ muzika ir ledine vonia po bėgimo. Renginio vieta - Palanga, renginio data - 2026 m. rugsėjo 13 d. Renginys apima socialinius bėgimus, miesto aplinką, registracija būtina iš anksto, renginys skirtas skatinti bendruomeniškumą ir aktyvų gyvenimo būdą.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The 2nd Złotów Ten is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in Złotów. Participants complete two laps of 5 km each, for a total distance of 10 km. The event is organized by the Złotów Social Activity Center and aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local running community together. All running enthusiasts are welcome to take part.
course_highlights: The course consists of two laps of 5 km each
A road race in the center of Złotów
Organized at the Municipal Stadium and on nearby streets
additional: The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Złotów and on nearby streets. The course consists of two 5 km laps. Registration is available through the Domtel-Sport platform. The organizer, the Złotów Social Activity Center, provides contact and support. A 10 km road race with online registration, support from local businesses, an appealing course, and prizes

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
location: Tor Poznań, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting motorsport events held at the race track in Poznań. Participants have the opportunity to compete, train, and take part in qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at motorsport enthusiasts and also offers car rentals and one-to-one instruction with instructors. It is a great opportunity to experience the thrill of motorsport and improve your skills on a professional track.
course_highlights: Race track in Poznań with professional facilities
Opportunity to take part in various rounds and qualifying sessions during the 2026 season
Training sessions and one-to-one instruction with instructors
additional: Cars can be rented for track use, for yourself or as a gift. The entry package includes participation by a team member, the option to co-drive (age >17), full catering, individual lap-time measurement, and the option of instruction with an instructor. Participation payments must include the correct payment reference to confirm entry. Multiple rounds include training sessions, qualifying, and night races, with a focus on sporty driving and the excitement of the track.

name: XI Bieg Nadziei oraz VII Mistrzostwa Wielkopolski Prawników
location: Środa Wielkopolska, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are a charity run organized in Środa Wielkopolska to support the work of the Piotr Hospice. The event combines sporting competition with an important social cause, engaging the local community and the legal profession. It is an established tradition that promotes physical activity and solidarity.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Old Market Square in Środa Wielkopolska
Charity run supporting the hospice
Various distances and activities, including children’s races and Nordic walking
additional: The run is a charity event supporting the Piotr Hospice. Registration opens on March 1, 2026. The website has no details about the course, start times, or fees. The event is scheduled for September 13, 2026, and includes various running and activity options; participation supports the work of the Piotr Hospice.

name: 16 Bieg Częstochowski
description: The 16th Częstochowa Run is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in the center of Częstochowa. The 10 km course follows the city’s prominent avenues, including the area around Jasna Góra, giving the race a distinctive prestige. The course is officially certified, attracting runners aiming for a fast pace and personal bests. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition in picturesque urban surroundings.
course_highlights: 10 km course through the center of Częstochowa
Route passes near Jasna Góra
Officially certified course suited to fast running
additional: Registration takes place at the Sports Hall of IV High School; the fee is payable in cash. The event also includes training sessions and information from sponsors.

name: Chyża 10
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a fast and popular 10 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Running Club. The event takes place in Nowy Tomyśl and counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix in running. The race starts at 9:00, and the race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and a well-prepared course.
course_highlights: Fast 10 km course
Race counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix
Start at 9:00; race office opens at 7:00
additional: The race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The winners’ award ceremony takes place at 10:45. The race is co-funded by the Municipality of Nowy Tomyśl and Nowotomyski County. The event also includes 5 km races, and registration opens on June 1, 2025. The race is part of a series of sporting events organized by the club.

description: The Northern Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on 13 September 2026 on the Hel Peninsula, bringing together the tradition of the Northern Marathon and the Marathon Relays under one name. The course passes through the scenic locations of Hel, Jastarnia and Rozewie, along Puck Bay, with sea views and four lighthouses giving the race its unique character. The event offers a range of distances for runners of all ability levels, from the marathon and relays to the half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, as well as a children’s race, the Little Lighthouse Keeper Run. It’s not just a sporting event, but also a journey through the coast’s beautiful spots and a chance to connect with nature.
course_highlights: The course runs along Puck Bay with views of the sea
There are four lighthouses along the course: in Hel, Jastarnia and two in Rozewie
The course passes through some of the most beautiful spots on the Hel Peninsula and the coast
additional: The course is available to download in .GPX, .KML and .TCX formats. Registration is open from 1 January 2026 to 24 August 2026 at 15:00. Co-organisers and partners include local sports and cultural centres and a holiday resort. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Marshal of the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The Little Lighthouse Keeper Run is for children and young people up to 14 years old. The course is available to download in .GPX, .KML and .TCX formats; coastal and seaside terrain; the event includes various distances and competitions for adults and children.

name: XV Półmaraton Damak
description: The 15th Damak Half Marathon in Tarczyn is a family celebration of running, promising a great atmosphere and unforgettable experiences. The half-marathon route passes through scenic areas alongside fields, forests and apple orchards, giving the race a distinctive character. The event attracts runners of all ages and also features races for children and teenagers. The organizers take care of participants by providing attractive race packs and support from sponsors.
course_highlights: The route passes alongside fields, forests and apple orchards
Scenic surroundings create a distinctive race atmosphere
A family-friendly event with races for children and teenagers
additional: Race packs include eco-friendly bags, reflective bands and thermal mugs bearing the Fakro sponsor logo. The race packs also contain Kamis spices. The participant limit for the children’s and youth races is 150. The race office is located at 8 Szarych Szeregów Street in Tarczyn. Urban area, online registration, family event, local sponsors and partners.

name: XXI Radomski Maraton Trzeźwości
location: Jedlnia-Letnisko, Kozienice County, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Radom Sobriety Marathon is an annual running event organized by the “Biegiem Radom!” Association. The races take place on scenic routes in the Kozienice Forest near Jedlnia-Letnisko, giving participants the opportunity to compete in the marathon, half marathon, and other accompanying races. The marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and sobriety, while also bringing the local running community together. It is a well-established event that attracts both amateur and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Routes run through the Kozienice Forest
Scenic forest trails and natural surroundings
Available distances: marathon and half marathon
additional: Medals can be personalized for a symbolic fee of 10 zł. The organizer encourages participation in the marathon, half marathon, and other accompanying races. The “Biegiem Radom!” Association also works to bring people together and promote running in the region. The event includes various distances, including the marathon and half marathon, with training plans and support for participants. Registration opens on September 14, 2025.

name: Żyrardów w Biegu
description: Żyrardów w Biegu is an annual running event organized by the Żyrardów Cycling Association, taking place on September 13, 2026, by the Żyrardów Reservoir. Participants can choose between two distances: 10 km and 5 km. Both routes go around the reservoir, with multiple laps and a finish at the reservoir grounds. The race promotes physical activity, community spirit and a welcoming sporting atmosphere, while also helping promote the city of Żyrardów and the Mazovia region. The event is open to adults, and athletes using active wheelchairs may also compete in the 10 km race.
course_highlights: Route around the Żyrardów Reservoir
4 laps for the 10 km distance; 2 laps for the 5 km distance
Start and finish by the Żyrardów Reservoir, 17 Ziołowa Street
additional: Online registration is available until September 10, 2026. After that date, registration is available only at the race office until 9:00 a.m. on race day. Each participant collects a race number with a chip at the race office. Athletes using active wheelchairs may compete in the 10 km race. The event base, start, finish and parking are by the Żyrardów Reservoir, 17 Ziołowa Street. Distances: 10 km and 5 km; online registration; a 100-minute time limit for the main race; wheelchair athletes may participate; the swimming area is open during the event weekend.

name: II Bieg Tropem Wilka
location: Korpele, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: III Palmirski Bieg Pamięci Janusza Kusocińskiego
Mälarömilen
description: After more than ten years away, Mälarömilen is back on Ekerö—a welcoming race for runners of all levels. The event features four races in one day: Mälarö Knattelopp, Lilla Mälarömilen, Mälaröfemman and the classic main race, Mälarömilen (10 km). The start and finish are at Träkvista sports ground, and the event emphasizes community, the joy of exercise and fast courses for those who want to compete. Teams and companies can also register together through a convenient group registration.
course_highlights: Paved walking paths and park trails
Signs at every kilometre marker
Start and finish at Träkvista sports ground; the course passes along the walking path north of the sports ground
additional: Online registration closes 7 days before the race; late registration is available on race day for an increased fee. The number of places is limited, and registration is valid only once payment has been completed. Timing and race bibs are used in all categories (except Mälarö Knattelopp, which is untimed; Lilla Mälarömilen girls/boys aged 9–11 are timed but not ranked). The event area is at Träkvista sports ground, with medical services, a water station just after the start/lap point, and toilets, showers and changing rooms in KOM-huset. Recommended public transport options: buses 177 and 301–311 (Träkvista Idrottsplats stop). The total limit is 1,000 runners, and all proceeds go back to Mälarö SOK’s sports activities. The race offers company and team registration, as well as support for teams.

name: Mjärdevistafetten
price_range: 700-1000 kr/lag (student/under 18 100 kr/lag; priser varierar efter anmälningsdatum)
description: Mjärdevistafetten is a lively public relay in Collegiumparken in Linköping Science Park. The competition is for teams of four, with each runner covering a leg of approximately 3 km. The race starts at 17:00, and there are activities, food sales, and an awards ceremony with a prize draw after the finish. The event welcomes everyone from elite teams to recreational runners and encourages colourful and creative touches along the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Collegiumparken, Linköping Science Park
Team competition: 4 people per team, each leg approximately 3 km
Awards ceremony at approximately 18:15 and a prize draw using race bib numbers
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Mjärdevi Center / DoSpace on Wednesday 11 September from 11:00 to 13:30 and Thursday 12 September from 11:00 to 13:30 (after that, in the start and finish area). Food is available on site, and an After Run package for the whole team is offered (price: 140 kr). The event encourages companies to create activities along the course (water stations, performances, etc.) and features attractive prize sponsors and prize draws. Teams collect their bibs at Mjärdevi Center/DoSpace before the event (usually from 11:00 to 13:30 on the days before), and After Run packages are available for teams (e.g. 140 kr according to the 2024 version). The event follows COVID-19 safety measures in line with recommendations from the authorities and encourages a focus on sustainability in themed activities.

name: Lietuvos aklųjų ir silpnaregių lengvosios atletikos bėgimo plentu čempionatas
location: Zelvė, Elektrėnų savivaldybė, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: Lietuvos aklųjų ir silpnaregių lengvosios atletikos bėgimo plentu čempionatas yra specializuotas bėgimo renginys, skirtas akliesiems ir silpnaregiams sportininkams. Varžybos vyksta Zelvėje, Elektrėnų savivaldybėje, ir yra organizuojamos Lietuvos aklųjų sporto federacijos (LASF). Federacija aktyviai remia aklųjų ir silpnaregių sportą Lietuvoje nuo 1990 metų, siekdama sudaryti lygias sąlygas dalyvauti įvairiose sporto varžybose ir renginiuose. Čempionatas yra svarbi tradicija, skatinanti sportininkų fizinį aktyvumą ir bendruomeniškumą.
course_highlights: Varžybos vyksta plentu Zelvėje, Elektrėnų savivaldybėje
Skirta akliesiems ir silpnaregiams sportininkams
Organizuojama Lietuvos aklųjų sporto federacijos
additional: Renginys skatina įtrauktį ir sporto plėtrą tarp regėjimo negalią turinčių sportininkų, vyks 2026 m. rugsėjo 19 d. Zelvėje.

name: Bėgimas „Ateik ir įveik!", skirtas prof. K. Baršausko atminimui
description: Bėgimas „Ateik ir įveik!“ yra tradicinis Kauno technologijos universiteto organizuojamas renginys, skirtas prof. K. Baršausko atminimui. Renginys kviečia dalyvius išbandyti savo jėgas įvairiose bėgimo ir ėjimo trasose, įskaitant naują 5 km bėgimą su šunimis. Tai puiki proga aktyviai praleisti laiką, skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir dalyvauti bendruomenės sporto renginyje. Varžybos vyksta KTU stadione ir Ąžuolyne, o dalyviai apdovanojami atminimo medaliais bei prizais pagal amžiaus grupes.
course_highlights: Varžybų startas ir finišas KTU stadione (Radvilėnų pl. 19, Kaunas)
Trasos: 10 km bėgimas, 5 km bėgimas, 5 km bėgimas su šunimis, 5 km ėjimas, 200 m vaikų bėgimas su kliūtimis
Renginio metu dalis startinio mokesčio skiriama gyvūnų prieglaudai
additional: Renginio programa: numerių atsiėmimas nuo 10:30 iki 11:50, 10 km bėgimo startas 12:00, 5 km bėgimo, bėgimo su šunimis ir ėjimo startas 12:10, 200 m vaikų bėgimo startas 13:40, apdovanojimai 13:55. KTU sporto rinktinių nariams registracija nemokama. Startinis mokestis pervedamas į Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociacijos sąskaitą. Dalyvio numerio perdavimas draudžiamas. Apdovanojamos gausiausiai dalyvavusi KTU fakulteto/administracinio vieneto komanda, jauniausias ir vyriausias dalyvis. Trasos: bėgimo ir ėjimo; amžiaus grupės: vaikai iki 12 m., suaugusieji; registracija internetu iki rugsėjo 18 d.; starto mokestis pervedamas į Lietuvos bėgimo mėgėjų asociaciją.

name: ELKE Tallinn Run - Noblessner 2026
description: The ELKE Tallinn Run takes place in Noblessner, offering the joy of exercise and experiences for the whole family. This beautiful seaside area provides an ideal setting for both sporting activities and an enjoyable day out. Race day begins with a children’s run and offers a choice of distances to suit both beginners and experienced runners. In addition to sports, the programme includes a free concert and a varied programme, creating a wonderful atmosphere for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: The beautiful seaside area of Noblessner
Views of Noblessner and North Tallinn
A variety of distances for children and adults
additional: Race day begins with the children’s run at 13:00. The 2.5 km and Stebby 5 km distances start at 14:30, and the Neptunas 10 km distance starts at 15:10. The event centre’s programme runs from 11:00 - 17:10. A free concert by INGER takes place at Noblessner Central Square at 13:40. Outdoor seaside setting, family-friendly, includes a run and a concert, autumn event

name: Jõhvi rahvajooks
location: Heino Lipu staadion, Jõhvi, Jõhvi vald, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
organizer: Jõhvi kultuuri- ja spordinõunik Avo Sambla
description: Jõhvi Fun Run is a traditional running event taking place for the 39th time at Heino Lipp Stadium in Jõhvi. This year, the course has been updated and, in addition to city streets, also runs through a park and the shops of Pargi Centre. The event offers an exciting and varied running experience over both 5 km and 10 km distances. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a rewarding sporting challenge.
course_highlights: The updated course runs along city streets, through a park and through a shopping centre
Distances: 5 km and 10 km
Start and finish at Heino Lipp Stadium
additional: The race takes place on 19 September 2026 at Heino Lipp Stadium in Jõhvi. The updated course includes city streets, a park and a shopping centre. The main distances are 5 km and 10 km. The event is community-focused and traditional, offering a sporting challenge for runners of different abilities. The race takes place at Heino Lipp Stadium and is part of the Ida-Viru Running Series, which attracts 600–700 participants, who can choose from different distances. Entry fees start at 10 euros, and registration takes place primarily before the event. The race is aimed at all age groups and emphasises the joy of participation and bringing the community together.

name: 13. Saarepeedi mägede jooks
location: Saarepeedi Rahvamaja, Saarepeedi, Põhja-Sakala vald, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: The 13th Saarepeedi Hills Run is a traditional running event held at Saarepeedi Community Centre. The race gives participants the opportunity to enjoy beautiful scenery and hilly trails. It is suitable for both recreational and experienced runners who want to test their endurance and agility. The organisers welcome all running enthusiasts to take part and enjoy an active day.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain around Saarepeedi
Beautiful natural views
A varied and diverse course
additional: The event is part of the Seeriajooks series and likely includes different distance options and results, giving athletes the opportunity to enjoy sport and nature.

name: PKO Wieczorny Półmaraton Łódź
description: The PKO Łódź Evening Half Marathon is a new, atmospheric running event held in the centre of Łódź. The start and finish are located at the revitalised EC1 combined heat and power plant, which is now a cultural and science centre. The 21.097 km course passes through the city’s best-known landmarks, bringing together its industrial history and modern character. This is a race where it’s not just the result that matters, but also the unique atmosphere and energy of the city.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the revitalised EC1 combined heat and power plant
The course passes through Łódź’s best-known landmarks
An evening road race in the city centre
additional: The participant limit is 5,000. The race pack includes a commemorative drawstring backpack, and everyone who finishes the race receives a medal. An official SMMASH technical shirt is available to purchase. Discounts are available to PKO Bank Polski customers paying online. Registration opened one week before the event. The course includes key locations in Łódź.

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
location: Gontyniec, Chodzież, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the picturesque Gontyniec Massif. Competitors cover the greatest distance they can, with well-stocked aid stations available after every loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, with beautiful views of the Noteć Valley and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It is a unique experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable impressions.
course_highlights: Non-stop race on loops of approximately 10 km
Aid station for competitors after every loop
Views of the Noteć Valley and unique figurative beehives along the course
additional: The race lasts 6 or 12 hours non-stop. The course consists of loops of approximately 10 km. An aid station is available after every loop. Competitors can choose the 6- or 12-hour option. The course runs through the Gontyniec Massif, with scenic views and natural attractions. Trail, mountain and forest paths; participant limit of 150 in each race; preparation period of 8 to 20 weeks.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 5 km - mieszkańcy Sopotu posiadający Kartę Sopocką

description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race taking place on September 19, 2026, in Sopot. The start and finish are located in the parking lot by the Forest Opera, and the course runs through the picturesque surroundings. The race is part of a series of four events held on different dates and at different locations in Sopot, offering participants a unique atmosphere and the chance to compete over a short distance. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and well-organized event.
course_highlights: A 5 km course around the Forest Opera in Sopot
Start and finish in the parking lot by the Forest Opera
The race takes place in picturesque parkland and green spaces
additional: The participant limit is 250. Only runners wearing race bibs and people performing organizational duties may be on the course. Runners line up at the start in the designated area. The finish is at the same location as the start. The event includes several editions, with the main race taking place on September 19, 2026; discounts are available to Sopot residents with a Karta Sopocka card; the courses include beach and park areas; participants receive medals and drinks.
